dkar chagagleng gzhi/ (1)rtsom sgrig pa'i gtam/ (3)skabs dang po/ rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/ (1)sa bcad dang po/ gso rig lo rgyus/ (1)dang po/ gna' rabs gyi skor/ (1)gnyis pa/ deng rabs kyi skor/ (9)sa bcad gnyis pa/ rtsa rgyud/ (11)dang po/ rkyang 'dems/ (11)gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/ (14)gsum pa/ ming 'grel/ (17)bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/ (19)lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/ (20)drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/ (25)bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/ (28)sa bcad gsum pa/ grub pa lus/ (29)dang po/ rkyang 'dems/ (29)gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/ (32)gsum pa/ ming 'grel/ (35)bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/ (38)lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/ (39)drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/ (50)1

gleng gzhi/bod zal mo sgang pa zhes 'dzam gling gi sgal steng du chags pa'i mi rigs 'di'i gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi rig pa ste tshe yi rig byed nyid la rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu mthong chen dang mtshar snang / 'dri rtsad dang gdeng 'jog slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug tha na nad thog lag len dang sman rigs gsar spel bcas sgo kun nas bgyid bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ chol kha gsum du grags pa'i bod rigs sa khul yongs su'ang ji skad du/ yig sna 'bru bsgrags kyi sman pa/ rgya ba phyogs bltas kyi sman pa/ shog bu mtshams phyed kyi sman pa/ nad pa rgan goms kyi sman pa ste gso rig zin tig tsam mthong thos dang skya rengs gsar ba lta bu 'don klog gis rang sbyong las thon pa'i bod lugs em ji'ang kha sang las de ring mang du mthong ba kun gyis rig rig go /de lta bu'i gnas tshul 'og rgyal khab kyis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho ltar bod lugs sman pa rnams kyi sman bcos chu tshad nyid gcig gyur can dang tshad ldan can du gtong slad/ bod lugs gso rig gi mtho rim rang sbyong rgyugs gzhi dang ched gnyer sman pa'i yig rgyugs te lag rtsal tshad 'jal rang bzhin gyi khrims srol gang mang nub rgyud gsar spel gyi 'gros dang mnyam du je mang nas je mang du spel bzhin pa la/ rgyugs yig gi rnam pa mngon pa'i dpyad gzhi tsam byung na'ang rang re'i las dang po ba rnams kyi ngor dus thog char ba'i tshul du 'gro bar gor ma chag gnas mchog tsong kha'i yul stod du 'khod pa'i mtsho sngon hong krung rdzong bod sman khang gi na gzhon sman pa dbang rgyal lags nas rtsom sgrig gnang ba'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i rang sbyong rgyugs gzhi ka ko la'i ljon bzang zhes pa 'di ni dngos su 'phrul par du btab pa'i bod lugs gso rig thad kyi rang sbyong rgyugs gzhi'i yig cha thog ma ste/1

deb 'dir dri ba dri lan dang bcas cung cha tshang ngang gcig tu bsdus pas spyi tshogs steng bod sman yig rgyugs sprod mkhan las dang po ba rnams kyis dpe mang 'tshol mi dgos zhing lta bde ba/ 'dri gzhi'i go rim deng gi rgyugs che ba'i yig srol ste rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/ rgyas 'grel bcas su bkod pas yig rgyugs mkhan gang gis sngon sbyong gnang sla ba/ dri lan rnams sgrig rtsom pa'i gang dran dran gyi blo bzo dang sgro bskur tsam ma yin par sngon byon mkhas pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa rnams la rgyab bcol yod pas yid ches kyi gdeng 'khel ba sogs khyad chos du mas brgyan 'dug 'on te bod kyi bsam blo ba chen mo rdo brag sprul skus/rgad po klu rgyal 'bum la don chung dang / /byi li bsod nams thar la don chen yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'gyur ba la'ang the tshom bral zhing gzhan du na deb 'di'i nang ma tshang chad pa bsab dgos pa dang / gong 'og 'khrugs pa sdeb dgos pa/ the tshom 'ching ba gcod dgos pa'i rigs sogs kyang 'phral la bltas pas kha shas snang byung bas rgya che'i klog pa po'i dgongs 'char dang lhan du thengs rjes mar bskyar dpar bgyid dus 'thus tshang je legs su gtong rgyu zhu zhes mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig tu mtsho sngon bod lugs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge ming 'dzin pa bya mdo klu byams rgyal gyis spyi lo2002zla4tshes15nyin shar tsong kha'i grong khyer zi ling nas bris pa dge /

rtsom sgrig pa'i gtam/bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i rang sbyong rgyugs gzhi ka ko la'i ljon bzang zhes pa 'di ni lo 'ga'i sngon rang nyid rgyal yongs bod lugs gso rig dar ma'i ched las kyi yig rgyugs la zhugs dus kyi bskyar sbyong zin tho'i rmang gzhi'i steng / bod ljongs sman rtsis khang nas spel ba'i gzhi rtsa gsum gyi rgyugs gzhi dang mtsho sngon bod sman slob grwa chen mos bton pa'i lo 'ga'i ring gi dar ma'i ched las rgyugs gzhi'i bzo stangs bcas la dpyad gzhi byas te bsgrigs pa yin la/ dmigs yul ni rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ gzhan don bsam pa'ang bdag la yod min te/ /rang gi yid la goms phyir ngas 'di brtsams/ /zhes pa ltar gtso bo rang nyid kyi sbyangs goms la gzhigs pa dang / gzhan du rang sbyong yig cha 'di lta bu zhig mchis pas dar ma'i yig rgyugs sprod par che chung la ma bltos pa'i ram 'degs kyi nus pa thon pa ni rang myong lag zin yin pas rang mnyam las dang po ba rnams la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi phan nus tsam 'byung bar gdon mi za snyam/ /deb 'di bsgrigs pa'i thad du deng gi rgyugs che ba'i yig srol la gzhi bcol te rkyang 'dems dang / mang 'dems/ ming 'grel/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/ dri lan 'debs pa/ rgyas 'grel bcas rnam grangs drug gi sgo nas bstan yod pa dang /de'ang rkyang 'dems zhes pa ni 'dri tshig gdams gzhi las yang dag pa'i dri lan gcig kho na nyid 'dem gses byas te gor rtags su de mtshon gyi gsal bshad yi ge 'god pa la zer ba dang / mang 'dems zhes pa ni 'dri tshig gdams gzhi las dri lan gnyis yan chad 'dems gses byas te 'god pa/ ming 'grel zhes pa ming tshig gam brda chad gang la mang nyung ran pa'i tshig 'grel rgyag pa/ dag pa ngos 'dzin zhes 3

pa ni 'dri tshig tu bkod pa'i bshad tshul gang zhig 'grig min thag gcod byas te gor rtags su rtags‘‘sa(’’dang yang na‘‘྾’’'god pa/ dri lan 'debs pa zhes pa ni 'dri tshig gang la bsam gzhigs byas te cung rgyas pa'i sgo nas 'grel lan yang dag spel ba/ rgyas 'grel zhes pa rgyud kyi rtsa tshig gam dri gzhi gang la rgyas pa'i sgo nas don 'grel spel ba la brjod do/ /spyir na rang nyid ni skyes sbyangs zung gi shes yon ha cang zhan pa dang lhag par du gso ba rig pa'i gzhung dang rjod byed sogs kyi thad la sbyangs pa'am go ba shin tu dman pas/ rang sbyong rgyugs gzhi 'di'i nang du nor 'chug nongs 'gal gyi cha mang du 'byung srid pas na dpyod ldan blo gros can rnams kyis skyon brjod dang dag bcos yo bsrang yod pa mkhyen mkhyen zhu/ mjug mthar kho bo'i deb 'di la rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gyi mtsho sngon bod sman slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan spyi dang sgos su gso rig gzhung lugs smra ba'i grogs mchog dam pa bya mdo klu byams rgyal lags kyis mdzub ston dang zhu dag de bzhin mdzad brel che ba'i phyag las khrod dpe deb kyi gling gzhi spel gnang mdzad pa bcas la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu'o//

skabs dang po/ rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs/sa bcad dang po/ gso rig lo rgyus/dang po/ gna' rabs kyi skor/1 zhang bod gso rig gi bstan bcos thog ma mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ spyi lo sngon gyi lo tshigs1917lor zhang zhung spu hreng sa char 'khrungs pa'i yab bon ston gshen rab mi bo che dang yum hos bza' rgyal med gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams pa'i drang srong dpyad bu khri shes zhu ba yin no/ /2bod kyi btsan po rnams la ched gnyer kyi bla sman bsko ba'i lugs srol ji ltar byung ba yin nam/lan/ spyi lo dus rabs bzhi ba'i nang 'phags yul gyi sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang / lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sras mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs pa'i sman pa dung gi thor cog can zhu ba des chung dus nas rang gi yab las reg pa rtsa'i mdo/ 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ sbyor ba sman gyi mdo/ gtar bsreg dpyad kyi mdo/ rma chas bzo yi mdo bcas dang / de dag gi 'grel bshad khog 'bugs/ sa bcad/ lag len sogs gsan te mkhas par gyur/ rgyal po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dang / de'i sras khri gnyan bzung btsan gnyis kyi bla sman mdzad/'di nyid ni bod yul gyi ched gnyer sman pa'i thog ma yin pa dang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon po yang gdung rus 'di las 'phros par grags/ dung gi thor cog can gyi sras blo gros chen po/ de'i sras blo gros mtshungs med/ de'i sras blo gros rab gsal/de'i sras blo gros rgyal mdzod/ de'i sras blo gros bshes gnyen bcas byung bas de 1

rnams kyis rim bzhin bod kyi rgyal po 'brong gnyan lde'u dang / stag ri gnyan gzigs/ gnam ri srong btsan/ srong btsan sgam po bcas kyi bla sman mdzad/3chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan nam tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i thog mar sprul pa'i sras gsum du grags pa de dag su dang su yin nam/lan/ rgya gar gyi sman pa dharma rā dza dang / rgya nag gi sman pa ha shang mahā kyin da dang / tsan pa shi li ha bcas la sprul pa'i sras gsum du grags so/ /4bi ma la mi tra zhes pa bod skad du bsgyur na mtshan gang yin/ khong chos rgyal gang gi sku dus su bod du byon pa yin nam/lan/ bi ma la mi tra zhes pa bod skad du bsgyur na dri med bshes gnyen zer zhing / dus rabs brgyad par chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su bod du byon pa yin/5 bod sman mkhas pa mi dgur so so'i lugs gang dang gang byung yod dam/lan/ bi byi'i lugs la bi byi'i po ti kha ser/ 'ug pa'i lugs la lag len gsal sgron/ cher rje'i lugs la cher rje'i zin tig brang ti'i lugs la gdams ngag gser bre dang dngul bre/ mi nyag lugs la rdo sbyor chen mo/ g.yu thog lugs la g.yu thog bu don nyams yig khrid yig rgyud kyi cha lag bco brgyad/ gnya' pa'i lugs la 'grel ba dri med 'od zer 'phros pa dbang gi rgyal po/ stod sman gyi lugs la stod 'grel gzi 'od 'bar ba/ mtha' bzhi'i lugs la bstan bcos lam gyi sgron me rnams byung yod do/ /6rgyud bzhi 'di nyid 'dod lha'i zhag gsum gyi ring gter du sbas zhes gsungs par mi lo brtsi na lo ngo ga tshod ring gter du sbas pa yin nam/lan/ 'dod lha'i zhag rer mi lo lnga bcu re brtsi bas rgyud bzhi 'di nyid mi lo brgya dang lnga bcu'i ring gter du sbas pa yin/7g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i sras kyi thu bor gyur pa'i slob ma su yin/ de'i slob ma'i gtso bor gyur pa de su yin nam/lan/ g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i sras kyi thu bor gyur pa'i slob 2

ma ni sum ston ye shes gzungs yin pa dang / sum ston ye shes gzungs kyi slob ma'i gtso bo ni gzhon nu ye shes red/ 8byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang gi gso rig gi slob ma dang bla sman zung du 'brel ba de su yin nam/lan/ slob ma dang bla sman zung du 'brel ba de de mi yi nyi ma mthong ba don ldan nam byams pa dkon mchog rin chen yin/9zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i gso rig gi slob dpon su yin/lan/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i gso rig yi/ slob dpon ni mtsho smad mkhan chen gyi slob ma glang bu chos rje zhu ba de yin/10 dpon tshang ye shes zhes pa de mkhas dbang su'i slob ma yin/ khong gis gso rig skor la bstan bcos gang brtsams pa red/ lan/ dpon tshang ye shes ni 'bri gung tshe dbang bstan pa'am dkon mchog 'gro phan dbang bo'i slob ma yin zhing / khong gis gadzoṭa rig skor la mo nad kyi bcos thabs lang tsho bde thang dang / rkang 'bam gyi bcos snyezabs myur mgyogs bgrod pa'i lam bzang / gces bsdus phan bde'i yang snying / dngul chu za 'chings kyi lag len gsang mdzod sbas pa'i lde mig sogs brtsams/11 yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa'i zari nga 'grel zhes pa de nyid lo tsā ba su dang sus bsgyur ba yin nam/lan/ rang 'grel de lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sku ring la paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī la dang /snye bo lo tsā ba dbyig gi rin chen/ mar lo rig pa'i gzhon nu/ dbyig gu dge slong shakyā blo gros rnams kyis bsgyur ba yin/12khog 'bugs 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i nyi ma zhes pa dus rabs gang la mkhas pa sus mdzad/lan/ de ni dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang byang ba bkra shis dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'phags yul dang bod du gso rig dar tshu95 dang / gso ba rig pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams byon tshul sogs 'khod ‘ pre'i sman gyi chos 'byung zhig 3

red/ khong ni byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang gi gso rig gi slob ma dang bla sman zung du 'brel ba mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don ldan nam byams pa dkon mchog rin chen gyi sras yin/13 zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje la gso rig gi slob ma mthar phyin bzhi yod pa de dag gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje la gso rig phyogs la mthar phyin gyi slob ma bzhi yod pa ni/ man ngag mthar phyin mi 'gyur tshe brtan dang / 'phrin las mthar phyin phrag dbon bsod nams bkra shis/ lag len mthar phyin tshe 'bum rdo rje/bshad pa mthar phyin li chung pad+ma skyabs dang bzhi'o/ /14 bod du dar snga shos kyi gso ba rig pa de gang yin nam/lan/ bod du thog mar dar ba'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs ni bon gyi gso rig yin/ de yang gnya' khri btsan po'i gong nas lha tho tho ri snyan shal bar du bod la bon lugs kyi gso rig dar khyab che ste/ de'i gtso bo ni dug sel gyi gnyen po/gtar bsreg byug gsum/ gso dpyad lugs la zas kyi tshod dang rma gsar ba la mar bzhus nas btang bas rtsa kha bsdams pa sogs yin no/ /15lo rgyus nang lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la bod du gso dpyad kyi dbu brnyes zer ba de yang ma nges te bon la brten pa'i gso dpyad ji snyed cig yod ces gsungs par yang snying bon la gso dpyad kyi sman gzhung gtso bo gang dang gang yod/lan/ bon la gso dpyad kyi sman gzhung gtso bo ni/ gso bya'i nad 'bum nag po dang / gso thabs kyi dpyad 'bum khra bo/ gso byed kyi sman 'bum dkar bo/rtsa ba thugs 'bum mkha' sngon te 'bum bzhi dang / dug bcos g.yung drung 'khyil ba/gso dpyad mdo dgu sogs dpyad rgyud nyis khri chig stong bcas yod /16bod du mgo rus gshags bcos kyi klad rus gsum rnyed pa der lo rgyus ga tshod yod dam/lan/ mtsho sngon lcang ra'i bang so'i tshogs las pho gzhon gnyis dang rgan pa gcig ste klad rus gsum rnyed par gna' rdzas rig pas brtag dpyad byas pa ltar na/4

da nas mi lo lnga stong yas mas ste rdo chas gsar ma'i dus skabs kyi gna' rdzas yin par ra sprod byung la/ des lo ngo lnga stong sngon du bod kyi gso rig gi sman dpyad chu tshad spyir btang tsam ma yin par klad rus gshags bcos byedzo da bzhin yod pa dngos su bden dpang btsan po thob bo /17 gso ba rig pa zhes pa gang dang gang la mkhas dgos sam/lan/ de ni rnam pa bzhir mkhas par bya ste/ nad la mkhas pa dang / nad ci las byung ba la mkhas pa/ nad byung ba bsal ba la zu 4khas pa/ nad bsal nas phyis mi 'byung bar bya ba la mkhas pa dang bzhi'o/ / 18g.yu rnying nyer lnga mkhas pa sus mdzad dam/ nyer lnga dang nyer bdun mchin nad tsha grang gang dang gang la gtong /lan/ g.yu rnying nyer lnga ni 'bri gung tshe dbang rngar+shastan pa'i slob dpon dpon tshang ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang / mchin nad tsha bar g.yu rnying nyer lnga sbyar/ /mchin nad grang bar g.yu rnying nyer bdun sbyar/ /zhes gsungatra / pa ltar ro/ /19rgya gar gyi gso ba rig pa nyid btsan po sus ring la bod du dar ba yin nam/lan/ yongs grags ltar na rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho tho ri mnyan btsan gyi sku dus su rgya gar sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang / bi dga' lha mdzes bya ba gnyis bod du phebs nas sman bcos gnang bas/ rgyal pope ṭa rang gi sras mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha sman pa bi byi dga' byed la btsun mor phul ba ‘ro sras dung gi thor cog can 'khrungs/ des sman pa gnyis kyi zhal nas sman dpyad kyi mdo bsam mi khyab pa sbyangs bas mkhas par gyur pa de nas rgya gar gyi gso ba rig pa nyid bod du dar bar zhes grags so/ /20 man ngag lhan thabs rtsom pa po su yin/ 5sdob byung dang spyi lo ga dus yin/lan/ man ngag lhan thabs ni sde srid sangs / spres rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags lug ste spyi lo1691lor brtsams nga/'o/ /21sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs yul gang dang 'khrungs dus nam yin 5

nam/lan/ lha sa'i byang phyogs nyang bran grong smad du rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul ste spyi lo1653lor 'khrungs/22zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i 'khrungs yul dang 'khrungs lo nam yin nam/lan/ zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje mchog shar dwags po'i sa cha la thog zur mkhar zhes par rab byung bdun pa'i sa lug ste spyi lo1439lor 'khrungs/23 byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang gi 'khrungs yul dang 'khrungs lo nam yin nam/lan/ byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang gi 'khrungs yul ngam ring yin pa dang /rab byung bdun pa'i shing phag ste spyi lo1395lor 'khrungs/24sman sbyor mu tig bdun bcu'i byung tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mu tig bdun bcu'i thog ma'i rmang gzhi ni bod sman mkhas pa g.yu thog pas brtsams gnang ba'i sman gzhung gtso bo man rgyud rtsa dkar gso ba'i nang nya phyis gtso bo byas pa'i nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba zhes pa de yin par/ gso rig 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i dus rabs 11pa'i nang phyag sman mkhas pas nya phyis tshab mu tig gtso bo byas pa dang / da dung shing mngar bsnan pa'i bsam 'phel sbyor ba zhes sman sna nyer drug yod pa zhig bzos pa de'i steng dus rabs bco lnga ba'i nang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rjes gso rig rgya mtsho'i dgongs don snying bo bsdus pa'i gtso bo btso thal dang / gzi'i rigs/ byu ru/ gser dngul thal pa sogs sman sna bzhi cu lhag tsam kha bsnan ste sman sna bdun cu bar 'phel rgyas btang ba red/ de rjes mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog nas kha skong snon 'phri dang phan nus phyogs sgrig gnang yod pa de rnams da lta bed spyod gnang bzhin pa red/25 'bum chung gsal sgron gyi mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ 'bum chung gsal sgron ni sum ston ye shes gzungs kyis mdzad/26 lhan thabs lde mig mdzad mkhan su yin nam/lan/ lhan thabs lde mig rtsom mkhan ni sde srid rin po che'i dngos slob ngag 6

dbang sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhes pa de yin/27 dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo mdzad pa dzetsho/ su yin nam/lan/ ston pa shākya thub pas mdzad pa'i bkaljori yin no/ /28 sbyor ba brgya dang rtsa a wa'i cho ga'i mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ rgya gar rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi ya gya95 slob dpon klu sgrub mchog yin no/ /29 yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa zhes pa de sus brtsams pa yin nam/lan/ slob dpon dpa' bo'am pha khol gyis myo/dzad pa yin/30 yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel ba zla zer mngu(da pa po su yin nam/lan/ kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mngon dga' ying ni/31 sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po zhes pa'i gzhung de'i mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ mkhas mang bgros pas so ma rā dzā byung zhes pa ltar bod dang rgya dkar nag gyi mkhas pa mang po'i blo gros kyi rtsal las byung b.rāre thun mong gi brtsams chos shig ste da bzhugs bod gso rig gi bstan bcos snga shos nge/ yin no/ /32 bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba 'bum nag gsal sgron gyi mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ g.yu thog pa'i thugs sras sum ston ye shes gzungs yin/33 dngul chu btso bkru chen mo'i zhal gdams sus mdzad/lan/ grub chen o rgyan rin chen dpal gyis dzo mdzad do/ /34bshad rgyud kyi 'grel ba bdud rtsi'i chu rgyumyo/ dang phyi ma rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rtsom pa po su yon nam/lan/ gso rig smra ba'i lugs chen gnyis kyi ya gyal byang lugs kyi shing rta chen po byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang yin/35 man ngag bye ba ring bsrel gyi mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ gso rig smra ba'i lugs chen gnyis kyi / ya gyal zur lugs srol btod pa po zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje yin/36 rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel ba legs bshad smra ba mchog thob dang / bshad rgyud kyi 7

'grel ba tshig don nyi ma/ man ngag rgyud kyi 'grel ba rnam bshad bde ba'i 'dod 'jo/phyi ma rgyud kyi 'grel ba lag len gsal byed bcas rgyud bzhi'i rnam bshad kyi mdzad pa po su yin nam/len/ skyems pa tshe 'bum rdo rje'i dngos slob skyems pa tshe dbang mchog ste rgyud 'grel grags can skyems 'grel zhes pa de'o/ /37 rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba mes po'i zhal lung gi rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud/ de bzhin phyi ma rgyud kyi chu mdo'i yan chad zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos mdzad pa dang / man ngag rgyud dang phyi rgyud chu mdo'i man chad ni dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis mdzad pa yin no/ /38 lus thig zla ba nor bu'i me long gi rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ bod mkhas pa dge legs rnam rgyal lo/ /39 rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba be+eḍūr sngon po'i mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ rgyal dbang lnga ba mchog gi thugs sras lha sa nyang bran sde bar 'khrungs pa'i sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lags so/ /40mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sman pa grwa tshang phyag 'debs pa po su yin nam/lan/ lcags po ri'i sman pa mkhas pa gtsang sman ye shes bzang pos dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang phyag 'dzugs gnang ba yin/41 mdo smad rje sku 'bum byams pa gling gi sman pa grwa tshang phyag 'debs pa po su yin nam/lan/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa'i yongs 'dzin kyi 'gan bzhes myong ba'i mkhas dbang chen po chu bzang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhu ba des rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags yos ste spyi lo1711lor phyag btab pa yin/42 mdo smad bya khyung dgon du sman pa grwa tshang thog mar phyag 'debs pa po su yin nam/lan/ zi na ngag dbang tshul khrims dar rgyas zhu ba des rab byung bcu gsum 8

pa'i me sbrul ste spyi lo1797lor gsar 'dzugs gnang /43 rgyud bzhi'i brda bkrol rnam rgyal a ru'i macesdos rgyan gyi mdzad pa po su yin/lan/ sog po lung rigs bstan dar yin/44gces bsdus phan bde bang mdzod kyi mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsho'o/ /45bod kyi gso rig gling du skad grags yod paḍirno shel gong phreng zhes pa'i bstan bcos kyi rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing sbrul lor sku 'khrungs pa'i de'u dmar dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs mchog gis lo du zu pu'i ring rgya gar nag dang /rang rgyal gyi yun nan/ zi khron/ bod khams mang che ba bcas la sku dngos su phebs te 'dri rtsad brtag dpyad gang mang gnang ste brtsams pa'o/ /46 byis pa btsa' thabs kun phan zla ba'i me tshe/nga zhes pa'i bstan bcos de'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ lha ldan sman rtsis khang gi yon krang dang 1 tho mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu mchog yin no/ /47nye rabs bod kyi gso rig lo rgyus su mig 'byed gshags bcos kyi bod sman mkhas pa zhig byung ba de su yin nam/lan/ lha ldan sman rtsis khang gi bud med sman pa mkhas can dbyangs can lha mo zhu ba de yin/ de spyi lo1907lor sku 'khrungs/ /gnyis pa/ deng rabs kyi skor/48 mkhas dbang byams pa 'phrin las kyis brtsams pa'i bod kyi gso rig gi mi sna'i lo rgyus rgyas pa de'i mtshan la ga re gsol bzhiskyakyi yod dam/lan/ gangs ljongs gso rig bstan pa'i nyin byed rim byon gyi rnam thar 9

phyogs bsgrigs zhu ba yin/49sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba bai sngon gyi tshun du byung ba'i gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba ste nang don ches rgyas shol dang kha gsal shol gyi gzhung de'i mtshan dang mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ gzhung de'i mtshan la gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen drang srong zhal lung byung zhing mdzad pa po ni gnas lnga'i dbang phyug khro ru tshe rnam mchog go /50 bod kyi gso rig las rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ngo bo bdag nyid gcig tu 'brel ba'i skor la dpyad rnga/ zhes pa'i ched rtsom de'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ snyigs dus kyi gso rig smra ba'i dbang bo khro ru tshe rnam mchog yin no/ /51bod lugs kyi nad thog lag len thad nye bar mkho ba'i gso rig snying bsdus skya rengs gsar ba zhes pa'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ bod ljongs lcags ri gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo ba bsam gtan yin/52 krung go'i gso rig kun 'dus las bod kyi gso ba rig pa zhes pa'i bstan bcos de'i mdzad pa po su yin nam/lan/ lcags ri dge rgan thub bstan phun tshogs dang byams pa 'phrin las gnyis kyis rtsom sgrig gtso gzhon kyi 'gan so sor bzhes pa'i gso rig kun 'dus kyi rtsom sgrig tshogs pas mdzad/53 bod gangs can pa'i gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi sogs kyi brda dang dka' gnad 'ga' zhig bgrol ba sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun g.yu thog dgongs rgyan zhes pa'i tshig mdzod de sus brtsams pa yin nam/lan/ bod ljongs lcags ri gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan dbang 'dus kyis dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i dus 'gor brtsams/54sman gnyer mkhas dbang karma chos 'phel kyis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i sman rdzas kyi bstan bcos rgyas pa de'i mtshan la ga re gsol bzhin yod dam/lan/ bdud rtsi sman gyi 'khrungs dpe legs bshad nor bu'i phreng mdzes zhes 10

gsol to/ /55 'khrungs dpe dri med shel gyi me long zhes nga/'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ bod ljongs chab mdo sman rtsis khang gi sman pa 'bum rams pa dga' ba'i rdo rje zhu ba de'o/ /56 bod kyi gso rig lo rgyus steng gi sems khams rig pa'i ched rtsom thog ma ste bod lugs gso rig gi sems khams rig pa dus rngori bas khye'u gsar bu'i rang mdangs zhes pa'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ mtsho sngon bod lugs gso rig slob grwa dzo tshen mo'i dge rgan bya mdo klu byams rgyal yin/57bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus gsal bar ston pa baiḍūr sngon po'i zhun thig zhes pa'i rtsom pa po su yin nam/lan/ kan su'u krung lugs gso rig slob grwa chen mo'i bod sman sde khag gi dge rgan skal bzang 'phrin las yin/sa bcad gnyis pa/ rtsa rgyud/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 rtsa ba sman pas gso bya'i yul/ ( )ka gnas bcu gcig kha skabs bco lnga/ ga mdo bzhi/nga yan lag brgyad/2 gso ba rig pa'i dpal ldan rgyud bzhi yongs la ba sdoms le'u/( )ka brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug kha brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun gdagu cu rtsa gnyis/ nga brgya dang lnga bcu nga bzhi/3 gnas bcu gcig ni ( ) kyi rjod byed 6pen/ka man ngag rgyud/ kha bshad rgyud/ ga phyi ma rgyud/ nga11

rtsa rgyud/4nad rnams skyed pa'i nye rgyu/( )ka nyes gsum/ kha ma rig pa/ ga dug gsum/ nganyon mongs/5 nyes gsum las rlung gnas ni/ ( )ka stod klad pa/ kha smad dpyi rked/ ga bar mchin mkhris/nga smad rgyu long / 6 nyes pa gsum las rlung gi rgyu lam/ ( )ka rjul/ kha khrag ga reg bya/ nga gcin/7 ngos 'dzin rtags kyi rtsa ba la sdong bo/ ( )ka gnyis/ kha bzhi/ ga gsum/ nga bdun/8 sman pa'i brtag thabs las reg bya'i yul gtso bo/ ( )ka lus kyi tsha grang / kha sra snyi/ ga lag pa'i mkhrig rtsa/ ngartsub mnyen/9 bad kan nad kyi rtsa rgyud ni/ ( )ka bying rgud dal/ kha bying la grims/ ga dal la rgyas/ ngaskabs su sdod/10 bad kan nad kyi gnyen po/ ( )ka dal bar sdod pa/ kha dro sa bsten pa/ ga rtsol ba bcag pa/nga gnyid ldog pa/11 rnam par gyur pa nad kyi sdong bor lo 'dab/ ( )ka bdun/ kha drug cu rtsa gsum/ ga nyer lnga/ nga bco lnga/12 mngar skyur lan tshwa'i ro yis ( ) nad 'joms/ka rlung nad/ kha mkhris nad/ ga bad kan gyi nad/ ngatsha ba'i nad/13 rnam par ma gyur pa'i skabs kyi rlung ni ( ) brjod/12

ka mtshan nyid dang ngo bo'i sgo nas grang bar/ kha ngo bo tsha bar/ga tsha grang zung du/ nga tsha grang gang yang ma yin par/14rno rtsub yang ba'i nus pas ( ) nad sel/ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga bad kan/ nga tsha ba/15 srin dang chu ser gnyis ka ( ) gnas/ka tsha bar kho nar/ kha pho ba kho nar/ ga tsha grang gnyis kar/nga grang ba kho nar/16 reg pa rtsa la spyi don ( ) gyis mdor ba stan/ka gsum/ kha bdun/ ga bcu gsum/ nga bcu bdun/17 mngar kha bska ba'i ro yis ( ) nad 'artsesdoms/ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga bad kan/ nga tsha ba/18 rgyud bzhi zhu pa po gang las sprul/ ( )ka sku/ kha gsung / ga thugs/ nga yon tan/19 rgyu 'dod chags dang rjes su mthun pa'i rlung gnas/( )ka lte ba man chad/ kha lte ba yan nas snying ka ga lus stod/nga yon tan/20 skabs bco lngas le'u rdzogs par ston pa ni/ ( )ka rtsa rgyud/ kha bshad rgyud/ ga man ngag rgyud/ nga phyi ma rgyud/21 yang rtsub g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni/ ( )ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga bad kan/ nga grang ba/22 gnas lugs nad gzhi las gso bya'i nad la/ ( )ka zhe brgyad/ kha nga brgyad/ ga zedro gsum/ nga gya brgyad/23 mkhris pa'i rgyu lam ste dri ma gsum las( )rgyu/ka reg bya/ kha rngul/ ga bshang ba/ nga gcin/13

24sbyong byed 'jam rtsi las rlung rkyang bar/ ( )ka 'jam rtsi/ kha bkru 'jam/ ga sle 'jam/ nga bkru ma slen/25 rlung gi nad can gyi lce ni/ ( )ka dmar la brlan zhing rtsub/ kha 'byar bag skya ser/ ga skya gleg mdangs med/ nga dmar zhing skam la rtsub pa/26 dri ba'i yal ga las mkhris nad goms pa'i lo ma ni/ ( )ka snum bcud/ kha zas spyod bsil/ ga zas spyod dro ba/nga rno bcud/27 sro.a/ la rgol ba dal zhing sman dpyad kyi nus pa myur du mi 'byung ba/ ( )ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga bad kan/ nga khrag28 lus zungs kyi ches mtha' ma ni/ ( )ka khrag kha rkang / ga mdangs/ nga rlung /29 gnas lugs nad gzhi rnams grangs lo ma du( )yod/7/ so brgyad/ kha go brgyad/ ga gya brgyad/ nga nga brgyad/30 ri dwags sha nyes gsum las gang la phan/ ( )ka bad kan/ kha/ mkhris ba/ ga bad rlung / nga tsha grang thun mong / gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 pho ba'i me drod rnam gsum ni/ ( )ka rlung me mnyam/ kha bad kan myag byed/ ga mkhris pa mdangs sgyur/ nga mkhris pa 'ju byed/2 rtsa rgyud mdo don rtsa ba lta bu ni/ ( )ka gnas lugs nad gzhi'i rtsa ba/ kha ngos 'dzin rtags kyi rtsa ba/14

ga bya byed sman pa'i rtsa ba/ nga gso drek+tod thabs kyi rtsa ba/3 nad 'phel zad 'khrugs gsucha/ gyi rkyen bzhi ni/ ( )ka dus gdon/ kha dus dpyad/ ga zas spyod/ ngasman dpyad/4nad kyi rgyu lam las mkhris nga/ ni/( )ka mchin mkhris/ kha glo snying / ga khrag rngul/ nga sha cigal/5 bad kan nad ldang dus ni/( )ka dpyid dus/ kha dbyar dus/ ga srod dang snga dro/ ngadagong da nga tho rengs 6mig gi blta ba gtso bo/ ( )ka mdog kha lce/ ga mdangs/ nga chu/7rlung gi lce ni/( )ka dmar/ kha skam/ ga skya gleg nga rtsub pa/8 mkhris nad zhi bar byed pa'i gnyen po/ ( )ka khu ba/ kha thang / ga cur nis/ nga sman mar/9 rus bcud gsum ni/ ( )ka sre long / kha mgo rus/ ga sog yu/ nga gzhug to/10 bad kan rgyu ba'i lam ni/ ( )ka lus zungs bdun las khrag dang rus pa/ kha dri ma gsum las bshang gci/ ga dbang bo lnga las sna lce/ nga don lnga las glo ba mtsher ba mkhal ma/11 mkhris pa rgyu ba'i lam ni/ ( )ka lus zungs bdun las rus pa/ kha dri ma gsum las rngul/ gdabang bo lnga las mig/ nga don lnga las snying / ca snod drug las mkhris pa/15

12 yan lag brgyad las nad med kyi dbang du byas pa ni/( )ka byis pa/ kha rgas pa/ ga ro tsa ba/ nga lus/ca mo nad/13 nad med rgyun ldan gyi mi'i lce ni/ ( )ka 'jam pa/ kha mnyen pa/ ga rlon shas can/ ngadamar mdangs can/ ca skya bo/14bcud bzhi ni/ ( )ka sha kha bu ram/ ga mar/ nga chang rnying /ca tshil/15 sman gyi sdong bo las lo ma bzhi re yod pa'i yal ga( )ka sman mar/ kha thang / ga cur nis/ nga ril bu/ca bshal/16dri ba'i sdong bo'i( )gyi yal ga lo ma bcu gcig re yod/ka rlung nad/ kha mkhris nad/ ga bad kan/ nga ldan pa/ca 'dus nad/17 gsham du bkod pa'i dag las nad kyi ming ni/( )ka rims/ kha gnod byed/ ga ma zhu'i skyon/ nga za byed/ ca sdig pa/18 yal ga gsum re yod pa'i sdong bo/( )ka rnam par ma gyur lus kyi sdong bo/ kha reg pa'i sdong bo/ ga dri ba'i sdong bo/ nga spyod lam gyi sdong bo/ ca dpyad kyi sdong bo/19 mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur/( )ka rno ba/ kha yang ba/ ga 'khru ba/ nga brtan pa/ca 'jam pa/20 rtsa rgyud la grub pa'i 'bras bu gsum ni/( )ka tshe ring / kha chos/ ga nad med/ nga bde ba/16

ca nor/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/bdud rtsi/ bdud ni na tsha dang rtsi ni 'joms byed kyi sman/bcom ldan 'das/ bdud bzhi bcom zhing legs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan pa/ srid zhi ba/nyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan no//de bzhin gshegs pa/ sangs rgyas te thub pa rma mas ji ltar byon pa de bzhin du gshegs pas so/ /dgra bcom pa/ bdud bzhi'i dgra thamape5 cad btul ba'am thul bar byas pa'o/ /drang srong / lus ngag yid gsum g.yo ba med par drang po'i phyogs su srong ba/gzhal yas khang / rgyu dang rgya khyon sogs kyi tshad dang yon tan 'jal mi nus pa'i lha'i khang bzang /ma la ya/ dri ldan te sman gyi grong /gh+rir lta na sdug gi nub phyogs na yod pa'i ri bo'i ming /sha chen/ mi nad med glo bur du paṃsgo ba'i sha'i gab ming /bur chang / gro nas gze ma rnams cha mnyam bsres la btsos te mnan nas langs pahāre glum la bu ram gyi chus bsrings pa'i chang gi ming /skom sha g.yag glang 'dus pa la sa skyes pa'i bu rtol zer ba de'i sha'o/ /chag tshe/ btus nas lo ma lon pa'i nas brdung ba'i tshod ma'am thug pa/17

lus zungs/ kha zas kyi dwangs ma sogs lus 'dzin par byed pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma bdun gyi ming ngo / /ting nge 'dzin/ bya ba'i yul de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pa'i ming /blo rmongs/ rang yul snang ba'i rig pa rmongs pas blang dor mi shes pa la'o /'bigs byed/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'bigs par byed pa ste rgya gar gyi ri bo zhig gi ming /gnad du babs pa/ snying dang klad pa lta bu gnyan pa'i gnad kyi gnas su mtshon phog nas bcos dka' bar 'gyur ba'i don/chu 'dra/ dri chu'i kha dog sngo la sla ba lu ma'i nang du 'khyil ba'i chu dang 'dra ba'o/ /'du ba gshed du babs pa/ nad tsha grang gnyis ka dus gcig tu 'doms pas gnyen pos mi len pa ste 'du ba gshed du babs pa'o/ /rtsol bcag bad kan gyi nad can la rtsol bas bcag cing 'gul spyod byed pa/cur nis/ legs sbyar gyi skad dod las byung ba'i sman phye ma'i ming ngo / /gnyen po/ log phyogs 'joms par byed pa'i stobs kyi don/g.yal/ don med du kha gdangs nas skad 'byin pa/zan chang / chang ltar bsnyal ba'i don/chab tsha/ tsha sdor med pa'i phye rtsam gyi thug pa sla mo/grang ba gting 'khar ba/ grang ba'i nad gting du byings pa'am rgyas pa/sbyor ba mtshungs/ nad tsha grang kun la'ang zas spyod sman dpyad chos mtshungs par bsten pa/gleg lce mthug po'am mdangs nyams shing ro mi gsal ba/rnam par 'tshe ba/ 'byung ba'i gdon ma rungs pas rnam par 'tshe bas bla 18

tshe phrogs pa/mgo khrol/ lug thong tsher gang rung gi mgo rus rul sungs su ma gyur pa'i rnying ba/zhi byed/ nyes pa rang gnas su 9dijog pa'i sman la zhi byed/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1nyes gsu ma lus kyi stod smad phyi nang kun tu /gyab kyang gtso che ba'i dbang gis gnas nges so/ /( )2 g.yal stong mang du byed cing lus 'dar ba/ bya rmyang yang yang byed pa/ grang shum rgyag pa sogs ni rlung nad kyi na lugs yin/( )3 mtshan nyid kyi zur rno bas tsha ba smin sla zhing / skrangs ba rnag sla ba/ nad 'phel 'grib skyen pas srog la rgol ba myur/( )4nad gang rkyen gang gis slong ba dang / na 'u/gas gang ltar na ba/ zas spyod gang bsten pas phan gnod sogs dri ba'i lan brjod pa las brtag pa ni thos pa sgra rig gi brtag tshul lo/ /( )5 ang ga zhes pa bdud rtsi la go /( )6 lce skam la rid pa ni tsha ba byer zhing rnyogs pa'i rtags yin/ ( )7 tha mal nad med kyi rtsa'i 'phar grangs ni nad pa'i phyi nang dbugs la lan lnga 'phar/ ( )8 a ru ra zhes pa'i sman thams cad kyi rgyal bo 'di shar phyogs kyi ri bo 'khrungs/( )9 rlung tsha grang 'jug zer ba ni mchan nyid la rnga|gongs pa yin/ ( )10 hor gyi me btsa' ni bad kan gyi nad lci baḍirno rigs la bsngags/ ( )19

lnga pa/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 rgyud bzhi zhes pa'i rgyud 'di la yon tan gyi khyad par gang dag yod/lan/ 'di ni sngags med pa yi srung sku yin/ /'chi bdag bdud sde 'joms pa'i 'phrul 'khor yin/ /nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin/ /'du ba 'phel zad snyoms pa'i spyi ba yin/ /dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri yin/ /nad kyi zug gzer gcog pa'i tho ba yin/ /sdug bsngal 'dam nas 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin/ /'chi ba'i srog skyob mi 'jigs sbyin pa yin/ /'chi ba slong byed bdud rtsi bum pa yin/ /2dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dum bu dang por ci'i phyir rtsa rgyud ces ming gis btags/lan/ dpal ldan gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi ga'i don gyi gnad 'dus shing sa bon lta bu rtsa bar gyur pa'i phyir ste/ phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud las/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud 'di sa bon 'dra/ /'di las ma skyes gso dpyad yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /3dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dum bu gnyis par ci'i phyir bshad rgyud ces ming gis btags/lan/ dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i gzhung lugs kyi don thams cad bshad pa'i steng nas mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar gtan la 'bebs nus pa'i phyir te/phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud las/ sku yi bshad rgyud bar snang nyi zla 'dra/ /tshig don ma lus sgrib med gsal bar ston/ /zhes gsungs so/ /4dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dum bu gsum par ci'i phyir man ngag rgyud ces ming gi btags/lan/ spyi bo'i gtsigs nas rkang mthil yan chad kyi nad mtha' dag lag mthil la skyu ru ra rlon pa bzhag pa bzhin rgyu rkyen rtags bcos sogs man ngag lag len kun ma 'dres par ston pa'i phyir te/ phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud las/ man ngag yon tan rgyud 'di nor bu 'dra/ /dgos pa ma tshang ba ni gcig kyang med/ /zhes 20

gsungs so/ /5dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i dum bu bzhi bar ci'i phyir phyi ma rgyud ces ming gis btags/lan/ gnyen po sman gyi sbyor thabs sogs lab/ len ji ltar byed tshul dang bcas pa'i nang don gsal bar ston cing gzhung gong ma gsum gyi phyi mar gyur pa'i phyir te/ phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud las/ phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud 'di pha lam 'dra/ /nad kyi steng du thogs pa yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /6 gso ba rig pa'i don kun bsdus na ji ltar ༈pen nam/lan/ gso bya gso byed ji ltar gso ba dang / /gso pa po dang rnam pa bzhi ru bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /7 gso bya yan lag brgyad ces pa gang dag yi na nam/lan/ yan lag brgyad ni rtsa rgyud las/ lu sa dang byis pa mo nad gdon/ /mtshon dug rgas dang ro tsa ba/ /yan lag brgyad du shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro /8 rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud bcas so sor sho lo ka ga tshod yod dam/lan/ rtsa rgyud la sho lo ka brgya dang nyi shu/ bshad rgyud la sho lo ka bdun brgya bdun cu don gsum dang phyed ka man ngag rgyud la sho lo ka stong phrag bzhi dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ phyi ma rgyud la sho lo ka chig stong chig brgya rngar+shacu bzhi ste rgyud bzhi yongs dril bas sho lo ka lnga stong dgu brgya sum cu so lnga dang phyed myo/chis so/ /9 gnas bcu gcig po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa ba mdo yi gnas dang gcig /grub pa las kyi gnas dang gnyis/ /'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas dang gsum/ /bya ba spyod lam gnas dang bzhi/ /'tsho ba zas kyi gnas dang lnga/ /sbyor ba sman gyi gnas dang dru ga /cha byad dpyad kyi gnas dang bdun/ /tha mal nad med gnas dang brgyad/ /ngos brngegrang rtags kyi gnas dang dgu/ /gso byed thabs kyi gnas dang bcu/ /bya byed sman pa'i gnas dang ni/ /bcu gcig 21

gnas su shes par bya/ /zhes pa'o/ /10 skabs bco lnga ji ltar yin nam/ lan/ dang po nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs/ /gnyis pa khong nad gso ba'i skabs/ /gsum pa tshad pa gso ba'i skabs/ /bzhi ba lus stod gso ba'i skabs/ /lnga ba don snod gso ba'i skabs/ /drug pa gsang nad gso ba'i skabs/ /bdun pa thor nad gso ba'i skabs/ /brgyad pa lhan skyes rma gso'i skabs/ /dgu ba byis pa gso ba'i skabs/ /bcu ba mo nad gso ba'i skabs/ /bcu gcig gdon nad gso ba'i skabs/ /bcu gnyis mtshon rma gso ba'i skabs/ /bcu gsum dug nad gso ba'i skabs/ /bcu bzhi rgas pa gso ba'i skabs/ /bco lnga ro tsa gso ba'i skabs/ /zhes pa'o/ /11 mdo bzhi bo ji ltar yin nam/lan/ brtag pa rtsa chu'i mdo dang gcig /zhi byed sman gyi mdo dang gnyis/ /sbyong byed las kyi mdo dang gsum/ /'jam rtsub dpyad kyi mdo dang bzhi/ /zhes pa'o/ /12 nad dam nyes pa'i rnam grangs bco lnga po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung la srog 'dzin dang / gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ me mnyam/ thur sel bcas lnga dang / mkhris par 'ju byed dang / mdangs sgyur/ sgrub byed/ mthong byed/mdog gsal bcas lnga/ bad kan la rten byed dang / myag byed/ myong byed/ tshim byed/ 'byor byed bcas lnga ste bsdoms rnam grangs bco lnga'o/ /13 lus zungs bdun po gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ zas skom kyi dwangs ma dang / de'i dwangs ma khrag de'i dwangs ma shade'i dwangs ma tshil/ de'i dwangs ma rus pa/ de'i dwangs ma rkang / de'i dwangs ma khu ba bcas so /14nad 'jug pa'i sgo drug po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ pags la gram zhing sha la rgyas pa dang / /rtsa ru rgyu zhing rus la zhen pa dang / /don la 'bab cing snod du lhung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /15 ldang dus dgu zer ba de gang dag yin nam/lan/ ldang dus dgu zer ba ni/ na sos ldang ba gsum/ yul gyi ldang ba 22

gsum/ dus kyi ldang ba gsum bcas dgu la'o/ /16 'bras bu srog gcod kyi nad dgu po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ 'tsho ba gsum zad 'du ba gshed du babs/ /sbyor ba mtshungs dang gnad du babs pa dang / /dus 'das rlung nad srog rten chad pa dang / /tsha ba la 'das grang ba gting 'khar ba/ /zungs kyis mi thub rnam par 'tshe ba rnams/ /'bras bu srog gcod nad dgu zhes su bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /17 nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa ba lta bu'i rgyu gcig ste ma rig pa dang / de las yan lag gi tshul du 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ 'bras bu'i tshul du rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung mkhris bad kan gsum yin no/ /18 nyes pa gsum gyi gnas sa gtso bo ni gang yin nam/lan/ bad kan ni rgyu gti mug dang rkyen klad par brten nas stod na shas cher gnas pa dang / mkhris pa ni rgyu zhe sdang dang rkyen srog rtsa nag po'am mchin mkhris la brten nas bar na shas cher gnas pa/ rlung ni rgyu 'dod chags dang rkyen gsang gnas sam dpyi dang rked par brten nas smad na shas cher gnas so/ /19 ldog rgyu bcu gnyis kyi grangs ji ltar brtsi rngapre yin nam/lan/ rlung nad bcos par rlung zhi nas mkhritra 4 par ldog pa dang bad kan du ldog pa/ rlung nad bcos kyang rlung ma zhi bar mkhris nga/ra ldog pa dang bad kan du ldog pa/ mkhris nad bcos par mkhris nad zhi nas rlung du ldog pa dang bad kan du ldog pa/ mkhris nad bcos kyang ma zhi bar rlung du ldog pa dang bad kan du ldog pa/ bad kan bcos par bad kan zhi nas rlung du ldog pa dang dzo 5khris par ldog pa/ bad kan bcos kyang bad kan ma zhi bar rlung du ldog pa dang myo/khris par ldog pa ste bcu gnyis so/ /20 chu tshan rigs lnga zer ba gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rdo sol dang cong zhi 'dres pa las byung ba'i chu tshan dang / rdo sol dang mu zi 'dres pa las byung ba'i chu tshan/ rdo sol dang dra/ga zhun 'dres pa las byung ba'i 23

chu tshan/ rdo sol dang cong zhi mu zi gsum 'dres pa las byung ba'i chu tshan/ rdo sol dang mu zi brag zhun ldong ros bzhi 'dres pa las byung pa'i chu tshan te lnga'o/ /21 brtag thabs sum cu rtsa brgyad po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ blta ba'i sgo nas brtag pa drug dang / reg pa'i sgo nas brtag pa gsum/ dri ba'i sgo nas brtag pa nyer dgu ste dril bas brtag thabs kyi rnam grangs sum cu rtsa brgyad yod do/ /22 blta ba lce la brtag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lce ni snying gi me tog lta bu yin la/ rlung khyab byed dang mkhris pa sgrub byed/ bad kan myong byed bcas kyi gnas kyang yin pas na lce la brtag pas gsal lo/ /23 me btsa' dang hor gyi me btsa' gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ hor gyi me btsa' ni go snyod dang phying ba snum ldan gyis drod dugs bya ba yin la/ me btsa' ni gsang dmigs sogs su spra ba'i me gdab pa'o/ /24'tsho ba gsum zhes pa gang yin nam/lan/ rang rang gi khams 'tsho ba'i rgyu tshe 'phen pa dang / sngon bsags kyi las/ bsod nams kyi mthu bcas gsum la'o/ /25 rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi rgyu lam gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ rlung ni lus zungs bdun gyi nang nas rus pa dang / dbang bo lnga las rna ba/ dri ma'am snyigs ma rnams kyi nang nas reg bya dang ba spu/ don lnga las snying dang srog rtsa/ snod drug las long ga bcas la rgyu ba dang / mkhris pa ni lus zungs bdun gyi nang nas khrag dang / dbang bo lnga las mig dri ma gsum las rngul/ don lnga las mchin pa/ snod drug las mkhris pa dang rgyu ma bcas la rgyu ba yin la/ bad kan ni lus zungs bdun gyi nang nas dwangs ma dang / sha tshil khu ba rnams dang /dbang bo las sna dang lce/ dri ma gsum las bshang ba dang gcin pa/ don lnga'i nang nas glo ba dang lgang ba bcas la rgyu'o/ /26 nad kyi zin tig drug cu rtsa gsum po gang yin nam/24

lan/ nad kyi rgyu gsum dang / rkyen bzhi/ ‘rajug sgo drug gnas gsum/rgyu lam bco lnga/ ldang dus dgu/ 'bras bu dgu/ sdi+og rgyu bcu gnyis/ mdo don gnyis bcas drug cu rtsa gsum yin no/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 gcig gsum gsum bzhi bzhi lnga drug pa gshā byeg /sdom gcig le'u sum cu rtsa gcig go /'grel/ bshad rgyud kyi le'u'i sdom tshig ste/ dang po rtsa ba mdo yi gnas la le'u gcig yod pa dang / gnyis pa grub pa lus kyi gnas la lus kyi chags tshul dang /'dra dpe/ ldang tshad kyi gnas lugs/ lus kyi ngo bo9ram mtshan nyid/ lus khams kyi las dang dbye ba/ lus khams 'jig pa'i ltas bcas le'u drug dang / gsum pa 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas la nad 'byung ba'i rgyu dang / slong ba'i rkyen/ nad kyi zhugs tshul/ nad kyi mtshan nyid/ nad kyi dbye ba rnga/cas le'u lnga dang / bzhi ba bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas la rgyun spyod dang / dus spyod/ gnas skabs kyi spyod lam bcas le'u gsum/ lnga ba 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la zas tshul dang / zas skom bsdams par bya ba/ zas tshod ran par bza' ba bcar le'u gsum/ drug pa sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la sman rdzas kyi ro dang / nus pa/ sbyar thabs spreprecas le'u go/sum/ bdun pa cha byad dpyad kyi gnas la gtsags bu sogs cha byad bzo bkod kyi le'u gcig brgyad pa tha mal nad med kyi gnas la mi na bar yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i thabs kyi le'u gcig dgu pa ngos bzung rtags kyi gnas la nyes pa dngos ston brtag pa dang /ngan pa'i g.yo rtsed ltar skyon gyi sgo nas brtag pa/ spang blang mu bzhi'i sgo nas brtag pa bcas le'u gsum/ bcu ba gso byed thabs kyi gnas la gso tshul spyir bstan pa dang / khyad par gyi gso tshul/ gso thabs gnyis sam brta bya dang smyung bya gnyis kyi gso tshul/ gso thabs dngos bcas le'u bzhi/ bcu kra/cig bya byed sman pa'i gnas la sman pa'i le'u gcig bcas dang / de ltar cha byad da pyad dang / tha mal nad med/25

bya byed sman pa'i gnas bcas gsum po le'u gcig gis gnas rdzogs par ston pa dang / bya ba spyod lam dang / 'tsho ba zas/ sbyor ba sman/ ngos bzung rtags kyi gnas bzhi bo le'u gsum gsum gyis gnas rdzogs par ston pa/ gso byed thabs kyi gnas gcig po le'u bzhis rdzogs par ston pa/ 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas gcig po le'u lngas rdzogs par ston pa/ grub pa lus kyi gnas gcig po le'u drug gis rdzogs par ston pa/ de dag gi don thams cad gnad bsdus kyi sgo nas sdom tshigs su bkod nas le'u gcig bcas bsdoms pas le'u sum cu rtsa gcig go/ zhes pa'o/ /2 lus la bdun cu byis pa mo nad dang / /dug gsum gdon lnga rma lnga bcud len gcig /ro tsa la gnyis rgyud gsum spyi khyab yin/ /'grel/ gso bya'i yan lag brgyad de/ man ngag rgyud du brten pa nad kyi ming rten lus kyi tha snyad du byas pa de la le'u bdun cu dang/ de bzhin byis pa la le'u gsum/ mo nad la le'u gsum/ dug nad la le'u gsum/ gdon nad la le'u lnga/mtshon rma la le'u lnga/ rgas gso bcud len la le'u gcig ro tsa la le'u gnyis bcas yod pa dang / gzhan shugs bstan du rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud bcas gsum ga'i brjod byar yang yan lag brgyad kyi nang don spyi la khyab pa'i tshul du gnas pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /3 gcig gcig gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bzhi gcig dang / /lnga dang drug dang brgyad gnyis bcu drug gcig /bcu dgu gcig dang zhus pas dgu bcu gnyis/ /'grel/ man ngag rgyud kyi le'u'i sdom tshig ste/ skabs bco lnga las bcu bzhi pa rgas pa gso ba'i skabs le'u gcig gis rdzogs par ston pa dang / drug pa gsang nad gso ba'i skabs dang bco lnga ro tsa gso ba'i skabs gnyis le'u gnyis gnyis kyis rdzogs pa/ dgu ba byis pa gso pa dang / bcu ba mo nad gso pa/ bcu gsum dug nad gso ba'i skabs gsum ni le'u gsum gsum gyis ston pa/ dang po nyes gsum gso ba'i skabs le'u bzhis ston pa gcig dang / bcu gcig gdon nad gso ba'i skabs dang bcu gnyis mtshon rma gso ba'i skabs gnyis le'u lngas lngas ston pa/ gnyis pa khong nad gso ba dang bzhi ba lus stod gso ba'i skabs gnyis le'u drug drug gis 26

ston pa/ lnga ba don snod gso ba dang drug pa lhan skyes rma gso ba'i skabs gnyis le'u brgyad res ston pa/ gsum pa tshad pa gso ba'i skabs gcig po le'u bcu dgus ston pa/ gzhan man ngag rgyud zhus pa'i le'u gcig ba cas yongs su dril bas le'u dgu bcu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa'o/ /4gnyis bcu bdun drug le'u nyi shu lnga/ /'grel/ dang po brtag pa rtsa chu'i mdo la rtsa ma do dang chu mdo'i le'u re ste gnyis yod pa dang / gnyis pa zhi byed sman gyi mdor thang dang / phye ma/ ril bu/ lde gu/ sman mar/ thal sman/ khaṇ+ḍa/ sman chang / rin po che/ sngo sbyor bcas le'u bcu/gsum pa sbyong byed las kyi mdor snum 'chos dang / bshal/ skyugs/ sna sman/ 'jam rtsi/ ni ru ha/ rtsa sbyongs bcas le'u bdun/ bzhi ba 'jam rtsub dpyad kyi mdor gtar ga dang / me btsa'/ dugs/ lums/ byug nga// thur ma ste le'u drug bcas phyi ma rgyud la bsdoms pas le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga yod/ ces pa'o/ /5 sdong bo dgu las gyes pa'i lo 'dab nyis brgya nyer bzhi'i grangs/'grel/ dang po rnam par ma gyur pa nad kyi rtswa/nga bo la lo 'dab nyi shu rtsa lnga rgyas yod pa dang / gnyis pa rnam par gyur pa lus kyi sdong bo la lo 'dab drug cu rtsa gsum/ gsum pa blta ba'i sdong bo la lo 'dab drug bzhi ba reg pa'i sdong bo la lo 'dab gsum/ lnga ba dri ba'i sdong bo la lo 'dab nyi shu rtsa dgu/ drug pa zas kyi sdong bo la lo 'dab sum cu so lnga/ bdun pa spyod lam gyi sdong bo la lo 'dab drug brgyad pa sman gyi sdong bo la lo 'dab lnga bcu/ dgu ba da/ hūṃd kyi sdong bo la lo 'dab bdun bcas bsdoms pa'i nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyes pa'o/ /6 rlung dang bad kan grang ba chu yin te/ /khrag dang mkhris pa tsha ba me ru 'dod/ /srin dang chu ser tsha grang thun mong gnas/ /'grel/ nyes pa gsum las gyur pa'i nad ji snyed yod pa thams cad gcig tu dril na tsha grang rnam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ de yang ( rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i nad gang yod thams cad ni rang bzhin bsil bas skra/nga ba chu dang mtshungs pa/ khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad ji snyed thams cad ni rang bzhin dro bas tsha ba me 27

dang mtshangs/ der ma 'dus pa'i srin dang chu ser gnyis ni rang bzhin tsha grang gang stoyang ma yin zhing de'i rigs sa gyar pa'i nad thams cad ni rkyen gang ngam grogs gang ra ༄dang bsdongs pa de'i rjes su 'brangs pas na tsha grang thun mong du gnas zhes brjod pa yin/bdunapa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1nga 2ka 3kha 4ga 5kha 6ga 7ga 8ga 9ka 10ga 11kha 12ka 13ka 144ga15ga 16ga 17kha 18kha 19ka 20ga 21ka 22ga 23kha 2'a ga 25nga 26kha 27ga28ga 29ga 30khaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1kakhang 2kakhang 3kag 'jikag 5kag 6khang 7kakhang 8khag 9kagang 10khagang 11khagaca 12khag 13kakhagang 1'jikakhagang 15khagaca 16kag 17kakhagangaca 18kakhagang 19kakhag 20khangaca1py-i ba/dahūṃ pa~X 'dzin/3tsu 4snyo 5྾ 6྾ 7྾8wa 9tsu 10྾

sa bcad gsum pa/ grub pa lus/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 lus chags pa'i rgyu gtso bo ni/ ( )ka khu ba/ kha sems/ ga ma ririg pa/ nga khu khrag sems gsum/2 khu khrag de nyid la nyes pa 'dus pa'i skyon byung na ni/ ( )ka dum bu chad/ kha rnag 'dra/ ga mdud pa can/ ngabashang gci 'dra/3 'byung ba lnga las sa khams kyi cha med na ni/ ( )ka sdud mi nus/ kha smin mi nus/ ga gzugs khams 'grub mi nus/ nga 'phel mi nus/4mngal chags 'phel ba'i rgyu ni/ ( )ka zas bcud/ kha mngal gnas rang nyid kyi lte ba/ ga rlung /nga ma'i lte ba/5 mngal 'phel bar byed pa'i rkyen ni/ ( )ka rnam par shes ba/ kha 'byung khams/ ga zas kyi dwangs ma/nga rlung /6 lte ba bsgyur ba'i thabs de dus gang du bya dgos/ ( )ka bdun phrag gsum pa/ kha pho mo'i dzo 5tshan ma gsal bar ma gyur gong / ga pho mo'i mtshan ma dod rjes/ nga bdun phrag bzhi ba'i skabs/7 khu khrag gnyis reg bya rtsub cing mdog nag la ro bsnasku ba 'byung ba ni/ ( )ka rlung gi skyon/ kha mkhris pa'i skyon/ ga bad kan gyi skyon/nga bad rlung ldan pa'i skyon/29

8 khu khrag cha mnyam pa las ni/ ( )ka bu dang bu mor skyes/ kha mtshe mar skyes/ ga ma ning skyes/nga mo gsham skyes/9 gso ba rig pa'i don mtha' dag bsdus na/ ( )ka yan lag brgyad/ kha lus nad gnyen po/ ga nad dang lus zungs dri ma gsum/ nga gso bya/ gso byed/ ji ltar gso ba dang gso pa po bcas bzhi/10 zla ba gnyis pa'i bdun phrag drug pa la/( )ka lte ba chags/ kha srog rtsa chags/ ga phyi nang 'brel ba'i rtsa rnams chags/ nga dbang bo chags/11 mngal gnas sems can de'i dran pa gsal ba'i dus skabs ni/ ( )ka bdun phrag so lnga nas/ kha bdun phrag rtsa drug pa/ ga bdun phrag rtsa bdun pa/ nga bdun phrag rtsa brgyad pa/12 rang gnas la skyo ba'i 'du shes 'byung zhing btsa' ba la mngon du phyogs pa ni/( )ka bdun phrag so lnga nas/ kha bdun phrag so drug pa nas/ gabadun phrag so bdun pa nas/ nga bdun phrag so brgyad pa nas/13 khu khrag gnyis lhan cig tu 'dus pa'i dus ni/ ( )ka bdun phrag dang po/ kha bdun phrag gnyis pa/ ga bdun phrag gsum pa/ nga zla ba dang po bdun phrag bzhi pa/14byis pa btsa' ba'i dus ni/ ( )ka zla dgu/ kha zla brgyad pa/ ga zla bcu ba/ nga zla bcu 'das nas/15 ma'i mngal dbus dma' la mtha' gnyis mtho na/ ( )ka bu mo skye/ kha pho skye/ ga mtshe mar skye/ nga ma ning skye/16 dpyi rus gnyis ni/ ( )30

ka mchong gi ka ba 'dra/ kha phyam gyi rten ma 'dra/ ga mkhar bad btags pa 'dra/ nga rtsig pa'i 'a gram gzhi 'dra/17 sdor gyi rkyal ba bkal ba 'dra ba ni/ ( )ka mchin pa/ kha bsam se'u/ ga mkhris pa/ nga pho ba/18 mkhris pa'i ldang tshad ni/ ( )ka lgang phug gang / kha gsang sgro gang / ga snyim pa gang / ngakhyor ba gang /19 mgo bo'i rus rigs kyi grangs ni/ ( )ka bzhi/ kha dgu/ ga brgyad/ nga lnga/20 so grangs so gnyis las smra brjod la gces pa'i so/ ( )ka bzhi/ kha brgyad/ ga drug nga bcu gnyis/21 snod drug las spyi khyab thun mong gi snyigs ma gsog pa'i snod ni/ ( )ka pho ba/ kha rgyu ma/ ga long ga nga gzhang ba/22 'phar ba rtsa yi sdong bo ni/ ( )ka srog rtsa dmar po/ kha srog rtsa nag po/ ga srog rtsa dkar po/ nga gser rtsa/23 klad pa rtsa yi rgya mtsho chen po las/ ( )ka srog rtsa dkar po gyes/ kha srog rtsa nag po gyes/ ga srog rtsa dmar po gyes/ nga rlung khrag 'dres pahāre rtsa gyes/24khyi khros sna nas gyen du sor lnga bcal ba ni/ ( )ka rmen bu mgo sngon/ kha rmen bu lcu spyog po/ ga rmen bu dkar po/ nga rmen bu dmar po/25 gnyid log 'phar rtsa'i ming gzhan la/( )ka rtse chung / kha rtse nag ga rtse chen/ nga rtse 'dra/26 byang khog glo rtsa sge dor ni/ ( )31

ka glo bu las byung / kha glo ma las byung / ga tshang tshing las byung / nga ma bu sgrog pa las byung /27 gnod bya rnams kyi stobs rgyas par byed pa'i rgyu gtso bo/( )ka dwangs ma/ kha khrag ga mdangs/ nga zas skom gyi bcud/28 me drod gsum las zas skom 'ju ba'i gzhi ni/( )ka rlung me mnyam/ kha mkhris pa 'ju byed/ ga bad kan myag byed/ nga 'dus ba/29 rang bzhin bdun las mchog du gyur pa ni/( )ka bad kan/ kha ldan pa/ ga 'dus pa/ nga rkyang ba/30 lug mkhal brtsegs pa dang 'dra ba'i sha gnad ni/( )ka spyi bo'i sha kha mtshog ma'i sha ga ltag pa'i sha ngamur gong gi sha31 lug gzhug g.yas g.yon gnyis las gyes pa'i chu rtsa ni/( )ka 'ja' byed/ kha rat+na/ ga sbu gu can/ nga gzhung rtsa/32 lus zungs kyi mthar phyin 'bras bu ni/( )ka khu ba/ kha tshil/ ga mdangs/ nga zungs khragaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 zla mtshan 'byung ba'i rtags/( )ka lus shed chung la bzhin rid pa/ kha nu ma cher skye zhing mig sbos pa/ga rked pa 'gul zhing na ba/ nga rgyu zhabs dang tshang ra g.yo ba/2 skye gzugs mi mthun pa 'byung ba ni/( )ka nyes pa'i dri mas sbags pa/ kha 'byung lnga'i cha shas ma rdzogs pa/32

ga sngon las med pa/ nga phyi rkyen du ma thebs pa/3 dus su btsa' mi thub pa'i 'gal rkyen ni/( )ka zungs khrag zags pa/ kha mngal / rmyas pa/ ga rlung 'khrugs pa/ nga zas spyod ma mthun pa/4byis pa myur tu btsa' ba'i rtags mtshan/( )ka mngal sgo lhod cing phyir lug pa/ kha tshang rked sogs zug gzer skye ba/ ga ldang dub byed pa/ nga mtshan phye gcin mang ba/5 lus kyi 'dra dpe yi bstan bya gtso bo ni/( )ka gnad che chung / kha gzugs dbyirngapres/ ga gnas lugs/nga nus pa/6 rus pa'i byed las ni/( )ka lus khams 'degs skyor byed pa/ kha/ gzugs dbyibs 'dzin pa/ga wo/ ga sgrom chags nas gal che'i dbang rtemyo/ byed pa/ nga sra zhing lci ba'i cha 'dzin pa/7 chu bas rus pa dang rus tshigs bar la thon pa'i nus pa ni/( )ka 'brel sbyor/ kha mthud 'dzin/ ga brtag srung / ngabacud sprod/8 brang khog ni rus pa ( ) dag las grurnga/ pa yin/ka brang rus/ kha rtsib ma/ ga sgal tshigs/ nga nyen sna/9 tshang ra'i nang du gnas pa'i dbang rten ni/( )ka bsam se'u/ kha lgang ba/ ga bu snod/ nga mkhal ma/10 'byin rjub kyi khong gtogs kyi dbang bo ni/( )ka sna'i bu ga kha glo mig ga gre ba/ nga rkan phugs/11 pho ba'i rtsa gnad ni/( )ka pho rtsa sbrul mig kha pho rtsa ka ba/ ga pho rtsa bong rmed/nga pho rtsa bya rkang /33

12 yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i chu rtsa gtso bo/( )ka 'ja' byed/ kha rat+na/ ga sbu gu can/ nga rtse nag13 mgo bo'i sha gnad dag ni/( )ka spyi bo'i sha kha mtshog ma'i sha ga mdzo sna/ ngartsibs gsham/14rus tshigs la 'gul skyod che chung gi cha nas/( )ka tshigs chen/ kha lag pa'i tshigs/ ga tshigs phran/ ngatshags dam pa'i tshigs/15 rus par pho mo ma ning phye pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/( )ka lha mig che chung / kha lha gdung gi srab mthug ga rus pa'i kha dog nga lha ba gsob min/16 lag pa'i 'phar rtsa dag ni/( )ka srin lag myur ba/ kha a so li ka ga snying rtsa mig dmar/nga snying rtsa rngul 'du/17 nyes pa'i bye brag las snying la gnas pa ni/( )ka khyab byed rlung / kha mkhris pa sgrub byed/ ga mkhris pa mdangs sgyur/ nga bad kan myong byed/18 bad kan gyi rang bzhin ldan pa ni/( )ka sha rgyas pa/ kha sha mdog dkar ba/ ga bzod sran che ba/nga gnyid srab pa/19 lus kyi 'jig ltas bstan pa la/( )ka ring ba/ kha shun tu ring ba/ ga nye ba/ nga nges sam ma nges pa/20 rmi lam 'byung ba'i nad gzhi ni/ ( )ka mthong thos/ kha gsol ba btab pa/ ga myong grub/ ngand las byung ba/34

gsum pa/ ming 'grel/khams drug sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste lnga dang de steng rnam par shes pa bsnan pas drug go /gtsub shing / 'phags yul sogs su reg bya shin tu rtsub pa'i shing pho mo rigs gnyis 'byung ba dag phan tshun brdar na me 'byung ba zhig go /dku 'dir mngal lam bu snod kyi ming la go'o/ /snyim pa/ lag mgo gnyis mnyam gshibs su byas pa'i tshad la zer ro/ /rlon khrus mas btang/ rlon zhes pa skyugs sman dang / khrus zhes pa bshal sman/mas btang zhes pa bsharnga ri lam nas yar gtong ba'i sbyong sman bcas so /thang re/ thengs re mos kyi don no/ /tshas kyis gso/ drod bcud ldan pa'i zas skom rigs kyis gso dgos zhes pa'i don/phyi sa/ bshang ba'i ming /'phang lo/ zlum po'am sgor mo zhes nga/'i don/nyag ma/ rkang grangs zhes pa'i don/rnam shes tshogs drug mig la sogs pa dbang ngotsho/ lnga'i rnam shes steng yid shes bsnan pa'o/ /gnod sbyin/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i kho ngas kyi lha'i 'gro ba/khyu mchog glang bo che dang ma he sogapo/ khyu tshogs nang gi mchog gam gtso bo'i ming /pho nya/ bang chen nam 'phrin skyel ‘ba'i ming /35

dge sbyong / nyan thos sam dam pa'i chos kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa/mtshun gtor/ pha mes kyi dur lha gsol ba'i chos gtor gtong ba/gcer bu/ gos med dmar hreng can gyi don/lcug ma/ yal phran nam 'khri shing rigs/tā la/ 'phags yul sogs su yod pa'i tā la'i shing /rme can nam dme can/ btsog cing bshan pa lta bu'i rigs/bro ba'i khral 'ded/ sha sogs zas rigs kyi khral 'ded pa'i don/'phan/ ba dan nam ka 'phan zhes mchod pa'i rdzas/nyam nga / ya nga ba'am 'jigs skrag can/rna ba hrid sbyar/ rna gshog ltag rgyab tu sbyar ba'i don/ut+ta chad pa/ legs sbyar gyi skad dod de skad sgra chad pa'i don/khengs po/ btsos nas tshos rjes rlangs pa bsub cing dus yun 'gor ba'i rigs/ga chad ngus pa/ yi thang chad chad du ngus pa'o/ /yen la gtad pa/ rgyun bsring ba'i don/chags rgyu/ khu khrag sems gsum dang yang na dkar dmar rlung gsum yang zer/grub pa lus/ 'byung ba chen po rnams dang khams drug sogs rgyu rkyen rten 'brel dang bcas pa yongs su tshogs pa las grub pa zhig yin gshis der grub pa lus zhes bya'o/ /dge ltas/ bzang po'i rtags mtshan/pad+ma phyung / snying ga nas me tog phyi rol tu phyung ba/rngul chags/ gdong la rngul 'phral 'phral chags pa/rgyal mtshan/ pho brang dang lha khang sogs kyi rgyan nam mchod rdzas kyi bye brag cigabu ga'i dri ma/ mig dang rna ba sogs kyi bu ga'i nang nas byung ba'i dri 36

ma rnams so/ /zas lam/ zas skom rnams rgyu ba'i la ma mam zhu ba'i gnas kyi lam/dar dpyangs/ dar gyi cod pan nam dar skud kyis btags pa'i thag pa/ba gam/ khang ba brtsegs thog can/rgya phubs/ gser zangs sogs las bzos pa'i khang ba'i thog khebs/khrag gis rul/ khrag gi skyon yod pa'i khu /sprug la'o/ /rtsa chen gnyis/ bsam se'u nas bu snod rngakayas g.yon du 'brel ba'i rtsa chen gnyis so/ /mgul ba/ ske'am mgrin pa'i zhe sa/lus snyom/ bya ba gang la yang 'jug shā pre 'dod par sgyid lug pa'i don/skar ma rgyal/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nang gses shigashugs bkag bshang gci sogs shugs kyis bkag pa'am ha cang btsir ches pa/dku lci/ mngal kha cung lhod cing myo/tshang ra sogs lus smad lci ba'o/ /lus rid/ gzugs po'i sha glo bur sdosme skam pa'am rid pa/dku bkag thur sel rlung gis dku'am mngal lam bu snod kyi sgo bkag pa'i don/mnga' bskur/ rgyal po'i mnga' thang 'dzin par dbang bskur ba'i don/'ja' bar byed/ rkang lag 'ja' pa'am 'a ba'i don/srog 'dor/ rang srog blos gtong ba/sgor 'jug snyigs ma rnams zhu ba'i kra/nas kyi sgo nas 'gror 'jug pa'i don/pho ba'i bad kan/ pho bar gnas pa'i be snarngapres sam myag byed do/ /dug can srin bu/ dug can gyi rdzas rigs la brten te gnas pa'i srin bu/'jigs ring / 'jig skrag gam zhed pa ‘sneng mgyogs pa'am brel ba'i 37

sgra bsdus pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1khu khrag gnyis 'dzoms shing dri za nye bar rgyu ba kho nas lus chags pa yin/( )2khu khrag gnyis la nyes pa'i skyon 'ga' thebs pa las kyang sa bon byed mi nus pa'i nges pa med/( )3skye gzugs mi sdug pa sogs 'byung ba ni 'byung ba lnga'i cha shas so so yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i skyon yin/( )'argyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms shing nyes skyon ci yang ma sbags na lus 'grub par nus/( )5mngal gnas lus can de nyid 'phel pa'i dngos rgyu ni ma'i kha zas kyi dwangs bcud de yin/( )6 'dra dpe ni gzugs dbyibs dang gnas yul sogs gsal bor rtogs bde ba'i phyir ro/ /( )7sbrum mas zas skom sna tshogs 'dod pa ni rang gi zungs stobs snyigs dor bcud len bya ba'i phyir/( )8lte bsgyur gyi thabs spyad pa'i sbrum ma gang dag gis lus zungs la gnod pa'i zas spyod sogs zla ba brgyad kyi ring la bsrung dgos/( )9 lte bsgyur ni pho mo'i mtshan ma gsal bar ma gyur pa'i gong du bya dgos pa'i nges pa med/( )10byis pa btsa' dus spyir zla ngo dgu 'am bcu yin par nges yang snga sor zla brgyad dang phyi sor zla bcu tshun btsas na yang legs par btsa' ba yin/( )11dar gyi dpyangs thag bcu gsum ni klad pa'i rje zhabs kyi yan lag khag la 'brel ba yin/( )38

12skyogs rwa'i tshigs mtshams nas phrag gong du sor bzhi bcal pa rmen bu smug po yin/( )13sbal nag gnyis ni byang khog gi sha gnad do/ /( )14chu rtsa 'ja' byed gnyis ni ltag zur spu 'a/rngubyel don te an stong tshigs pa dang po nas dpyi leb mtshams su brgyud yod/( )15byang khog stod smad kyi mtshams tshad ni maḥkyi na dri yis dbye ba 'byed pa yin/( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1grub pa lus kyi gnas 'di nyid bshad rgyud k+to) thog mar smra dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ des lus kyi chags tshul dang gnas lugs mtshan nyid bcas rim bzhin ston pas grub pa lus kyi gnas ma bshad na nad 'jug pa'i gzhi dang sman dpyad sogs bya ba'i yul ngo mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /2 bshad rgyud la bslab pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ bshad rgyud mi shes pa des ni lus kyi ma /tshan nyid mi shes pa dang / lus kyi mtshan nyid mi shes pa des ni nad kyi rang bzhin mi shes pa dang / nad kyi rang bzhin mi shes pa des ni sman dpyad zas spyod kyi tshuk+ṣapre mi shes/ sman dpyad zas spyod kyi tshul mi shes pa des ni gso ba rig pa'i phyogs tsam yang mi shes pa/ gso ba rig pa mi shes pa des gso thabs kyi lag len bkod mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /3 mngal chags pa'i rgyu gang dag 'tshogs dgos sam/lan/ lus khams chags pa'i rgyu ni khams da kar dmar dang de la lhan skyes su yod pa'i nyes gsum dang shin tu phra ba'i 'byung lnga'i cha shas rnams tshang shing 'dzoms na mngal chags nus so/ /4 rgyu mtshan gang la bltas nas 'byung ba lnga ḍā/sa ming btags pa yin nam/39

lan/ snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' bcas/ /'di dag la brten 'byung ba'i phyir/ /'byung ba zhes su btags pa yin/ /5 'byung ba ma tshang na lus khams mi 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ khu khrag gnyis lhan cig tu tshogs pa'i tshe 'byung ba sa'i rang bzhin med na mi 'grub la chu med sdud mi nus/ me med mi smin rlung med 'phel mi 'gyur/ nam mkha' med par 'phel ba'i go mi 'byed pa'o/ /6 dwangs ma las byung zla rer bsags pa'i khrag /rtsa chen gnyis nas nag cing dri bral ba/ /zhes dang / zla mtshan tshos khu ri bong khrag 'dra ba/ /bkrus na dag 'gyur skyon med mngal chags byed/ /ces rgyud du gsungs pa gnyis gong 'og 'gal lam/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mi 'gal te/ 'dir zla mtshan phyir 'byung ba'i dus su thul sel rlung gis ded pas kha dog cung zad nag cing dri bral 'byung zhes pa zla mtshan 'byung pa'i zhag dang po'i don yin la/ phyir 'byung ba rgyun chad nas skyes pa dang 'dus pa'i dus su bsam se'i nas babs pa'i khams dmar po de ni nad gzhan dang ma 'dres pa ri bong gi khrag ltar 'byung zhes pa'i don no/ /7 mngal chags pa'i rgyu las 'bras bu skyed tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ pha yi khu bas rus pa klad gzhung skyed/ /ma yi zla mtshan sha khrag don snod skyed/ /rang gi sems las dbang bo'i rnam shes 'byung / /sa las sha dang rus pa sna dri skyed/ /chu las khrag dang lce ro rlan pa skyed/ /me las drod dang mdog gsal mig gzugs skyed/ /rlung las dbugs dang pags pa reg bya skyed/ /mkha' las bu ga rna ba sgra skyed 'gyur/ /goms pas bya ba la 'jug snang ba mched/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms pas lus su 'grub/ /8bud med gang zhig la mngal ldan pa'i skabs su zla mtshan mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mas ro drug gi bza' btung 'phrod par zos pa'i bcud rnams pho ba'i gnas nas rim pas lus zungs so sor 'phel pa'i dwangs ma bdun po de nyid bsam 40

se'ur bsags pa las bsam se'u dang bu snod g.yas g.yon gnyis su rtsa'i rgyun srang gis 'brel zhing bu snod kyi rtsa de yang mngal gnas kyi lus can de'i lte ba dang 'brel ba'i dbang gis rdzing dang 'dra ba'i bsam se'u nas yur ba dang 'dra ba'i rtsa'i sbubs gnyis su chu dang 'dra ba'i dwangs ma'i rgyun 'byung ste/ zhing dang 'dra ba'i mngal gnas gyi lus la me tog dang 'dra ba'i khams sum cu rtsa drug rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pas na zla mtshan mi 'byung ngo / /9 ci zhig la zla mtshan zhes btags pa yin/lan/ sbrum ma dang mo gsham ma yin pa'i bud med lo na bcu gnyis nas lnga bcu yas mas bar zas skom gyi dwangs ma rnams las rim bzhin byung ba'i tha ma mdangs zhes pa de'i snyigs mar khams dkar dmar gyi cha gnyis su yod pa'i dmar cha de bsam se'u nas bu snod g.yas g.yon 'brel baglure rtsa chen gnyis po brgyud nas zla re re bzhin bu snod nas brdol te thog mar kha dog cung nag cing dri ma dang bral ba zhig thur sel rlung gis mtshan ma'i sgor ded nas zha ga gsum mam lnga'i bar 'dzag pa de la zla mtshan zhes bya'o/ /10 skye gnas mi mthun pa dag 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mi la skye gnas mi mthun pa byol song rnga) nga grod pa sha thum sogs dang /skye gnas mthun yang mi'u thung dang zha long sogo/sa ga zugs mi sdug pa sogs 'byung ba ni pha ma'i khu khrag gnyis la rlung la sogs pa'i nad a+yaubye/na sbags pa dang / 'byung ba lnga po so so'i cha shas yongs su ma rdzogs pa dang sngon las bcas las skye par 'gyur ba'o/ /11 sbrum ma'i mngal bsrung dgos don ci/lan/ spyir sbrum ma mtha' dag dang / khya da par tu lte bsgyur gyi thabs spyad pa'i sbrum ma gang dag gis gzhung nas gsungs pa'i zas spyod de rigs spyad pas ma'i lus zungs zad nas mngal gnas kyi lus stobs skyesprasdo pa'i rgyu med pa'i don gyi mngal 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / yang na rlung 'phel paṇire dbang gis dku'am mngal gyis nang skam par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /12 mngal chags 'phel ba'i rgyu ni lte ba zhes pa'i lte ba ni mngal 'phel ba'i 41

rgyu dngos yin nam/lan/ rgyu dngos ma yin te/ rgyu dngos ni ma'i kha zas kyi bcud kyi dwangs ma yin la de nyid rgyu bar grogs sam rkyen byed pa'i rtsa sbubs te lte ba nyid rgyu lta bur bzhag yod/13phung bo 'dra ba'i dpe bstan pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ 'gro ba mi'i lus ji ltar chags pa de rnams kyang tshul gang dang gang 'dra ba mi shes pa rnams kyi slad du 'dra ba'i dpe dang sbyar te bstan la phung bo'i cha shas rnams kyi gnas lugs shes pa'i ched du yin/14gnyan pa'i gnad ni rgyal po'i mnga' bskur 'dra zhes pa gang la zer ba yin nam/lan/ phyi nang gi gnyan pa'i gnad rnams ni rgyal po'i mnga' bskur ba'i pho nya ba mang po dang 'dra ste/ pho nya dang 'dra ba'i gnad rnams ma bde na rgyal po dang mtshungs pa'i snying yang 'khrugs te lus srog 'joms par 'gyur ba yin/15 lus kyi gnas lugs zhes par tshig gi go don ci ltar yin nam/lan/ lus kyi gnas lugs zhes pa lus grub pa'i nad zungs dri ma don snod dang bcas pa'i tshad gzhi'am ldang tshad dang rnam grangs sogs bstan pa zhig yin pa'i don gyis der lus kyi gnas lugs zhes bya ba yin/16 rus pa'i ldang tshad las rus rigs nyer gsum po gang dag yin nam/lan/ sgrog rus brang rus dpung rkang rus pa dang / lag ngar che chung pran rtse rus pa dang / lag mthil rus dang sen mo'i rus pa/ lha nga'i rus dang rje ngar che chung dang / lag tshig rkang sor sre long rkang mthil rus/ pran rtse brla rkang gzhug chung dang / tshang rus dpyi rus rkang tshigs rus pa dang / lha ru rtse dang rtsib ma mgal rus dang / dpral pa'i rus bcas nyi shu rtsa gsum mo/ /17 rus pa'i dbyibs kyi sgo nas dbye tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rus pa la ring bo dang / ldum ldum/ leb leb/ kong kyong bcas rigs bzhi dbye chog pa yin/ de yang dpung rkang / brla rkang / lag ngar/ rje ngar bcas 42

kyi rus pa ni rus ring khongs su gtogs pa dang / sgal gzhung gi tshigs dang / lag mgo'i rus pa sogs ni rus pa ldum ldum gyi khongs su gtogs pa dang / rtsub ma dang /brang rus/ dpyi rus/ sog rus/ rna lhan rus pa sogs ni rus leb kyi khongs su gtogs la/ so dang rna lhan phud pa'i rus pa ni kong kyong gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / da dung sna rtse'i rus pa dang / rna gshog gi rusru su pa/ lha ru rtse'i rus pa/ tshigs pa'i mkhar mtshams sogs khrung rus kyi rigs kyang yo/da pa red/18rus pa'i dum bu 'dren pa'i skabs su bod lugs gso rig la rus pa ga tshod yod pa dang phyi lugs kyi rus grangs ga tshod yod dam/lan/ bod lugs gso rig la rus dum360dang / deng rabs gso rig gis mi dar mar dngos bstan rus pa'i dum bu206yod pa gnyis dbye stangs dang bgrang tshul tsam mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis grangs kyi mang nyung shor ba ma gtogs don thog dngos yod gcig rang la 'khel bzhin mchis/19 mgo rus la dum bu du yod pa dang gang da ga yin nam/lan/ de yang mgo bor dpral ba'i rus pa da nga / ltag pa'i rus pa gnyis dum bu re re dang / thod pa'i rus pa dang / rna lhan gyi rus pa/ mig 'bor ram mig chu'i rus pa/ ya mgal dang ma mgal gyi rus pa/ rkan gyi rus pa bcas dum bu gnyis re/ phye ma leb kyi rus pa/ mig dbrag rus pa/ gshog rus/ lce rtse'i rus pa/ ma mgal lam ya mgal gyi rus pa bcas dum sdinā re re/ rna ba g.yas g.yon la sgra len rus pa gsum re drug dang / so'i grangs ni smra nga/rjod sogs la gces pa'i mdun so yas mas bzhi re ste brgyad dang / mdzes byed kyi mche ba yas mas gnyis re ste bzhi/zas sogs ldad cing gcod par byed pa'i 'gram so ya sa mas brgyad re bcu drugamatha' bzhi'i so chung bzhi bcas mgo la rus dum drug cu re gcig go /20 byang khog la rus dum ga tshod yod dam/lan/ byang khog la mjing tshigs bdun dang / sgal tshigs bcu gnyis/ rked tshigs lnga bcas gzhung tshigs nyer bzhi bo rnams so sor mkhar ram 'phang lo re re dang / mkhar mtshams re re/ mkhar nas phyogs g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i bya 'dab 43

rus pa gnyis re bcas bzhi re dbye bas bsdoms pas rus dum dgu cu go drug dang /tshang rus sam wa gdong la rus dum lnga/ gzhug chung la rus dum lnga/ dpyi rus g.yas g.yon gnyis/ sog rus g.yas g.yon gnyis/ sgrog rus g.yas g.yon gnyis/brang rus la brang mgo dang brang dkyil dang lhin sna bcas gsum dang / rtsib ma'i bar 'brel ba'i lha ru rtse'i rus dum nyi shu/ lha ru rtse dang 'brel ba'i rtsib ma g.yas g.yon bcu re ste nyi shu/ brang rus dang ma 'brel ba'i rtsib thung g.yas g.yon gnyis re ste bzhi bcas bsgril bas bsdoms byang khog la rus dum brgya dang lnga bcu nga dgu yod do/ /21 yan lag la rus dum ga tshod yod dam/lan/ lag par dpung rkang gi rus pa g.yas g.yon gnyis dang / lag ngar g.yas g.yon so sor rus pa che chung gnyis re bzhi/ lag mgo g.yas g.yon so sor pran rtse'i rus pa brgyad re ste bcu drug lag mthil g.yas g.yon so sor rus pa lnga re ste bcu/ sor mo g.yas g.yon rnams so sor rus dum bcu bzhi re ste nyer brgyad/sen mo g.yas g.yon bcu dang bcas bsdoms rkang lag gnyis la rus dum bdun cu re ste bsdoms pas brgya dang bzhi bcu tham pa yod do/ /22 yan lag la tshigs chen ga tshod yod pa dang gang dag yin nam/lan/ lag par dpung tshigs g.yas g.yon gnyis dang / gru tshigs g.yas g.yon gnyis/ mkhrig tshigs g.yas g.yon gnyis/ rkang par dpyi tshigs g.yas g.yon gnyis/ pus tshigs g.yas g.yon gnyis/ rgya tshigs g.yas g.yon gnyis bcas bsgril bas yan lag bzhi bor tshigs chen rnam pa bcu gnyis yod pa yin/23 chu rgyus gnyis kyi ngo bo ji ltar yin nam/ lan/ chu ba ni rus tshigs dang rus pa phan tshun 'brel sbyor dang mthud 'dzin brtan srung bcas byed rgyur gal che'i nus pa thon mkhan gyi grub cha zhig ste/ der mkhrig ma'i chu ba dang / gru mo'i chu ba/ dpung ba'i chu ba/ gzhung tshigs kyi chu ba/ dpyi mgo'i chu ba/ pus mo'i chu ba/ long tshigs kyi chu ba/ sor tshigs kyi chu ba bcas bcu drug go / rgyus pa ni sha sne rnams las gyes shing phan tshun 'brel te mthud sbyor byed pa 44

la/ der dbye na ske sogs nam tshong yan la sum brgya dang / yan lag bzhi por don lnga re ste sum brgya/ byang khog stod smad gnyis la sum brgya bcas bsdoms pas dgu brgya tsam yod/24don snod so so'i 'byung ba khams dang rten bcas ji ltar yin nam/lan/ snying ni 'byung ba nam mkha'i dwangs ma me khams yin la tshe srog sems kyi rten du gyur pa dang / glo ba ni 'byung ba rlung kyi dwangs ma lcags khams yin la 'byin rngub dbugs kyi rten du gyur pa dang / mchin pa ni 'byung ba me'i dwangs ma shing khams yin la khrag dang drod kyi rten du gyur pa da nga / mtsher ba ni 'byung ba sa'i dwangs ma sa khams yin la lus zungs khrag gi rten du gyur pa dang / mkhal ma ni 'byung ba chu'i dwangs ma chu khams yin la rlan zhing gsher ba'i rten gyur pa'o/ /25 ci zhig la 'phar rtsa zer/lan/ snying gi rtsa bar 'dus pa las nyon mongs pa'i yid rgyu ba'i dbang gis snying 'phar bar byed la/ de'i don gyis snying dang gtso bo 'brel ba'i rtsa thams cad du rlung khrag 'dres par rgyu zhing rtsa yang 'phar ba red/26 srog rtsa dkar nag gi nges tshig ci/lan/ srog rtsa dkar po las rlung rtsa dang / srog rtsa nag po las khrag rtsa 'byung bar bshad pas 'brel ba'i rtsa gyes pa'i gzhi ni srog rtsa dkar nag go /de yang srog rtsa dkar po ni smin mtshams nas klad pa'i dar 'og na sa brgyud de sgal tshigs la 'byar ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje'i nor bu'i rtsa bar mar sne ru zug pa yin no/ /de'i nang du lte ba yan du srog chen po'i rlung dang / man chad du thur sel gyi rlung rgyu ba yin/srog rtsa nag po ni srog rtsa dkar po'i mdun ste ske stong thad nas gzhug chung thad kyi bar du gnas shing khrag rgyu'o/ /27 rlung khrag 'dres pa'i rtsa rnams gang las gyes pa yin nam/lan/ rlung khrag 'dres pa'i rtsa rnams gang las gyes snyam na/ snying gi rtsa bar 'dus pa las nyon mongs pa'i yid rgyu ba'i bu ga'i dbang gis snying 'phar bar byed la/de'i don gyis snying dang gtso bor 'brel ba'i rtsa thams cad du rlung khrag 'dres par rgyu 45

zhing rtsa yang 'phar ba ste/ rtsa de rnams gnyan pyo'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /28 don snod nang 'brel sbas pa'i rtsa chen brgyad ni gang dag yin nam/lan/ srog rtsa dag las tshigs pa gsum pa'i thad nas mdun ngos su rtsa 'dab gsum du byung ba'i dbus kyi rtsa a ma de snying dang thad kar 'brel ba'i don gyis snying ni rtsa de'i 'bras bu'i tshul du gnas pa dang / g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis po glo bu gnyis su zug pa dang bcas gsum dang / tshigs pa brgyad pa'i mtshams nas mchin dri phug nas thad kar mchin pa dang 'brel ba'i rtsa gcig tshigs pa bcu gcig gi mtshams nas mcher ba dang 'brel pa'i rtsa gcig tshigs pa bcu bzhi'i mtshams nas mkhal ma g.yas g.yon du 'brel ba'i rtsa gnyis bcas brgyad po ni nang don snod du 'brel zhing phyir mi mngon pas sbas pa ltar gnas pa'o/ /29 yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa bcu drug ni gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ ol gong nas g.yas g.yon du tshon re bcal ba'i sa na srog rtsa dmar po las gyes pa'i 'phar rtsa gnyid log bya ba gnyis dang / rtse 'dra bya ba gnyis/ de nas phyir phun re bcal ba'i sa na srog rtsa nag po las gyes pa'i khrag rtsa rtse nag bya ba gnyis bcas rtsa drug po rnams ske rgyud nas mgo bor 'brel ba dang / de bzhin yan lag bzhi la srog rtsa nag po'i yal ga rtsa chen re re dang / srog rtsa dmar po las gyes pa'i 'phar rtsa'i yal ga re re ste brgyad/ gzhan yang mtshan 'gram gyi 'phar rtsa gnyis bcas rtsa bcu drug go /30'brel ba rtsa'i gnas lugs skabs kyi chags srid 'brel ba tshe yi rtsa dang bzhi zhes pa de rgyu mtshan gang la brten nas gsungs pa yin nam/lan/ de ni lus kyi rtsa rigs gsum po ste khrag rtsa dang 'phar rtsa chu rtsa ste/dang po lus chags pa'i skabs kyi chags tshul dang / bar du srid pa'am gnas tshul/lus steng gi 'brel tshul dang de dag gis tshe srog la nus pa ci ltar 'don pa sogs dus dang gnas tshul byed las bcas kyi sgo nas btags pa ma gtogs rtsa'i ngo bo gcig ste rlung rtsa khrag rtsa rlung khrag gnyis 'doms kyi 'phar rtsa bcas gsum mo/ /31 rtsa zhes pa'i ngo bo dang nges tshig ji ltar yin nam/46

lan/ rlung khrag sogs rgyu ba'i ched bu ga'i rgyu lam gyi tshul du lus khams stod smad phyi nang kun tu dra ba ltar 'brel zhing khams rnams bskyed cing gnas par byed pa de ni rtsa'i ngo bo yin la/ rtsa'i nges tshig ni lus khams rnams thog mar skyed cing 'phel ba dang / bar du gnas shing 'tsho ba/ mthar 'jig pa bcas kun gyi rtsa ba ltar gnas pas so/ /32 mgo bo'i sha gnad lnga po gang dag yin/lan/ bzhag sgor 'khyil 'dra spyi bo sha gzhu shul btang 'dra mtshogs ma'i sha nya ldang gshibs 'dra ltag pa'i sha lug mkhal brtsegs 'dra mur gong gnyis bcas mgo la sha gnad lnga'o/ /33 rmen bu'i gnad de gang dag yin nam/lan/ men bu'i gnad ni skyogs ra'i tshigs mtshams nas/ /phrag gong sor bzhi men bu mgo sngon gnad/ /khyi khros sna nas gyen du sor lnga na/ /dpung ba'i rmen bu sngon po gnas pa yin/ /pus mo'i phyi zur tshigs kyi mtshams nas yar/ /mtho gang bcal ba rmen bu dkar po'i gnad/ /de nas sor gsum sbrul mgo gdengs pa'i gnad/ /de brgyad lhog thabs skrangs dang srog 'phrog gnad/ /34 rgyu lam bu ga'i rnam grangs so sor gang dag yin nam/lan/ lus khams phyi nang gi bu ga gnyis yod de/ de yang srog gi rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga gcig dang / de bzhin pho ba nas mchin pa'i bar du dwangs ma rgyu ba'i bu gamachin pa nas sha'i bar du rgyu ba'i bu ga khrag nas tshil bar sha rgyu ba'i bu ga sha nas rus pa'i bar tshil rgyu ba'i bu ga tshil nas rkang mar gyi bar du rus pa rgyu ba'i bu garus pa nas khu ba dkar dmar gyi bar du rkang mar rgyu ba'i bu ga rkang mar nas bsam se'u'i bar du khu ba dkar dmar rgyu ba'i bu ga bcas zungs bdun rgyu ba'i bu gapho ba nas gzhang gi bar du bshang ba rgyu ba'i bu ga pho ba nas chu so la thug gi bar du gcin rgyu ba'i bu ga ba spu rnams su rngul rgyu ba'i bu ga bcas dri ma rgyu ba'i bu ga gsum/ gzhan chu rgyu byed kyi bu ga zas rgyu ba'i bu ga ste rgyu srang bcu gsum du gnas pa yin no/ /phyi'i bu ga ni mgo bo'i mig gnyis/ sna gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ kha gcig 47

bcas bdun dang / gsang bar bshang gcin kyi bu ga gnyis te skyes pa la dgu dang /bud med la de'i steng du mngal lam bu snod kyi sgo dang / nu ma'i bu ga gnyis kyis lhag pas bcu gnyis 'byung ba'o/ /35 rgyu lam bu ga'i dbyibs dang nus pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dbyibs zlum sbom dang phra la ring 'brel gyes/ /lo ma'i rgyab kyi rtsa ltar gnas pa'o/ /dwangs ma nyer 'phel sgo ni bu ga'o/ /36 mkhal ma dang bsam se'u gnas pa'i yul thig ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tshigs pa bcu bzhi g.yas g.yon sor bdun dang / /dpangs su sor lnga mkhal ma'i yul skal te/ /mkhal 'bras ngo bo rna ba'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /bsam se'u tshigs pa bcu gsum 'og na gnas/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /37 gnyan pa'i gnad ces pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ don snod lta bu rab tu gnyan pa'i gnad rnams su phog tshe des 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / chu rgyus lta bu 'bring du gnyan pa'i gnad rnams su phog tshe des sbyong ba'am zha bas yun du mnar bar 'gyur ba/ sha grims kyi gnad lta bu tha mar gnyan pa'i gnad rnams su phog tshe des gso dka' bar 'gyur ba bcas gnod pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyan pa'i gnad ces bstan pa' yin no/ /38 gnod bya bcu so sos las gang dang gang byed dam/lan/ de la dwangs mas gnod bya 'phel bar byed/ /khrag gis brlan zhing srog 'tsho sha yis g.yogs/ /tshil gyis snum dang rus pas brten pa dang / /rkang gis bcud 'gyur khu bas mngal 'dzin byed/ /bshang gcis rten 'drul 'byin par byed pa ste/ /rngul gyis pags pa mnyen zhing ba spu brtan/ /zhes pa'o/ /39 lus khams kyi me drod de gtso bo gang la ngos 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ me drod ces bya 'ju ba'i gzhi yin te/ /'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pa de la bshad/ /nad dang lus zungs dri ma kun kyi drod/ /de yis nad med brtson dang gzi mdangs dang / /tshe dang lus zungs me drod stobs 'phel byed/ /zhu nas sgo 'jug zas lam sgo gtan yin/ /de stobs ldan na zhu nas thur 'gro ste/ /stobs rgyas 'phel bar 48

byed pa'i rgyu yin te/ /ma zhu dwangs sogs rgyas par mi 'gyur phyir/ /zas skom spyod lam yang la dro ba yis/ /'bad des me drod srung bar gnas gyur na/ /lus kyi stobs dang tshe ni gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /40 ro drug ldan gyi kha zas lus zungs su gyur pa'i tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dwangs ma lus zungs rang rang me drod kyis/ /smin par 'gyur te dwangs ma pho ba nas/ /dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu mchin lam brgyud/ /mchin pa'i gnas su khrag 'gyur khrag las sha /sha las tshil 'gyur tshil las rus par 'gyur/ /rus las rkang 'gyur rkang las khu ba 'gyur/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /41 me drod kyis kha zas 'ju tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ me drod de yis kha zas 'ju tshul ni/ /zas skom srog gi rlung gis lto bar bcug /skom gyis bshig cing snum gyis mnyen par byed/ /me mnyam rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed bus/ /pho ba'i gnas su sman ltar bskol bar byed/ /dang po ro drug zas skom gang zos pa/ /bad kan myag byed dag gis myag par byed/ /ro mngar wu ba can 'gyur bad kan skyed/ /bar du mkhris pa 'ju byed kyis bzhus pas/ /rnam par tsha bas ro skyur mkhris pa skyed/ /tha mar me mnyam rlung gis dwangs snyigs phye/ /kha bar 'gyur te de yis rlung skyed 'gyur/ /'byung ba lnga ldan zas kyi yon tan gyis/ /lus kyi 'byung ba lnga po rgyas par byed/ /ces pa'o/ /42 dwangs ma len pa'i rtsa dgu po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ pho ba dang mchin pa'i bar na dngos su 'brel ba'i rtsa rta rnga bshags pa'i tshad tsam yang med na dgu tsam 'byung ba lta ci smos/ 'on kyang gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ pho ba rang gi nang ngos na rtsa sbubs shin tu phra ba dra ba ltar yod pa'i nang nas mchin pa'i rtsa ba phyogs dang gang reg pa'i rtsa mig gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa dgu las ngang gis 'ongs pa mchin pa'i rtsa bo cher 'gro ste/ dper na gnye ma nas lgang bar chu gsog pa'am/ ras tshags dam por chu blugs par ngang gi 'dzag pa'am rdza so ma btang bar chu blugs pa rjul ba ltar 'gro ba'o/ /43 mdangs kyi mtshan nyid ji ltar yin nam/49
