lan/ lus kyi gzi brjid dang bkrags mdangs sogs rten byed pa'i snying la gnas pa'i dwangs ma la mdangs zhes bya ste/ rgyud las/ lus zungs khu ba'i mthar phyin mdangs mchog ste/ /snying la gnas kyang lus kun khyab pa dang / /tshe gnas gzi mdangs bkrag dang ldan par byed/ /ces pa'o/ /44ci zhig la gnyid log gnyis zer/lan/ ol mdud kyi steng nas g.yas g.yon gnyis su tshon gang re gzhal ba'i sar yod pa'i rnying khrag gnyis 'doms kyi 'phar rtsa'i ming ste/ de la ci'i phyir gnyid log ces zhe na/ rtsa de gnyis la brdab 'grams shor ba'i tshe gnyid log pa ltar dran med du brgyal bar 'gyur bas na gnyid log ces ming btags pa'o/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 nya yi gnas skabs zhes par don 'grel gyis/ /'grel/ mngal gnas de chu khams la brten nas 'tsho ba shugs che zhing chu zad na mi 'tsho ste ma'i zas kyi dwangs ma len pa bul zhing lte ba'i lam chags med pas bcud thams cad mngal chu la rag las shing nya ltar chu med na mngal gnas de yang 'tsho mi thub pa'o/ /2mngal chags 'phel ba'i rgyu ni lte ba ste zhes pa nas dper na rdzing yur chu yis zhing bskyed 'dra/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ de yang rdzing dang 'dra ba'i snying rtsa'am 'phar rtsa las byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma de dang / yur ba dang 'dra ba'i rtsa spubs lte ba las/ chu dang 'dra ba'i dwangs ma'i mngal nang gi lo tog dang 'dra ba'i mngal gnas sems can de'i khams rgyas par byed do/ /3 klad pa rtsa yi rgya mtsho chen po las/ rtsa ba lta bu thur du zug pa/ zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ lus stod klad kyi char gnas pa'i klad pa ni rtsa dkar thams cad 50

bskyed pa'i gzhi rgya mtsho chen po dang mtshungs shing / de las rtsa ba ltar kha thur bltas su zug pa'i rtsa rgyungs pa ni sbom phra mda' smyug tsam la chu'i rang bzhin gyis gang bas mdog dkar po ste rim gyi je phrar song bas gzhug gu chung du zad la shin tu gnyan zhing rtsa dkar thams cad bskyed pa'i gtso bo'i don gyis srog rtsa zhes bya'o/ /4'chi sbyong gso ba dka' phyir gnad ces bya/ /zhes par 'grel gyis/'grel/ gnyan pa gnad la rnam grangs bdun du phyes nas gnod pa'i rang bzhin gsal bor bstan pa de dag mdor na don snod lta bur rab tu gnyan pa'i gnad rnams su mtshon gyis phog tshe 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / chu rgyus lta bu 'bring du gnyan pa'i gnad du phog tshe sbyong ba ste zha bas yun tu mnar bar 'gyur ba dang / sha grim gyi gnad lta bur tha mar gnyan pa'i gnad rnams su phog tshe des gso ba dka' bar 'gyur ba bcas gnod pa'i mthu dang ldan phyir gnad ces bshad do/ /5skye ba'i dang po khu ba khrag la gnas/ /dper na dug can srin bu'i dug bskyed mtshungs/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ lus 'di thog mar chags shing cher skyes pa'i dang po ni pha ma'i khu khrag yin la/ de gnyis kyang nyes pa gsum gyi rang bzhin 'ba' zhig las byung zhing gnas pa'i phyir de gnyis las grub pa'i lus khams der yang nyes pa gsum po'i rang bzhin rnams grub pa yin te/ dper na dug gis lus can phal cher gyi srog 'phrog par byed kyang / dug der brten pa'i srin bu rnams kyi lus dug gis bskyed par byed pa bzhin no/ /6rgyu dang ngo bo dpe dang 'bras bu dang / /gnyen pa'i sgo nas grangs dang go rim grub/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ nyes pa gtso che'i dbang du byas pa rlung mkhris bad kan ste rnam pa gsum du yod pa la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu dug gsum du nges pa dang /ngo bo btang snyoms tsha bsil gsum tu nges pa/ dpe dpang bo sngar rgol phyir rgol lta bu gsum du nges pa/ 'bras bu rnam 'gyur gyi nad rlung mkhris bad kan du nges pa dang /gnyen po chu me rlung gsum tu nges pa'i phyir/ nyes pa nad gzhi'i grangs kyang gsum kho 51

nar nges shing / zhar la rlung mkhris bad kan gsam gyi snga phyi'i go rim 'di ltar ༄'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang grub pa'o//bdun pa/rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/rkyang 'dems/1nga 2nga 3ga 4kha 5nga 6kha 7ka8ga 9nga 10kha 11kha 12kha 13ka 14ka 15ga 16nga 17ga 18kha 19nga 20kha21kha 22ka 23 ka 2'jikha 25kha 26kha 27ka 28kha 29ga 30nga 31ka 32gaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1kakhagang 2kakhag 3kakhag 4gakakhagang 5kakhagang 6kakhag 7kakhagang 8kakhag 9kakhag10kakhag 11kakhag 12kakhag 13kakha 14gakag 15kakhag 16kakhang 17kakha 18kakhag19kagang 20kakhagang1py-izhi ba/dahūṃ pa ༵sa 'dzin/3sa 4 5tsu 6sa 7྾8྾ 9྾ 10sa( 11྾ 12྾ 13྾14tsu

sa bcad bzhi ba/ 'phel 'grib nad/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 'phel 'grib nad kyi gnas la rnam pa( )yis bstan/ka lnga/ kha drug ga bdun/ nga brgyad/2 nad rnams kyi nye ba'i rgyu ni/ ( )ka dug gsum/ kha ma rig pa/ ga nyes pa gsum/ nga rlung /3 nad rnams kun gyi thun mong gi rgyu ni/ ( )ka nyes gsum/ kha ma rig pa/ ga rlung mkhris/ nga'adod khro gti gsum/ 4dus la tsha dus grang dus char dus zhes pa'i char dus ni/ ( )ka hor zla gnyis pa nas lnga ba'i bar/ kha hor zla drug pa nas dgu ba'i bar/ ga hor zla bzhi ba nas dang po'i bar/ nga hor zla gsum pa nas drug pa'i bar/5 rlung nad zhi ba'i yon tan ni/ ( )ka bsil ba/ kha lci ba/ ga skya g.yo/ nga snum dro/6 mkhris nad ldang ba'i yon tan ni/ ( )ka rno snum/ kha bsil ba/ ga tsha ba/ nga lci rtul/7 gsog ldang zhi gsum las rlung bsags pa'i dus dang yon tan ni/ ( )ka dpyid ka'i dus dang phyi snum gyi yon tan/ kha so ga'i dus dang rtsub yang skya ba'i yon tan/ ga ston ka'i dus dang rno tsha snum pa'i yon tan/ nga dbyar dus dang rno dro snum pa'i yon tan/8gsog ldang zhi gsum las bad kan ldang ba'i dus ni/ ( )ka dpyid dus/ kha dgun smad/ ga sos ka'i dus/ nga53

ston ka'i dus/9rlung ni gnod bya rnams kyi nang nas ( ) ru gnas/ka rkang mar/ kha dwangs ma/ ga rus pa/ nga sha tshil/10 rlung mkhris thun mong gi gnas ni/ ( )ka pho ba/ kha reg bya/ ga rus tshigs/ nga rngul/11 lus kyi sha skem mdog nag drod la dga' zhing lus 'dar pa sogs 'byung ba ni/( )ka rlung nad 'phel ba'i rtags/ kha mkhris pa zad pa'i rtags/ga bad kan 'phel pa'i rtags/ nga rlung nad zad pa'i rtags/12 sems la sdug bsngal chen po byung ba'i dbang gis/ ( )ka lus stobs nyams/ kha mdangs zad/ ga rlung nad bskyed/nga mkhris pa 'phel/13 lce skam dmar rtsub kha ro bska ba bro ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ( )ka rlung gi mtshan nyid rtsub yang dang bye brag khyab byed kyis bskyed/ kharlung gi mtshan nyid yang g.yo phra bas khrag mkhris tsha ba skyed pa las byung / garlung rgyu ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ nga rang bzhin yang g.yo yin par phyir/14rlung nad sbo 'khrog byed cing dgong dang tho rengs zhu dus su na ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/( )ka rang gnas long du babs pas sbo 'khrog byed pa dang rlung dri ma la 'bab cing bye brag me mnyam gyi dbang gis zhu rjes su na/ kha rlung gi mtshan nyid yang g.yo gtso bor 'phel ba/ ga rlung gi gnas dang dus babs pa/nga rlung gi rang gsang yin pa'i phyir/15 mkhris pa 'khrugs pas mgo bo na ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ( )ka mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid 'phel ba/ kha me'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ ga mkhris pa me'i rang bzhin gyi rlangs pa gyen du rgyu ba/ nga54

rno tsha gnyis ches cher 'phel ba/16skrangs pa rnag tu mi khug la tsha ba smin dka' zhing lto bar sbyongs mi thebs pa ni/( )ka bad kan gyi brtan pa nad du gyur pa'i rtags/ kha rlung gi phra ba nad du gyur pa'i rtags/ ga rlung gi sra ba nad du gyur pa'i rtags/nga bad kan gyi rtul ba nad du gyur pa'i rtags/17 skyes pa'i nad la dbye ba/ ( )ka lnga/ kha bzhi/ ga gsum/ nga gnyis/18 rlung nad rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ ( )ka bcu gnyis/ kha drug ga nyi shu/ nga bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/19 mkhris nad rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ ( )ka bdun/ kha gsum/ ga lnga/ nga nyer lnga/20 nam tshong spyir gnas pa'i nad rigs dbye ba/ ( )ka lnga/ kha dgu/ ga bzhi/ nga gnyis/21 tsha ba sde drug gi nad 'bab sa'i gnas ni/ ( )ka lus stod/ kha phyi gnas/ ga phyi nang kun khyab/ ngadon snod/22 smyo brjed gnyis 'bab sa'i gnas ni/ ( )ka sems/ kha lus/ ga snying / ngadabang shes/23 yon tan bsil snum phyi bas bad kan bsgongs nas ldang mi nus pa ni/( )ka mtshan nyid kyi chos mi mthun pa/ kha dgun smad dus su lhag par grang ba/ ga bad kan lngi rtul brtan pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa/nga dngos po'i chos nyid/55

24mig ni don snod rnams las ( )me tog yin/ka snying / kha glo ba/ ga mcher ba/ nga mchin pa/25 bad kan nad gsog pa'i dus ni/ ( )ka ston/ kha dgun/ ga sos ga nga dbyar/26 bad kan nad kyi ldang dus ni/ ( )ka dbyar/ kha ston ka ga dpyid ka nga dgun smad/27 bad kan gyi nad ldang ba'i ro ni/ ( )ka mngar kha bska/ kha tsha skyur bska/ ga tsha mngar kha/ ngakha tsha bska/28 sha rus kun la gnas pa'i nad ni/ ( )ka dreg kha rkang 'bam/ ga grum bu/ nga dreg grum/29 tsha ba'i nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni/ ( )ka nyoms rmongs/ kha zhe sdang / ga bdag med/ nga ma rig pa/30 rlung nad gsog pa'i dus kyi ngo bo/ ( )ka dro snum/ kha bsil/ ga lci rtul/ nga yang rtsub/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 nad rnams kyi khyad par gyi rgyu ni/ ( )ka 'dod chags/ kha zhe sdang / ga gti mug nga nyes gsum/ ca ma rig pa/2 nad kyi rgyu de rnams mngon sum du skyed pa'i rkyen ni/ ( )ka skye mched/ kha zas spyod/ ga dus ga/don/ nga56

gsog ldang / ca slong rkyen/3 dbang yul lnga bo log pa'i spyod pa ni/ ( )ka shin tu nye dang ring ba/ kha shas cher gtad pa/ ga ha cang che'am chung ba/ nga 'jigs su rung ba/ ca mi sdug pa/4mkhris nad zhi ba'i yon tan ni/ ( )ka rtul/ kha rno ba/ ga skya/ nga lci/ ca snum/5 bad kan gyi nad gsog pa'i yon tan ni/( )ka lngi/ kha snum/ ga bsil/ nga rtul/ca brtan/6 mkhris nad gsog ldang zhi ba'i dus ni/( )ka dbyar dus/ kha ston dus/ ga dgun stod/ ngadagun smad/ ca dpyid dus/7 nad kun slong bar byed pa'i thun mong gi rkyen ni/( )ka 'byung ba'i dus gdon/ kha mi 'phrod pa'i zas dang dug gagaso ba log pa/ nga sngon las rnam smin/ ca nyon mongs/8 mkhris nad kyi slong rkyen du 'gro ba'i zas spyod ni/( )ka tsha ba'i ro dang rno tsha'i rigs bsten drags pa/ kha zho dang dar ba sogs yun tu bsten pa/ ga sa sran brkos pa dang rdo dbyug gis brdungs pa/ nga ri sgog dang rjen zas sogs bsten pa/ ca yid thang chad pa'i bar du ngus pa/9 rlung nad kyi gnas sa ni/ ( )ka dpyi mig rus tshigs/ kha rna ba'i dbang bo/ ga ma zhu ba'i gnas/ nga long ga ca sna lce'i dbang bo/10 lus zungs bdun las khrag 'phel na ni/ ( )ka khong 'bras skyed/ kha mcher nad 'byung / ga khrag mkhris 'phel/ nga rus tshigs 'gyur/ ca za 'phrug langs/57

11 lus zungs rnams kyi dwangs ma mthar thug pa mdangs zad pas/ ( )ka dngangs shing skrag snang skye/ kha lus stobs nyams/ ga mi dga' ba'i blo skye/ nga mgo bo 'khor/ ca sna khrag 'dzag12 nad byung ba rgyu'i sgo nas dbye na/ ( )ka nyes gsum/ kha dug gsum/ ga tshe rabs sngon las/ ngadug gdon mtshon/ ca lus sems/13 mkhris nad rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ ( )ka thang la lhag pa/ kha kha lud/ ga rtsar rgyug ngaganas gyur/ ca mdog gsal/14ldan pa'i 'phel zad las mnyam pa zhes pa ni/ ( )ka rlung mkhris gnyis mnyam du zad pa lta bu/ kha rlung mkhris gnyis mnyam du 'phel ba lta bu/ ga bad rlung gnyis cha mnyam du 'phel ba lta bu/ nga bad mkhris gnyis mnyam du 'phel ba lta bu/ ca bad mkhris gnyis cha mnyam du 'phel ba lta bu/15 gzhan rgyud bla gnyan nad la dbye na/ ( )ka zhugs pa/ kha log pa/ ga lhag pa/ nga 'doms pa/ca 'khrugs pa/16don snod spyir gnas pa'i nad ni/ ( )ka ma zhu ba/ kha sur ya/ ga rgyu gzer/ nga tshad 'khru/ca skyugs pa/17 rlung 'phel pa'i rtags ni/ ( )ka sha skem la nag kha bkres shas che/ ga smra ba mang / ngaganyid yer ba/ ca mgo yom 'khor ba/18 'dus pa'i 'phel zad la mtshungs gcig ni/ ( )ka rlung 'khrugs pa'i rtags/ kha mkhris pa 'khrugs pa'i rtags/ gabad rlung gnyis 'thab pa'i rtags/ nga rkyang ba 'phel zad kyi rtags 58

min/19 bad kan nad kyi slong rkyen du 'gro ba'i zas spyod ni/( )ka mi theg bzhin khur ba/ kha ri sgog dang rjen zas bsten drags pa/ga zho dar yun du bsten pa/ nga gnyid yun chag pa/20 mkhris pa 'phel ba'i rtags ni/ ( )ka lus tsha la thur du 'khru bar byed/ kha gnyid dang skom dad che ba/ga dbugs mi bde ba/ nga bshang gci ser/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/'phel 'grib/ rang gi ldang tshad las lhag par 'phel ba'am nyung du zad pa/nad/ lus kyi 'byung ba ma snyoms pa/phung bo lnga/ gzugs kyi phung bo/ tshor ba'i phung bo/ 'du shes kyi phung bo/'du byed kyi phung bo/ rnam par shes pa'i phung bo bcas lnga'o/ /'dod chags/ yul yid du 'ong ba'i rigs la 'dod pas chags par 'dzin pa'i don/zhe sdang / yul yid du mi 'ong ba'i rigs la khro zhing 'khon du 'dzin pa'i don/gti mug blang dor legs nyes kyi gnas mi shes pa'i don/skye mched/ nad kyi rnam pa mang du 'phel zhing stobs 'phel ba'am mched par byed pa'o/ /gsog ldang / skye zhing mched pa'i nad de nyid rang gnas su gsog cing gzhan gnas su ldang bar byed pa/slong rkyen/ rang gnas su bsags pa de nyid slar mngon sum du 59

slong bar byed pa'o/ /dman/ rang gi rang bzhin las zhan pa/lhag rang gi rang bzhin las lhag pa/log rang gi mtshan nyid las phyin ci log pa/shugs bkag 'byung bzhin du mi gtong bar yar bkag pa/btsir gcus/ mi 'byung bzhin du nan gyis btsir ba/ma rig pa/ rig pa'i ye shes kyi ldog zla/kha mngal/ ro mi gsal ba/zho ras/ nu zho rul ba/la phug ras/ la phug rul nas yun ring 'gor ba'i rnying pa/las mtha' ring / sgyid lug pa'am rgyud ring ba/ga chad ngus/ yid thang chad du ngus pa/mi 'phrod zas/ kha zas mi 'phrod pa'i rigs lhan cig sbyar nas bsten pa/gso ba log sman pas gso bya'i yul dang gnyen po gnyis go log tu song ba/tshad gung / nyin gung /'dzing ga bgye ba/ lus kyi shugs bskyed de phan tshun drag tu 'gran pa/bang mchongs/ drag tu rgyugs pa/shu ba/ pags pa rtsub la thor ba mes 'tshigs pa ltar rim bzhin rma ru 'gyur ba'i pags nad/mdzer ba/ lus kyi pags pa'i steng du gzer bu btab pa dang 'dra nyam ba'i pags nad cigango khab/ pags mdog skya phra sogs kyis ngo gdong g.yogs pa'i pags nad cigaser can/ gro dang sran ma sogs skam thag ma chod pas rlon zhing gsher ba'i rigs/60

gsar thog gro dang sran ma sogs brngas ma thag pa'i lo tog gsar ba/sungs pa/ 'bru rigs sogs yun ring lon nas rnying pa/skom sha rtol shartsi mar/ rtswa dang me tog sogs kyi dwangs ma las byung ba'i 'o ma'i snying po mar la'o/ /rjen pa/ rlon pa'am ma 'tshos pa/khengs pa'i zas/ snyoms par 'tshos kyang yun lon pa'i zas la gomakhris nad/ lus kyi me khams 'khrugs pa las byung ba'i tsha ba'i nad/reg bya/ lus kyi dbang bos reg par bya ba'i yul gyi ming /rul myags/ rul zhing ldur ba'am 'dal ba'i don/rtun ngas/ brda rnying ste bstud drags pa'am cher 'jug pa'i don/brnab sems/ gzhan pa'i rgyu nor la 'dod sems sam ham sems 'chang ba'i don/yen la gtad pa/ zas spyod gang zhig rgyun bsrings nas bsten pa'i don/sha rid/ sha shed skyo ba'am zhan pa'i don/lo shur/ sran ma dang la phug sogs kyi lo ma'i rigs rnyil ba/khong snyom/ brda rnying ste sgyid lug pa'i don/g.yung ba/ chung ba'am zhan pa'i don/phrum ser khyer/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams zum zhing ba spu 'greng ba'i don/dkyel che ba/ nad stobs che zhing 'phel myur ba'i don/dbang bo lnga la me tog shar ba/ mig sogs dbang bo lnga la nad zhugs pa'i don/ /bla gnyan/ sngar yod pa'i nad kyi steng du slar yang nad gzhan zhig bsnon mar byung ba'i don/ /nam tshong / spyir sgrog rus ske stong nas gre ba'i bar gyi spyi ming ngo / /g.yan pa/ pags nad za 'phrug gi ming / /61

glang shu/ rma shu don nas glang gi gnya' pags ltar mthug mkhregs chags pa'i pags nad/za rkong / za 'phrug langs nas lkog shun bud de rkong bur gyur pa'i pags nad/zags chu/ don snod skran dang bcas pa'i gnas su chus khengs pa'i don/'khyims chu/ pags pa dang snod kyi phyi rol dang bcas pa chus khengs pa'i don/rnam par bcad pa/ rbad kyis chod pa'i don/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 nad can nad med ces pa ni rgyu'i dbang du byas pa yin/( )2 gsog pa'i ngo bo ni rang gnas su gsog cing gzhan gnas su 'khrugs pa/( )3 kha zas lci snum rang bzhin bsil ba dang bcas bsten tshe bad kan ldang /( )4rlung gsog dus ni bad kan zhi ba'i dus kho na nyid do/( )5 ro kha ba bsten pas rlung nad kho na slong bar byed/( )6 rtsa rgyud stong ba ni mi 'phar ba'o/ /( )7 mdangs 'phel bas tsho che zhing lus mi bde/( )8skrangs pa rnag tu mi smin pa ni mtshan nyid brtan rtul sra ba bcas las 'byung /( )9 skrangs pa'i nad 'phel 'grib skyen pa ni mtshan nyid tsha rno g.yo ba'i dbang gis so/ /( )10 bad kan rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na drug yod/( )11 kha zas snum pa bsten drags pas bad mkhris gnyis ka slong bar byed/62

( )12 rlung khrag pus mor babs pa ce spyang mgo dang rlung skrangs gnyis nor nyen che/( )13 pags pa ni bad mkhris gnyis kyi thun mong gi gnas yin/( )14ldang ba ni nad kyi ngo bo yin/( )15 bad kan mgul 'gag la pho rub kyi nad ces kyang zer/( )16 ma zhu bar rdzas kyis dbye na sngo chu zhag gsum/( )17 ma zhu chung ngu la rgyam tshwa bzhi thang gtong /( )18 rlung mi ldang ba'i mgo gnon ni bad po/ri ldang ba'i yon tan no/ /( )19 kha ba'i ro bsten drags pas bad rlung gnyis ka'i nad slong /( )20 zhi ba'i ngo bo ni nad gang zhig zas spyod sman dpyad bzhis mgo mnan te mi ldang ba la bya'o/ /( )21 zhe sdang drag pos mkhris nad 'phral du bskyed do/ /( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 'phel 'grib nad ces pa'i go don ci/lan/ rgyu rkyen gang rung zhig gis nad dang lus zungs dri ma gsum po rang rang gi ldang tshad dang / byed las/ rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid sogs las gzhan gnas su 'phel ba'am zad pa de la'o/ /2 nad kun thun mong gi slong rkyen de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ nad kun slong bar byed pa'i thun mong rkyen/ /'byung ba'i dus dang gdon dug mi 'phrod zas/ /gso ba log dang las ngan sad las 'byung / /zhes pa'o/ /3 rkyen bzhi zhes pa gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ dus dman lhag log pa dgun gcer bur sdod pa lta bu dang / gdon glo bur ba bdud dang rgyal pos 'tshe ba/ zas mi mkhas pa nyi mar sha chang bza' ba lta 63

bu/ spyod lam mi mkhas pa tshad dus pags gos gyon nas nyi mar sdod pa lta bu bcas so/ /4nad kyi ngo bo zhes pa ci ltar yin nam/lan/ lus la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gsum po phyi nang gi rkyen gyi phrad de rnam par gyur nas cha mi snyoms par 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum du gyur pa de ni nad kyi ngo bo ste/ des lus dang srog la gnod cing zug rngu'i gdung pa skyes nas mthar srog kyang 'joms par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /5 khyad par gyi rgyus nad so so ba gang dang gang bskyed dam/lan/ ma rig pa las byung ba'i rgyu 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum las 'bras bu rlung mkhris bad kan bskyed pa'o/ /6 zung 'jug rlung zhes tsha grang gnyis kar khyab par gsungs pa dang / rtsa rgyud las rlung dang bad kan grang ba chu yin zhes pa gnyis nang 'gal yod dam/lan/ nang 'gal med de/ tsha grang gnyis la 'jug pa ni byed las la dgongs pa dang / grang bar bshad pa ni mtshan nyid la dgongs pa yin/7 nad kyi rgyu de rnams phan tshun gyi 'brel ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu de dag gcig gi nyer len gcig gis byed pa'am/ gcig gi rten gcig gis byed par ltos nas ring rgyu dang nye rgyu ru bzhag pa yin zhing / de yang ma rig pa ni nad thams cad kyi rgyu'i rten byed pas na spyi ring rgyur bzhag pa yin zhing /de las skyes pa'i 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum ni rlung mkhris bad kan gsum skyed par byed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i don gyis khyad par gyi rgyur bzhag la/ rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ni rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i skad cig la 'phel zad 'khrugs te nad du 'gyur bas na nad kyi ngo bo'am nye rgyur bzhag pa bcas yin zhing /de bas spyi'i rgyu ni rtsa ba lta bu dang / khyad par rgyu ni yal 'dab lta bu/ nye ba'i rgyu ni 'bras bu'i tshul du 'brel zhing gnas pa'o/ /8 mkhris pa 'khrugs pas lus zungs bsreg pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ dus sogs rkyen 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad pas mkhris pa'i rang bzhin de 64

nyid 'khrugs par gyur te/ lus zungs bdun dang zhugs nas dri ma rnams kyang bsrul zhing rul ba'i rnam par gtong bas na bsreg ces smos pa'o/ /9 mkhris pa zhes bya ba'i nad kyi ngo bo ci ltar yin nam/lan/ mkhris pa zhes bya ba'i nad 'di'i ngo bo ni me'i rang bzhin tsha bar gnas pas na lus smad kyi char rgyu ma sogs la gnas na yang 'bras bu stod du ngang gis 'bar zhing rgyas par byed pa'o/ /10 bad kan 'khrugs pas lus kyi me drod 'joms pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gtso bo be snabs 'byar bag can de nyid 'phel ba las me drod kyis 'ju dka' ba dang / bsil ba 'phel ba las grang ba'i stobs cher rgyas nas pho ba'i me drod bsad pa yin no/ /11 skye mched dbang po'i sgo nas nad kyi rkyen du gyur tshul ci ltar yin nam/lan/ lce sogs dbang bo mnar dang nyams bde min/ /zhes pa las 'phros te dbang lngas yul lnga so sor spyad pa dman pa sogs gsum te nad slong bar byed pa de la zer/12 rlung gi gsog ldang zhi gsum gyi mtshan gzhi ci ltar yin nam/lan/ kha zas rtsub cing snum bag med pa sogs rang nyid dro ba dang ldan pa dang yang na dro ba'i kha zas nyid dang lhan cig tu za ba ni rlung nad gsog pa dang / gsog pa de la kha zas bsil ba grang mo dang 'phrad tshe rlung nad langs te na bar byed pa/ de la kha zas snum bag la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan pa dro bar byed pa ni rlung nad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /13 mkhris pa gsog ldang zhi gsum gyi mtshan gzhi ci ltar yin nam/lan/ kha zas rno ba sogs rang nyid bsil bag ldan pa'am yang na bsil ba'i kha zas nyid dang lhan cig za ba ni mkhris pa gsog pa dang der kha zas tsha bag dang ldan pa bsten pa las ldang zhing / de la kha zas mngar bag can yon tan rtul ba sogs bsil bag can sbyar ba ni mkhris nad zhi bar byed do/ /14 bad kan gsog ldang zhi gsum gyi mtshan gzhi ci ltar yin nam/65

lan/ kha zas rtsub pa ma yin par lngi zhing snum bag can de bsil ba'i kha zas nyid dang lhan cig tu za ba ni gsog pa dang / gsog pa de kha zas drod mo'i rigs dang 'phrad tshe bad kan gyi nad langs te na bar byed la/ de la kha zas snum bag med pa skya bo'i rigs sogs rtsub pa dang sbyar bas bad kan nad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /15 dus ma yin par gsog ldang 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ gsog ldang dus gcig tu 'byung ba dka' la byung tshe nad gzhi stobs dang ldan pa yin pas dus kho na la babs shing zas spyod dus gdon 'ga' zhig gis 'phral du gsog ldang zhi gsum 'byung ba'ang yod do/ /16 gsog ldang zhi ba'i ngo bo ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gsog pa'i ngo bo zhes pa ni zas spyod yul dus sogs kyi rkyen pas nad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum rang rang gi gnas su 'phel zhing gsog pa dang / gsog pa'i ngo bo log pa'i lam du zhugs nas na zug bskyed cing rtsa chu sogs phyi yul du rang rang gi nad rtags rnams gsal bor ston pa ni ldang ba'i ngo bo/ rang gnas su ldang tshad ltar mnyam par gnas pa ni zhi ba'i ngo bo'o/ /17 sos dus rlung nad gsog pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/lan/ dpyid ka 'das nas dbyar gyi char rlung ma rgyas pa'i bar so ga'i dus de ni nyi ma byang bgrod gyi mthar thug pa nyi ma'i stobs dang ldan pa'i dbang gis phyi rol du'ang shin tu rno tsha rtsub pa'i ngo bor gyur te nyi ma'i stobs kyis zla ba bsil ba'i rang bzhin can gyi yon tan snum pa rnams zad par byed pas yul dus kyang rtsub ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur nas dus de'i tshe rlung rang gnas su 'phel zhing gsog par byed pa yin no/ /18 nad kun slong bar byed pa'i thun mong gi rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ nad kun thun mong du slong bar byed pa'i rkyen ni sos ka sogs 'byung ba'i dus dang / 'byung po mi ma yin pa gdug rtsub can la sogs pa'i gdon/'phral du srog 'dor bar byed pa'i nyes pa 'khrugs par gyur pa la sogs pa'i dugakha zas mi 'phrod pa bsten pa/ sman pa'i gso bya'i yul dang gnyen po gnyis go log 66

tu song ba/ tshe rabs snga ma'i las ngan sad pa bcas kyis nad sna mi 'dra ba dpag med 'byung ba'o/ /19rkyen bzhi bo nyes par phog kyang des lus zungs nyen par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/lan/ zungs bdun dang nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kan de dag rten dang brten pa'i tshul du 'brel ba'am ngo bo bdag nyid gcig tu 'brel phyir rkyen bzhi nyes par phog kyang lus zungs nyen pa'o/ /20 nad dang lus zungs rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gtso bo phan tshun gyi gnas las bya ste/ spyir gnod byed gsum mam brten pa po lus kyi gnas phra zhing phra bas spyi khyab du gnas la lus chags gnas 'jig gsum gyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / 'dir shas che chung tsam las/ brten pa rlung rten rus pa la gnas pa dang / brten pa mkhris pa rten khrag rngul la gnas pa/ brten pa bad kan rten lhag ma ste dwangs ma sha tshil rus rkang khu ba bshang gci bcas la gnas pa bcas rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba grub bo/ /21 lus zungs 'phel zad kyi rgyu rkyen gang gis byed dam/lan/ gtso bo mkhris pa 'ju byed kyis byed de/ me drod zhan pas dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rgyu byas te khrag dang sha la sogs pa rnams kyang rang rang gi me drod kyis ma smin pa'i phyir phyi ma phyi ma'i zungs rnams kyang cher 'phel zhing 'khrugs te so so'i nad rtags ston par byed la/ de bzhin du pho ba'i me drod spyi dang bye brag me drod rnams kyi stobs 'bar drags nas kha zas kyi dwangs ma skem par 'gyur zhing / dwangs ma skem par gyur pa na khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs phyi ma phyi ma rnams kyang rim bzhin du zad cing 'grib par gyur nas zad pa'i rtags rnams ston par byed pa'o/ /22 nyes gsum 'phel ba'i rtags gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ de rtags rlung 'phel skem nag drod la dga'/ /lus 'dar lto ba sbo zhing bshang ba sri/ /smra mang mgo 'khor stobs gnyid dbang bo nyams/ /mkhris pa 'phel bas bshang gci lpags mig ser/ /bkres skom lus tsha gnyid chung 'khru bar byed/ /bad kan 67

'phel bas drod nyams zas mi 'ju/ /lus lci mdog dkar khong snyom yan lag lhod/ /mchil mang lud pa gnyid che dbugs mi bde/ /zhes pa'o/ /23 mkhris pa 'khrugs pa'i rtags gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ mkhris pa 'khrugs rtags rtsa rgyas phra grims mgyogs/ /chu mdog dmar ser dri dugs rlangs pa che/ /mgo na sha tsha kha ro skyur la kha/ /lce steng bad kan che la sna sgo skam/ /mig sprin dmar ser gzer ba gcig tu 'dril/ /nub gnyid chung la nyin par gnyid mi thub/ /lud pa dmar ser tsha drod skom dad che/ /khrag mkhris 'khru skyugs rngul che dri ma mnam/ /kha dog dmar ser smin cing 'dril bar byed/ /nyin gnyid mtshan dgung zhu ba'i dus na na/ /zhes pa'o/ /24rlung nad dbye ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rlung nad dbye ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni/ /rigs kyis dbye na rlung nad nyi shu ste/ /gnas kyis dbye na 'jug sgo rnam pa drug / dbang bo lnga la me tog shar dang bdun/ /bye brag srog 'dzin la sogs rnam gyur lnga/ /bad kan mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru 'dod/ /dbye ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rlung gi nad/ /ces pa'o/ /25 nyes gsum rkyang ba'i 'phel zad dbye ba bco brgyad de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ nyes gsum rkyang ba'i 'phel zad bco brgyad ni/ rkyang ba gsum po de yang 'phel zad kyi dbye bas 'di ltar 'gyur te rlung 'phel ba tsam dang / rlung rab tu 'phel ba/ rlung gong na med par mchog tu 'phel ba bcas gsum dang / de bzhin du zad pa bcas gsum ste de ltar rlung 'phel zad kyi dbye ba drug byung ba ltar bad mkhris gnyis la'ang sbyar bas rkyang ba'i 'phel zad kyi dbye ba drug gsum bco brgyad 'byung ba yin no/ /26bad kan grum bu dkar po zhes pa rgyu mtshan gang la brten nas bshad pa yin nam/lan/ bad kan grum bu dkar po zhes bya ba/ /ma zhu rang gnas bad kan 'phel ba yis/ /pho ba mchin pa gang yin cha med na/ /kha zas ci zos mi zhim 'khru 68

skyugs byed/ /nywa gzhi mig rus na zhing chu tshan 'byung / /mjug tu yan lag la byer grum bu 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /27 bad kan smug po zhes pa'i go don de gang yin nam/lan/ bad kan smug po'i nad ces pa ni nad kyi rgyu dang rang mdog la bltos nas btags pa'i ming ste/ mtshon bya rgyu yi 'dus pa rlung mkhris bad kan gsum dang khrag dang chu ser bcas kyi rgyu'i rang bzhin 'dus pa'i nad yin pa dang / mtshon byed nad khams kyi rang mdog sngo ser dkar dmar sogs 'dres pa smug po'i mdangs su shar bas na smug por bshad pa'o/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1nad rnams kun gyi rgyu ni gcig pu ste/ /zhes par don 'grel byos/'grel/ spyir phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen ci rigs pas nad 'phel zhing 'khrugs nas nad kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa'i ngang tshul grangs med du gyur pa rnams kyis lus nyid nye bar gzir bar 'gyur zhing de dag so sor rgyu re yod mod du zin kyang /de dag re re nas 'di'i rgyu ni 'di yin no zhes sus kyang bstan par mi nus pa'i phyir nad kyi rnam grangs de rnams kun gyi thun mong ba'i rgyu ni gcig pu ste/ bdag med don ma rtogs pa'am ma rig pa zhes bya ba de yin la/ dper na bya gshog rtsal dang ldan pa gang zhig nam mkha'i mthongs la lding gyur kyang / rang gi gzugs las byung ba'i grib ma de skad cig tsam la yang rang gi lus dang mi 'bral ba de bzhin du/ 'gro ba sems can kun kyang re zhig nad med tha mal du bde bar gnas shing rang rang gi phun tshogs kyi dpal la longs spyod par byed na'ang ma rig pa de nyid thog ma med pa nas rgyud la yongs su grub pa'i rkyen gyis nad 'byung ba'i rgyu de dang ji srid bar 'bral bar mi srid pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ /2nye rgyu rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gsum/ /rnam par ma gyur nad kyi rgyur 'gyur la/ /rnam gyur ma snyoms nad kyi ngo bo yin/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/69

'grel/ nad kun gyi dngos rgyu'am nye rgyu ni mi'i khams la gnas pa'i rlung mkhris bad kan gsum yin la/ de la ci'i phyir nye rgyu zhes zer na lus srog la gnod cing zug rngu'i gdung ba mtha' dag dngos su bskyed pa'i phyir dang / de yang nyes gsum slong byed rkyen bzhi bo gang rung dang ma 'phrad pa'i gnas skabs der rnam par ma gyur pa nad kyi rgyu zhes dang / rkyen gang rung dang 'phrad pas rnam par gyur tshe nad kyi ngo bo yin/3 de ltar rgyu la rkyen gyis bskyed byas nas/ /'jug pa'i tshul ni 'phang bya'i yul de la/ /'phen par byed pa'i rkyen ni rnam bzhi yis/ /'phen bya gcig la phog dang 'brel bas dpag /ces par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ 'di ni bya byed las gsum gyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ dper na mda' 'phang bya'i yul lam 'ben lta bu rlung mkhris bad gsum de la 'phen par byed pa'i mi lta bu'i rkyen dus gdon zas spyod bcas rnam pa bzhi'i byed pa des mda' lta bu'i rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang rjes su mthun pa'i yang rtsub sogs kyi yon tan rnams 'phang ba'i bya ba des 'ben lta bu'i rlung mkhris bad gsum gang rung gcig la phog pa'i las de dang 'brel ba las gzhan rnams kyang dpag dgos pa'o/ /4dang po nyes pa 'phel dang zad pa'i rgyu/ /zas spyod mi 'dod slong dang mi 'phrod 'phrod/ /spang spyin de dang des 'phel zad par 'gyur/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ dang po rlung mkhris bad kan bcas nyes pa rnams 'phel zad kyi rgyu gtso bo ni/ mi gang zhig nad 'phel ba dang zad pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe zas spyod log pa yid la 'dod de/ dper na sha chang sogs mngar ba'i zas skom dang dro zhing dal ba'i spyod lam rigs yid la mi 'dod cing de'i dbang gis ma bsten pa spang drags pa sogs mdor na zas spyod gang yang lus khams dang nad gzhi la 'phrod dang mi 'phrod/ zhib tu ma brtag par 'dod pa kho na'i dbang gis snga ma spang drags pa de rlung 'phel ba dang / phyi ma bsten drags pa de rlung zad par byed do/ /70

5de ltar phan tshun rten dang brten pa'i tshul/ /nyes pa 'khrugs pas lus zungs nyen byas te/ /gnyis kas dri ma la ni gnod par byed/ /ces par rgyas 'grel gyis/ 'grel/ dwangs ma la sogs gnod bya bcu rnams rten dang / rlung sogs gnod byed nyes pa rnams brten pa po'i tshul du phan tshun nye bar 'brel zhing gnas pa'i phyir/ rkyen dus gdon zas spyod bzhi bo las byung ba'i yang rtsub sogs rlung mkhris bad kan gsum po gang rung gi mtshan nyid dang rjes su mthun pa'i yon tan des rang gi chos dang mthun pa'i nyes pa der phog pa'i tshe/ thog mar nyes pa de nyid rang gi gnas dang ldang tshad las 'khrugs par gyur pa des dwangs ma sogs rang gi rten yin pa'i lus zungs rnams la gnod cing nyen par byed pa dang / de ltar nyes pa 'khrugs pa dang lus zungs nyen pa gnyis kas bshang pa la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams la gnod par byed pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ka 2 ga 3 kha 4kha 5 nga 6 ga 7 kha 8ka 9 ga 10 kha 11 ka 12 kha 13 ka 14ka15 ga 16 ga 17 nga 18ga 19 kha 20 ka 21ga 22 ka 23 kha 24nga 25 kha 26 ga 27 nga28 ga 29 kha 30 ngaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 ka kha ga 2 ka nga ca 3 ka ga nga ca 4ka ga nga 5 ka kha ga6 ka kha ga 7 ka kha ga nga 8 ka ga 9 ka kha nga 10 ka kha ga11 ka kha ga 12 ka ga 13 ka kha ga nga 14ka kha ga nga ca15 ka kha nga 16 ka kha ga nga 17 ka ga nga ca 18 ga nga 1971

kha ga 20 ka ngabazhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 ྾ 2 ྾ 3 tsu 4tsu 5 ྾ 6 ྾ 7 ྾8 tsu 9 tu 10 tsu 11 du 12 ྾ 13 ྾14du 15 tsu 16 ྾ 17 snyo 18 tsu 19 tsu20 ྾ 21 ྾sa bcad lnga ba/ tha mal nad med/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 bya ba spyod lam gnas kyi brjod bya gtso bo ni/( )ka gnas skabs 'phral gyi spyod lam/ kha zas skom bsten tshul dang lus sbyong gi spyod lam/ ga nyin re bzhin rgyun tu spyod pa dang / dus dang mthun pa'i spyod lam/ nga gnas skabs 'phral gyi spyod lam/2nad kun slong ba'i rkyen gnyis ni/ ( )ka dus gdon/ kha zas spyod/ ga sman dpyad/ ngazas gdon/ 3 dang po tshe brkyang ba'i spyod lam la dbye ba/( )ka bcu gnyis/ kha bcu/ ga bcu gcig nga bcu bzhi/4dus min du gnyid bsten pas nyes pa ( )bskyed/ ka bad kan/ kha mkhris pa/ ga rlung / nga rims/5 dril phyis byas pa'i phan yon ni/( )ka dbang bo gsal la lus kyi stobs bskyed cing ngal dub sel/ kha bad kan sel zhing tshil 'ju la mdog gsal yan lag brtan par byed/ ga72

lto tshil 'ju zhing khrag 'phel ba'i nad sel la gnyid 'phel bar byed/ ngakhrag 'chag 'ju la dbang bo rnams yul la gsal bar byed/6mig bsrung thabs kyi sman mchog ni/( )ka skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ kha star khaṇ+ḍa/ ga bar shun khaṇ+ḍa/ ngaseng ldang khaṇ+ḍa/7 dus drug las lus stobs che chung gi go rim ni/ ( )ka dgun che zhing ston dpyid chung la dbyar sos 'bring / kha dpyid chung la dgun che zhing dbyar sos ston rnams 'bring / ga ston che la dpyid dbyar 'bring ba dgun dang sos ka chung / nga sos dang dbyar chung la stod dpyid 'bring dgun che/8 dgun stod kyi khyad chos gtso bo ni/ ( )ka kha ba 'bab pa dang sa gzhi 'khyags pas bsdams pa/ kha nam zla 'khyags pa dang lus drod khong du 'bar ba/ ga grang bas ba spu'i sgo bkag ste me drod khong du 'bar ba/ nga grang bas ba spu'i sgo bkag ste me drod 'bar bas lus zungs 'bri bar 'gyur ba/9 bod zla gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni/( )ka smin drug dang mgo zla ba/ kha rgyal dang mchu zla ba/ gdabo dang nag pa zla ba/ nga so ga dang snon zla ba/10dpyid dus bad kan sel ba'i ched du( )gtong /ka ni ru ha/ kha 'jam rtsi/ ga skyugs/ nga bshal/11 bad kan gsog pa'i dus ni/( )ka ston/ kha dbyar/ ga dpyid/ nga dgun/12 gnas skabs kyi spyod lam la rnam pa( )yod/ka gsum/ kha bcu bzhi/ ga bcu gsum/ nga drug13 'bru'i rigs rnams kyi ro dang zhu rjes phal cher/ ( )ka skyur/ kha mngar ba/ ga kha ba/ nga bska ba/73

14'bru la rigs kyi dbye ba/ ( )ka gnyis/ kha gsum/ ga lnga/ nga drug15zas dang skom gnyis su phye ba'i zas la don rnam pa( )yis bstan/ka gsum/ kha lnga/ ga bdun/ nga bzhi/16rim pa bzhin nus pa yang zhing 'ju sla ba'i 'bru rigs ni/( )ka rnying ba/ gsar thog smin pa/ kha rjen pa/ btsos pa/ g.yos su byas pa/ ga gsar thog rlon pa/ rnying ba/ nga bsregs/btsos/ rjen pa/17srog chags gnas tshul gyi dbang gis gnas rnam pa( )yod/ka gnyis/ kha drug ga gsum/ nga bzhi/18 ri dwags che ba'i khongs gtogs srog chags ni/( )ka rgya/ kha stag ga dom/ nga gnyan/19 snum rigs bzhi ni/( )ka mar dang sha tshil rkang / kha zhag dang til mar tshil/ gamar dang til mar tshil dang rkang / nga sha tshil zhag rkang /20 snum rigs mtha' dag gi mchog ni/( )ka mar gsar/ kha zhun mar/ ga rkang mar/ nga zo mar/21 skom rigs kyi sde la dbye ba/( )ka lnga/ kha bdun/ ga bzhi/ nga gsum/22 'o ma'i rigs las snying la gnod pa ni/ ( )ka ba yi 'o ma/ kha rta bong 'o ma/ ga lug gi 'o ma/ nga'abri yi 'o ma —23 chu yi sde las mchog tu gyur pa ni/( )ka gangs chu/ kha skar chu/ ga char chu/ nga chu mig24chang thams cad kyi ro ni/ ( )ka mngar skyur tsha/ kha mngar skyur kha/ ga tsha skyur bska/74

nga tsha bska mngar/25 pho bas 'ju dka' ba'i sha'i nus pa dang ngo bo'i rigs ni/ ( )ka sha skam sha rjen 'khyags po/ kha sha rjen 'khyags pa mer bsregs/ga sha rnying mer bsregs 'khyags po/ nga sha rjen btsos pa khengs pa/26 zas tshod ma zin pa zhes pa ni/ ( )ka zas tshod ma zin par mang du zos pa/ kha zas sna gcig yun ring du bsten pa/ ga zas sna mang po mnyam du zos pa/ nga zas nyung ba'am mang ba'i tshod ma zin pa/27 zas tshod 'dzin pa'i tshad du pho ba cha( ) ru bgos pa yin/ka gnyis/ kha gsum/ ga bzhi/ nga gcig28 dpyid stod kyi dus su ro drug las gang dag bsten dgos/ ( )ka mngar skyur lan tshwa/ kha kha tsha bska/ ga lan tshwa tsha skyur/nga mngar kha bska/29 sha'i rigs la srog chags kyi sde du( )yod/ka drug kha brgyad/ ga bcu/ nga bcu gnyis/30 dril phyis byas na gnas gang la bya dgos/ ( )ka lus stod/ kha lto ba/ ga brang ka nga rkang lagaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 dus min du gnyid bsten na/( )ka bad kan skyed/ kha skya sob tu skrangs/ ga cham rims 'byung / nga lus kun na/ ca pho ba sbos/2 dus rtag tu bsku byug bsten dgos pa'i yul/ ( )ka rgas pa rlung shas can/ kha lus ngag dub pa/ ga dbang bo 75

skyon can/ nga lus khams kyi stobs shin tu rid pa can/ ca byis pa/3 rtsol spyad bya mi rung ba/( )ka rgan po/ kha byis pa/ ga dar ma/ nga rlung mkhris nad/ ca bud med/ 4glo bur nad lnga zhes pa de gang dag yin/( )ka gag lhog kha glang thabs/ ga pho log nga nya logaca sna khrag mang du shor ba/5 tshad med bzhi zhes pa de( )yin/ka byams pa tshad med/ kha dga' ba tshad med/ ga snying rje tshad med/ nga smon pa tshad med/ ca btang snyoms tshad med/6 dgun stod ni bod zla( )yin/ka rgyal zla ba/ kha smin drug zla ba/ ga mgo zla ba/ ngadabyug pa zla ba/ ca snon zla ba/7 dbyar dus su zas skom kyi nus pa( )bsten dgos/ka yang ba/ kha lci ba/ ga dro ba/ nga snum pa/ carno ba/8 ston kha'i dus su ro( )bsten dgos/ka skyur/ kha mngar/ ga kha ba/ nga bska ba/ca tsha ba/9 shugs bcu gsum gyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/ ( )ka dbugs gnyid/ kha bshang gci/ ga g.yal sbrid/ ngabakres skom/ ca 'gro skyod/10 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la( )bcas so/ka zas tshul/ kha zas bsdam/ ga dus min bza' ba ngazas tshod 'dzin pa/ ca sha rigs kyi sde/11 'bru rigs 'bras kyi nus pa ni/ ( )76

ka snum pa/ kha skya ba/ ga yang ba/ nga bsil ba/ca 'jam pa/12 rlan la gnas pa'i sder gtogs pa'i srog chags ni/( )ka so bya/ kha 'phyi ba/ ga sram/ nga rtsangs pa/ca nya/13 rtsal mthus za ba'i srog chags ni/ ( )ka khra/ kha stag ga spyang ki nga glagaca ri bong /14lug sha'i nus pa ni/ ( )ka lci/ kha dro/ ga bsil/ nga snum/ca yang /15sgog skya'i nus pa ni/( )ka lci ba/ kha tsha ba/ ga snum/ nga rno ba/ca bsil/16 chu'i dbye ba rnam pa bdun gyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/ ( )ka gangs chu/ kha g.ya' chu/ ga rbab chu/ nga char chu/ca khron pa'i chu/17 chang la nus pa gang dag( )ldan/ka rno ba/ kha dro ba/ ga rtsub pa/ nga yang ba/ca tsha ba/18 zas rigs phan tshun mi 'phrod pa ni/ ( )ka nya sha dang 'o ma/ kha sha mo yungs dkar mar la brngos pa gakhyim bya sha dang lug sha/ nga shing tog dang zho/ ca nya sha dang tshal/19 zas tshod ma zin par tshad las thal drags na ( ) bskyed/ka ma zhu bsud nad/ kha ma zhu shing rengs/ ga gcong nad/nga lus stobs nyams pa/ ca rlung mkhris/77

20 pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs che chung la dpag nas pho ba cha bzhir bgos pa de ni/( )ka cha gnyis zas/ kha cha gcig skom/ ga cha gcig rlung rgyu'i gnas/ nga cha gcig 'ju byed gnas/ ca cha gsum bad kan gyi gnas/21 zas tshod ran par zin pa'i yon tan ni/ ( )ka me drod skyed pa/ kha dang ga bde ba/ ga dbang bo gsal ba/nga 'og rlung bde bar rgyu/ ca lus shed che/22 'o ma spyi'i phan yon ni/ ( )ka ro tsa bar byed/ kha khrag 'chag 'ju/ ga rlung mkhris sel/nga mdangs skyed/ ca lus brtan/23 rgas nad gso ba bcud len gyi phan yon ni/( )ka tshe bsring ba/ kha lus mdangs rgyas pa/ ga nad rigs bsrung ba/ nga blo rno ba/ ca pho long bde ba/24bcud len bya ba'i yul/ ( )ka sa phyogs gtsang la dben pa/ kha chu shing 'dzoms pa gamakha' rlung legs pa/ nga snyan mo gar la rol ba ca rang mos yul/25 rtsi bzhi bo ni/ ( )ka shug 'bru/ kha ba lu/ ga mtshe ldam/ nga 'om bu/ca mkhan pa/26 ro tsa bar byed pa'i dgos pa ni/ ( )ka nad med lang tsho rgyas pa/ kha bu tsha rigs rgyud skyed pa/ga yid sems dga' ba/ nga rnam shes dwangs pa/ ca blo sems bde ba/27 gsham gyi gang dag la khrus bsten mi rung( )78

ka sbrum ma/ kha tshad 'khru/ ga ma zhu ba/ nga cham pa/ca mkhal nad/28 rtsol ba spyad na phan yon gang ldan/ ( )ka lus yang / kha lus la sha rgyas/ ga me drod skyed/nga lus mdangs rgyas/29 skyugs pa bkag na skyon gang dag 'byung / ( )ka dbugs mi bde/ kha skya rbab/ ga lud pa 'phel/nga mgo yu 'khor ba/30 skye bo gang dag la zas skom mi 'phrod pa mi 'byung / ( )ka dar ma/ kha rgas pa/ ga rtsol bcag bya/ nga lus stobs ldan/gsum pa/ mi nga 'grel/rgyun spyod/ nyin re bzhin nam dus rgyun du nges par shes dgos pa'i spyod lam/dus spyod/ dus tshigs dbyar dgun sogs la shes par bya ba'i spyod lam/gnas spyod/ bshang gci sogs bkag drags pa ste gnas skabs shes par bya ba'i spyod lam/tshe brkyang / tshe brkyangs pa dang bsrings pa'i don/nad slong rkyen gnyis/ zas spyod mi mthun pa/mi bsrun/ rgyud rtsub pa'am spyod pa rtsub po'i don/smyung bya/ zas mi za bar ltogs par gnas dgos pa'i don/mi sdug mdzes po min pa'am yid du mi 'ong ba'i don/bkan byed/ gyen du ded pa'am 'khrig pa'i don/79

skabs phyed/ stod smad gzugs dbyibs sbom phra dang bcas pa dbye ba gsal bor phyed pa'i don/rismra dgu/ mang tshig ste smra ba yod tshad ces pa'i don/sbad kha lci ba/ don yod tshad dang bsam tshad tshang ma kha nas gang thon du shor mi rung ba'i don/tshig dron mi gzhug zol lam rdzun lhad zhugs pa'i gtam smra mi rung ba'i don/yan par mi btang / gnya' rengs sam rgya yan du mi gtong ba'i don/bsten rdzi/ bsten skor dang srung skyob kyi don/ngag 'khyam pa/ snying po med pa'i 'chal gtam bshad pa'i don/dbyen sbyor/ mthun pa 'byed pa'i gtam gyis dkrugs shing rgyag pa'i don/tha mal/ gzhan gyis ma bsgyur 'i/nga rang bzhin du gnas pa ste/ tha ces mi 'gyur bar tha tshig mal zhes pa rang mal du gnas pa'o/ /rdzi char/ lho phyogs kyi rlung dri zhim pa'i ngad ldang ba dang 'jam 'dres pa la zer/rab phra'i gos/ rgyu spun rab tu phra ba'i don/ tshobadag po can/ chos dang khyim gyi bdag po yod pa la zer/mig rtul/ mig mi rno ba ste gsal bo mi mthong ba/khron gyis brko ba/ rkang lag gis zas sogs brkos te 'tsho ba'i sde/skyur po/ yungs dkar dang la phug gi myug gu btsos te sran phye dang bsdebs te bsnyal bas langs pa la zer/bu rtsi/ bu mi skyes pa'i sman/brtan g.yung chu/ mtsho lta bu drag tu mi 'gro ba'am dal gyis 'gro ba'i chu/mo gsham/ phru gu mi skyes pa'i bud med spyi la goro tsa/ 'dod pa spyod nus pa ro dang tsa ni rigs rgyud spel nus pa 80

ste skabs 'dir khu ba 'phel ba'i don/cam la brling / spyang bo'am mdzangs pa ste 'tshab 'tshub med pa'i don/sngar drin mig ring blta/ sngar drin che ba mi brjed par mig gis ring bor blta ba/rgan pa bzhi/ yang rab thos pa'i rgan po/ rab rigs kyi rgan po/ 'bring nor gyi rgan pa/ tha ma na tshod kyi rgan pa bcas la'o/la yogs/ tshul min gyi bya ba byas pa'i 'bras bu rang steng du smin pa/des pa/ zhi zhing dul ba'am rang bzhin bzang bo/skad cig ma/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa brgya nyi shu la skad cig ma'o/ /dud rnon/ tsan dan dang a gar la sogs pa'i dud pa rnon po rngubs pa/kha bkang dbo ba/ tsan dan dang a gar la sogs chur sbangs pa'i sman chus khur ba bkang bar bya ba/gnya' rengs/ ske 'gyur mi shes pa/kha yo/ kha phyogs gcig tu yo ba/'gram chag rlung nad 'gram pa nyams pa'i don/gra ma can/ 'bru phub kyi rtse rno ba spu ltar gzengs pa de la bya/gud gud/ so sor zhes pa'i don/g.yas sbyar/ zas rigs kha shas bsres nas sbyar ba'am yang na tsha sdor spod dang bcas pa lhan cig du sbyar zhing bcos pa'i don/chag grugs/ chag nas gas grums shor ba'i don/khron/ rkang pa'am sder mo'i ming /rma 'jig rma kha gsos pa'i don/rgas sra/ rgas pa dal ba'i don/phrum gsar/ 'o ma'am zho kha'i spris ma bsags pa las byas pa/rmya/ nyams chung zhing sgyid pa shin tu skyur ba'i don/81

'bras chan/ 'bras rlangs btsos byas pa'i don/srus/ gro nas sogs 'bru rigs yongs su ma smin pa las byas pa/a sbyar/ rtsam par chu skol lam ja thang blugs te sla mor byas pa'i don/tshod ma'am tsha ba/ sngo tshod rigs kyi ming /rtug skem/ bshang ba skam po chags pa'i don/kha na ma tho/ 'jig rten na smad 'os su gyur pa'i nyes pa'i bya ba'i rigs/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 skye bo snum la bsten par byed pa rnams nang gi drod zhan pa'o/ /( )2 ri sgog thams cad 'ju dka' zas len lngi ba yin/( )3 lcum dang chu los mkhris skyed bad kan 'phel/( )4gnyid log gi spyod pa tshul bzhin ma spyad na stobs 'phrog la rlung 'phel bar 'gyur/( )5 dril phyis bad kan sel zhing tshil skyed pa dang yan lag brtan par byed/( )6 mig gi dbang bo ni mcher ba'i 'brel 'byor ram me tos/ lta bu yin/( )7 glo bur du 'phrad pa'i nad rnams lus srog la shin tu gnod pa yin/( )8dbyar gyi dus su zas skom dang spyod lam nus pa bsil dro snyoms pa bsten par bya/( )9bde ba 'dod pa rnams kyis zas skom sbyor ba shes shing mkhas pa ci nas gal che/ ( )82

10'bru kun gsar thog rlon pa lci la smin nas rnying bar gyur tshe yang ba yin/( )11skam gsher thun mong la gnas pa'i srog chags ni ri dwags che ba khung la gnas pa/ mis bdag byed kyi sde yin/( )12g.yag sha snum bsil rlung sel bad kan dang mkhris nad skyed/( )13nya sha snum dro pho ba'i nad dang dang ga 'byed par byed/( ) 14sngo rigs kun gyis rtsa sgo 'gag cing sman nus 'joms/( )15rtsam pa nus pa yang la 'jam dang lus stobs skyed par byed/( )16rtsa'i sgo rnams 'byed cing bad rlung gi nad dag skyed par byed pa ni g.yer ma yin/( )17'bri yi 'o mas bad mkhris nad la gnod/( )18chu bskol grang zhag gcig lon tshe nyes skyon gang yang med/( )19zas skom bsdams par bya ba ni dug dang ldan pa'i kha zas kho na'o/( )20zho chang dug sbags sbrang rtsi zos pa la rjes su chu bsil 'thung na phan pa yin/( )21ser sha sogs sha mo'i rigs yungs dkar gyi mar la brngos nas zos na gnod pa med/( )22mi 'phrod pa'i zas skom 'dris goms sgo nas cha yis bslab par bya/( )23cham pa dang skad 'gags sogs nam tshong nad la chu bskol btung na legs/( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas zhes pa'i go don ci yin nam/lan/ tshe ring bar 'dod pa rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba spyod pa 83

lam du ji ltar khyer ba'i spang blang zhib tu 'chad pas na bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas zhes bya ba yin no/ /2 nad kun rgyu las rkyen gyis bslang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ 'bras bu 'byung rung ba'i rgyu dngos su yod kyang rkyen dang ma phrad tshe rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba bya dngos kyi gshis lugs la mi srid pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /3 bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas la rnam pa du yi sgo nas bstan pa yin nam/lan/ thog ma nas nad rigs mi 'byung ba'i sngon 'gog dang phyis byung ba gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po bya ba spyod lam gyi gnas la bslab pa la/ nyin re bzhin dus rgyun du spyod par bya ba'i lam dang / dbyar dgun sogs dus khams dang bstun nas spyod par bya ba'i lam/ gnas skabs 'phral du spyod par bya ba'i lam bcas rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten pa'o/ /4gnyid log pa'i spyod pa ji ltar bsten dgos sam/lan/ mtshan gnyid ma log rtsub pas ci bder log /ma log nang par smyung bya phyed gnyid log / ra ro stobs zad mya ngan rtsol bas dub/ /smra mang rgas dang 'jigs pa'i mi rnams la/ /sos ka rtsub cing mtshan mo thung bas na/ /lus kyi stobs 'phrog rlung 'phel 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /nyin par gnyid log snum lcir 'gyur bas phan/ /gzhan du nyin gnyid bad kan skyed cing skrangs/ /rmongs bag mgo na sgyid skyur rims 'debs 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /5 lus khams la bsku mnye byugs pa bsten pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ rgas dus rtag tu lus khams la snum bsku zhing byugs pa dang mnye ba'i cho ga spyod pa des rgas pa'i nad las skyob par byed pa dang / rgas ka sra zhing tshe 'phel ba/ gnyid 'gug cing dbang bo gsal ba/ lus khams rgyas shing pags pa 'jam pa/lus ngal ba'i nad dang rlung gi nad kun 'joms par byed pa yin no/ /6 rtsol spyod ran par bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rtsol spyod ran par spyad pas lus khams yang zhing tshil 'bri ba dang /lus khams stod smad la sogs pa'i sbom phra'i cha rnams so sor phyed pas skye mched 84

gtsang ba/ lhag par du pho ba sogs me drod kyi cha shas thams cad skyed pa dang lus khams mkhregs shing brtan pa'i bya ba bcas 'byung ba yin/7 tshad med bzhi yi sems bskyed ces pa de gang dag yin nam/lan/ mya ngan nad phongs sdug dang ldan pa'i rigs la snying rje tshad med kyi sems bskyed dang / 'bu srin grog ma sogs srog chags phra mo dang bcas pa kun kyang rang srog dang 'dra bar byams pa tshad med kyi sems bskyed/ mi nang phan tshun smra ba gang yang bslu ba med par rnam dpyod kyi khong yangs shing bzhin 'dzum dang bcas drang por smra ba dga' ba tshad med kyi sems bskyed/ rang nyid la dgra ru 'dzin pa'i dgra bo la'ang 'khon du mi 'dzin par ci nus kyis phan gdags gtso bor byed pa btang snyoms tshad med kyi sems bskyed bcas so/ /8 tshe brkyang ba'i spyod lam de nad gzhi sngon 'gog byed pa'i thad rin thang gang ldan yod dam/lan/ tshe yun ring du brkyang zhing bsring bar bya ba'i 'gro 'dug dang gnyid log rtsol spyad la sogs pa dag ji bzhin rang gis nyin mtshan gang dang gang du gnas pa'am phyir 'gro bcas dus rtag tu sems la dran bzhin yid la 'jog dgos te/ de ltar rnam pa kun tu bsten na 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan rnams su sdug bsngal gyi snod du mi 'gyur ba dang tshe ring du bsring zhing bde ba'i rang bzhin du longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /9'jig rten mi chos kyi spyod pa der mi rnams kyi gshis spyod sogs legs 'gyur byed rgyu'i thad dngos yod kyi rin thang gang ldan yod dam/lan/ 'jig rten mi chos kyi spyod pa de rnams tshul bzhin spyad pas/ gang zag de dag snga sor gnyen 'khor ci yang med par rang nyid gcig pur skyes pa dag rang dbang gzhan la mi 'chor la/ snga sor bran g.yog gi lus su skyes kyang mthar skye bo mtha' dag gis bkur bar 'os pa'i dpon du 'gyur ba la the tshom ci yang med cing snyan grags dang bcas thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /10dam pa lha chos kyi spyod pa der mi rnams kyi sems rgyud dang gshis rgyud 85

'dul ba byed rgyur dngos yod kyi don snying gang ldan yod dam/lan/ dam pa lha chos kyi spyod pa des dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang /sdig grogs spang ba/ skyabs su 'gro zhing mi dge ba sdom pa/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la blo gtod pa/ tshad med bzhi'i sgo nas smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa nyams su len pa bcas gtso bor gsungs pas na mi rnams kyi sems rgyud dang gshis rgyud je legs su gtong bar don snying gal chen ldan no/ /11 nad kun slong bar byed pa'i rkyen spang dgos don ci/lan/ spyir nad slong bar byed pa'i rkyen las zas spyod gnyis rang la rtag tu 'grogs shing bsten par bya ba yin stabs yid kyis dran pa'i sgo nas rgyun du mi mthun pa'am mi 'phrod pa'i rigs ma spang na/ nad kun dngos su bskyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /12 nam zla dus drug gi spyod lam so sor bstan pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ nyi ma'i bgrod phyogs la brten nas nam zla dus tshigs kyi rnam pa drug tu phyes shing de dag gi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas 'byung ba'i khams 'di yang mi 'dra bar 'gyur bzhin yod stabs dus tshigs re re'i khyad chos dang mthun par zas spyod bsten tshul shes pa'i phyir dus drug gi spyod lam so sor bstan pa yin no/ /13 dgun stod kyi khyad chos gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ dgun stod kyi khyad chos gtso bo ni nam zla grang ngar che ba dang / mtshan mo shin tu ring ba'o /14dpyid stod kyi khyad chos gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ dpyid ka ni dgun dus grang reg gis bsgongs pa'i bad kan grang ba'i khams rnams nyi 'od kyis dros pas pho ba'i me drod gsod pa dang bad kan gyi nad ldang ba'i dus yin pa'o/ /15 gnas skabs spyod lam gyi gzhi rtsa'i dgos 'dun de gang yin nam/lan/ bkres skom sogs 'byung ba'i shugs yar bkag pa dang / mi 'byung 86

bzhin du nan gyis bcir ba gang dag gis nad rigs rnams bskyed pa dang / lhag tu rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur ba de'i phyir snga sor rlung de nyid zhi bar bya zhing de dang lhan cig tu shugs bkag pa'am btsir ba las bskyed pa'i nad de dag zhi bar byed pa'o/ /16 nad slar mi ldog phyir bya thabs gang dang gang 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ rtag tu phan pa'i zas dang spyod lam rnams/ /nyams ldan bsten par byas na nad mi 'byung / /nad kun mi skye skyes pa'ang zhi bya'i phyir/ /gnas skabs spyod pa'i cho ga 'di nyid bsngags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /17 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la bslab pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ zas skom gyi phan gnod legs par brtags shing longs spyad na lus dang srog la nye bar phan pas yun ring du 'tsho zhing / bab col du zos shing 'thungs na dman lhag log pa gang yang rung bar gyur nas nad bskyed cing lus srog 'joms par 'gyur ba de'i phyir 'tsho ba zas kyi gnas la bslab par bya dgos so/ /18 'bru rigs kun la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi nus pa gang ldan pa yin nam/lan/ 'bru kun gsar thog rlon pa lngi ba ste/ /smin 'gyur skams dang rnying pa yang ba yin/ /rjen pa btsos dang g.yos su byas pa kun/ /rim bzhin yang zhing 'ju sla 'phrod par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /19 mi yis bdag byed pa'i srog chags gang dag yod dam/lan/ mdzo dang / g.yag rnga mong / rta/ bong bu/ ba lang / rtol/ ra/ lugakhyi/ phag pa/ khyim bya/ byi la la sogs pa rnams ni mi yis bdag po byed pa'i srog chags yin/20 skam gsher thun mong gi sde ji ltar yin nam/lan/ ri dwags che ba dang rtsal mthus za ba'i sde dang mis bdag byed pa'i sde gsum thun mong du gnas pa'i sde'o/ /21sha rgyu'i 'tsho gnas byed yul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis khyad par gang yod dam/lan/ skam sa'i sha rnams bsil zhing yang la rtsub/ /rlung dang bad kan ldan 87

pa'i tsha ba sel/ /rlan gnas sha rnams snum zhing lci la dro/ /pho ba mkhal rked grang rlung nad la phan/ /thun mong gnas pa nus pa gnyis dang ldan/ /bya gcan rtsal mthus sha rlon za ba rnams/ /rtsub yang rno bas pho ba'i me drod skyed/ /skran bshig sha 'phel grang ba'i nad kun sel/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /22 sha kun lngi yang gsar rnying gi khyad par ji ltar yin nam/lan/ sha kun pho mo'i stod smad phyed lci la/ /sbrum ma kun lci rkang bzhi mo yi yang / /bya rnams kun ni pho yi yang ba yin/ /mgo dang ro stod brang rgyab dpyi rked lco/ /lus zungs bdun po phyi ma phyi ma lngi/ /sha gsar bsil zhing sha rnying dro la bcud/ /lo sha khyad par rlung gnon me drod skyed/ /rlon pa 'khyags po bsregs pa 'ju dka' lci/ /skam dang btsos pa yang zhing 'ju sla ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /23 'o ma spyi'i phan nus ci ltar yin nam/lan/ 'o ma phal che ba ni ro dang zhu rjes gnyis ka mngar ba dang / nus pa snum la lci bsil dang ldan pas lus zungs rnams 'phel zhing gzi mdangs rgyas pa dang / rlung mkhris kyi nad sel ba/ ro tsa'am khu ba'i stobs 'phel la bad kan skyed par byed pa'o/ /24chang spyi'i phan nus dang ngo bo ci yin nam/lan/ spyir chang thams cad ro mngar skyur kha gsum dang ldan la/ zhu rjes skyur ba nus pa rno zhing dro la rtsub cing phra ba dang / des nus pa myur du khyab pa'i thur du cung zad 'khru ba/ drod 'bar la spobs pa skyed pa/ gnyid 'phel ba dang bad rlung dag sel bar byed pa'o/ /25zas bsdam pa zhes pa des lus khams bde srung thad dngos yod kyi don snying gang ldan yod dam/lan/ sbyar ba la sogs pa'i dug dang ldan pa'i zas dang mi 'phrod pa'i rigs kyi kha zas de dag ma bsdam par bab col du zos shing 'thung na/ des 'phrad du srog 'dor ba'am rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa rnams 'khrugs par gyur te mi bzod pa'i zug rngus 'debs par 'gyur ba de'i phyir/ dus rgyun du 'bad pas bsdam la bsrung 88

ba bya dgos pa'o/ /26 kha zas dug yod med kyi brtag thabs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dus ldan zas de kha dog dri ro ldog /mer bsregs du ba rma bya'i mgrin 'dra 'byung / /me lce gcig tu 'khyil zhing me stag brgal/ /mthong na bya rog skad 'don rma bya dga'/ /khyi la byin na lto ba dros nas skyugs/ /sha la dug yod dmar la lcags mi len/ /sbos shing chang sbyar mig bdug tsha zhing 'khrug /ces pa'o/ /27 zas skom mi 'phrod pa'i rigs zos kyang gnod par mi 'gyur ba'ang yod dam/ ci'i phyir/lan/ yod de/ gang zhig rgyun tu rtsol bcag dang kha zas snum bcud rigs bsten pa dang / pho ba'i me drod 'bar zhing che ba/ na so dar la babs pa/ lus stobs dang ldan pa bcas de dag gis kha zas mi 'phrod pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig zos kyang nad du mi 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin mi 'phrod pa'i zas rigs de rnams sngar nas zos shing goms par gyur pa'i rigs la yang gnod par mi 'gyur ba yin no/ /28 mi 'phrod pa 'phrod pa byed na thabs tshul gang dang gang spyod dgos sam/lan/ skye bo gang dag kha zas mi 'phrod pa'i rigs bsten par byed pa'am yang na sngar nas 'phrod cing goms zin pa'i kha zas rnams spang bar byed pa gang rung rim bzhin snon 'phri'i cha bskyed de goms pa'i sgo nas cha yis bslab dgos pa las/ glo bur du 'phrod cing goms pa'i rigs spong ba dang / mi 'phrod cing mi goms pa'i rigs bsten par gyur na nyes pa dang bcas pa myur du 'khrugs par byed pa'o/ /29zas tshod ma zin tshe nyes skyon gang dang gang ldan yod dam/lan/ gal te zas tshod ma zin chung gyur na/ /stobs mdangs mi 'phel rlung nad ma lus 'byung / /tshad las thal na ma zhu be snabs skyed/ /de yis me mnyam rlung rgyu'i rtsa sbubs bkag /pho ba'i drod nyams nyes pa ma lus bskyed/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /30lto ba'i cha bzhi zhes pa'i tshad gzhi de kun gyis bltos med du spyod rung ngam/lan/ spyir lto ba'i cha bzhi zhes pa ltar zos tshod ran pa'i tshad 'dzin pa dang /gzhan na tshod dar la babs pa dang / pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs che ba/ lus khams 89

rtsol bas brel ba sogs la de ltar ma yin par zas skom bltos med du cung zad 'grangs bar spyod rung ba'o/ /31skom 'thungs tshul mi 'dra bar gzhigs nas 'bras bu mi 'dra ba gang 'byung ngam/lan/ zas zos rjes su skom 'thungs ngoms dang khyab/ /zas 'drul 'ju zhing lus brtas stobs 'phel byed/ /skad 'gag glo rdol lud pa cham pa sogs/ /nam tshong yan chad nad la gnod pa yin/ /me drod chung la sha zos chang 'thungs bya/ /sbom po dbri la sbrang rtsi chu btung ngo / /zho chang dugs sbags sbrang rtsi zos pa dang / /rjes su chu bsil 'thungs na phan pa yin/ /zas zos bar mtha' thog mar skom 'thungs na/ /nyam tshags ran zhing sbom dang skem por 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /32 zas tshod ran par zin na yon tan ci 'byung ngam/lan/ nyes pa lam min mi 'gro me drod 'bar/ /lus yang dang ga bde la dbang bo gsal/ /stobs che bshang gci 'og rlung bde bar rgyu/ /zas tshod legs par zin las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 mig ni me yi rang bzhin bad kan 'jig /mchi ma 'dzag phyir mig sman skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /rtag tu zhag bdun lon tshe nyin re blug /ces par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ mig gi dbang bo ni mchin pa'i 'brel 'byor ram me tog lta bu yin pa dang me'i rang bzhin shas che ba'i dbang gis bad kan tshim byed sa chu'i rang bzhin gyi stobs dag 'jig ste gnyan tshad kyang skyes sla bas na/ sa chu'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mig gi mchi ma nyid skye zhing 'dzag pa dang / mig rang nyid kyi stobs skyed cing bcud len pa'i ched du mig sman skyer khaṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba de nyid rtag tu zhag bdun re'i nang thengs rer blugs shing bsten par bya'o/ /2'jig rten mi chos dang dam pa lha chos bar gyi khyad par de phan tshun gyi gzhung 90

tshig gnyis nas gsum bar lung drangs te dbye zhib kyis rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ spyir 'jig rten mi chos dang dam pa lha chos bar bde ba ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ste/ 'jig rten mi chos ni 'jig rten 'di'i 'gro 'dug bya ba byed tshul nyal bo spang blang / mtshan snyan grags ci ltar thob tshul sogs 'jig rten 'di'i bde ba kho na yin la/ dam pa lha chos ni 'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma gnyis la bltos te sems can kun bdag gcig tu lta zhing mi dge ba'i lus kun dang bral te mthar thug thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob te sangs rgyas par byed rgyu de yin la/dper na/ rgyud kyi 'jig rten mi chos bshad pa las/ dgra bo yan par mi btang 'dam ring thabs kyis 'dul/ /zhes dang / dam pa lha chos bshad pa las/ gnod brtson dgra la'ang phan gdags gtsor byas te/ /zhes pa lta bu tshig 'di gnyis la mtshon na yang gong ma las rang nyid kyi dgra bo yin na rang nyid kyi mgor shor du mi 'jug par mgo gnon dgos la/ der yan par btang na rang nyid kyi mtshan snyan sogs la gnod 'gro bas yan par mi btang ba dang / tha ma las tshe 'di'i mtshan snyan la bsam gzhigs ma btang bar phyi ma'i bde ba bsam te dgra bo la'ang phan gdags pa'o/ /yang 'jig rten mi chos las/ 'bu srin sogs rang 'drar blta lta bu gnyis la mtshon na yang snga ma las nye ring chags sdang spang med par rang gi nye 'khor la sha tsha'i bskyangs pa sogs rang la phan gdags pa rnams la drin gyis bskyangs pa yin la/ tha ma ni gong las ldog pa'i nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral te 'bu srin sogs rang la phan gdags med na'ang rang nyid dang gcig mtshungs su bltos te phan 'dogs sogs mdor na 'jig rten mi chos dang dam pa lha chos gnyis las snga ma ni 'jig rten 'di'i bde ba dang phyi ma ni tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bde ba gtso bo bzung nas brjod pa red/3skad cig la sogs thang cig yud tsam la/ /nyin zhag zla ba dus dang lor 'gyur te/ /nyi ma brgyad gsum dbyar dgun dbus su'ang ldog /gsum ni lho dang byang du 'gro zhes bya/ /nam dang nyi ma phyed na mnyam pa yin/ /brgyad dang bcu na sgra sgrogs chad par 'gyur/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/91

'grel/ dus kyi thung mtha'i sems kyi skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig ma yin la/ skad cig de sum cu la thang cig dang / thang cig sum cu la yud tsam gcig yud tsam sum cu la nyin zhag gcig nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba gnyis la dus gcig dus drug la lor 'gyur ba bcas yin pa dang /de yang grub pa'i lo de'i nyi bgrod kyi dus mtshams de rags pa'i dbang du byas na lo sngon ma'i dbyar kha dang / dgun kha so so'i nyi ldog gi tshes grangs de'i steng du zhag brgyad dang gsum bsres bcu gcig re bsnan pa nas 'khor los bsgril lhag gi tshes grangs su ldog cing / dper na/ snga lo'i dgun nyi de zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la ldog yod tshe 'di lo'i dgun nyi de zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer lnga la ldog pa lta bu yin la/ yang na dbyar nyi de dbyar zla gsum du brtsis pa'i dbyar kha'i dbus sam 'bring po ste snon zla ba'i dus dang / dgun nyi de yang dgun zla gsum du brtsis pa'i dbus de bcu gcig pa mgo zla ba'i dus gnyis su ldog pa'ang yod cing /de ltar dbyar nyi ldog nas dus gsum mam zla ba drug gi ring nyi ma lho ngos kyi mthar thug bar 'gro ba dang / dgun nyi ldog nas dus gsum mam zla ba drug gi ring nyi ma byang ngos kyi mthar thug bar 'gro ba yin la/ nam dang nyi ma de yang zla drug so so'i phyed de dbyar nyi ldog nas zla ba gsum phyin pa'i rjes sam lho bgrod kyi phyed du slebs skabs ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang / dgun nyi ldog nas zla ba gsum phyin pa'i rjes sam byang bgrod kyi phyed du slebs skabs dpyid mtshan mnyam pa yin la/ de yang dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam nas zhag brgyad 'gro ba'i nyin der 'brug gi sgra sgrogs pa dang /ston nyin mtshan mnyam nas zhag bcu 'gro ba'i skabs der 'brug gi sgra chad par 'gyur ba yin zhes pa'i don no/ /4sngo ngad sgog btsong la sogs tsha ba dang / /khur mang rgya khur la sogs kha ba dang / /skam dang gsher ba'i gnas su skyes pa dang / /skam dang rlon pa g.yos byas rjen pa rnams/ /dro yang bsil lci grang ba'i tshad nad sel/ /ces par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ kha zas su byed pa'i sngo ngad kyi nang nas sgog skya dang btsong sogs ro tsha ba'i rigs dang / khur mang dang rgya khur sogs ro kha ba'i rigs/ de dag kyang 92

skam sa'i gnas su skyes pa dang / gsher ba'i gnas su skyes pa'i khyad par/ de bzhin skam par byas pa dang / rlon par byas pa'i khyad par/ tsha sdor btab ste g.yos su byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i rjen pa'i khyad par bcas kyi dbang gis snga ma snga ma rnams nus pa dro zhing yang ba dang ldan la des bad kan grang ba'i nad rnams sel ba dang / phyi ma phyi ma rnams ni nus pa bsil zhing lci ba dang ldan la des mkhris pa tsha ba'i nad rnams sel ba bcas kyi yon tan dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ /5dgun stod dgun smad dpyid ces pa nas dbyar dgun dbus su'ang ldog ces par rgyas 'grel gyis/ 'grel/ dgun zla ra ba nas brtsis pa'i zla ba gnyis gnyis la rim bzhin dgun stod dgun smad/ dpyid/ sos ka dbyar/ ston bcas dus drug yin la/de dag kyang sems kyi rnam par rtog pa brgya nyi shu la skad cig ma yin la/ de drug cu thang cig de sum cu yud tsam/ de sum cu nyin zhag gcig de sum cu la zla ba/zla ba gnyis la dus dang / dus drug la lo ru 'gyur ba yin/ lo de yi nyi ma'i bgrod pa gnyis ni lo sngon ma'i dbyar dgun gang ldog gi tshes grangs steng zhag brgyad dang gsum bsres pa ste bcu gcig re bsnan/ 'khor lor bsgril pa'i tshes grangs su ldogade yang dbyar dgun gnyis ga'i dbus su ste dbyar 'bring dang dgun 'bring gi stod smad gang rung du ldog pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ga 2 kha 3 nga 4ka 5 kha 6 ka 7 nga 8kha 9 ga 10 ga 11 nga 12 ga 13 kha 14ka15 nga 16 kha 17 ga 18 ka 19 ga 20 kha21 nga 22 ga 23 ga 24 kha 25 ga 26 nga27 ga 28 kha 29 kha 30 kha93

sa bcad drug pa/ sbyor ba sman/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 thun mong kun la spyi khyab tu gnas pa'i 'byung ba ni/ ( )ka rlung / kha me/ ga nam mkha'/ nga chu/2 ro bska ba ni 'byung ba ( )shas che ba las skyed pa yin/ka sa chu/ kha me sa/ ga chu rlung / nga sa rlung /3 rlon nam skyugs par byed pa'i sman ni 'byung ba ( ) las bskyed/ka sa me/ kha sa rlung / ga sa chu/ nga me rlung /4nyes gsum las mkhris pa sel bar byed pa'i 'byung ba ni/( )ka chu/ kha me/ ga rlung / nga sa/5 sa sman gyis sel ba'i nyes pa ni/ ( )ka mkhris pa/ kha bad kan/ ga rlung / nga chu ser/6 gyen 'dren sman ni me dang rlung yin zhes pa'i ro ni/( )ka ro bska ba/ kha ro tsha ba/ ga ro lan tsha/ nga ro mngar ba/7 ro lan tsha bsten drags pas skra 'byi skra dkar 'byung ba ni/( )ka chu me las skyed pa'i phyir/ kha me rlung las skyed pa'i phyir/ garlung me mnyam/ nga bad kan myag byed/8 nus brgyad las rno ba'i go ldog ni/( )ka rtsub pa/ kha skya ba/ ga rtul ba/ nga bsil ba/9 mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa dang mthun phyogs 'phel ba de la/ ( )ka nus pa/ kha mthu/ ga stobs/ nga yon tan/95

10 nus stobs yon tan dang bcas 'byung ba'i gzhi ni/( )ka 'byung ba/ kha ro/ ga ngo bo/ nga zhu rjes/11 mtshan nyid nyi shu 'joms pa'i gnyen po ni/( )ka nus brgyad/ kha yon tan bcu bdun/ ga stobs/nga mthu/12 bsil gyi rgyal po ga bur sgyur byed kyi blon po ni/( )ka cong zhi/ kha gur gum/ ga cu gang / nga brag zhun/13 dmar tshag ling tog sogs mig nad la phan pa ni/( )ka skyer ba'i me tog kha skyer ba'i 'bras bu/ ga skyer ba'i bar shun/ nga skyur shun khaṇ+ḍa/14sman sbyor thams cad mdor dril bas( )gnyis su 'dus/ka zhi sbyong / kha tsha sel/ ga grang sel/ nga bsil drod/15 nad rigs gang smin sdud 'byed pa la thog mar gtong ba ni/( )ka thang gi sbyor sde/ kha phye ma'i sbyor sde/ ga lde gu sbyor ba/nga sman chang sbyor ba/16 khrag nad 'byed cing smin byed la/( )ka ba sha ka'i chig thang / kha ba ru'i chig thang / ga skyu ri'i chig thang / nga a ru'i chig thang /17 'phel zad bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen po ste ro sbyor gyi grangs ni/( )ka nga bdun/ kha bcu bdun/ ga re gcig nga don bdun/18 rten 'byung lngas bskyed pa'i sman gyi nus pa ni/( )ka ro nus/ kha stobs sam yon tan/ ga ro nus ngo bo/nga zhu rjes dang stobs/19 thang sman gyi nang gses dbye ba/( )ka lnga/ kha drug ga gsum/ nga bcu gsum/20 khrag 'thung zhes pa'i sman ni/( )96

ka dar ya ka kha pri yang ku ga ba sha ka nga bong dkar/21 chu yi snying bo zhes pa'i sman ni/( )ka rgya tshwa/ kha rgyam tshwa/ ga sdig srin/ nga nyi dga'/22 rtsa da byid zhes pa'i sman ni/( )ka dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu/ kha tang kun/ ga ra mnye/nga dbang lag23 grog ma'i gzugs can zhes pa'i sman ni/( )ka pi pi ling / kha ru rta/ ga se 'bru/ nga bong dmar/24brgya sbyin sbrang zhes pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka grog mas bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi/ kha sbrang mas bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi/ ga thang chu/ nga shing kun/25 dag med bong bu'i klad pa zhes pa ni/( )ka spyang ki kha gla ga ri bong / nga bong bu/26 rtsa ba brgya zhes pa'i sman ni/( )ka re lcag kha ra mnye/ ga nye shing / nga spang spos/27 'dod 'jo smug po zhes pa'i sman ni/( )ka brag zhun/ kha star khaṇ+ḍa/ ga 'bri mog nga stod ja/28 ban de'i mkhris pa zhes pa'i mkhris pa ni/( )ka khyim bya/ kha chu bya ngur ba/ ga lha bya gong mo/nga 'ug pa/29 pad rag mdog ldan gyi sbyor ba'i pad rag ces pa ni/( )ka ha lo'i me tog kha da li me tog ga gang ga chung /nga sran me/30 mtshan mo'i 'od can zhes pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka gser men/ kha gser/ ga cong zhi/ nga brag zhun/97

31 rgyal po 'khyil ba zhes pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka g.yu/ kha byu ru/ ga mu tig nga mu men/32 smug po chig thub mi nor ba'i gzer gtso bo ni/ ( )ka bcag na mdung rtse bzhin rno 'bigs kyi dbyibs dang ldan pa/ khabacag na kha mkhregs pa/ ga bcag na 'od dang ldan pa/ ngabacag na chung 'gyur bzang ba/33 dngul rdo mi nor ba'i gzer ni/ ( )ka rdo la ri mo bris pas dngul 'od 'phro ba/ kha rdo dmar smug lci la mkhregs pa/ ga rdo la ri mo bris na skya bo dod pa/ nga kha dog dmar gsal/34li gri ldong ros dang mi nor ba'i gzer ni/ ( )ka mdog dmar ser gnyis spel mar 'dres pa/ kha kha dog dmar ser shin tu dwangs pa/ ga cung lci ba/ nga li gri snyi la ldong ros sra ba/35 bad kan kyi nad rnams gyen tu 'dren pa la bzang ba ni/ ( )ka lcum rtsa/ kha spyang tsher/ ga pad rtsa/ nga brag zhun/36 nad kun gyen du 'dren zhing skyugs sman kun gyi mchog ni/ ( )ka po so cha/ kha da trig ga rgya skyegs/ nga myang rtsi sbras/37 zhi byed sde tshan mdor bsdus na/ ( )ka gsum/ kha lnga/ ga brgyad/ nga bcu/38 sman chang gi sbyor ba bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ ( )ka bad rlung chu ser gyi nad sel ba/ kha khrag mkhris tsha ba'i nad sel ba/ ga bad kan grang ba'i nad sel ba/ nga nad lhag 'don la lus stobs gso ba/39 tsha ba smin byed kyi sman ni/ ( )98

ka ma nu bzhi thang / kha bla med ril bu/ ga ru rta drug pa/nga phag mo grub pa/ri40 li shi drug pa'i phan yon ni/ ( )ka gsang nad la mchog tu phan/ kha glo nad skad 'gag la phan/ga ma zhu me drod nyams pa la phan/ nga rtsa dkar gyi nad la phan/41 a gar brgyad pa'i phan yon ni/ ( )ka dreg grum chu ser kun la phan/ kha snying gi nad spyi la phan/ gamakhal ma la phan/ nga ma zhu dug tu 'gyur bar phan/42 bdud rtsi sum sbyor ni/ ( ) ka cong zhi 'jib rtsi ma nu gsum/ kha se 'bru sug smel pi pi ling /ga gu gul 'dzin pa a ru ra/ nga tig ta gser me bong nga gsum/43 dug srin mkha' mchin gnyan nad sel ba la/ ( )ka dom mkhris/ kha gla rtsi/ ga brag zhun/ nga gur gum/44gla rtsi'i mdog la brtag pa la rab/( )ka ser bo/ kha dmar kham/ ga nag go nga ser skya/45 tig ta la 'byung yul gyi dbang gis dbye ba/ ( )ka gnyis/ kha brgyad/ ga drug/ nga gsum/46 bsdus thang kun la khu ba/( )ka sum gcig bsdu/ kha sum gnyis bsdu/ ga bzhi gnyis bsdu/ nga gnyis gcig bsdu/47 bshal skyug thun mong gi sman ni/ ( )ka dan rog kha po so cha/ ga dur byid/ nga spyang tsher/48 mtshal dang cog la sman du gtong tshe lag len/ ( )ka sla ngar mdog cung ma log par brngo/ kha sla ngar mdog dmar ser log par brngo/ ga brngo mi dgos/ nga nad gzhi las dpag99

49 dung sman du gtong tshe lag len ci ltar/ ( )ka sol mes dkar sang bar bsregs/ kha ma bsregs phye ma gtong /ga spyi 'dus ltar/ nga yang yang bkru/50 mig nad gso ba'i bdud rtsi/( )ka a wa bdud rtsi/ kha skyer ba'i me tog ga dom mkhris/nga kha gur/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 ro kha ba'i sder gtogs pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka gla rtsi/ kha brag zhun/ ga re skon/ nga ut+pal/ca ma nu/2 ro bska ba'i sder gtogs pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka tsan dan/ kha a ru ra/ ga ga dur/ nga sga gsher/ca hong len/3 chu sman gyi byed las ni/ ( )ka brlan pa/ kha 'jam/ ga mkhrang / nga sdud byed/ ca brtas byed/4ro mngar ba'i ngo bo ni/ ( )ka kha la chags pa/ kha zhim pa/ ga sred pa skyes pa/ ngartsub snyam byed pa/ ca bzhin sdud/5 nyes gsum las bad kan sel ba'i ro ni/ ( )ka mngar/ kha tsha ba/ ga skyur/ nga lan tshwa/ca bska ba/6ro skyur ba bsten drags pa'i nyes skyon ni/ ( )ka khrag mkhris bskyed/ kha mgo 'khor/ ga me drod 'bri/100

nga skom dad che/ ca lud pa 'phel/7ro kha ba bsten drags pas ( ) bskyed/ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga bad kan/ nga khragaca chu ser/8 nus pa brgyad las rtsa ba'i nus pa bzhi ni/ ( )ka lci ba/ kha snum/ ga bsil/ nga rtul/ca rtsub/9 bad kan 'joms byed kyi yon tan ni/ ( )ka skya/ kha tsha ba/ ga bsil ba/ nga lci ba/ ca'ajam pa/10 yon tan rtsub pa gcig gis 'joms pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ ( )ka 'jam pa/ kha 'byar bag can/ ga 'khru ba/ nga sra ba/ca rno ba/11 khrag tshad sel zhing khrag rlung 'thab pa la phan pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka gi wang / kha tsan dan dmar po/ ga btsod/ ngagla rtsi/ ca se 'bru/12 mgo thang gsum gyi sbyor ba ni/ ( )ka mi thod rnying ba/ kha 'brug rus/ ga tig ta/ ngabong dkar/ ca dom mkhris/13 ma nu bzhi thang gi sman rdzas ni/ ( )ka sle tres/ kha tig ta/ ga kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ nga sga skya/ca bong nga /14drag por 'khru ba'i sbyong byed sman ni/ ( )ka thar nu/ kha dan rog ga shrī khaṇ+ḍa/ nga lcum rtsa/ca lca ba/15srin sman kyi sder gtogs pa'i sman ni/ ( )101

ka sgog skya/ kha g.yer ma/ ga byi tang ga nga 'jam 'bras/ ca re lcag16 chu 'gags 'bigs byed kyi sman ni/ ( )ka rgya tshwa/ kha spang rtsi/ ga sbal ba lag pa/ nga lcum pa/ca lca ba/17 srin sel sman sbyor skabs kyi rtse gsum zhes pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka thang phrom lang thang rtse'i 'bru/ kha ma ru tse/ ga byi tang gang gres 'bru/ ca sran ma/18 rtsi sman la nang gses dbye ba/ ( )ka rtswa las byung ba'i rtsi sman/ kha shing las byung ba'i rtsi sman/ gasrog chags las byung ba'i rtsi sman/ nga sngo las byung ba'i rtsi sman/ca rdo las byung ba'i rtsi sman/19 srid pa'i byang sems dkar dmar ni/ ( )ka dkar bo cong zhi/ kha dmar po brag zhun/ ga dmar bo stod ja/ nga dkar bo ga bur/ ca dkar po 'o ma/20 mkhris chen gsum zhes pa ni/ ( )ka mi mkhris/ kha dom mkhris/ ga phag mkhris/ nga nya mkhris/ ca lug mkhris/21 gzer sman gsum zhes pa ni/ ( )ka a byag gzer 'joms/ kha tsher sngon/ ga yu mo mde'u 'byin/ nga ming can ser po/ ca sro lo dmar po/22 be snabs mi nor ba'i gzer ni/ ( )ka bcag kha mkhregs shing 'od dang ldan/ kha ngar lcags la brdabs pas me 'byung / ga rdo la ri mo bris na kha dog med pa/ nga zhib par btul na phye ma dkar skyar 'ong ba/ ca ro mngar la cung bska ba/23 dngul chu'i 'byung khungs gtso bo ni/ ( )102

ka gser zil/ kha dngul zil/ ga cog la/ nga star zil/ ca mu zi/24ldong ros gi nor ba'i gzer gtso bo ni/ ( )ka mer bsregs mu zi'i dri bro la dud pa ser po/ kha snyi bas sen mos gcod gtub thub pa/ ga kha dog dmar ser shin tu dwangs pa/nga cung yang ba/ ca cung sra la mkhregs pa/25 lcags phye lnga thang gi sbyor ba ni/ ( )ka skyer shun/ kha 'bras bu gsum/ ga 'om bu/ nga.a ru ra/ ca lcags phye/26 skyer shun sum thang gi sbyor ba ni/ ( )ka mkhan skya/ kha hong len/ ga tig ta/ nga dom mkhris/ ca skyer shun/27 so phag sum thang gi sbyor ba ni/ ( )ka 'u su/ kha pho ba ril/ ga ka ra/ nga dzā ti/ caso phag28 'khrugs tshad kyi rgyal blon gsum po ni/ ( )ka ga bur/ kha cu gang / ga tsan dkar/ nga bong dkar/ ca hong len/29 sngo yi tsha ba gsum ni/ ( )ka lce tsha/ kha dbyi mong / ga srub ka nga sga skya/ca tsi tra ka30 ril bu'i che chung gi tshad la rigs du yod/ ( )ka sran ma phos pa tsam/ kha sran ma chung shos sam/ ga lug ril tsam/ nga ser ba rus tsam/ ca cung tsam/31 mu men la dbye na rigs du yod/ ( )ka gser mu men/ kha g.yu mu men/ ga mthil mu men/103

nga dngul mi men/ ca zangs mu men/32 big pan zhes gang dag la 'jug ( )ka tsher sngon/ kha sgog pa nus bsregs kyi thal/ ga tsha la bsregs thal/ nga sbrul nag bsregs thal/ ca da li bsregs thal/33 rin chen gser brtag pa'i tshul/ ( )ka rang bzhin lci snang la brtag pa/ kha sgra la brtag ga g.ya' chags rgyu brtag nga sra snyi la brtag ca mdog la brtag34ma nu mi nor ba'i sa ni/ ( )ka phyi la gnyer ma rwa khrag 'dra ba yod pa/ kha brdung na rwa gzhob dro ba/ ga ba yi nu zho 'dra ba/ nga dkyil du khung bu yod pa/35 skyugs pa gcod pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i sman ni/ ( )ka gser phye/ kha rgya tshwa/ ga po so cha/ nga spyang tsher/36 'khru gcod sman gyi sde/( )ka da trig kha bya rkang / ga rgyam tshwa/ nga bil ba/37 srin sman gyi sde/ ( )ka ma ru tse/ kha gres 'bru/ ga thar nu/ nga lcum rtsa/38 sman nus rtsar khrid byed kyi rta ni/ ( )ka bu ram/ kha ka ra/ ga gangs chu/ nga sbrang rtsi/ca chu skol/39 ston ka rtsi skam dus su btu ba'i sman rigs ni/( )ka lo ma/ kha 'bras bu/ ga rtsa ba/ nga yal gca sdong po/40 sngo sman btus pa'i dus su dug phral mi dgos pa ni/ ( )ka zho/ kha rkang / ga tshi ba/ nga lpags/ca bar shun/104

gsum pa/ ming 'grel/brtas/ lus khams rgyas shing 'phel ba'i don/bkru sman/ thur du sbyong zhing 'khru bar byed pa'i don/bzhin sdud/ ngo gdong gi sul sdud pa'i don/yi ga ldog slar za mi 'dod pa'i don/rtsabs/ zho rtsi lta bu skyur rta'i rigs kyi ming /lus lhod/ lus khams lhod zhig tu gyur pa'i don/'drul/ myag cing rul ba'i don/g.yan pa/ lus su za 'phrug langs pa'i don/smyug rtsi/ smyug ma gzhon nu'i shun pa la bzhed pa zhig dang smyug ma'i me tog la bzhed pa gnyis yod/kron/ brdung na thor sla ba'i don/ldum bu zangs rtsi/ dug dang sbyong sman ma yin pa'i bsil ba'i sngo sna tshogs/rtsi sman/ cu gang gur gum li shi sogs dri shas che ba'i sman/'ba' sam/ sman mang ba phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa'i don/khrag rkang / sngo sman gyi nang tshan ser po khrag rkang dang myang rtsi spras kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /son cha/ po so cha yi ming gi rnam grangs/sna sbyong / sna'i nang du sman blugs nas sna'am mtshul pa 'gags pa sogs nam tshong yan gyi nad bsal bar byed pa'i sbyong byed kyi ming /sman rta/ khong tu 'phul byed dam sman nus rtsar khrid byed kyi rta ste chu skol chang sogs kyi ming /rtsi stag mo/ chu ma rtsi yi ming gi rnam grangs/105

khye'u sus/ zas sogs nyung nyung bsten pa dang yang na tho rengs dus la bsten pa'i don/stobs kyi nus pa/ bsil sman grang sar skyes pa dang drod sman dro sar skyes nas tsha grang 'joms pa'i khyad 'phags kyi stobs dang ldan pa'i sman gyi nus pa'o/ /so ma rnying ba/ sngo las gyur pa'i sman rdzas lo dus ma lon pa la zer/zhi sbyong / gnyen po bzhi'i ya gyal sman zhi byed dang sbyong gnyis la gob byung rnam lnga/ ba dmar zal gyi dri chu gci 'o ma mar zho bcas lnga'i bsdus ming skam sa'i sha/ skam sar gnas pa'i srog chags gna' dgo rkyang 'brong sogs kyi sha la zer/'khrang / yan lag sogs brtan zhing sra bar byed pa'i don/na le sham/ pho ba ris kyi ming gzhan zhigasge gsher/ sman sga rlon pa'i ming /sra 'khyil/ lus khams kyi cha shas sra por gyur pa dang rlung dang bshang ba 'khyil ba'i don/brun/ 'dab chags dang srog chags rigs kyi dri chen/'brum nag nyen kha che ba'i 'brum pa nag po'i nad cigare ral gsum/ rgyal bo re ral dang btsun mo re ral blon po re ral bcas so/ /rma rtsi/ rma 'byor byed kyi sman/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1'byung ba sa yis dngos po thams cad skye zhing gnas pa'i rten byed pa yin/( )106

2skra 'byi skra dkar 'byung ba ni khrag tshad kyi drod rlangs mgo la don pa'i phyir ro/ /( )3pho ba'i zhu rjes kha bas nyes pa bad kan kho na sel/ ( )'askyur ba'i zhu rjes mi 'gyur ba ni 'ju byed dang rang bzhin mi mthun pa'i phyir/( )5zhu rjes gsum bshad pa'i dgos pa ni zhu rjes gsum gyi byed las shes pa'i ched yin/ ( )6mtshan nyid nyi shu 'joms byed kyi gnyen por yon tan bcu bdun kho na dgos pa'i nges pa med/ ( )7zangs thal bzo skabs rang byung yin pa'i nges pa ma mchis/ ( )8smug mo chig thub bcag na che chung ji ltar yang mdung rtse bzhin rno 'bigs dbyibs so/ ( )9ldong ros li gri la mi nor ba'i gzer ni mer bsregs na mu zi'i dri 'dra ba dang dud pa ser po 'byung ba/ ( )10kha dog ser bo che chung nges med lcer glan na 'byar zhing myang na ro kha ba ni rdo mkhris dman pa yin/ ( )11ba bla rab ni kha dog dmar shas yod pa la shin tu ser ba dwangs shing rta so bcag pa 'dra pa zhig yin/ ( )12dom mkhris yin min chu la dris na 'ja' yi ka ba tshugs pa dang mkhris pa'i pags mnyen pas mi chag skya sob tu 'gro ba/ ( )13'ol mo se ni khrag gi skya ba 'dra zhing mo nad kun la mchog ( )14big pan zhes pa dbang bo'i nad kyi skabs su sgog thal dang tshad rlung skabs su mtsher sngon yin/( )15me tog 'bras bu rtse mo gsum ston ga rtsi skam gyi dus su btu dgos/( )16lus stobs zad pa'i rgas pa dang byis pa sbrum ma bcas rlung shas ches pa'i 107

rigs la bshal skyugs bya mi rung / ( )17gnyan nad kun la gi wang dang gla rtsi mchog ( )18dbang bo'i ril bu dug 'joms nor bu yin/ ( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la bslab pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ gang zhig phung bor zug cing brdungs bar byed pa'i nad de nyid gso ba dang zhi bar byas te mi na ba gnas pa'i bya ba dang na ba gso bar bya ba'i don byed na/nges par du gso dpyad kyi gnyen po bzhi las khyad par du gnas drug pa sman gyi tshig don 'dzin pa'i gnas sbyor ba sman gyi gnas la bslab dgos so/ /2 sbyor ba sman zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ sman gyi sde tshan dang ro nus sogs kyi sbyar thabs gtso bor ston pas na sbyor ba sman zer/3 'byung ba chen po tshogs pa rnams las sman rnams 'byung zhing skye ba yin pas ro gcig kho na'i nges pa yod dam/ ci'i phyir/lan/ med de/ des bskyed gyur kyang shas cher ro gcig min/ zhes gsungs te/ de yang sa yis gzhi rten chus brlan sogs rkyen de lta bus bskyed pa mtshungs kyang sa bon nyid kyang rang bzhin dang 'byung ba phan tshun shas che chung gi dbang gis ro gcig kho nar nges pa yod pa ma yin no/ /4sman rnams 'byung ba chen po lngas ji ltar byas nas bskyed pa yin nam/lan/ rgyud las/ sa yis gzhi rten chus brlan me yis drod/ /rlung gis bskyed byed nam mkhas go phye bas/ /des bskyed gyur ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /5'byung ba chen po phan tshun gcig tu 'dus pa'i tshe shas che chung gi dbang gis ro gcig tu ma nges pa de ji ltar yin nam/lan/ sa dang chu shas che ba las ro mngar ba dang / me sa las skyur ba/ chu me 108
