las ro lan tshwa/ chu rlung las kha ba/ me rlung las tsha ba/ sa rlung las bska ba bcas so/ /6 'byung lnga so so'i las ji ltar yin nam/lan/ sa'i las ni rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad skye zhing gnas pa'i rten byed pa dang / chu'i las ni rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad brlan zhing gsher bar byed pa/ me'i las ni rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad drod kyi las byed pa/ rlung gi las ni rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad 'gul zhing bskyod par byed pa/nam mkha'i las ni rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad go 'byed pa ste/ thams cad mi 'gag pa'i bya ba byed pa'o/ /7 ro mngar ba dang por bgrang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ go rim bzhin du 'tsho byed stobs chen yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ ro mngar bas ni srog gi rten lus zungs 'phel bar byed te bde zhing yun du 'tsho bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /8 gyen 'dren sman ni me dang rlung las 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ me ni thur tu bstan na'ang / /gyen la 'gro ba dngos po'i gshis/ /zhes pa bzhin me rlung gnyis ni gyen du 'gro ba'i rang bzhin can yang ba sogs shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /9 ci zhig la ro zer/lan/ lce'i dbang bo dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ de'i bye brag dang bcas gsal bar 'gyur bas na ro zhes bya'o/ /10 ro la ngo bo bcu bzhi yod pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ kha la chags pa/ zhim pa/ sred pa skye ba/ so brtse ba/ bzhin sdud pa/ kha chu 'dzag pa/ reg na tsha ba/ mtshil ma 'du ba/ kha yi dri sbyong ba/ yi ga ldog pa/ kha lce bsreg pa/ mig chu 'dzag pa/ lce rkan la chags pa/ rtsub snyam byed pa bcas so/ /11 ro drug po go rim bzhin du 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/109

lan/ ro de rnams so so grub pa'i rgyu'i yon tan gyi dbang gis go rim bzhin lus srog 'tsho ba'i stobs che chung la ltos nas bzhag pa red/12 spyir ro yis nyes gsum sel ba'i las ji ltar yin nam/lan/ de yang ro mngar ba skyur ba lan tsha ba bcas bzhi pos rlung nad 'joms pa dang / ro kha dang mngar dang bska ba gsum gyis mkhris pa'i nad sel la/ro tsha ba skyur ba lan tshwa gsum gyis bad kan gyi nad sel bar byed do/ /13 ro mngar ba phal cher gyis bad kan skyed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ ro mngar ba ni 'byung ba sa chu shas che ba las skyed pa'i dbang gis bad kan dang chos mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /14zhu rjes dang nyes pa'i 'phel zad kyi 'brel ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mngar bas rlung mkhris sel la bad kan skyed/ /skyur bas bad rlung sel la mkhris pa skyed/ /kha bas bad mkhris sel la rlung bskyed 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /15 ci zhig la zhu rjes zer/lan/ rdzas gang zhig pho ba'i me drod gsum gyis myag bzhu dwangs snyigs phyes pa las khyad par smin zhing gzhan du gyur pa'i gnas skabs de la zhu rjes ces bya'o/ /16 nus stobs yon tan gsum go rim bzhin 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ bsal bya nad kyi spyi bye brag la ltos pa ste/ nad nyes gsum du gnas pa la 'joms byed kyi gnyen po nus brgyad gyi 'gro ldog bstan/ nyes gsum tsha grang gnyis su 'dus pas nad de'i gnyen por stobs tsha bsil gnyis bstan/ nyes pa de gsum la mtshan nyid nyi shu yod par dgongs nas de'i gnyen por yon tan bcu bdun bzhag pa red/17sman gyi ro la spyi khyab tu gnas pa'i nus stobs yon tan gsum gyi ngo bo gang yin nam/lan/ ro spyi'i rang rgyud la yod pa'i 'byung ba'i rang bzhin lci ba sogs phan gnod byed pa la nus pa zhes bya/ de rnams kyi nang nas kyang ro nus zhu rjes thams cad du nad sel ba'i bya ba mthar phyin pa'i ngang tshul khyad par thon pa de la mthu zhes 110

bya/ mthu de yang tsha bsil gnyis su gyur pa dang / de'i byed pa phul du byin pas ldog phyogs 'joms pa de la stobs zhes so/ /18 ngo bo'i nus pa la nang gses su dbye ba du yod dam/lan/ dbye ba brgyad yod de/ stobs kyi nus pa/ ro dang phyogs mthun pa'i nus pa/ dri'i nus pa/ gnyen po'i nus pa/ rigs mthun pa'i nus pa/ dbyibs mthun gyi nus pa/ rten 'brel gyi nus pa/ smon lam gyi nus pa bcas so/ /19 ro nus zhu rjes thams cad mthun na las gang dang gang byed dam/lan/ sman rdzas gang dag gi ro dang zhu rjes/ ngo bo'i nus pa thams cad mtshungs par mthun na des ro dang rjes su mthun pa'i las byed pa yin te/ de yang ro bzhin mi gnod pa zhu rjes kyis ro las ldog pa'i las byed pa/ lhag par du ro dang zhu rjes gnyis ka las go ldog ste nus pas las byed pa dag kyang yod/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir thang phye sogs sman sbyor gang yang ro yis las byed pa'i nus pa rnams ro la brten nas bsdebs shing sbyor ba dang / ngo bo'i nus pas las byed pa'i nus pa mthun pa rnams zhu rjes rang gi nus par brten nas bsdebs shing sbyor bar bya dgos so/ /20ro las go ldog nus pas las byed pa zhes go ldog ces pa gang 'dra zhig la go dgos sam/lan/ ro las go ldog nus pas las byed pa ni/ dper na ro'i dbang du byas na ka rañja lta bus bad rlung skyed kyang de las go ldog pa'i ngo bo'i nus pa dro bas bad rlung sel ba bzhin gyi las byed pa yin no/ /21 dung thod bcings pa'i blon po zhes pa sman gang gi ming yin nam/lan/ dung thod bcings pa'i blon po de dpe rgyan gyi sgo nas btags pa'i re lcag pa'i gab ming ste/ nges tshig ni re lcag pa'i me tog dkar po dung thod bcings pa ltar yod pas de la dpe blon po'i gzugs su bkod pa'o/ /22 bzang bo drug gi 'byung khungs mchog gang yin nam/lan/ bzang bo drug gi 'byung khungs gang las byung zhe na/ cu gang pre ta pu ri las byung ba bzang / gur gum kha che'i yul du byung ba bzang / li shi li yi yul du 111

byung ba bzang / dzā ti srin po'i yul du byung ba bzang / sug smel rgya mtsho'i gling nas byung ba bzang / ka ko la rdo rgod yul du byung ba bzang ba'o /23 gangs sbal la stobs ldan mu tig gos can zer ba'i go don ci/lan/ gangs sbal de nyid gangs kyi nang rtag tu gnas thub pa'i lus stobs ldan zhing / rgyab la pags pa mu tig gi gos g.yogs pa ltar 'od chem mer gnas pas mu tig gos can zhes btags pa yin no/ /24cong zhi zhes pa'i go don ci/lan/ gcong nad rgyu dang ma zhu ba dang / bad smug mkhris dug grang rigs/skran dang skya rbab 'or dmu chu/ mdor na gcong chen sde bzhi dang zur brgyad phra mo bcu drug sogs cong zhis sel phyir byed las la bltos nas cong zhi ste gcong dang cong gnyis don gcig go /25 'ching byed lcags brgyad ces pa gang dag yin nam/lan/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags/ 'khar ba/ ra gan/ zha nye/gsha' dkar bcas brgyad la 'ching byed lcags brgyad zer/26 mkha' lding dgra zhes pa'i sman de gang la go sam/lan/ ko byi la'i ming la 'jug pa ste/ ko byi la dug ma bton pa'i spu bzhar nas zan dang mnyam du sbyar te bya rog la byin na de'i nus pas bya rog myos nas 'phur mi shes par 'gyur bas so/ /27 sman rta la rigs gang dag dang nyes gsum so sor ji ltar sbyor dgos sam/lan/ de la sman nus rtsa rgyud du khrid byed kyi rta dang / sman khong du 'phul byed kyi rta gnyis las snga ma bu ram grang rlung sel ba'i rta/ ka ra khrag mkhris tsha ba sel ba'i rta/ sbrang rtsi chu ser bad kan sel ba'i rta dang / phyi ma rlung khong du 'phul byed kyi rta ni gar chang dang / mkhris pa'i sman khong du 'phul byed kyi rta ni gangs chu'am chu bskol grang mo/ bad kan kyi sman khong du 'phul byed rta ni chu bskol tsha ba yin no/ /28 thang dang phye ma ril bu bcas kyi 'brel ba ci ltar yin nam/lan/ thang gis gtso bo ro yis las byed pa dang / phye mas gtso bo zhu rjes 112

kyis las byed pa/ ril bus gtso bo nus pas las byed pa bcas 'di gsum po dus dang byed las dang nus pa'i go rim gyis 'brel ba'o/ /29 sman mar gyi khyad chos dang nges tshig ci/lan/ thang phye sogs dang mi 'dra bar lus kyi zungs stobs bskyed cing dbang bo gsal bar byed pa'i sbyor ba ste/ rtsi bcud dang ldan pa'i sman rigs rnams mar dang 'o ma mngar gsum sogs gdus nas bcud du bkugs pas na sman mar zer ro/ /30 sngo sbyor bstan pa'i dgos pa ci/lan/ zhi byed sde brgyad rin chen sbyor ba rnams/ /gso bya'i nad la mi sel 'ga' med kyang / /nam zhig lnga brgya'i dus su slebs tsam na/ /dbul po'i nad pa rnams kyis blur mi theg /mtha' 'khob yul du btsal bas rnyed pa dka'/ /thag ring yul du btsal bas nad pa 'chor/ /de phyir sa la skyes pa'i sngo rnams kun/ /skyes tshad mthong tshad sman du sbyar thabs zhu/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /31 gces pa'i yan lag bdun ldan gang dag yin nam/lan/ skyes sar skyes dang dus su btus pa dang / /skam gsed legs dang so ma rnyings pa dang / /dug 'don 'jam btsal 'phrod par sbyar ba'o/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /32 'jam btsal ba'i thabs gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ 'jam btsal zhes pa de ni sman sbyor gyi nus pa je 'jam du btang nas phog thug gi rang bzhin chung du gtong ba zhig yin te/ de yang thabs tshul mi 'dra ba'i rigs gsum yod/ sbyor ba'i sgo nas 'jam btsal ba dang / kha 'dzin gyi sgo nas 'jam btsal ba/ gnyen po'i sgo nas 'jam btsal bcas so/ /33 rdo sman rnams spyi 'dul byed pa'i lag len ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rdo sman 'brug klad dang rdo klad khra mgo bye'u mgo phag mgo khab len gangs thigs sogs nas 'bru tsam brdungs nas bong nga dmar po de'i phyed dang ljid tshad mnyam par byas pa'i grung chu la dus tshod gsum tsam du btsos nas khu ba dor 113

dgos so/ /34gser rdo dang stang zil mi nor ba'i khyad par ci/lan/ dang po gser rdo bcag pas kha ser shas che yang 'od kyi sna thung zhing gser zil sna ring ba yin/ stang zil gser zil gyi 'od kyi sna 'dra yang stang zil kha dog nag po yin/35 be snabs mi nor ba'i gzer ci/lan/ mi nor ba'i gzer bzhi ste/ gtso bo bcag kha mkhregs shing 'od dang ldan pa/ ngar lcags la brdabs pas me 'byung ba/ rdo la ri mo bris na kha dog med pa/zhib par btul na phye ma dkar skya 'ong ba'o/ /36 grang ba sel ba'i phye ma'i sbyor ba ga tshod yod dam/lan/ grang ba'i nad mtha' dag sel ba la rgyal po se 'bru'i sbyor ba dang /blon po da lis kyi sbyor ba/ rjes su rgod ma kha'i sbyor ba/ sna tshogs kha 'thor dmangs kyi sbyor ba bcas rnam pa bzhi yod/37 grang ba sel ba'i sman mar gyi sbyor ba gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar dang / rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar/ 'ba' sam sman mar/ da byid sman mar/ sgog skya bdun pa'i sman mar/ sgog skya'i sman mar/ ba spru gnyis pa'i sman mar/ bzang bo lnga'i sman mar/ gze ma'i sman mar bcas dgu yod do/ /38 lag len bco brgyad po gang dag yin nam/lan/ thang / phye ma/ ril bu/ lde gu sman mar bcas sde tshan lnga dang / snum 'chos/ bshal/ skyugs/ sna sman/ 'jam rtsi/ ni ru ha/ rtsa sbyongs bcas sbyong byed bdun dang / gtar/ bsreg dugs/ lums/ byug pa/ thur ma bcas dpyad drug ste bsdoms pa'i lag len bco brgyad do/ /39 bshal gtong rung dang mi rung ba'i nad gzhi'i khyad par gang yod dam/lan/ rung ba rims 'khrugs tsha ba smin rgyas dang / /dug dang snod tshad ma zhu skran nad dang / /skya rbab dmu chu bad smug chu ser mdze/ /dreg grum srin nad rab 114

rib rma rnying sogs/ /khyad par mkhris pa'i nad la mchog tu bsngags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 40 sman gtong tshul mi 'dra ba bcu yod pa de dag ji ltar yin nam/lan/ bad kan nad la zas ma zos pa'i lto stong dang gcig thur sel rlung la zas za ba'i sngon dang gnyis/ me mnyam rlung la zas kyi dbus dang gsum/ khyab byed rlung la nang par zas zos pa dang gyen rgyu'i rlung la dgong mo zas zos pa'i mthar dang bzhi/ yi ga 'chus par sman dang zas kham re spel nas gtong ba dang lnga/ nad phal cher la zas zhu mtshams gtong ba dang drug 'khru skyugs dang lud pa glo nad dbugs mi bde bar dus min tse gur gtong ba dang bdun/ sman gyis bsun par zas bcas gtong ba dang brgyad/ skyigs bu dang 'dar ba la zas kyi sngon rjes gnyis sman gyis mnan pa'i tshul gyis gtong ba dang dgu/ nam tshong yan chad kyi nad la mtshan mo gtong ba bcas bcu'o/ /41 nus bsregs thal ba zhes pa'i go don gang yin nam/lan/ shing sngo ldum brun la sogs nus ldan du bsregs dgos du ba ma shor bar kha bcad bsregs la/ grang nas kha phyes te nag 'tsher 'od dang ldan pa byung na legs pa'i rtags dang / sngo dkar thal sngon 'dra ba rnams nus shor ngan pa'i rtags dang / kham ser rang mdog ldan rnams ni ma tshigs pa'i skyon no/ /42 rin chen grang sbyor gyi bsten thabs dgu po gang dag yin nam/lan/ g.ya' phyi dug 'don 'jam btsal sna khrid dang / /bshig dang rtsa kha dbye ba snod btang dang / /phyi bsrung ba dang nus pa skyed pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1de bas dngos dang sbyar ba'i dbang gyur las/ /sa steng sman min ci yang yod ma yin/ /'grel/ mngar ba so gas kyi ro dang ldan pa'i sman rdzas kun la 'byung ba'i rang 115

bzhin dang de'i byed las kyis khyab par gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan de lta bas na/ sman nam rdzas su gyur pa'i dngos po gcig kho nar spyod pa'am rnam grangs 'ga' zhig mnyam du sbyar nas spyod pa dang / yang na ma bsgyur ma bcos pa'i rjen pa dngos sam sde tshan dang las lnga sogs su bstun te 'dul sbyong gi sgo nas nad dang ji ltar 'tsham par sbyar ba bcas gang gi dbang du gyur pa las kyang phan gnod kyi don byed nus pa'i phyir/'jig rten khams kyi gzhi chen po 'di'i steng du sman rdzas su 'khod mi nus pa'i dngos po ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ /2 mdor bsdus mngar ba'i ro yis rlung mkhris sel/ /nas rnying skam sa'i sha rnams ma gtogs pa/ /phal cher bad kan skyed par byed na'ang / /g.yag rgod nya lug sha dang sbrang rtsis phan/ /'grel/ ro rnams kyi las mdor bsdus pas mngar ba'i ro rnams kyis rlung dang mkhris pa'i nad sel ba dang 'brel/ de dag gi nang nas rnying ba dang skam sar gnas pa'i srog chags rigs kyi sha ma gtogs pa phal che bas bad kan grang ba'i nad skyed par byed cing / da dung g.yag rgod kyi sha dang / nya lug sbrang rtsi lta bu ni ro mngar ba'i khongs su gtogs mod kyang de dag gi ngo bo rang gi nus pa'i stobs kyis bad kan grang ba'i nad la shin tu phan pa'i las byed pa yin no/ /3nyes pa gsum po gnyis gnyis re res sel/ /'grel/ rlung sogs nyes pa gsum po'i nang nas rlung mkhris gnyis ni zhu rjes mngar ba des sel ba dang / bad kan dang rlung gnyis ni zhu rjes skyur ba des sel zhing / bad kan dang mkhris pa gnyis ni zhu rjes kha ba des sel ba bcas de ltar nyes pa gnyis gnyis zhu rjes re res sel bar byed pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ /4gangs can 'bigs byed zla nyi'i stobs can las/ /bsil drod phul du byung bas stobs zhes bya/ /'grel/ sman rdzas kyi nus pa'am mthu de dag la yang skye gnas kyi 'gyur ba'i dbang gis nus stobs che chung la khyad par yod cing / de yang ro mngar kha bska zhing nus pa bsil rtul dang ldan pa'i sman rdzas gang dag ni ri bo gangs can zhes srib ri'i 116

ngos su skyes pa dang / ro tsha skyur lan tshwa zhing nus pa tsha rno dang ldan pa'i sman rdzas gang dag ri bo 'bigs byed ces dro ba'i ngos su skyes pa bcas bsil sman bsil sar skyes pa dang drod sman dro sar skyes pa zhig yin zhing / de ltar bsil sman rnams bsil ba zla ba'i stobs can gyi gnas las byung ba dang / drod sman rnams dro ba nyi ma'i stobs can gyi gnas las byung ba yin gshis/ bsil drod gnyis kyi nus pa phul du byung ba'i don gyis de gnyis kar stobs dang ldan zhes bya'o/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ga 2 nga 3 nga 4ka 5 ga 6 kha 7 ka 8ga 9 nga 10 kha 11 kha 12 ga 13 nga 14ka15 ka 16 ga 17 ga 18 ga 19 ka 20 ga21 ka 22 ka 23 ka 24 ka 25 ga 26 ga27 ka 28 kha 29 ka 30 ka 31 nga 32 ka33 ka 34 ka 35 kha 36 ka 37 kha 38 ka39 ka 40 kha 41 kha 42 ka 43 kha 44 ka45 nga 46 kha 47 ga 48 ka 49 ka 50 kaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 ka kha ga 2 ka kha ga 3 ka kha nga 4ka kha ga 5 kha ga nga6 ka kha nga 7 ka ga 8 ka kha ga nga 9 ka kha nga 10 ka kha11 kha ga 12 ka kha ga 13 ka ga nga 14kha ga 15 ka kha ga16 ka ga 17 ka kha ga 18 ka kha ga 19 ka kha 20 ka kha nga21 ka kha nga 22 ka kha ga nga 23 kha ga 24ka kha ga 25 kakha ca 26 ka nga ca 27 ka ga ca 28 ka kha ga 29ka kha ga30 ka kha ga nga 31 ka kha ga 32 ka kha ga 33 ka kha ga 34117

ka kha 35 ga nga 36 ka kha nga 37 ka kha 38 ka kha nga39 ga nga ca 40 ka kha ga bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 tsu 2 tsu 3 ྾ 4྾ 5 tsu 6 ྾ 7 tsu8 snyo 9 tsu 10 ྾ 11 tsu 12 tsu 13 tsu14 ྾ 15 ྾ 16 tsu 17 ྾ 18 tsus bcad bdun pa/ ngos bzung rtags/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 brtag tshul rnam pa gsum ni/( )ka rgyu rkyen/ gnas/ mtshan nyid/ kha blta ba/ reg pa dri ba/ga rgyu/ rkyen/ rtags/ nga dus/ dbang bo/ spyod lam/2 nad pa'i sgo nas gso sla bar cha rkyen du yod/( )ka dgu/ kha brgyad/ ga bcu/ nga bcu gnyis/3 yan lag gi sgo nas gso sla ba gsum ni/( )ka sman pa/ nad pa/ sman/ kha sman pa/ nad pa/ nad g.yogs/ gasman pa/ sman/ nad g.yogs/ nga sman/ nad pa/ nad g.yogs/4nad pa'i sgo nas gso sla ba las gtso che ba ni/ ( )ka na gzhon pa/ kha snying stobs ldan pa/ ga bsgo ba la nyan pa/ nga sman kun bzod pa'i lus/5 'chi rtsa las mchil pas sgum 'thu 'dra ba'i rtsa'i 'phar tshul ni/( )ka bad kan gyi 'chi rtsa/ kha bad rlung gi 'chi rtsa/ ga bad mkhris kyi 'chi rtsa/ nga rlung mkhris kyi 'chi rtsa/118

6 'chi chu las 'o ma shi 'dra lta bu'i chu ni/( )ka rlung gi nad/ kha mkhris pa'i nad/ ga bad kan nad/nga khrag gi nad/7 chu'i ku ya sprin dang 'dra ba ni/ ( )ka snying nad/ kha mchin nad/ ga mkhal nad/ nga glo nad/8 sbrum ma'i rtsa dang khrag gi rtsa gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ ( )ka sbrum ma'i rtsa las khrag gi rtsa myur/ kha khrag gi rtsa las sbrum ma'i rtsa shed che/ ga sprum ma'i rtsa las khrag gi rtsa cung zad dal/ nga khrag rtsa dang sbrum ma'i rtsa la khyad par med/9 nad med kyi rtsa'i 'phar grangs ni/ ( )ka skabs rer lan lnga 'phar/ kha sman pa'i phyi nang gi dbugs la lan lnga 'phar/ ga nad pa'i phyi nang dbugs la lan lnga 'phar/ ngaskad cig la lan lnga 'phar/10 srin rtsa'i 'phar tshul ni/ ( )ka 'khyug cing rtsub par 'phar ba/ kha rtsub cing mgyogs par 'phar ba/ ga 'khyig cing myur la drag par 'phar ba/ nga 'khyig cing zheng tu leb mor 'phar ba/11 mig gi blta ba'i brtag tshul ni/ ( )ka khyad par lce dang chu la brtag kha lus yul tsha grang 'bur 'jam brtag ga rgyu gnas mtshan nyid dris la brtag nga tsha grang gnyis su brtag par bya/12 dri chu'i gyur tshul la sa bcad dbye ba/ ( )ka gnyis/ kha lnga/ ga bdun/ nga brgyad/13 spyir nad gzhi dang nad rtags bar gyi 'brel ba ni/ ( )ka me dang shing / kha chu dang 'khyag pa'i tshul/ ga me dang du ba/ nga nyi ma dang ba mo/119

14ngos bzung rtags kyi gnas la sa bcad dbye ba/ ( )ka gsum/ kha lnga/ ga bdun/ nga dgu/15 reg pa rtsa'i don thams cad mdor bsdus na/ ( )ka lnga/ kha brgyad/ ga bcu/ nga bcu gsum/16lus kyi stod smad don snon phyi nang kun tu nye ring 'tsham pa'i blta gnas ni/( )ka ltag rtsa/ kha ske rtsa/ ga mkhrig rtsa/ nga mchan 'og rtsa/17dpyid zla ra 'bring gi zla ba'i 'byung khams ni/ ( )ka me/ kha chu/ ga rlung / nga shing /18 rtsa rgyud mi khengs par zhar cing 'dar la 'phrig pa ltar 'phar ba ni/( )ka chu ser gyi rtsa/ kha srin rtsa/ ga mdze rtsa/ nga khrag rtsa/19 tsha ba'i nad kyis skyug na chag rtsa sogs rtsa smad/ ( )ka zhan pa/ kha snyoms pa/ ga drag nga rgyas/20 chu'i me tog phug ron khra yis gtor ba dang 'dra ba ni/ ( )ka dug kha byer ba/ ga rlung / nga mkhris/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 gdon rtsa spyi'i mtshan nyid ni/ ( )ka rtsa rgyud mi snyoms par 'gyur ldog mang / kha nges med du lcam dral byed pa/ ga drag cing lhog lhog tu 'phar ba/ nga nges med du sdod 'then byed pa/ ca dal bar 'phar ba/2 nad g.yog gi yan lag gi cha rkyen du gtogs pa ni/ ( )ka rig pa sgrin zhing blo dang ldan pa/ kha rtags la mkhas shing snying rje che ba/ ga gtsang spra che zhing blo dang ldan pa/ nga dpyad la goms shing bzod pa che ba/ ca sdug bsngal la mi 'dzem pa/120

3 gso thabs med pas spang bar bya ba ni/ ( )ka shin tu phyin ci log tu gyur ba/ kha mig gis gyen la blta ba/ ga'achi ba'i ltas snang ba/ nga srog gcod nad dgus bzung ba/ ca dbugs rgod pa/4ldog par mi 'gyur ba'i chu ni/ ( )ka khrag shed che ba/ kha gdon shas che ba/ ga tsha ba byer ba/nga grang ba 'byams pa/ ca bad kan nad can/5 rnam par ma gyur par tha mal du gnas pa'i rtsa rgyud rnam gsum ni/ ( )ka pho rtsa/ kha bu rtsa/ ga mo rtsa/ nga ma ning rtsa/ cabyis pa'i rtsa/6 sa khams mcher rtsa'i 'phar tshul ni/ ( )ka grims/ kha thung / ga 'jam/ nga rtsub/ca spud/7 bud med sbrum ma'i rtsa'i 'phar tshul ni/ ( )ka drag kha rgyas/ ga 'bur/ nga 'dril/ca mgyogs/8 grang rtsa'i khongs su gtogs pa ni/ ( )ka gud pa/ kha lhod pa/ ga bul ba/ nga mkhrang pa/ca 'dril ba/9 ma zhu gsar ba'i dus kyi rtsa ni/ ( )ka sbom/ kha zhan/ ga bying / nga mkhrang /ca phra/10khrag rtsa rlung rtsa rkyal bas mtshungs na yang rlung rtsa stong la khrag rtsa ni/( )ka 'bur/ kha grims/ ga 'dril/ ngargyas pa/ ca mkhrang /121

11 'chi rtsa las rtsa rgyud sdod pa ces bya ba ni/ ( )ka na sdod/ kha 'dre sdod/ ga 'chi sdod/ nga gcod sdod/ ca gdon sdod/12 gnyan tshad kyi rtags bzhi ni/ ( )ka dmar/ kha skrangs pa/ ga tsha ba/ nga sbun/ca gzer/13 dri chu la tsha mo'i dus su nges par du gsal bar brtag dgos pa mi//( )ka chu mdog kha rlangs pa che chung / ga ku ya dang spris ma'i srab mthug nga ldog tshul/ ca dri dang lbu ba/14tha mal nad med kyi dri chu'i khyad chos/ ( )ka kha dog 'bru mar bzhus 'dra/ kha ku ya snyoms khyab/ ga log rjes sngo ba/ nga rlangs yal yun ring ba/ ca spris ma srab pa/15 tsha ba'i nad can gyi dri chu ni/ ( )ka ku ya dang spris ma mthug pa/ kha rlangs pa che la yun thung ba/ga drod rlangs ma yal tsha log byed pa/ nga ngo bo log rjes smug la gar ba/ ca me tog sngon po 'char ba/16dri chu ldog par mi 'gyur ba'i nad gzhi ni/ ( )ka tsha ba byer ba/ kha grang ba 'byams pa/ ga gdon shas che ba/nga mdze nad/ ca dreg nad/17 ngo gdong la sha khebs 'khor ba de ni/ ( )nad rtags yin/ka pho ba/ kha snying / ga mngal 'khri ba/ nga mcher ba/ ca rlung tshabs/18 bad kan smug po'i nad kyi bshang mdog dang ngo bo dag ni/( )ka smug po/ kha ser nag ga skam pa/ nga sha ba'i ril ma 'dra/ ca gsob pa/122

19 rlung las tshad pa kha mtho ba'i nad kyi lcer brtag na/ ( )ka lce'i rtse yar 'dril ba/ kha skam pa/ ga mdog nagang lce rid pa/ ca lce gzhung gas pa/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/gso dka' ba/ tshegs chen po dgos pas gso dka' ba'o/ /gso sla ba/ bde blag tu grub pas gso sla ba'o/ /gang zag gdags gzhi phung bo lnga bo gang rung la brten nas btags pa'i mi'am skye bu'am sems can gang de'i rgyud la skyon yon gnyis ga re zhig gang ba dang re zhig zag pas na de ltar btags so/ /gtsang / lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i dri mas ma gos pas gtsang ba'o//cho ga thabs dang go rim la 'jug kyang skabs 'dir thabs la go /blo dang ldan pa/ spyod lam dang zas gang rung gi spang blang shes pas blo dang ldan pa/gnod bya mi mtshungs pa/ dper na rlung nad rus par ma zhugs pa lta bu/dus mi mtshungs pa/ rlung nad dbyar dus ma ldang ba lta bu/skye bo ya ga ngan pa/ skye bos brjod pa ngan pa ste ngan smras tshig rtsub 'byung ba'i don/shin tu phyin ci log grang bar tsha rtags ston pa dang tsha bar grang ba'i nad rtags ston pa lta bu/zhi ba/ ma snyoms pa snyoms par byed pa zhi ba'o/ /sbyong / dag par bya ba'i don/123

gal 'gag bzhi/ rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ga tsha ba dang / /rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ga grang ba/ /phyi rtags tsha yang ngo bo grang ba/ /ngo bo tsha yang phyi rtags grang ba'o/ /pha tse'i re so/ pha tse zhes gtsang yul gyi sgye mo'i ming yin la skabs 'dir don snod so so'i rtsa rgyud ma 'dres par gsal bor 'byung ba'i dpe'o/ /drung gsum/ tsha khu mag gsum/ zhang tsha skud po gsum/ khu ne zhang gsum sogs rang dang nye ba'i drung gsum la zer/la nye/ skabs 'dir rtags dang mtshan ma la go dgos/rmugs shing 'thibs pa/ rmugs pa zhes shin tu mi gsal ba dang 'thibs zhes dpyad 'jug mi thub pa/'brub cing brgyal ba/ rtsa rgyud phu chu ltar drag cing myur la brgyal zhes drag par 'phar rjes sdod pa/skyer tsher 'dra ba/ skyer shing gi tsher ma ltar sor mo'i ngos su 'bigs snyam byed pa ltar 'phar ba/me lce chad 'dra/ 'phar grangs shed mi snyoms par res che res chung bar 'phar ba/gcod sdod/ 'phar tshul rigs mi mthun gyis bar du gcod pa/gong brgal/ blta rtsa 'khrig ma'i rgyab ngos su brgal ba/rgyas/ rtsa rgyud sha khar yar don nas 'phar ba/'dril/ lcags kyi thur ma la sogs pa bzhin du sha nang nas rtsa gril gril mngon pa/mkhrang / mar mnan na stong sob mi byed par sra ba/zhan pa/ 'phar shed chung ba/bying ba/ sha gting du mar bying ba/gud pa/ sha nang nas mi mngon par nyams dma' zhing mi 124

gsal ba/bul ba/ bul ba zhes grangs dal bar 'phar ba/lhod/ rtsa shed gcig tu ma 'dres pa rnam pa 'bol bo/gnyan/ phyi nang gi srin bu 'khrugs pa las byung ba'i nad yod do cog gi ming /lcam dral/ 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba gnyis gshib tu 'phar ba/dar lce rlung bskyod/ dal brel mi snyoms pa stong zhing sbom la 'phar 'phror 'dar ba/khra yi mjug rtse 'dra ba/ myur bas grangs rtsis mi zin pa/thigs zags chu gzhug 'dra/ gcig gi rjes gcig gis ma slebs par snga phyi mi snyoms pa/nya mo rngam 'dra/ rlung mkhris ldan pa'i rtsa ste shed chung bar mnan na 'phar zhing 'dar la shed che bar mnan na mi 'phar ba/mchil pas sgum 'thu/ lan bzhi tsam thung zhing mgyogs la 'jam par 'phar nas 'dar ba/smin ma 'tshom/ tha dad du gzeng ba ste smin ma'i spu tshom bur 'khyil ba zhes kyang 'byung /yas/ bon po'i glud rdzas mdos gtor sogs la bshad/sbre dri/ ra lug sogs dud 'gro 'og can gyi rmongs kha'i dreg pa'i dri ma'i ming /spris ma/ chu kha'i zhag ste lus zungs chen po bdun gyi ya gyal tshil bur dwangs snyigs gnyis su phye ba las/dwangs ma rus pa'i gnas su 'gro ba dang snyigs ma rmen bu'i gnas su 'gro zhing de'i cha shas phra mo zhig dri 125

chu'i lam du phyin pa la spris ma zer/snag tsha chad pa/ snag tsha chus sbyangs pa dang 'dra bar dwangs snyigs phye ba/'gras/ phan tshun dgrar 'dzin pa'i bsam pa skye ba'i don/'chol ba/ go rim ma nges pa'am rtsa rgyud 'gyur ba'i don/byid po/ rgya mchil mgo dmar/tshogs pa chad 'dra/ sngo tshod btsos pa'i khu ba dwangs snyigs so sor phye ba la go /dam srid/ dam tshig nyams pa/gdags sribs/ tsha grang la godamar yol/ phor rtsi dmar po can/ku ya/ gcin nang 'dres pa'i zags rdzas phra mo zhig go /lu ma'i chu/ na gshongs nas skyes pa'i chu/ldog dus/ dri chu ngo bo ldog dus la zer/kha bcing / nad pa'i kha bkag pa/spo la 'don pa/ nad gang yin gsal bor rtogs nas de ji bzhin smra ba'i dpe ste dar lcog ri bo'i spo la bton pa lta bu/sngar tshul/ nad shugs ma rdzogs pa'i skabs de la zer/gnod bya mnyam pa/ bshang gci gnyis dus mnyam du 'gag pa lta bu/bol la brtag rkang ba'i bol gong gi 'phar rtsar brtag dgos pa'i don/la nye/ rten 'brel gyi don/rbad rbad/ thung thung ngam dum bur bcad pa'i don/snyigs/ rtsa dpangs dma' bas gting du bying zhing 'phar rgyun ring ba'i don/spun pa/ rtsa rgyud phra la thung thung du 'phar ba'i don/la shan dbye/ dbye 'byed byed pa'i don/126

khrag rgan/ khrag nad yun lon nas rnying ba'i don/cho rol/ nges med dam go ldog ces pa'i don/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1grangs dang dus nges pa can du sdod pa ni 'chi sdod yin/ ( )2tshon kan chag gsum zhes pa blta yul nad pa'i mkhrig ma'i mdun ngos la zer/( )3rims la yu la dus mtshungs na gso sla bar 'gyur// ( )4me tog phra la mdog ser zhing sangs skyen pa ni tsha ba'i nad kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i rtags/ ( )5 tsha grang gi spyi rtsa las rgyas bying gnyis ni shed che chung gis phyes pa yin/( )6dri chu'i nang du bal dang phye rdul lta bu rdzas zur ba zhig shor ba 'dra ba la ku ya zhes brjod/ ( )7nad gang brtag tshe nad de nyid kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin gsal por shes par bya/( )8nad gang brtag pa'i gzhi lta bu ni 'phel zad du ma gyur pa'i nyes pa rlung mkhris bad gsum yin/ ( )9gso sla ba'i yul du gyur pa'i nad gzhi la yan lag bcu gnyis po ldan dgos/( )10chu 'gags kyi nad la bshang pa'ang mnyam du 'gags par gyur na gso dka' ba'i mi yin/( )11nad gang gnod bya dang yul dus rang bzhin na tshod bcas mtshungs na gso sla ba yin/ ( )12srog gcod nad dgus lus khams nye bar bzung ba de gso bya'i nad yin phyir spang mi dgos/ ( )127

13glo bur du blta dgos pa byung ba'i nad par rtab rtab por rtsar blta dgos/( )14lus phyi'i 'phar rtsa blta gnas gtso che ba'i dbang du btang na bcu gnyis yod/ ( )15tshe gnas min kyi bla rtsa mkhrig ma'i mar zur gyi chu rgyus gseb tu brtag dgos/ ( )16'byung ba rnams lus khams kyi mtha' nas nang ngos su rim bzhin sdud pa'i phyir 'chi rtsa rkang ba'i bo'/ gong la brtag ( )17snying rtse bu ga'i gtad phyogs las pho mo'i blta rtsa phan tshun g.yas g.yon go ldog tu blta dgos/ ( )18lce skam zhing gyong la kha ba bro ba de ni snying la tsha ba zhugs pa'i nad rtags yin/ ( )19rlung nad drag pos thebs pa'am klad par skyon yod na mig ha rer bltas nas sdod 'dug ( )20rna ba'i rtsa'i mdog dmar zhing sbom phra snyoms pa dang shing lo rgyas pa 'dra bar rtsa ba ma thon pa bcas ni nad can yin rung nyes pa cher mi 'byung ba'i rtags yin/ ( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 ci zhig la ngos bzung rtags zer/lan/ me dang du ba ji bzhin du/ /nad kyi ngos ni rtags la bzung / /zhes pa ltar/ de yang nad gzhi dang nad rtags bar gyi 'brel ba ni me dang du ba'i 'brel ba ltar du ba mthong ba na me ru shes pa ji bzhin du nad rigs kyi ngos 'dzin ni nad rtags kyi snang tshul la brten nas ngos 'dzin dgos pas na ngos bzung rtags zhes brjod do/ /128

2 brtag tshul las khyad par lce la brtag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lce ni snying dang 'brel ba ste/ snying la khyab byed rlung dang mkhris pa sgrub byed gnas pa ma zad/ bad kan myong byed kyang lce rang la gnas pa dang / de bzhin rlung gyen rgyu'i rgyu lam yod pa sogs nyes pa gsum ka lce la gnas pa'i don gyis so/ / 3nyes pa dngos su ston pa'i brtag thabs la nang gses brtag tshul ga tshod yod dam/lan/ slong ba rgyu yi sgo nas brtag pa dang / /mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa dang / /phan gnod bsten pa'i sgo nas brtag pa bcas gsum mo/ /4ngag gis dri ba'i brtag tshul la khyad par gang yod dam/lan/ nad de nyid slong ba'i rgyu rkyen dang / na sa'i gnas/ nad de'i mtshan nyid bcas zhib tu dris la brtag dgos shing / ci'i phyir zhe na/ nad de nyid rkyen gang gis bslang ba yin min dris shing brtags pa de las nyes pa gsum po gang zhig yin pa shes thub pa dang / stod smad phyi nang sogs gang du gnas pa'i gnas dris shing brtag pa de las nad de nyid 'jug pa'i sgo drug gang zhig yin pa shes thub la/'phel zad 'khrugs gsum mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dris shing brtag pa de las nad rigs bye brag phra mo dang bcas pa kun shes shing ma 'dres par dbye ba phye nus par 'gyur ba bcas/ rgyu mtshan de lta ba'i phyir nad rigs la brtag par bya ba'i thabs tshul gang dag kun la dri ba'i brtag pa nyid ches gal che zhing gces par gdams pa yin/5 ngan g.yo skyon gyi sgo nas brtag pa la thabs rnam pa ga tshod yod pa dang gang dag yin nam/lan/ brtag pa'i thabs la rnam pa brgyad yod de/ mtshan nyid shes pa'i thabs dang / mtshang 'bru ba'i thabs/ yun dus bsring ba'i thabs/ sngar gyi rjes dpyad pa'i thabs/ bcud la bor ba'i thabs/ kha bcings ba'i thabs/ spo la gdon pa'i thabs/ thabs 'og gzhug pa'i thabs bcas so/ /6 blta reg dri gsum gyi dgos pa gang yin nam/129

6 blta reg dri gsum gyi dgos pa gang yin nam/lan/ reg pa rtsa la 'tsho 'chi dpyad pas rtogs/ /blta ba tsha grang chu la mthong bas gsal/ /slong rkyen gar babs na lugs dris pas shes/ /zhes pa'o/ /7 gso sla ba'i yan lag gang dang ldan dgos sam/lan/ sman pa sman dang nad g.yog rnam pa gsum/ /sman pa mkhas pa'i stegs la 'dzegs pa dang / /gzhung gi don shes las rnams mthong zhing gtsang / /sman ni cho ga yon tan mang du ldan/ /phun sum tshogs shing 'phrod par sbyar ba'o/ /nad g.yog sgrin brtse gtsang sbra blo dang ldan/ /yan lag bcu gnyis ldan na gso ba sla/ /zhes pa'o/ /8 reg pa rtsa'i spyi don bcu gsum po gang dag yin nam/lan/ sngon 'gro lnga dang dngos gzhi brgyad de/ zas spyod kyi spang blang bslab pa dang / rtsa blta ba'i dus/ rtsa blta ba'i gnas/ 'phar rtsa'i mnan tshad/ 'phar rtsa blta ba'i tshul bcas sngon 'gro lnga dang / tha mal rtsa rgyud gsum du brtag /dus gzhi'i rtsa la khams lnga'i 'byung ba rtsi/ /ngo mtshar rtsa bdun nad med mi la blta/ /nad dang nad med 'phar ba'i grangs las dpags/ /spyi dang bye brag rtsa yi nad ngos bzung / /'chi rtsa gsum gyis 'tsho 'chi kha dmar gdags/ /gdon rtsa glo bur ye 'drog rim gro 'bogs/ /tshe rtags bla yi rtsa la brtag pa bcas dngos gzhi brgyad do/ /9 rtsa blta mkhan gyi sman pa la mtshan nyid gang dag ldan dgos sam/lan/ sman pa gnyid log chang ma 'thung / /drag las smra ba mi bya zhing / /mya ngan ma btab sems mi bde/ /nad kyis ma btab lus bde ba/ /bud med lhan cig gnas pa spang / /khams gsal ba ni blta bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /10 rtsa blta ba'i khyad chos drug ldan de gang dag yin nam/lan/ blta dus mkha' la nyi shar klungs ma phebs/ /nang dbugs dron mo phyir ma rgyus pa dang / /phyi dbugs grang mo nang du ma shor ba/ /mal nas ma 'gul kha zas ma zos pa'i/ /gdags sribs dbugs snyoms rtsa mal gnas dus blta/ /zhes pa'o/ /11 dus su rtsa blta dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/130

lan/ dus su ma yin par snga ba'am 'phyi na phyi nang chos mtshungs kyi dbang gis rtsa gzhan dang 'khrul 'a gro ba yin te/ 'phar rtsa'i nang rlung khrag gnyis rgyu ba yin pas de las snga ba'i tho rengs sam grang ba'i dus su rtsar bltas pa yin na grang ba'i stobs des khrag gi rgyug shugs chung du song ste rtsa'i 'phar shugs kyang chung stabs bad rlung sogs grang ba'i rtsa dang 'khrul 'gro ba dang / de las 'phyi ba'i nyin gung ngam tsha ba'i dus su bltas pa yin na lus khams 'khrugs pa dang drod tshad kyi dbang gis rtsa'i nang khrag gi rgyug shugs che ru phyin te rtsa'i 'phar shugs kyang che ru phyin stabs khrag mkhris tsha ba'i nad dang 'khrul 'gro ba yin no/ /12 rtsa blta ba'i gnas zhes pa gang yin nam/lan/ rtsa blta ba'i gnas ni lag pa gnyis po'i mkhrig ma'i gnyer ma dang po nas nad pa rang gi tshon gang mar bcal ba'i rus pa 'bur po'i zad mtshams kyi ldebs de nas 'go bzung ste sman pa'i mdzub mor tshon dang / gung mo la kan/ srin lag la chag ces grags pa de gsum ma 'drus pa ste phan tshun ma 'brel tsam snyoms par bzhag ste blta bar bya dgos/13'phar rtsa lus khams kyi mgo rked rkang lag kun tu khyab kyang lag pa'i mkhrig rtsa la blta dgos don ci/lan/ de yang gnyid log dang mchan khung gi 'phar rtsa sogs la bltas tshe/don snying dang nye bas ri gzar gyi phu chu 'brub pa'i sar mi gnyis phan tshun gtam gleng byas pa ltar snying gi nad tsam las gzhan rtogs mi nus la/ yang rkang ba'i bol rtsa sogs la bltas tshe/ don snying dang thag ring bas sa thag ring ba nas 'ong ba'i mgron pa'i gtam dang 'dra bar nad rigs bye brag rnams kyi rtags gsal bar mi rtogs pas na/ mkhrig ma'i blta gnas 'di nyid ni lus kyi stod smad dang / don snod phyi nang thams cad du nye ring 'tsham pas rgyang grags kyi dbyar skad bzhin du gsal ba'o/ /14tshon kan chag gsum gyi mnan tshad mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lag ngar gyi nywa sul gyi srubs nas thon pa'i rtsa dbyibs de sa 'og nas rim gyis thon pa'i la phug dang 'dra ste/ sha rngams gru mo'i phyogs su nye ba de zab pa 131

dang / mkhrig ma dang nye ba'i sha rngams mi zab pa las byung ba yin/15 bud med sbrum ldan gyi 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba de ci 'dra yin nam/lan/ bud med mngal du byis pa chags pa'i dus su byis pa de'i dbang gis rtsa rgyud 'bur la 'dril zhing gting shas che bar 'phar ba dang / de yang byis pa bu yin na mkhal rtsa g.yas pa drag par 'phar ba dang / bu mo yin na mkhal rtsa g.yon par drag par 'phar gyi yod pa red/16 skyes pa dang bu mo gnyis kyi tshon rtsa g.yas g.yon go ldog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ spyir skyes pa dang bud med kyi glo ba dang snying gi sdod phyogs la gzhogs g.yas g.yon du nye ring gi khyad par med mod kyang / snying gi rtse mor yid 'jug bu ga yod pa de skyes pa thabs kyi rang bzhin yin pas snying rtse'i bu ga rkyang ma ste g.yon phyogs su nye ba dang / bud med shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pas snying rtse'i bu ga ro ma ste g.yas phyogs su nye ba'i phyir ro/ /17 nad ngos 'dzin par brtag thabs kyi man ngag gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ brtag pa'i gzhi dang / gang la brtag pa'i yul/ gang du brtag pa'i sgo/ji ltar brtag pa'i tshul bcas rnam pa bzhi yi sgo nas bstan pa yin/18nad pa glo bar du blta dgos pa'i tshe yid gzab byed dgos pa gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ ji skad bstan pa'i sngon 'gro zas spyod kyi spang blang de rigs sgrub khom med pa'i nad pa glo bur tu blta dgos pa byung ba rnams la yang de 'phral rtab rtab por rtsar mi blta bar/ snga sor nad pa dang sman pa gnyis so so bgrod pa'am rtsol bas dub pa'i dbugs kyi ngal gsos shing 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba nyid mal du tshud de rang sor gnas pa'i rjes gzhi nas blta dgos pa ma zad/ da dung nad pa'i lus khams 'khyags drags pa'am drod drags pa dang / lag pa bsdams pa'am gcus pa sogs mdor na glo bur ba'i rkyen gzhan sna tshogs pas rtsa'i dpangs ma btegs pa bya dgos pa de ci nas kyang gal che zhing gces par bzung nas brtag dgos pa yin/19 ngo mtshar rtsa bdun po gang dag yin nam/132

lan/ khyim gyi mo phywa dang / mgron gyi mo phywa / dgra yi mo phywa/ grog gi mo phywa/gdon gyi mo phywa/ da dung me chu go ldog ces pha bu dang khyo shug phan tshun go ldog ste blta ba dang / sbrum ma bu rtsa brtag pa bcas rnam pa bdun gyi sgo nas bstan pa yin/20 nad med lus la cha snyoms ldan pa'i rtsa drug ni gang dag yin/lan/ che chung med par snyoms par 'phar ba dang / stod smad phra sbom med par snyoms par 'phar ba/ drag dal med par snyoms par 'phar ba/ bying rgyas med par snyoms par 'phar ba/ sdod 'then med par snyoms par 'phar ba/ thang lhod med par snyoms par 'phar ba bcas so /21 gzhi rtsa ma rtogs na nyes skyon gang dang gang dag yod dam/lan/ 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba gnyis mnyam gshibs lta bu'i lcam dral du 'phar ba la sogs pa lta bu gzhi rtsar yod pa'ang nges med du 'byung srid pa'i phyir na/ sman pas kha dmar dngos su ma gdags gong du blta yul nad pa de nyid kyi gzhi rtsar gnas tshul de rigs yod med zhib tu dris nas shes pa'i rjes gang la de 'tsham gyi sgo nas nad de dang de'i kha dmar gdags shing gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /gal te nad pa de nyid kyi gzhi rtsar skyon gang dang gang yod pa sogs kyi shes byed gang yang med par rtab rtab por smras pa na kha dmar log par 'gro ba dag yod la/ der ma zad da dung pho rtsa dang /mo rtsa bud med sbrum ma'i rtsa bcas gsum po zhib tu ma shes na de dag tsha ba'i nad kyi rtsa dang 'khrul so yod pa dang / byang chub sems rtsa rgyun ring 'jam la mnyen pa de bad kan grang ba'i rtsa dang 'khrul so yod cing / da dung don snod gang rung gi rtsa ma tshang ba dang / 'phar mtshams gcod pa/ grangs gang rung gi mtshams su sdod pa rnams 'chi rtsar 'khrul ba dag yod gshis/ gzhi rtsa blta ma myong ba'i nad pa rgyus med rnams la thog ma nyid nas pho rtsa yod dam mo rtsa yod pa la sogs dri ba gces so/ /22 stod smad don snod kyi nad rnams ji ltar blta dgos sam/lan/ de dag stod smad don snod gar babs nad/ /tshon rtsa gnyis kyis glo snying stod nad brtag /kan rtsa gnyis kyis pho mchin bar nad brtag /chag rtsa gnyis kyis mkhal rked smad nad brtag /gdags sribs rtsa yis don lnga snod drug brtag /133

yar zur don lnga phyir rgyu gdags kyi rtsa/ /mar zur snod drug nang rgyu sribs kyi rtsa/ /don snod phal cher cho rol mi 'byung zhing / /don tsha snod la grang ba 'byung srid kyi/ /snod tsha don la grang ba 'byung mi srid/ /stod smad gnyis kyang de bzhin shes par bgyi/ /de dag ma 'dres phra zhib phyed par rtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /23 tsha grang spyi rtsa bcu gnyis po gang dag yin nam/lan/ 'phar tshul sdom na 'di lta ste/ /drag zhan gnyis ni shed che chung / /rgyas bying steng 'og gnas stangs blta/ /ril ril gcig 'dril mi gsal gud/ /mgyogs bul gnyis ni grangs kyis dpag /gzhu rgyud ltar grims de lhog lhod/ /mkhrang ba mnan bzod stong mi bzod/ /ces pa'o/ /24 rtsa'i nor 'phrang drug po ji ltar ngos 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ khrag rtsa rlung rtsa rkyal byed nor ra re/ /rgyas tshad stongs tshad rgyug byed nor ra re/ /bad kan khrag rgan bying byed nor ra re/ /khrag rtsa rkyal yang grims shing mnan na bzod/ /rlung rtsa rkyal zhing stong bas mnan mi bzod/ /rgyas tshad drag la grims pa mnan na bzod/ /stong tshad mnan mi bzod la stong cha yod/ /bad kan rtsa rgyud bying zhing gud pa yod/ /khrag rgan rtsa la shed che'i khyad par yod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /25 rtsa rgyud 'gyur ba'i nad de dag nyes gsum dang sbyar na ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung la sbyar na dar lce rlung bskyod 'dra ba dang mkhris par sbyar na khra yi mjug rtse 'dra ba/ bad kan dang sbyar na thigs zags chu gzhug 'dra'o/ /26 ma tshang ba'i don lnga'i rtsa la phyi rtags gang dag 'byung ngam/lan/ snying rtsa ma tshang lce nag 'bur tshugs blta/ /glo rtsa ma tshang sna zhom nang spu log /mchin rtsa ma tshang mig ldog smin ma tshom/ /mtsher rtsa ma tshang mchu 'phyangs lhin sna rdib/ /mkhal rtsa ma tshang sgra chad rna ba sbyar/ /zhag gcig gnyis gsum lnga dang brgyad na 'chi/ /zhes pa'o/ /27 bla rtsa blta ba'i gnas gang yin nam/lan/ bla rtsa ni lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i rus pa 'bur po'i mar zur chu rgyus kyi 134

gseb tu blta dgos pa yin no/ /28 bla rtsa'i yon tan ni ji ltar yin nam/lan/ bla rtsa snyoms par lan brgya 'phar ba ni/ /lo brgya thub ste lnga bcus lnga bcu thub/ /de bzhin 'phar res lo re thub par bshad/ /ces pa bzhin no/ /29 mthong ba me long chu zhes pa'i go don ci/lan/ mthong ba me long chu zhes sman pas mig gis mthong ba me long gi gzugs brnyan rtogs pa ji bzhin du chu yi kha dog dang ku ya sogs las nad gdon rtogs thub pas na chu la brtag par bya'o/ /dper na/ nyi mas 'od las nyin mo snang ba ltar/ /ji bzhin ston 'di chos nyid yin mod kyi/ /rtags la brten nas rnam dpyod blo mig gis/ /lkog gyur mngon sum mthong ba e ma mtshar/ /zhes pa'o/ /30 chu la blta ba'i sngon 'gro'i dgos pa gang dag yod dam/lan/ chu la blta ba'i sngon 'gro'i dgos pa ni sngon 'gro'i spang blang bzhin byas nas chu mdog mi 'khrul ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /31 chu snod dkar yol nang du blta dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ chu snod dkar po'i nang blta dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni snod dkar po ma yin pa'i kha dog dmar po sogs kyi nang du bltas na chu mdog snod kyi kha dog tu 'gyur bas spang dgos pa yin no/ /32 nad ngos 'dzin stangs ga 'dra zhig la ltar snang lnga phrug zer/lan/ nad gzhi'i ltar snang 'khrul so rtags kyis bsal/ /rtags kyi ltar snang 'khrul so bcos kyis bsal/ /bcos kyi ltar snang 'khrul so goms pas bsal/ /goms pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so skyed kyis bsal/ /bcos skyed ltar snang 'khrul so chu yis bsal/ /chu mdog ltar snang 'khrul so ku yas bsal/ /de la nor ba nam yang 'byung mi srid/ /de dag ltar snang lnga phrug zhes bya ste/ /'khrul med tsha grang nad kyi gal mdo yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /33 chu la brtag pa'i dus gsum dang brtag tshul rnam pa dgu zhes pa gang dag yin nam/135

lan/ dus gsum tshan de ngad yal grang ba gsum/ /tshan de'i dus su mdog rlangs dri me tog /ngad yal dus su ku ya spri ma brtag /grang nas ldog dus ldog tshul log rjes brtag /bcas so/ /34sman pa mkhas pas chu la brtag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ spyir don nad rnams rtsa la gsal zhing snod nad rnams chu la gsal ba dang / khyad par du 'tsho 'chi'i dbye ba rtsa yis 'byed par byed kyang / tsha grang la shan chu la gsal bas sman pa mkhas pas chu la brtag par bya ba yin no/ /35 tha mal nad med kyi chu gang 'dra zhig yin nam/lan/ tha mal nad med gnas pa'i chu bstan pa/ /kha dog 'bri mar bzhus 'dra sbre dri mnam/ /rlangs pa che chung yun ring me tog snyoms/ /ku ya snyoms khyab spris ma ko chu tsam/ /rlangs yal dus na mtha' nas sgor mor ldog /log rjes dkar ser dwangs pa nad med yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /36 ku ya zhes pa gang 'dra zhig la zer/lan/ ku ya zhes pa dri chu'i nang du bal lta bu'am sa rdul lam spu sogs dri chu rang ma yin pa'i rdzas zur pa zhig shor ba 'dra ba sprin ling ling ba de la brjod/37dri chu'i gyur tshul ga 'dra yin pa dang dri chu de nyid las nad ngos bzung thub pa'i don ci/lan/ gyur tshul zas skom pho bar dwangs snyigs phye/ /snyigs ma rgyu ma'i nang tshud ska sla phye/ /sla ba rgyu grog rtsa nas lgang bar 'dril/ /dwangs ma mchin pa'i gnas brgyud khrag tu 'gyur/ /khrag gi snyigs ma mkhris pa'i gnas su gsog /mkhris pa'i dwangs ma lus kyi chu ser 'gyur/ /mkhris pa'i snyigs ma chu yi ku ya 'gyur/ /rtsa mig 'grims nas lgang ba'i nang du gsog /de phyir chu yi kha dog zas kyis sgyur/ /ku ya khrag mkhris gnas nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ /lus la tsha grang gang yod chu la gsal/ /dper na tshong bas tshong 'dus gtam brjod bzhin/ /zhes pa'o/ /38brtag thabs reg mthong gnyis kyi lag len zhe brgyad kyis nad ngos bzung zhes pa'i lag len zhe brgyad gang dag yin nam/136

lan/ brtag thabs reg mthong gnyis kyi lag len zhe brgyad ni/ thog mar rtsa la spyi don bcu gsum yod pa'i sngon 'gro la lag len re re dang / dngos gzhi brgyad kyi dang po tha mal pa la brtag pa'i rtsa rgyud gsum/ gnyis pa dus don khams sbyor ba dang skor 'go dgra grogs brtsi ba gnyis/ gsum pa la ngo mtshar gyi rtsa bdun/ bzhi ba la nad med kyi rtsa gcig lnga ba la spyi bye brag gsum/ drug pa la chu rtsa gsum/bdun pa la gdon rtsa brtag pa dang / rim 'gro 'bogs pa gnyis/ brgyad pa tshe la brtag pa gcig ste nyer bdun dang / chu la spyi don brgyad yod pa'i dang po sngon 'gro lnga la lag len re re dang / drug pa la brtag pa'i dus gsum dang brtag tshul dguspyi bye brag gnyis te bcu bzhi/ bdun pa 'chi chu dang brgyad pa gdon chu gnyis la re re ste nyer gcig bcas bsdoms zhe brgyad do/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1dri bas brtag pa rna ba'i yul kun te/ /gang gis gang ltar gang du gang / /khyad par rgyu gnas mtshan nyid dris la brtag /rgyu las nyes pa gnas la 'jug pa'i sgo/ /mtshan nyid nad rigs bye brag phyed par 'gyur/ /de phyir brtag pa kun la dri ba gces/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ de yang brtag tshul gsum las gces par 'dzin pa ni dri bas brtag pa nyid yin te/ nad pas ci brjod pa sman pas rna ba gzhan la ma g.yeng bar nyan dgos pa dang / thog mar nad pa la 'dri ba'i dus gang gis te rgyu rkyen zas dang spyod lam rnams gang zos gang byas dri zhing des nad kun shes par 'gyur ba dang / phyis su gang ltar te na lugs ji ltar na ba dri ba dang / gang na ste gnas gang du na ba dri ba/gang du ni dus gang du ste nyin mtshan dus drug la sbyor ba/ mtha' ma'i gang zhes zas dang spyod lam gang dang gang gis phan pa dang gnod pa 'byung ba dri ba byas te brtag par bya'o/ /de ltar brtag pa yin mod khyad par du rgyu ste slong rkyen dang / gnas te 137

gang du na ba'i gnas/ mtshan nyid de rlung mkhris bad kan gyi mtshan nyid kyi zur 'don pa bcas gsum gyis brtag par bya ste/ rgyu slong rkyen nyid kyi ngo bo dang mtshan nyid shes dgos pa rmang gzhi'o/ /nad kyi gnas de gsal bor dris pas 'jug sgo rnam pa drug po ste pags pa sha rtsa rus don snod sogs gang la babs pa gsal bar shes la des nad rigs spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba phra mo dang bcas pa gsal bor rtogs par 'gyur phyir brtag tshul 'di gces par bzung bas kha dmar dang gso bcos legs po bya nus so/ /2 ci'i phyir 'phar rtsa kun la yod mod kyang / /don dang nye na phu chu 'brub dang mtshungs/ /ring ba thag ring mgron po'i gtam dang 'dra/ /'tsham pas rgyang grags dbyar skad bzhin du gsal/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ blta rtsa de nges par du mkhrig ma'i rus pa'i ldebs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod pa la/ 'phar rtsa ste rlung khrag 'doms pa'i rtsa tsam zhig brang khog stod smad mgo ske rkang ba yongs la khyab nas yod mod kyang / de dag las don snying dang nye ba 'ga' la rtsa bltas na shin tu ma rung bar 'gyur te/ lung ba'i phugs su gnas pa'i chu nyid 'brub pa dang mtshungs shing der nad pa dang sman pa gnyis gang zag gnyis kyi dbang tu byas nas phan tshun gyi gnas tshul lab gleng ci byas kyang sgra tsam las go rgyu mi 'dug pas don snying kho na'i rtsa tsam las gzhan gyi rtsa dag mi shes la/ shes kyang phu chu 'brub pa'i tshul du song ste drag cing grims sogs tsha ba'i rtsa dang nor nyen che'o/ /phan tshun bar thag ring bor gyur pa/ dper na/ bod rang la rgya gar nas 'ong ba'i gtam lta bu ste de la yid ston bya mi thub la rdzun gyi tshig sogs brjod 'ong ba ltar thag ring ba rkang ba sogs kyi rtsar bltas pas kyang rtsa'i rgyun chags kyi bar mtshams dag du zas spyod sogs rgyun ldan gyi las kyis byas te 'phar tshul la dgra byed do/ /de'i rkyen gyis blta gnas thag ring thung snyoms pa mkhrig ma'i gnas su rtsa bltas na 'os shing 'tsham par 'gyur la/ rgyu mtshan ni chu bo chen po'i pha rol du mi gnyis kyis skad chen po'i bshad pas/ de dang rgyang grags kyi sar chod pa dag gis dbyar kha'i dus der nyan pas ji dang ji brjod pa mi gsal zhing mi go ba'i skabs med pa ste/ blta gnas der 138

rtsa bltas pas don snod bye brag dang bcas pa'i rtsa ste/ 'di pho bar nad yod pa'o/'di snying gi tshad pa'i rtsa yin no sogs kyi kha dmar legs par gdags nus so/ /3sha chang la sogs drod bcud drag po dang / /'ju dka' bsil ches nad gzhi 'khrug pa spang / /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ spyir nad can dang nad med gang yin yang sang zhogs rtsa blta ba'i snga rol nas sha chang bur rnying sogs drod bcud drag po'i rtsa yang tsha rtsa dang mthun zhing /de bzhin 'ju dka' rul sungs bsil ches grang ba'i nad gzhi slong ba dang / 'grangs ches dus su rtsa dpangs mtho la grims par 'gyur ba/ ltogs ches dus su rtsa dpangs dma' la grims pa/ nyal bo gnyid chag sogs kyang rlung rtsa dang mthun pa/ 'gro 'dug mang bas rtsa yang 'tshub pa 'ong ba/ lus kyi dro grang steng nas tsha drod rgyu bas rkyen de rnams spang nas brtag na/ lus khams kyi 'du ba rnams gsar dus mi 'khrugs pa'i nad gzhi rang nyid kyi ngo bo rnams gsal bar rtogs nus pa yin pa'o/ /4mkhrig ma'i ngos kyi 'phar rtsar blta skabs de'i mnan tshad go rim 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ lag ngar nya sul gyi srubs nas thon pa'i 'phar rtsa'i dbyibs de sa 'og nas rim gyis rgyas te thon pa'i la phug dang 'dra bar gnas shing / de ni lag ngar ngos kyi sha grims kyi rngams zab cing mthug pa dang / mkhrig ma'i ngos kyi sha rngams mi zab cing srab pa bcas kyi khyad par las tshon gyis pags pa non tsam dang /kan gyis sha non tsam/ chag gis rus pa non bcas 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba ji bzhin gsal ba non dgos pa yin/5don tsha snod la grang ba 'byung srid kyi/ /snod tsha don la grang ba 'byung mi srid/ /ces pa'i rgyu mtshan shod/'grel/ don ni zhe sdang srog rtsa khrag la brten de gnas pa las mkhris pa skyed pa sogs kyis 'brel che zhing rang bzhin gyi tsha ba shas che ba dang / snod du me drod 'phel te tsha ba yod na don la grang ba 'byung mi srid de snod snyigs ma'i gnas las rang bzhin gyi grang ba shas che ba'i phyir dang / don la khrag 'khrugs pa'i tsha ba yod pa 139

la/ snod la me drod nyams pa'i grang ba 'byung srid kyi/ dper na glo la rnag tshad yod pa la/ long du grang bas sbo 'khrog byed pa 'byung srid pa bzhin no/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 kha 2 kha 3 ga 4nga 5 kha 6 ga 7 nga 8ga 9 kha 10 nga 11 ka 12 ka 13 ga 144ka15 nga 16 ga 17 nga 18 ga 19 ka 20 khaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 ka kha nga 2 ka ga 3 ka ga nga 'jikha ga nga 5 ka ga nga6 kha ga 7 ga nga 8 ka kha ga 9 ka nga 10 ka ga nga 11ka kha ga 12 ka kha ga ca 13 ka kha ca 144ka kha 15 ka ga nga16 ka kha ga nga 17 ka ga nga 18 ka ga nga 19 ka kha ngabazhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 du 2 ྾ 3 tsu 4྾ 5 ྾ 6du 7 tsu8 ྾ 9 sa( 10 ྾ 11 ྾ 12 ྾ 13 ྾14tsu 15 tsu 16tsu 17 tsu 18 ྾ 19 20 tsu140

sa bcad brgyad pa/ gso byed thabs/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1gso yul nad rnams mdor bsdus na/( )ka bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ kha stong dang nyis brgya/ ga brgya rtsa gcigang gsum/2rlung nad thams cad sel ba'i thabs ni/ ( )ka 'jam rtsi dang snum 'chos/ kha 'jam rtsi dang bcud ldan/ gabashal dang bsil sman/ nga 'jam rtsi dang skyugs/3 nad rigs skyed cing 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu ni/ ( )ka zas spyod mi mthun pa/ kha dus dman lhag log pa/ ga dbang bo stobs mdangs nyams pa/ nga pho ba'i 'ju stobs zhan pa/4zung 'jug rlung la mchog tu gyur pa ni/ ( )ka sbrang rtsi/ kha bu ram/ ga ka ra/ nga til mar/5mkhris pa tsha ba'i nad la mar gsar mchog ces pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ( )ka nus pa bsil ba'i phyir/ kha ro mngar ba/ ga zhu rjes las byed pa/ nga bcud che ba/6rlung dang grang ba'i nad rnams sel ba la/ ( )ka gtar ga kha me btsa'/ ga thur ma/ nga rtsa sbyongs/7gtar ba snga ba'i skyon ni/ ( )ka rlung skyed tsha ba byer/ kha ngan khrag rtsa 'grams/ ga tshad ro lus/ nga nad khrag mi thon pa/8 khrag ma gtar sngon thang gtong ba ni/ ( )ka nad khrag dang zungs khrag dbye ba/ kha nad khrag 'byin sla ba/ gzungs khrag mi 'chor ba/ nga lus zungs snyoms pa/9 gtar rtsa don bdun las lag pa'i gtar rtsa/( )141

ka su ma cu so bzhi/ kha nyer gcig ga bco brgyad/ nga bzhi/10 mig dmar ling thog mod pa la gtar pa'i rtsa ni/( ) ka gser mdung / kha mig rtsa/ ga dngul mdung / nga spyi gtsug 11 gtar ga'i log gnon la grangs rnam pa/( ) ka khrag ma thon pa sogs bcu/ kha ngan khrag med pa sogs lnga/ gakhrag ma chod pa sogs drug nga rlung skyed pa sogs kha shas/12me btsa' gdab skabs spra ba'i sbyor tshad ni rtsa sgo 'gags pa la/( )ka mdzub mo'i rtse mo tsam/ kha mtheb chung tsam/ ga a ru ra tsam/nga leb mo ril ma tsam/13 lkog nad smra mi shes pa'i gsang ni/( )ka mchu 'og kha phyi long / ga lce rtsa/ nga snying rtsa/14khyon bsdoms me gsang la grangs ka( ) ka bdun bcu don dgu kha nyer brgyad/ ga nyi shu/ ngabadun cu don gcig15mdun gsang la me dmigs kyi grangs ka( )ka nyi shu/ kha nyer brgyad/ ga nyer dgu/ nga bco lnga/16spra ba btu ba'i dus bzang ni/( )ka dbyar/ kha dgun/ ga ston/ nga dpyid/17ske stong tsa ra khung gi gsang ni/( )ka srog rtsa dang snying 'doms pa'i gsang / kha srog rtsa'i gsang / garlung gsang / nga snying gsang /18 bshal gtong rung ba'i nad gzhi ni/( )ka skran nad/ kha gzhang nad/ ga zug rngu khong du lus pa/ ngaskyug lang can/19 sman gyi btang tshul las rgyug che ba ni/( )142

ka zas ma zos/ kha zas mtshams/ ga zas mnan/ nga zas sngon/20 bad kan gyi nad la mchog tu gyur pa ni/ ( )ka nya sha/ kha 'bru rnying / ga sbrang rtsi/ nga chu skol/21 rkyang ba'i nad la spyod pa'i gso tshul ni/ ( )ka byi la 'jab pa/ kha dme shor 'khrug zlum/ ga mi sha 'phrang 'phrad/ nga dpa' bos dgra 'dul/ 22 rlung 'phel ba'i nad la/ ( )ka brta bas gso/ kha smyung bas bcos/ ga tsha bas bcos ngarno bas bcos/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 nad kyi sgo nas gso sla ba ni/ ( )ka rgyu dang sngar tshul mtshan nyid chung ba/ kha gnod bya yul dus rang bzhin mtshungs pa/ ga gnod med lan gcig rkyang ba/ nga na tshod gzhon pa/ ca pho ba'i me drod che ba/2 gso thabs med pas spang bar bya dgos pa ni/ ( ) ka shin tu nad stobs che ba/ kha phyin ci log pa/ ga 'chi ltas snang ba/ nga 'bras bu srog gcod nad dgu smin pa/ ca nad tshabs che ba/3 sman gyi btang tshul bcu po'i bltos sa ni/ ( )ka zas za ba'i chos nyid/ kha nad ldang ba'i dus tshod/ ga nad gzhi'i rang bzhin/ nga nad stobs che chung / ca na tshod kyi rang bzhin/4bye brag gi gso tshul de la nang gses dbye ba/ ( )ka ma zhu ba dang bcas pa'i gso tshul/ kha rkyang ba rang rgyud can gyi gso tshul/ ga 'dres pa gzhan dbang can gyi gso tshul/ nga khyad par 143

ldan 'dres kyi gso tshul/ ca dus kyi gso tshul/5mkhris nad kyi kha 'dzin sman ni/ ( )ka tig ta/ kha hong len/ ga bse yab/ nga gser me/ca ba sha ka6lus stobs skyed pa brta ba'i yul ni/( )ka btsas rjes khrag zags pa/ kha mya ngan gyis dub pa/ ga glo rdol rgas pa/ nga dpyid dus/ ca lo nari gzhon pa/7nad pa'i zug rngu'i tshor ba che chung las dpyad la dbye ba/( )ka 'jam/ kha drag ga dal/ nga rtsub/ ca mgyogs/8 gtar ga mi rung ba'i nad gzhi ni/ ( )ka skya rbab/ kha mdze nad/ ga me drod nyams pa/ nga gdon can/ ca rgas pa/9 dbye thang ma btang bar khrag gtar bas ni/ ( )ka zungs khrag 'chor ba/ kha nad khrag mi thon pa/ ga rlung skye ba/nga tshad ro lus pa/ ca chu ser 'dren pa/10 snying tshad nad la gtar ba'i rtsa dmigs ni/ ( )ka snod ka kha lce rtsa/ ga thong rtsa/ nga ru thung / cabyin gzhug11 gtar ga gdab thabs kyi gtsags bu'i 'debs tshul la/ ( )ka glo phug kha sgang gshags/ ga dol chod/ nga nyis len/ca smyug kha/12 nad can gyi khrag pra ni/ ( )ka mdog ser la ngo bo sla ba/ kha dri dugs la wu ba dkar ba/ gasna ring la be snabs rnag mkhris chags pa/ nga dmar nag gi ri bo 'byung ba/ ca dri mi zhim pa/13 mdangs gsum zhes pa ni/ ( )144

ka mig mdangs/ kha lus mdangs/ ga sha mdangs/ nga so mdangs/ ca skra mdangs/14gnas kyi sgo nas me btsa' mi rung ba ni/ ( )ka snod la zas zos ma thag pa/ kha dbang po'i sgo/ ga pho mo'i srid rtsa/ nga snying gsang / ca mkhris pa'i gsang /15me btsa'i gdab dmigs la/ ( )ka nad kyis tshur bstan pa/ kha sman pas phar btsal ba/ ga rang bzhin gyi gsang / nga glo bur gyi gsang / ca na tshod kyi gsang /16me btsa' gdab thabs kyi rnam pa/ ( )ka btso ba/ kha bsregs/ ga bsro ba/ nga bsdig pa/ camanan/17me btsa'i phyi rjes kyi cho ga ni/ ( )ka me shi spra grangs mtheb rgyas gdab pa/ kha gom pa 'ga' bcag pa/ga de nub chu mi btung ba/ nga zas spyod gzab pa/18 bsregs legs pa'i rtags su/ ( )ka ya yo med pa/ kha chu bur phra mos me btsa'i mtha' bskor ba/ game shul na tsha med pa/ nga me khod snyoms pa/ ca dbang bo gsal ba/19 dugs bya mi rung ba'i nad gzhi ni/ ( )ka ku ya nag po/ kha rlung gzer/ ga dmu chu nag po/ ngazos rjes/ ca bad kan nad/20 gnas kyi dbang gis lums bya mi rung ba ni/ ( )ka mig kha mkhur tshos/ ga snying kha/ nga dreg bzhi/ca pho gsang / 21 lums kyi phan yon ni/ ( )ka tsha rlungs ba spur 'don/ kha rlung 'dul/ ga skrangs 'joms/145

nga dbang bo gsal ba/ ca mkhris nad sel/22 lums bya thabs kyi sta gon la/ ( )ka sman rdzas 'thu ba'i rim pa/ kha chang dang phabs kyi rim pa/ga bdud rtsi lnga bsnyal ba'i rim pa/ nga lums 'dug stangs kyi rim pa/ca phyi rjes kyi rim pa/23 'du ba cha snyoms kyi sman ni/ ( )ka a ru ra/ kha dzā ti/ ga brag zhun/ nga gur gum/ case 'bru/24rlung gi nad sel ba'i yon tan dang las ni/ ( )ka skyugs/ kha bcud/ ga bsil/ nga 'jam/ca snum/25 bad mkhris ldan pa'i nad kyi gnyen po ni/ ( )ka bcud/ kha bsil/ ga yang / nga drod/ca snum/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/gso tshul/ gso thabs spyi'i rtsa 'dzin nam rtsa don la zer/gso thabs/ nad la gso byed gnyen po dngos bsdebs pa'o/ /brta/ rgyas pa'i don/dman/ nyams chung bar btang ba/shi bo/ 'thab byed dus dpung chung ba'am pham kha byung ba'i phyogs la zer/'od ma/ rgya gar sogs su skyes pa'i smyug ma'i rigs shigakhye'u sus/ skabs 'dir snga dro skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su gotse gur btang / sman thun chung ba yang yang btang ba'i don/rtse bcil/ nad kyi rtse zhi ru 'jug pa'am nad gnya' gcog 146

pa'i don/shi bo/ phyogs gnyis 'khrugs pa byed pa'i nang re zhig pham kha 'khel ba'i phyogs de'i mi/byi la 'jab pa/ byi la 'jab nas byi bar so lta byed pa'i don/sad mda'/ tshod bgam mam tshod blta byed pa'i don/spo la dar 'phyar/ ri bo lta bu spo mtho'i rtse la dar 'phyar ba'i don/rta rgod dkyus 'dzud/ rta rgod lam shur gyi dkyus su btsan thabs kyis bcug pa'i don/skyar mo nya len/ bya skyar mos snga sor brtags te mthong ba'i rjes de 'phral nya bzung ba'i don/dme shor/ nang mi spun mched lta bu rus rgyud nye ba'i bar 'khrug pa shor ba'i don/sna sel 'khrog thang / lto ba sra snyir brtag pa'i sman sbyor gyi ming /kha col chung ba/ yid rten mi rung bar 'gyur ba'i don/kha 'dzin/ gzhi rtsa'i sman sbyor gyi steng du nad rigs bye brag pa so sor phan pa'i sman rdzas kha tshar ram kha snon pa'i don/chud mi gsan/ 'phro brlag gam stongs zad du gtong mi rung ba'i don/yib/ sha rigs yun lon nas ham spu chags pa'i don/khur tshod/ khur mong g.yos pa'i tshod ma la zer/chag tshe/ nas chag bskol ba'i thug pa/yab cha/ yo byad/khrag pra/ khrag bzang ngan rnam par dbye ba'i pra/dol chod/ rtsa rbad chod du bcad pa'i don/nyis len/ thengs grangs gnyis len pa'i don te/ de yang dang po gtsag bus pags pa bkral/ gnyis pa khab rtse 147

gug pas rtsa btegs nas gtar dgos pa'i khrag gtar thabs kyi ming /bem tol/ mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis phan tshun gnon 'then byas pa las thon pa'i gnon shugs/log gnon/ slar nad log mi yong ba'i phyir nan gyis gnon pa'i don/'bog dran med du brgyal ba'i don/sdigs/ 'jigs skul btang ba'i don/rlung nad kha yan/ rang dgar 'phel ba'i rlung nad kyi ming /brdugs/ thabs shes bral ba'i don/ skar chu/ tho rengs skar ma ma yal ba'i dus su blangs pa'i chu/byang ma'i rmos lcags/ gshol lcags byang lta'am rnying pa brdar zad kyis 'jam sha 'don pa la zer/shag ma/ rdo'i shag phye'am bye gsega'akhar gong srin can/ srin 'bus zos pa ltar khung bu mang po bton pa'i 'khar gong /dbyig dug rin po che'i rigs las byung ba'i dug nad/mchod rten na bza'/ mchod rten gyi ldebs su gsol ba'i dkar rtsi/khru gang 'og sa/ thal lud dri chu sogs ba tshwa yod sa'i ngos nas gting du khru gang brkos pa'i 'og gi sa/sbang gar/ chus ma bsings pa'i sbang glum/slo dron/ rta bong gi grod pa'i nang gi slo dron mo/kha nyen po/ mi gang rgyun du stobs med par gnyom chung nus med du gnas pa/sbeg lus kyi sha skem pa'am rid pa/sman dred/ sman 'thung drags nas 'jigs pa'am sun snang 148

skyes pa la zer/mi bsrun/ rgyud rtsub pa'am spyod pa rtsing ba'i don/smyung bya/ zas mi za bar ltogs par gnas dgos pa'i don/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 gso tshul ni nad rigs gso bcos byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don yin/ ( )2 gso thabs ni zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi'i gnyen po dngos yin/( )3 pho long gnyan srin gyi sad mda' bya khyung lnga ba yin/ ( )4nad gang gsog dus zhi la zhi dus su zas spyod gang 'phrod bsten dgos/( )5gso byed kyi gnyen po kun mdor bsdus pas zhi byed dang sbyong byed gnyis/( )6dbugs mi bde ba'i nad la phan pa'i sman ni mtshan mo nyal kha'i dus su gtong /( )7me btsa'i sad mda' rdo grang chu bcag bya dgos/ ( )8dugs ni phog thug thebs thub pa'i dngos rdzas rigs kyis thad kar na zug yod sar bdug par brten nas nad gzhi gso thabs byed pa zhig yin/ ( )9ma zhu ba dang glang thabs kyis gzer zug langs ba la bsil dugs brgyag chog( )10byis pa'i mchin dugs ni byis pa'i mchin pa cher rgyas pa'i nad la spyod pa'i thabs shig yin/( )11 brag zhun dang 'dres pa'i chu tshan gyis pho ba'i drod nyams pa dang grang skran sogs la phan/ ( )12 sna nad la sna rtsa dang rna ba'i nad la rna rtsa gtar dgos/ ( )13 rlung dang mkhris pa ldan pa la bsil drod snyoms par bcos/ ( )14ni ru ha zhes pa legs sbyar skad kyi mas btang gi don yin/ ( )149

15lus tsho che bas men bu'i nad dang khrag rtsa'i nad rigs gcin snyi sogs 'byung sla la lus kyi 'gul skyod dka' ba bcas 'byung phyir tsho ba las skam pa bzang ( )16rtsa dkar nag gi nad dag par byed pa la rtsa sbyong zer/ ( )17snum 'chos drags pas ma zhu ba dang bad rlung skyed/ ( )18 bad rlung grang ba'i nad rnams rang gnas su bsad cing ro mi ldang bar byed pa la dugs/ ( )19 bad rlung nad kyang khrag mkhris bsdongs na gtar/ ( )20 nad khrag mdog gzhan du snang nas ri mo med na gtar mi rung / ( )21 gtar ga'i skabs khrag thon pa las khrag gi rlangs thon na de bas phan che/( )22 snying nad cis kyang ma phan la lce rtsa gtar dgos/ ( )23 khrag bska sla yi khyad par 'byed pa'i pra la khrag khra zer/( )24gtar drags na zungs zad la rlung skyes nad gzhug lus pa yin/( )25 thun mong gi gso yul gnyis ste 'phel ba dang zad pa gnyis/( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 gsog ldang zhi gsum gyi dus dang sbyar ba'i gso tshul de ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung la sogs pa'i nad rigs rnams rang gnas su gsog pa'i dus su thang dang phye ma'i sbyor ba sogs zhi byed kyi sbyor ba rnams kyis zhi bar bya dgos la/rang gnas las langs nas rgyas par gyur pa'i skabs su bshal skyugs sogs sbyong byed kyi sbyor ba rnams kyis phyir sbyang ba'i sgo nas bcos dgos pa dang / de ltar bcos nas nad zhi zhing 'joms par gyur pa'i dus la slebs tshe zas spyod gang dag gzab cing nad gzhan dang zungs la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba 'jam po'i rigs kyis nad mjug 'don zhing lus zungs gso bar bya dgos pa'o/ /2 spyir gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis yod pa rnams dril na ji ltar yin nam/150

lan/ mdor bsdus gnyen po sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi/ /sman la zhi sbyang zhi la bsil drod gnyis/ /sbyong byed kun la drag dang 'jam pa gnyis/ /dpyad la 'jam rtsub zas la phan gnod gnyis/ /spyod lam drag dal zas sman spyir 'gro'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /3 nad rtse zhi zhing gzhom min gyi tshad gzhi de gang la 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ nad gang gso dpyad sbyar yang mchil snabs mang / /lus lci dang ga mi bde zas mi 'ju/ /rgyun skam khong 'drul bshang gci dus min 'byung / /shed chung skad dma' nad rtse ma zhil rtags/ /nad gang zhi dus gong las ldog rtags 'byung / /zhes pa'o/ /4nad spyi'i gso tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dang po rlung la sogs pa'i ji snyed nad/ /rang gnas gsog pa'i dus su bsal bar bya/ /langs shing rgyas nas nad gzhan 'khrug byed phyir/ /gzhan la gnod pa med pa'i sbyor bas gso/ /nad gzhan skyes na nad stobs gang che bcos/ /zhes pa'o/ /5 rkyang pa rang rgyud can gyi nad rigs rnams la gso tshul ji ltar 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ de dag thog mar rlung zhugs nad 'khrug phyir/ /'jig cing 'ju byed zas kyis smin byas pas/ /nad 'thor rlung de tshar gcod khong par bsdu/ /dper na char ba 'bebs pa'i rlung gnon 'dra/ /de nas gang dang nye ba'i lam nas sbyang / /yan lag phyir gnas khong du ma 'dus na//rtsa sgo phyi dang nang nas sbyangs la dbyung / /zhes pa'o/ /6'dres pa gzhan dbang can gyi nad rigs rnams la gso tshul ji ltar 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ gzhan dbang bla gnyan bcas pa'i nad yin te/ /rang gi gnas nas langs nas gnas gzhan phyir/ /phyin nas rang gnas snga ma la gnod 'khrug /de stobs chung na rang gnas snga ma gso/ /phyi ma stobs che bla gnyan de bcos pas/ /rang gnas gnas pa bcos mi dgos par 'tsho/ /dper na rkun mo bsten pa'i rje bo bzhin/ /zhes pa'o/ /7 lus khams su nad gang zhig byung rung stobs che ba de thog mar bcos dgos 151

don ci/lan/ thog mar nad stobs che ba de ma bcos na rang gi srog la nyen kha che ba'i phyir te/ de yang stobs che ba de nyid bcos shing 'joms par gyur pa na stobs zhan pa de nyid bcos mi dgos par rang bzhin gyis 'tsho ba yin/8 nad zungs thun mong du gso ba ces pa de ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gso yul nyam tsha0/ cing sbom pa dang nyam chung zhing rid pa gnyis su nges pa'i phyir gso thabs kyang rnam pa gnyis te/ gang zhe na stobs skyed pa'i phyir brta bar bya ba dang / nyam dmad pa'i ched du smyung par byed pa'o/ /9 mdor na nyes gsum rkyang ba ldan 'dus so so ji ltar bcos dgos sam/lan/ mdor na rlung nad 'jam rtsub bcud kyis bcos/ /mkhris pa'i nad la bshal dang bsil gyis bcos/ /bad kan nad la skyugs dang drod kyis bcos/ /rlung dang mkhris pa ldan la bsil bcud bsten/ /bad mkhris ldan la bsil la yang bas bcos/ /bad rlung ldan la dro la bcud pas bcos/ /'dus pa'i nad la bsil bcud yang bas bcos/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /10nyes gsum nad gso bcos skabs su mi 'da' ba gsum yod pa de gang dag yin nam/lan/ rlung 'jam rtsi las mi 'da' ba dang / mkhris pa bshal las mi 'da' ba/bad kan skyugs las mi 'da' ba bcas gsum mo/ /11 dpyad ces pa'i go don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ cha byad dam sman rdzas sna tshogs pas lus khams kyi phyi nas reg pa'am dpyad de zug rngu la sogs pa'i nad gang dag mngon sum du phyir 'byin pa'am nang du zhi bar byed pa gang yin pa der dpyad ces tha snyad gdags pa yin/12 cha byad kyi skor la rnam grangs sde tshan ga tshod yod dam/lan/ cha byad kyi skor la rnams grangs lnga yod de/ zug rngu brtag pa'i cha byad dang / zug rngu 'byin pa skam pa'i cha byad/ 'dral zhing nad khrag 'byin pa gtsag bu'i cha byad/ dbugs pa thur ma'i cha byad/ phran bu sna tshogs pa'i cha byad bcas so /152

13 gtar ga'i cha byad la khyad chos gang dag 'dzoms dgos sam/lan/ dang po cha byad rno mnyen ldan pa'i lcags/ /mgar ba mkhas pas sbu gu'i sgro 'dra'i dbyibs/ /rtse sgur tshes ris zla ba lta bu'am/ /ltag nyal so drang brang ba can dang ni/ /sta re'i kha 'dra kun kyang srid sor drug /thar 'byongs ngar ldan brdungs 'thems brdar legs pa༈ /rno tshad gyen du spu gshog nus pa ste/ /gze dang mi gze de la rag las pas/ /gtsags legs rtag tu lus la bcang bar bya//zhes pa'o/ /14gtar ga'i sngon 'gro tshul bzhin ma byung na nyes skyon gang yod dam/lan/ gtar ga'i sngon 'gro gdus thang nad gzhi dang bstun nas ma btang bar gtar bas zungs khrag 'chor zhing nad khrag mi thon la rlung skye zhing tshad ro lus pa'i nyes skyon dag yong gi yod pa red/15 gtar ga gdab thabs kyi cho ga'i lag len ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gdab thabs rtsa ma 'chus par mthe bos mnan/ /cung zad thur du 'then pas rtsa mi 'gyur/ /phal cher bsnyal 'og sor gsum 'og tu gtar/ /glo phug sgang gshags dol chod nyes len dang / /smyug kha la sogs gang bde gang goms gdab/ /de yang rtsa chen rnams la sgang gshags bya/ /rtsa phran smyug kha shin tu phra ba bcad/ /gnad steng rtsa la nyis len bsngags pa yin/ /khrag pas rlangs phan rma kha che bar bya/ /rma chung skrangs dang khrag gi rlangs mi thon/ /rtsa kha lpags kha mnyam na legs pa yin/ /rus steng rtsa la sta re so yis gtar/ /rtsa stong mi 'gyur 'phrad btsugs bem tol brdeg /ltag rtsa sdud sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyen du gshag /mur gong 'phar rtsa skra yi gseb tu gtar/ /rtse chu nga mas kyi sor bzhi bcal bar gtar/ /gtar ma thog tu mi glod khrag mi thon/ /mgo ske long rtsa gsum la glod mi bya/ /gzhan dag khrag chad dus na cha yis glod/ /zhes pa'o/ /16 gnad steng rtsa la nyes len bsngags pa yin zhes pa'i go don ci/lan/ snod ka sogs gnad steng rtsa la nyis len te thog mar gtsag bus gshags shing rtsa dngos shing bur bteg ste slar gtsag bu brdeg pa'i don no/ /17 gtar mi rung ba'i nad gzhi gang dag yin nam/ 153

lan/ gtar du mi rung ba'i nad gzhi ni gdon can zungs zad sbrum ma dang /btsas rjes skya rbab gcong chen me drod nyams/ mdor na bad rlung las gyur nad la spang dgos mod/ rgyud las/ 'on kyang khrag ma phyed dang rims ma smin/ /stongs tshad dug ma gsod dang gnyan tshad dang / /zungs zad tsha ba yin yang gtar mi rung / /bad rlung nad kyang khrag mkhris bsdongs na gtar/ /dog dang rtsa mdud bla gnas sar mi gtar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//18 nad gang byung 'phral gtar dgos pa gang yin nam/lan/ byang khog khrag babs don la zin pa dang / /khrag ma chod dang rgyas 'khrugs smin long med/ /dus la mi bsdad brtson pas thog mar gtar//zhes pa'o//19 gtar dus ma shes pa'i skyon gang dag yin nam/ lan/ gtar dus thog mtha' bar gsum dang mi ldan par gtar ba sngas na des rlung skye zhing tsha ba slar byer bar byed la/ 'phyis na ngan khrag de nyid phyi nang gi rtsa mig nang du sib kyis 'grams te nad ro mi thon zhing / lhag par tsha stobs che ba la gtar ba 'phyis na tsha ba de'i stobs kyis rtsa dang don glo snying sogs nad gang babs de nyid 'drub zhing rnag tu 'gyur ba bcas pa'i skyon 'byung ba yin no//20 khrag gi dbyung tshad la tshod 'dzin ji ltar byed dgos sam/lan/ dbyung tshad nad thon zungs khrag byung na bcad/ /zungs khrag khrag zhabs med kyang ran tshod bzung / /don gzer zug gcog khrag gzer dbyung ba dang / /'ol ka bsgyur gsum zungs khrag yin yang gdon/ /zungs zad rlung ldan ngan khrag yin yang bzhag /rgyas 'khrugs gzer dang byang khog khrag rgyas dang / /yan lag skrangs shor bungs skyed khrag shed dmad/ /de ma yin la mang gtar nyung du dbyung / /wu ba khrag dmar spris g.yogs gtar 'phro bcad/ /zungs ngan gtar tshad rnag tu 'ong ba'am/ /gtar khrag chu dang 'dra na gtar tshod bzung / /rnag la bltas nas mang du gtar ba yis/ /zungs 'dzad gso dka' dmu chu 'gyur ba yod/ /ces pa'o/ /21 gtar ga'i skabs khrag mi thon pa'i rgyu gang dag yin nam/lan/ khrag mi thon pa'i skyon ni lus grang ba dang / mtshon rtul ba'i rno med pa/154

zas kyis 'grangs drags pa/ nad pa gtar gar skrag pa/ gdon kyis gnod pa/'grul sna byung ba/rma kha chung ba/ bsdams skabs pags pa 'chus pa/ bsnyal ma thog tu gtar ba/ gtar ma thog tu glod pa bcas de dag bcu bo ni khrag mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin no/ /22gtar skyon du dman lhag log gsum 'byung ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gtar ga'i skyon la dman lhag log dang nyes pa bcas phyogs rnam pa bzhi yi sgo nas bstan pa ste/ gtar zhan khrag ro mi thon nad gzhug lus/ /mchin skran smug po mdze 'bras sur ya skyed/ /byang khog yan lag chu ser rnag tu 'gyur/ /gtar drags zungs 'dzad rlung skye me drod 'chi/ /grang skran skya rbab dmu chur 'gyur ba mang / /log pa mi rung nad la gtar ba'am/ /nyes pas sha gdan snad dam chu rgyus bcad/ /gnad la song ngam 'phar rtsa bcad pa yis/ /sman pa'i lag dgras bya nyes bsad pa yod/ /de phyir skyon la mkhas pas gzab par rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//23 gtar legs pa'i yon tan gang dag yod dam/lan/ gtar legs yon tan rtsa nad ngan khrag sbyong / /gzer ba zug gcog skrangs pa rgyu nas 'joms/ /'drul ba rtas byed rnag chu rtsad nas gcod/ /rma yi mdog 'byin 'khol bu'i nad rlangs 'don/ /sbom po 'bri la skem po sha rgyas byed/ /nad dngos phyir 'byin dpyad mchog gtar gar bshad//ces pa'o//24spra ba'i las snon ci ltar yin nam/lan/ ston dus btu ba'i spra ba de nyid skam gsed byas rjes sna ma chad par shing bus brdungs nas khu lu ltar chags rjes spra shig dang / thal rdul/ snyigs ro sogs med par bzos thog za shing gi 'tshag ro dang spra ba mnyam du 'phur mnyed legs par btang ste spra ba'i mdog nag la bsgril bde zhing me len sla ba zhig chags par byed dgos/25 spra ba spyod skabs sgog skya byug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ sgog skya byug pas gcig nas spra ba de gsang dmigs su 'byar sla ba dang / gzhan da dung sgog skya ngo bo lci bas rlung kha gnon pa'i nus pa yod do/ /155

26 me btsas gdab thabs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ tshigs pa'i mkhar la mdzub mo'i rtse mo tsam/ /mgo dang yan lag mdun la mthe chung tsam/ /rtsa sgo 'gag la leb mo ril ma tsam/ /'bras dang skran la a ru ra tsam bya/ /byis pa'i lhan snar sran ma 'phos pa tsam/ /zhes pa'o/ /27 me btsa' gdab tu rung ba'i nad gzhi gang dag yin nam/lan/ ma zhu me mnyam skya rbab dmu chu skran/ /grang mkhris mgo dang yan lag chu ser dang / /'bras dang lhog pa stongs pa'i tsha ba dang / /smyo byed brjed byed rtsa nad thams cad dang / /tsha rjes phal cher me yis bcad pa ste/ /mdor na bad rlung las gyur grang ba kun/ /rtsa nad chu ser me yis bsregs pa bsngags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang gza' skar sper sme sogs dang / de bzhin bla gnas dang rigs ldan gyi dus bcas su bsregs mi rung /28 me btsa' gdab thabs kyi cho ga'i lag len ji ltar yin nam/tā/na/ spra ba bzhag la me spar skyabs 'gro bya/ /me phabs thal ba mi 'gul thud kyis brdeg /du ba chad nas spra lhag khab mgos gsang / /sum gnyis mched nas spra ba gcig la spar/ /tsha ba rgyun mi chad na tshos pa skyen/ /bsregs legs khod snyoms ya yo med pa dang / /chu bur phra mos mtha' bskor na tsha med/ /tshos tshad mdun btab rgyab tu kar rtse na/ /rgyab btab mdun du na zhing skyugs snyam byed/ /'tshos pa yin pas spra ba bsregs 'phro bcad/ /tog thon spra ba yar na phan cher 'dod/ /ces pa'o//29 hor me'i gsang dmigs gang dag yin nam/lan/ mgo bo'i spyi gtsug dang / ltag pa'i sdud sgo/ mtshog gsang / rna lhan gyi 'dus srubs/ brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams/ tshigs pa dang po dang drug bdun rkang lag mthil bzhi sogs rlung gsang rnams la spyod dgos pa'o/ /30 me btsa'i phyi rjes kyi cho ga ji ltar byed dgos sam/lan/ phyi rjes me shi spra grangs mtheb rgyas gdab/ /gom pa 'ga' bcags de nub chu mi btung / /bcags pas lus brtas chu 'thungs me dbal gsod/ /ces pa'o/ /31 me btsa' legs pa'i phan yon ji ltar yin nam/156

lan/ phan yon rtsa yi 'bros 'phrang 'gegs par byed/ /a na'i zug gcog rlung nad kha yan gnon/ /ma zhu 'ju zhing lhin skran bshig par byed/ /'bras dang rma rgan sha ro ngan pa gcod/ /skrangs pa'i mgo gnon chu ser 'dren skem sdom/ /don snod sgo srung drod skyed dran pa gsal/ /gso dpyad gzhan brdugs phal cher me yis gso/ /zhes pa'o/ /32 me btsa' gdab thabs las dang po btso ba zhes pa'i go don gang yin nam/lan/ 'bras dang skran nad kyi rigs nad tshabs che bar me btsa' thengs gcig gi rjes su slar yang gcig bskyar nas gdab pa'i thabs shes la brten nas me thengs grangs nyi shu yan chad kyi bar gdab ste 'tshos par bya ba'o//33me btsa' mi rung ba'i skabs pho mo'i srid rtsar spang zhes pa'i srid rtsa de gnas gang du yod dam/lan/ pho mo'i srid rtsa ni mtshan dbrag tu rtsa gsum 'ong ba'i dbus chu rtsa dang /g.yas srog rtsa/ g.yon srid rtsa yin no//34dugs bya rung ba'i nad gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ dang po bad rlung ma zhu glang thabs dang / /chu ser khrag 'khyags tshad pa'i gzer la bsten/ /zhes pa'o/ /35 dugs kyi dpyad der dmigs gsal gyi khyad chos gang yod dam/lan/ stabs bde la nad 'joms shing zug 'phral du gcog pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan no/ /36 hor me rgyag stangs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ go snyod kyi 'bru dang dza ti gnyis zhib brdungs byas pa zho do'i tshad sang ras nang bsgril te mar khur btsos nas rlung gsang rnams la tsha rgyag byed dgos pa zhig yin/37 lums zhes bya ba'i go don ci/lan/ sman dang chu tshan gyi nus par brten nas rengs 'khums sra mkhregs su gyur pa'i rigs sogs mnyen zhing lums par byed pas na lums zhes bya ba yin/157

38 bsil lums dang drod lums gnyis las drod lums la rigs du yod dam/lan/ chu tshan gyi lums dang / bdud rtsi lnga lums/ mi rus btsa' ma'i lums/bye lums/ rlangs lums bcas lnga yod/39 lums bya rung ba'i nad gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rung ba yan lag rengs 'khums zha ba dang / /'bras dang lhog pa rma rnying rma gsar skrangs/ /tshabs dang sgur po sha rus chu ser g.yos/ /rlung nad ma lus kun la bsngags pa yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /40 chu lums dang bcing lums kyi khyad par ci/lan/ chu lums ni rang byung chu tshan nam sman rdzas kyi dwangs ma bzos mar lus byings zhugs nas bcos thabs shig dang / bcing lums ni sman rdzas dwangs snyigs 'dres mas gnas nges can zhig mnyen par byed pa la'o/ /41 chu lums nam dus ga tshod la rgyab na 'tsham po yod dam/lan/ chu lums rgyag pa'i dus tshod de dpyid ka dang ston mjug gi dus tshod gnyis la brgyab na 'tsham po yod de/ dus der gnam gshis dro grang snyoms pa dang /lhag par chu tshan gyi nus pa che ba dang nad pa'i lus khams la 'phrod pa bcas kyi dge mtshan yod pa red/42spyi gtsug tu spra ldan gser me rgyag skabs gnas kyi tshad gzhi de ji ltar 'jal dgos sam/lan/ nad pa'i lus 'drong por bzhag rjes smin dbrag nas ltag khung bar dang / rna ba g.yas kyi bu ga nas g.yon gyi bu ga so sor thig re 'then pas dkyil gyi rgya gram 'khel sa'i spyi gtsug gi gnas der dug sel byas rjes spra ldan gser khab btsugs dgos/43 me bum rgyag skabs lag len gyi go rim gang dang gang byed dgos sam/lan/ me bum rgyag skabs nad pa'i gnas tshul la gzhigs te me bum che chung 'os 'tshams zhig bed spyad de me 'bar sla ba'i shog tshal chung ngur me spar te me bum nang mgyogs por bcug nas nad dmigs steng sbyar te sha pags dam por bzung ba 158

dang lag pas yang yang brdungs/ zug 'jags rjes de'i mtha' chu phran tsam byugs te lag gcig gis sha pags mnan pa dang / gcig gis me bum de ga ler bkod pa'i gnas der skrangs pa dang mdog dmar smug khrag ngan chu ser sogs yod na rma chung mang po gshags nas yang bskyar me bum btsugs te 'then dgos min gnas tshul la blta dgos/44bsil dugs de nad rigs gang la sman rdzas sogs dngos rdzas gang gis gnas gang du rgyag dgos sam/lan/ bsil dugs de tsha ba'i nad rigs mi 'dra bar gzhigs te skar chu dang /gangs chu/ chu rdo/ rmo lcags/ 'dag pa sogs dang/ yang na sman rdzas khag gcig gangs chu sogs la sbangs te nad dmigs gang yod sar dugs rgyag dgos/45drod dugs de nad rigs gang la sman rdzas gang gis gang du rgyag dgos sam/lan/ drod dugs de grang ba'i nad rigs mi 'dra bar gzhigs te lan tshwa dang /chu rdo sman rdzas/ pags pa'i rigs/ spu sogs tsha bo bsros te nad dmigs gang yod sar dugs dgos pa bcas yin/46nad pa lums rgyag skabs nad skyong bas lag len gang dang gang la do snang byed dgos sam/lan/ nad pa'i rlung kha dang / khrag shed/ snying 'phar grangs sogs la do snang byed dgos pa dang / rlung bcos dang dro bcos byas te rgyal chu 'don thabs dang rngul chu phyi ba/ nad khams dang mthun pa'i byug pa rgyag dgos pa bcos byed rgyu red/47 byug pa bya rung ba'i nad gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rung ba lus rtsub khrag dang khu ba zad/ /stobs chung rgas dang mya ngan sems las che/ /mig 'grib gnyid med rtsol bas dub pa dang / /rlung nad kun la snum byug bsten par bya/ /pags nad 'brum thor skrangs la lde gu byug /ces pa'o/ /48 byug pa kun la byugs mnye phyi gsum byed dgos don gang yin nam/lan/ snum bzhi po gang rung byug la mnye zhing phur te skam nas sran phyes phyi dgos pa bcas bsku mnye kun la byug mnye phyi gsum de ltar ma byas na byug pas rlung 159

'joms kyang ma phyis na bad kan 'phel zhing / de yang rtsam pas phyis na bad rlung skyed par byed pas cho ga 'di dag gal che'o/ /49 tsho bas skem bzang brta ba tshod zin bya zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lus tsho ches bas men bu'i nad dang khrag rtsa'i nad rigs gcin snyi sogs 'byung sla la lus 'gul skyod dka' ba bcas 'byung bas tsho ba las skem pa bzang te brta ba tshod zin rgyu gal che ba'o/ /50 ded dpon bcu sbyor gyi sbyong sman de'i nus pa rno 'jam myur ba'i rgyu mtshan skyubye/lan/ sman sna mang ba dang / ba dmar zal gyi chu dang sbyar ba/ de yang khaṇ+ḍa byas pa bcas kyis rno 'jam myur ba'o/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1kun la gnod bya la sogs chos bcur sbyar/ /mdzo khal lug khal lta bur 'tshams pa bcos/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ 'di ni gong bstan gso tshul brgyad po'i mdo don yin la/ mdzo khal dang lug khal mdzo la bkal ba ltar nad dang gnyen po stobs mi mtshungs par sprad na dman lhag log pa'i sbyor bar 'gyur ba'o/ /2 khyad par gyi gso tshul dgu bo ji ltar yin pa gsal bor shod/'grel/ ma rtogs dogs bcas gdeng ma thob pa'i nad/ /byi la 'jab pa lta bu'i sad mdas bcos/ /ngos zin nges pa rnyed cing gdeng thob na/ /spo la dar 'phya lta bur dngos su bcos/ /gnyen po thog tu mi 'bab nad lam gzud/ /rta rgod dkyus su 'dzud pa lta bur bcos/ /sngar bcos nad la dman lhag log pa gsum/ /brtags la skyar mo nya len bzhin du bcos/ /stobs chung nad la spyod lam zas sman dpyad/ /skas gdang lta bur mas 'dzeg rim pas bcos/ /rkyang ba'i nad la dpa' bos dgra 'dul bzhin/ /de gzhin gzhan la gnod med sbyor bas bcos/ /ldan 'dus nad la 'du ba cha snyoms gces/ /gtso bo dme shor 'khrugs zlums ltar bu bcos/ /kun la gnod bya 160
