la sogs chos bcur sbyar/ /mdzo khal lug khal lta bur 'tsham par bcos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /3 sman gyi gtong tshul bcu bo ji ltar yin pa shod/'grel/ bad kan nad la zas ma zos pa'i lto stong dang gcig thur sel rlung la zas za ba'i sngon dang gnyis/ me mnyam rlung la zas kyi dbus dang gsum/ khyab byed rlung la nang par zas zos pa dang / gyen rgyu'i rlung la dgong mo zas zos pa'i mtha' dang bzhi/ yi ga 'chus par sman dang zas kham re spel ba dang lnga/ nad phal cher la zas zhu mtshams dang drug 'khru skyugs dang lud pa glo nad dbugs mi bde bar dus min tse gur dang bdun/ yi ga 'chus pa sogs la kha zas dang mnyam bsres kyis gtong ba dang brgyad/ skyigs bu dang 'dar ba la zas kyi sngon rjes gnyis sman gyis mnan pa'i tshul dang dgu nam tshong yan chad kyi nad la mtshan mo gtong ba ste bcas sman gtong tshul mi 'dra ba dag shes par bya dgos so/ /4rten dang brten pa 'phel zad bcos thabs gcig /ces par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ spyir nyes gsum ldan 'dus kyi ngos nas mtshon na rlung 'phel zhing bad mkhris lta bu nad gzhan gang yang zad par gyur pa la brta ba'i thabs la brten nas gso dgos pa dang / rlung zad cing bad mkhris 'phel bar gyur pa la smyung zhing dmad pa'i sgo nas bcos dgos pa las/ de yang gzhan rten gnod bya dang / brten pa gnod byed gnyis 'phel zad kyi bcos thabs gcig pas 'thus pa ste/ dper na/rten dwangs ma dang brten pa bad kan 'phel ba gnyis bcos thabs gcig pa dang /rten khrag dang brten pa mkhris pa gnyis bcos thabs gcig pas 'thus pa dang / de bzhin du rten dwangs ma dang brten pa bad kan zad pa gnyis bcos thabs gcig pas 'thus pa ltar gzhan rnams la yang de ltar shes par byed pa'o/ /5 chu bzhi dang me bzhi'i gnyen po ji ltar yin pa shod/'grel/ de yang me bzhi dang chu bzhi zhes thog mar tsha ba stobs chen nad la zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi bo bsil ba kho nar bsten dgos pa ste/ bsil ba'i zas skyabs dang khur tshod/ chab tsha chu bsil sogs yen la gtad pa lta bu zas kyi chu dang /161

lus mi 'khrugs shing gnyid ma log pa chu 'gram shing grib phog sar sdod pa lta bu spyod lam gyi chu/ ga bur chang sbyar sogs bsil ba'i sman kho na btang ba lta bu sman gyi chu/rtse chung sogs gtar ba dpyad kyi chu ste bzhi'o/ /grang ba stobs chen nad la gnyen po me bzhi spor dgos pa ni/ drod sman gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i sman rdzas yod pa kun bsdus shing sbyar ba lta bu sman gyi me dang / pho gsang du me btsa' 'jog pa lta bu dpyad kyi me/ drod bcud mtha' dag bza' ba zas kyi me/ gnas dang gos dro ba ni spyod lam gyi me ste bzhi yin no/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ga 2 ka 3 ka 4nga 5 ka 6 kha 7 ka 8 ka9 ka 10 kha 11 ga 12 nga 13 kha 14 nga 15 kha16 ga 17 ka 18 ga 19 ka 20 ga 21 nga22 kaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 kag 2 kha ga nga 3 ka kha 4ka kha ga 5 ka nga 6 ka kha ga7 ka kha nga 8 ka ga nga 9 ka kha ga nga 10 ka kha ga 11 ka kha ga ngaca 12 ka kha ga 13 ka ga nga 1'gaka kha ga 15 ka kha 16 kakha ga nga 17 ka kha ga 18 ka kha ga nga 19 ka ga nga 20 ka kha gang 21 ka kha ga 22 ka kha ga 23 ka ga 24kha nga ca25 kha gabazhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 gyo 2 du 3 du 4྾ 5tsu 6 ྾ 7 ྾ 8 du 9 ྾10 gyo 11 ྾ 12 tre 13 ྾ 14gyo 15sa 16tsu 17 ྾18 ྾ 19 snyo 20 ྾ 21 du 22 ྾ 23 ྾ 24྾ 25du162

skabs gnyis pa/ nad thog lag len/sa bcad dang po/ khong nad gso ba/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 khong nad la nang gses kyi dbye ba/ ( )ka drug kha nyer brgyad/ ga zhe drug nga bco brgyad/2khong nad kun gyi thog mar ( ) bstan yod/ka nyes gsum/ kha rlung / ga ma zhu ba/ nga gcong nad/3 rlung nad la man rgyud du dbye ba/ ( )ka brgyad cu/ kha bcu bzhi/ ga nyer brgyad/ nga re gsum/4lus khams 'dar la stod brgyangs shes pa 'khrul ba bcas 'byung ba ni/ ( )ka snying rlung / kha srog rlung / ga mgo rlung / nga mchin rlung /5nad rnams thams cad skyed pa'i gzhi ni/ ( )ka ma rig pa/ kha nyes gsum/ ga zas spyod/ nga ma zhu ba/6rlung nad la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/( )ka brgyad/ kha bdun/ ga nyi shu/ nga nyer brgyad/7rlung nad las lus sgur la bsdus pas phug ron skad ltar 'don pa ni/ ( )ka da rgan/ kha a warta/ ga rtsa 'dzin/ nga brla rengs/8pags mdog 'gyur nas 'brum bu 'byung ba ni rlung( )ru zhugs pa'i rtags/ka tshil/ kha rtsar/ ga sha nga tshigs/9 rlung nad lus la zhen par phan pa ni/( )163

ka 'don bzhi/ kha sman chang / ga rlangs lums ngasman mar/10 rlung nad brla rengs kyi bcos ni/( )ka snum bcos/ kha rtsub bcos/ ga bcud bcos/ nga me btsa'/11ngar gdong chu rgyus sna nas sbal nag gi bar dmar khra skrangs shing ba spu'i khung bu rnams gas par mthong ba ni/ ( )ka grum bu'i nad/ kha gnyan nad/ ga rlung nad lce spyang mgo ngarkang 'bam/12dbugs rngub dka' la 'byin pa bde snyam byed pa ni/ ( )ka stongs tshad/ kha khrag rlung stod 'tshangs/ ga snying rlung / ngadamu chu/ 13 mkhris nad kyi rgyu ni/ ( )ka me drod mkhris pa/ kha snod kyi mkhris pa/ ga nad gzhi mkhris pa/ nga thun mong mkhris pa/14mkhris nad rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na ni/ ( )ka bcu dgu/ kha lnga/ ga bcu/ nga bcu gsum/15mkhris pa'i nad la dpyad kyi mchog ni/( )ka skyugs/ kha sbyong / ga bshal/ nga sman mar/16bad kan skya bo rang rgyud can la dbye na/ ( )ka drug/ kha gnyis/ ga nyi shu/ nga zhe gcig17bad kan ser po ni mkhris nad ( ) yin/ka kha lud/ kha rtsar rgyugs/ ga kha shor/ nga gnas gyur/18 bad kan mgul 'gags ni/( )ka khyab byed rlung 'khrug/sa pa las byung ba/ kha mnyam gnas rlung 'khrugs pa las byung ba/ ga gyen rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs pa las byung ba/164

nga gyen rgyu'i rlung 'phel ba las byung ba/19 zas ci zos kyang 'grangs pa med cing lus stobs chung la sha skam pa bcas ni/( )ka bad kan lcag dreg kha bad kan 'ju skem/ ga grum bu dkar po/ nga mgul 'gags/20'ju dka' sgreg skyug dros drags rlan grang na zhes pa ni smug po( )gnas pa'i rtags/ka mchin par/ kha long du/ ga rgyu mar/ nga pho bar/21 khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ ( )ka bad kan/ kha nyes gsum/ ga ma zhu ba/ nga rlung /22 gang ma zhu ba'i zas de lhag par gnod pa ni/( )ka dwangs ma ma zhu ba/ kha snyigs ma ma zhu ba/ ga ngo bo ma zhu ba/nga rigs kyi ma zhu ba/23 skran rnams gsar ba'i dus su/( )ka grang ba shas che/ kha tsha ba shas che/ ga bsil drod snyoms/nga rlung shas che/24mdor na bar skran phal cher spyod pa ni/ ( )ka sman/ kha me bum/ ga gtar ga nga thur ma/25 'or nad ni ( ) bcos rnying las byung ba yin/ka ma zhu ba/ /kha skran nad/ ga skya rbab/ nga dmu chu/26 'or nad mi nor ba'i rtags gtso bo ni/( )ka mkhar brgyad skrangs pa/ kha 'og tu gang bcug yon por skrangs pa/ga mtshan gnyid chung la nyin gnyid che ba/ nga dros tshe lhag par skrangs pa/27 chu nad kyi rigs la dbye na( )yod/ka bdun/ kha bcu gsum/ ga bcu bzhi/ nga brgyad/165

28 snying ni( )gdan la zhugs pa 'dra'o/ka btsun mo/ kha sras/ ga bu mo/ nga rgyal po/29 khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad ni ( )dang nor nyen che/ka grum bu/ kha gnyan nad/ ga stongs tshad/ nga rtsa dkar/30 bad kan gyi nad la mchog tu gyur pa ni/( )ka bu ram/ kha mar gsar/ ga ka ra/ nga sprang rtsi/31 mkhris nad k+ṣa nag po zhes pa ni/ ( )ka sngon las rnam smin/ kha zad byed/ ga gcong nad/ ngasrog gcod nad/32 glo tshad gzer thung skabs rlung khrag gnyan gsum las khrag gzer gyi rtsa ni/( )ka spun zhing 'khrig kha 'dar sdod thung / ga 'bur rgyas grims/nga drag cing thung /33 grang mkhris nad la thog mtha' bar gsum du( )mi bya/ka bshal/ kha me btsa'/ ga gtar/ nga lums/34bad kan smug po dus kyi sgo nas dbye na/( )ka gnyis/ kha gsum/ ga bzhi/ nga lnga/35 bad kan smug po tha ma rgyas nas( )skyug pa yin/ka chu tshan chu skyur/ kha ser po rgya bshal/ ga khrag rul dud khu/nga sngo skya lud pa can/36rgyu gzer stobs chen nad la bcos tshul rnam pa/ ( )ka gsum/ kha lnga/ ga bdun/ nga dgu/37snying chu'i rgyu rkyen khyad par can ni/( )ka snying la bad kan zhugs pa/ kha snying la chu ser zhugs pa/ gasnying la mkhris pa zhugs pa/ nga snying la tsha ba zhugs pa/38 snying nad khrag gzer nyid dus su ma bcos tshe/ ( )166

ka smyon par 'gyur/ kha nad gzhan slong nyen che/ ga myur tu 'chi/nga bcos dka' ba/39 snying nad cis kyang ma phan pa la( )gtar/ka rgyab rtsa drug 'dus/ kha snod ka ga ru thung / nga rkang mthil rgyu rtsa/40 glo ba ni 'du ba( )yul yin/ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga bad kan/ nga khrag41 snying 'phyos nad ni ( ) 'khrugs pa las byung /ka gyen rgyu rlung / kha khyab byed rlung / ga srog 'dzin rlung / ngasnying rlung /42 glo nad thes po'i khyad par gyi rgyu rkyen ni/( )ka bad kan glo yul du zhugs pa/ kha bad kan glo ba'i rtsa sbubs su zhugs pa/ ga bad rlung glo mig du zhugs pa/ nga rlung glo mar zhugs pa/43 wa yi glo ba glo nad( )la bsngags/ka glo gcong / kha glo rgyas/ ga glo rdol/ nga glo nad bung tshang can/44glo nad rlung gi grogs dang ldan tshe( )btung na mchog tu phan/ka lug gi 'o ma dron mo/ kha ra'i 'o ma dron mo/ ga ba'i 'o ma dron mo/ nga mdzo'i 'o ma dron mo/ 45 glo gcong nad glo rnag thon dka' ba la( )gtar/ka sgab rtsa/ kha ru thung / ga drug mgo nga snod ka46 mchin nad bco brgyad las tsha ba'i dbye ba( )yod/ka bdun/ kha lnga/ ga bcu/ nga bcu gsum/47 lce khra bo gyur pa ni mcher nad( )rtags/ka mcher nad khrag sbos/ kha mcher nad tsha ba/ ga mcher nad 167

grang ba/ nga mcher rlung /48 mchu la bad kan chags pa mcher nad( )rtags/ka mcher nad bad kan/ kha mcher nad tsha ba/ ga mcher rlugs/nga mcher nad grang ba/49 sha skem shed chung 'gul mi nus la byi la'i mgul 'dra zas sman phan skyed chung ba ni/( )ka glo nad bungs tshang can/ kha glo rdol/ ga glo gcong / ngaglo rnag50 pho nad la man rgyud du dbye ba/ ( )ka drug/ kha bdun/ ga brgyad/ nga bcu drug/51 kha zas gang yang mi 'ju bar rtsam mdog 'khru ba ni/( )ka pho nad tsha ba/ kha pho nad grang ba/ ga pho ba'i me drod nyams pa/nga pho log52 rgyu nad las nang gses rgyu 'khrol dang rgyu 'khril ni( )las gyur/ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga khrag nga bad kan/53 skad 'gags kyi nad byung sa'i gnas gtso bo ni/ ( )ka gre ba dang mid pa/ kha mid pa dang glo yu/ ga gre ba dang glo migang rkan dang gre ba/54khrag shas che ba'i skad 'gags la( )gtar/ka rgyu rtsa/ kha long rtsa/ ga byin gzhug nga srin lag55rlung nad ce spyang mgo ni( )las skyed pa yin/ka rlung / kha khrag ga chu ser/ nga rlung khrag56sor mo'i chu ba rnams 'khums nas lag pa'i 'gul bskyod nyams pa ni/( )ka rlung nad sra 'theng / kha rlung nad bi sha rtse/ ga rlung nad dpung 'ja'/ nga rlung nad 'phyes pa/168

57rlung nad bi sha tse ni( )zhugs pa'i nad yin/ka rkang ngar la/ kha long mor/ ga lag ngar la/ nga gru mor/58me drod mkhris pa ma zhu ba dang bad kan gyi gnas su gyur tshe mi 'gyur ba'i rtags su/ ( )ka dri ma skya la sob/ kha bad kan smug po bzhin/ ga dri ma skam la sha ril 'dra/ nga na zug che/59 mchin tshad spyi bcos dpyad du( )gtar/ka ru thung / kha byin gzhug ga long rtsa/ nga drug mgo60 snying 'phyos kyi nad la dpyad du/( )ka ru thung / kha mchin mkhris 'doms rtsa/ ga tshigs pa drug bdun/ nga snod ka61 mcher nad tsha ba'i bcos su dpyad du( )gtar/ka sgang rtsa/ kha rta thur/ ga tshigs pa bcu ba/ nga byin gzhug62 glang thabs rgyu ma'i gnas su ldang bar( )gtar/ka ru thung / kha long rtsa/ ga snod ka nga rgyu rtsa/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 snying rlung yin pa'i rtags su/( )ka lus khams 'dar ba/ kha mgo yu 'khor ba/ ga gnyid chung ba/nga shes pa 'chol ba/ ca khog pa sbo ba/2 rlung nad dpyad bcos la ( )ka bsku mnye/ kha dugs/ ga me btsa'/ nga gtar gca thur ma/3 srog rlung nad kyi mi 'gyur ba'i rtags su/( )169

ka shes pa 'phyo ba/ kha yid sems mi bde ba/ ga sems la 'jigs skrag snang ba/ nga dbugs sdud dka' ba/ ca mig gis mi mthong ba/4'dus so gsum zhes pa ni/( )ka spyi gtsug kha mtshog ma/ ga 'dus so/ nga sdud sgo/ca smin dbrag5 rlung nad ce spyang mgo dang nor nyen che ba'i nad ni/( )ka dreg nad/ kha grum bu/ ga gnyan nad/ nga rkang 'bam/ca rtsa dkar/6 khrag rlung stod 'tshangs nad kyi khyad par ba'i rtags ni/( )ka dbugs 'byin rngub mi bde ba/ kha brang gi mdun rgyab gzer ba/ga grang shum byed pa/ nga lus dgye sgur dka' ba/ ca glo lu byed pa/7mkhris nad rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ ( )ka nad gzhi mkhris pa thang la lhag pa/ kha me drod mkhris pa gzhan gyi gnas gyur/ ga snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud kha shor/ nga thun mong mkhris pa rtsa ru rgyu ba/ ca mkhris pa 'ju byed nus pa nyams pa/8 bad kan gzhan rgyud can la/ ( )ka skya bo/ kha ser bo/ ga smug po/ nga dmar po/ casngon po/9 bad kan lhen zhes bya ba'i slong rkyen ni/ ( )ka zas spyod mi 'phrod pa'i rigs/ kha ngo bo 'ju dka' ba'i rigs/ga sngar ma goms pa'i rigs/ nga rten grang rlung can/ ca rang bzhin gyis mi 'phrod pa/10snyigs ma ma zhu ba las chang ma zhu na spyi sman steng kha tshar ( )gtong dgos/170

ka phabs/ kha ka ra/ ga chang / nga chu bskol/ casbrang rtsi/11 rus pa la rlung zhugs pa'i rtags su/( )ka rus zug che ba/ kha sha mdog mi sdug pa/ ga sha skam pa/ ngayan lag rengs pa/ ca za 'phrug langs pa/12rlung nad dbye ba drug bcu rtsa gsum po ni/( )ka rigs kyi nyi shu/ kha gnas kyi nyer brgyad/ ga rigs kyi brgyad/nga bye brag bco lnga/ ca nang tshegs bcu/13 rlung nad ldang ba'i dus na/ ( )ka snga dro/ kha dgong / ga tho rengs/ nga zas sngon/ca zhu rjes/14rlung nad da rgan nang gug ces bya ba mi nor ba'i rtags su/ ( )ka ske'i rus pa thung ngur gyur pa/ kha brang 'bur zhing mtho ba/ garngul mang 'byung ba/ nga ro stod 'bur ba/ ca zas mi 'ju ba/15me drod mkhris pa ni( )gnas su gyur nas byer/ka rlung / kha khrag ga bad kan/ nga ma zhu ba/ cachu ser/16me drod mkhris pa de nyid rlung gi gnas su gyur na/( )ka khong ba sbo zhing 'khrog pa/ kha dri ma skam pa/ ga sgyid pa skyur ba/nga g.yal mang ba/ ca dang ga 'gags pa/17bad kan mgul 'gags zhes pa'i ming rnam du/( )ka mid 'chus/ kha pho rub/ ga mid 'gags/ nga gre gcong / ca pho log18 smug po la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ ( )ka byer/ kha rgyas/ ga 'gyings/ nga 'dril/ ca rdol/19 ma zhu bar ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/( )171

ka dwangs ma/ kha be snabs/ ga snyigs ma ma zhu ba/ nga ma zhu shing 'dra/ ca dug nad/20 ma zhu ba'i rkyen bzhi po ni/( )ka rten/ kha ma goms/ ga mi 'phrod/ nga ngo bo mi 'ju ba/ ca sha rlon/21 dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rtags su/( )ka yi ga 'gag kha pho ba 'tshing / ga snying ga rtsub log na/ ngagang ma zhu ba'i zas lhag par gnod/ ca sgreg pa 'byung /22 ma zhu ba'i rgyu las bskyed pa'i gcong nad gsar ba ni/( )ka skran/ kha lten/ ga lcags dreg nga bad kan smug po/ ca skya rbab/ 23 gcong chen skran nad kyi rgyu ni/ ( )ka ma zhu ba/ kha srin/ ga chu ser/ nga spu/ ca khrag24snyigs ma ma zhu ba'i zas skran 'byung mang ba'i gnas ni/( )ka pho ba/ kha mchin pa/ ga rgyu ma/ nga long ga cagasher ma/25gcong chen skran nad kyi spyi rtags su/( )ka chu la skran thig byung ba/ kha sha skam shed chung ba/ ga 'grangs rjes na ba/ nga khong ba sbo ba/ ca rngul mang ba/26grang skran las zungs gsum shor zhes pa de ni/( )ka sha shor bas mur gong gi sha skam pa/ kha rtsa shor bas rtsa la shed med pa/ ga khrag shor bas khrag gi rgyu ba nyams pa/ nga me shor bas zas mi 'ju zhing dang ga zhan pa/ ca rlung shor bas dbugs rngub dka' ba/27'or nad bskyed pa'i rgyu rkyen ni/( )ka zas/ kha dus/ ga rkyen/ nga gdon/ ca dug28 dmu chu'i nad skyed par byed pa'i rkyen ni/( )172

ka bshal rjes zas spyod log pa/ kha ngal dub rjes su chu grang 'thungs pa/ ga rlan gsher che sar 'dug pa/ nga sems las che ba caganyid mang du log pa/29 snying la tsha ba 'khyil ba yin na/( )ka na zug phur ba btsugs pa ltar gzer ba/ kha na zug gri yi gtubs snyam byed pa/ ga kha lce skam la thung ba/ nga kha lce skam la rtsub pa/ca khong khro langs pa/30 khrag shas che ba'i glo nad kyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/( )ka glo nad theng po/ kha glo gcong / ga bung tshang can/ ngaglo rgyas/ ca glo tshad/31 mchin nad tsha ba'i rigs ni/( )ka dug thabs/ kha ldem bu/ ga mchin rgud/ nga mchin grum nag po/ ca rlan grangs/32 mcher nad tsha ba'i rtags su/( )ka lce mdog khra ba/ kha mchu la bad kan chags pa/ ga ma mchu thur du 'phyang ba/ nga mchu mdog smug po 'byung ba/ ca khog pa sbos pa/33 'khru nad la rgyu yi sgo nas dbye na/( )ka ma zhu ba/ kha me drod nyams pa/ ga mchin tshad thur du babs pa/ nga mkhris pa snod du lhung ba/ ca grang ba/34mchin tshad thur du babs pa'i 'khru mdog ni/( )ka dmar/ kha ser/ ga smug nga dud khu/ casngon po/35 gcin snyi nad kyi mngon tshul ni/( )ka mal stan gnyid la brtse/ kha gcin mdog rnyog ma can/ gagacin shul sbrang tshogs 'dus/ nga mthil bzhi grang ba/ ca kha zas mi 'ju ba/173

36 grum bu'i nad rtags su/( )ka gdong snum/ kha brla rkang rus tshigs na/ ga lus dgye sgur dka' ba/ nga nyin gnyid mi thub/ ca mtshan gnyid bya ltar yer ba/37 chu ser zad pa'i rtags su/( )ka sha dang pags pa skam pa/ kha nyams stobs mi skye ba/ ga glang shu 'byung ba/ nga grum nad 'byung ba/ ca za 'khrug langs pa/38 dar gyi dpyang thag bcu gsum las mkhris pa'i rtsa( )dang 'brel/ka glo ba/ kha long / ga snying / nga mchin pa/ capho ba/39 mkhal nad gtso che ba'i dbye ba gang dag bstan yod/ ( )ka mkhal tshad/ kha mkhal 'grams/ ga mkhal grum/ ngamakhal gcong / ca da rgan/40 bad kan las gyur ba'i pho nad yin na/ ( )ka pho ba 'tshing sgreg che ba/ kha kha zas ma smin skyugs pa/ ga rtsam mdog 'khru ba/ nga grang lhags gnod pa/ ca tsha grang gnyis ka gnod pa/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/sungs pa/ zas rigs yun ring lon nas dri ro gzhan du gyur pa/lo bshur/ sran ma dang la phug sogs kyi lo ma'i rigs rnyid pa/lten/ lten zhes pa be snabs kyi ming yin zhing / de mang du 'phel te tshogs pa la bad kan lhen zhes so/ /lcags dreg kha zas ma zhu ba'i rgyu las byung ba'i pho ba'i nang sul du lcags g.ya'i khu ba ltar gyi dreg pa chags pa'i pho ba'i gcong chen po zhig174

mgul 'gags/ mid pa'i spubs su be+e snabs chags nas mid pa 'chus shing zas skom mi thar ba 'gags par gyur pa'i nad kyi ming /grum bu dkar po/ nad rtags grum bu dang cha 'dra zhing mthar grum bur 'gyur nyen che ba dang ngo bo grang ba'i khams 'phel ba las gnyan tshad kyi cha shas tsam ma 'dres pa der grum bu dkar po zhes so/ /'ju skems/ bad kan rigs drug gi nang tshan zhig ste nad rtags su kha zas zos kyang mi 'grang ba dang lus kyi sha skem la gsus pa ldir ba sogs 'byung ba zhigakhrag mang zags/ sna khrag mngal khrag mtshon khrag la sogs pa lus las khrag mang po lhung ba'i don/gzhu sran bkang / gzhu sra ba 'then mi thub bzhin du 'then pa/yid 'chus/ yi ga 'chus te zas la dang ga 'gags pa/g.yan pa/ za 'phrug 'byung zhing chu ser 'dzags pa'i pags nad cigango khebs/ pags mdog dkyus dang mi 'dra ba skya ther sna tshogs shar ba'i pags nad rigs shigasmug po byer/ smug po'i nad de khrag nang zhugs nas srog rtsa nag po brgyud lus kyi gnas kun tu byer ba'i don la gosmug pa rgyas/ bad kan smug po khrag mkhris stobs rgyas pa'i skabs der nang gses dbye ba gyen du rdol ba dang thur du ral ba gnyis mchis pa'o/ /smug po rdol/ bad kan smug po rgyas pa'i skabs su khrag gyen thur gnyis su byung ba'i don/smug po ral/ bad kan smug po rgyas pa'i skabs su khrag thur du bshal ba'i don/175

smug po 'gyings/ bad kan smug po pho bar 'gyings te skyugs pa dang mar bshal ba byed mi thub par pho ba khengs shing hrem mer na ba'o//smug po 'gril/ smug po ma zhu ba las byung ba de dwangs ma dang snyigs ma rgyu ba'i gnas su skran du 'gril ba'i don/smug po 'thab/ bad kan smug po dus gsum gyi nang tshan tsha grang 'thab pa'i skabs te/ nad rtags su zas mi 'ju zhing sha skem pa dang glang thabs yang yang ldang ba bcas 'byung ba la zer/smug po 'or lhung / bad kan smug po chu bzhi dang bsdongs nas skrangs pa 'og tu lhung ba'i ming ngo / /dmar khrid/ lag len kun dmar rjen du ston pa la zer/ol gong tsha ba/ lug gi ol mdud gri thag byas pa'i tshod ma/tshoms phye/ nas dkar mes mi tshig pa'i ched du chu la spangs nas rlan thag chod par brngos pa'i phye ma'i don/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 nad rnams thams cad skyed pa'i gzhi lta bu ni nyes pa rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gsum yin/( )2 bde ba med pa'i rlung nad la a warta sogs bsdoms pa'i dbye ba nyer brgyad yod/( )3rlung chu lu ma'i chu 'dra sngo la dwangs shing phal cher log rjes ska ba yin/( )4rlung nad tsher ma can rkang ba la brten nas long mor zhugs pa'i nad cig yin/( )5 rlung nad rkang brtse zhes pa ni bad kan dang rlung 'dres pa las byung ba yin/( )176

6 sgreg skyug byed cing pho ba spo la skom dad che ba dang dbugs mi bde ba bcas ni zas la rlung zhugs pa'i rtags yin/( )7rlung nad lus la zhen pa rnams phyir 'don pa'i sbyor ba dkar 'don kho na yin/( )8sgog skya tshos par btsos pa'i khu ba la lug gi mar dang rus bcud bcas kha tshar sman btab nas btsos pa de sgog 'don yin/( )9rlung nad spyi dang bye brag ma lus 'joms pa'i sbyor ba ni dro la bcud che ba'i sman mar yin/( )10rlung nad brla rengs bad tshil las skyed pa yin yang rlung nad yin phyir snum 'chos bya dgos/( )11 me drod mkhris pa zhes pa ni gtso bo 'ju byed dang de'i cha shas drod rnams la nges pa yin/( )12 mkhris nad byer dang kha lud kha shor bcas rang rgyud tsha ba kho na'i nad min/( )13 snod mkhris de nyid kha shor na lus shed nyams la mkhris khu 'khru ba'am yang na skyug pa yin/( )14lce mdog ser la gnyid yer bza' btung grang mo 'dod pa mchin par mkhris par zhugs pa yin/( )15mkhris nad 'di nyid gdon shas che bas gtso bo gdon bcos bya dgos/( )16bad kan gyi ngo bo lci la bsil ba'i phyir zas sman gang rung drod rigs kho na bsten/( )17 bad kan smug po sha la rgyas pa dang rtsar byer na sa bdag gi rtags bcos dang 'dra/( )18 bad kan smug po 'khrugs na gso ba dka' zhing sman gyi phan nus chung /( )177

19 khong nad phal cher smug po'i rgyu las bskyed pa yin/( )20'dus pa'i nad sa dang 'dra bar gnyen pa'i kha na gso dka' bas bcos bskyar bya dgos/( )21dkar skyur sngo ngad 'o ma sogs snga ma ma zhu bar phyi ma zos pa'am yang na bsres nas zos pa ni ngo bo mi 'ju ba yin/ ( )22kha zas kyi dwangs ma dang snyigs ma 'byed pa'i shugs de ni mkhris pa 'ju byed yin/( )23ma zhu bas bad kan be snabs 'phel zhing rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa sbubs dag bkag nas gcong nad ma lus skyed pa yin/( )24gcong nad phal cher snyigs ma ma zhu ba'i rgyu las bskyed pa yin/( )25ma zhu gsar rnying thams cad la smyung bar bya ba dang bcags pa bsten na phan/( )26dwangs ma ma zhu ba de yun ring 'gor nas rnying ba'i dus su dug tu 'gyur ba yin/( )27ma zhu ba las bskyed pa'i 'bras bu ni gcong gi nad yin/( )28 skran nad dbye ba bad kan zas skran bcas rnam grangs bcu gsum yod/( )29'or nad dang skya rbab gang yang rung ba ma thub par rnyings nas nang du babs na dmu chur 'gyur ba yin/( )30lud pa 'gog dka' la wu ba dkar po 'byung zhing lud pa dngos mi thon pa ni glo nad thes po'o/( )31 glo mig bad kan gyis 'gag pa las lud pa mang na grer ba gsog nas thon dka'/( )178

lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 rlung gi nad de nyid thog mar ston dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rlung ni nad rnams kun gyi 'khrugs pa'i rgyu/ /sna 'dren mjug sdud 'thor dang khyab par byed/ /rang rgyud gdug cing nad mang rtsub pa'i phyir/ /thog mar rlung gi bcos thabs bshad par bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /2 rlung nad rigs kyi dbye ba mdor bsdus na ga tshod yod dam/lan/ mdor bsdus rengs 'khums skams dang sbos pa dang / /'phyes gzer 'phyos dang bog pa brgyad du 'du/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /3 rlung nad gnas kyi dbye ba mdor bsdus na ga tshod yod dam/lan/ mdor bsdus mgo rlung snying rlung glo rlung dang / /mchin rlung pho rlung mkhal rlung bdun/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /4spyir rlung nad la dbye ba du yod dam/lan/ a warta sogs rigs kyi dbye ba nyi shu dang / lpags la grams pa sogs gnas kyi dbye ba nyer brgyad/ mdor bsdus mgo rlung sogs bcu/ mdor bsdus rigs kyi dbye ba lnga bcas bsdoms pa'i rlung nad drug cu rtsa gsum yod pa yin/5 rtsa ba'i rlung lnga zhes pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ lus grub pa'i thog mar pha ma'i khu khrag gnyis kyi dbus su srog rlung chags pa ni rlung srog 'dzin nam mkha'i khams/ rlung thur sel sa khams/ gyen rgyu me khams/ me mnyam rlung khams/ khyab byed chu khams ste rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'o/ /6 yan lag gi rlung lnga zhes pa de gang dag yin nam/lan/ klu sa rlung mig la gnas nas rab 'bring tha ma mthong bar byed/ lha byin mnyam rgyu chu rlung rna bar gnas nas yang dag par rgyu/ rus sbal rlung ni rlung khams lce gnas ro yang dag par rgyu/ rtsangs pa me rlung sna nas dri yang dag par rgyu/nam mkha'i rlung ni da lta dngos su mi rgyu ste/ tshigs pa rnams la gnas nas reg bya tshor bar byed cing 'chi khar rlung 'di gtso bor rgyu zhes gsungs/179

7slong ba rgyu dang mtshan nyid rtags phan gnod bsten pa'i sgo nas brtag pa'i tshul bcas ji ltar yin nam/lan/ nad ngos 'dzin par nad rtags la brten dgos pa yin gshis/ der brtag par bya ba'i thabs su nad de nyid rgyu rkyen gang las bslangs ba las gzhan du mi srid de/ ci phyir rgyu las 'bras bu 'gal mi srid pa dang / mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas nad rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid las gyur pa dang bye brag gnas las gyur pa brtag pa dang / zas spyod kyi phan gnod bcas sgo nas nad gzhi gang rigs brtag dpyad la dgos pa chen po yod pa'o/ /8 rlung rtags su 'gro 'dod shus 'debs shes pa yang la 'phyo ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mtshan nyid yang zhing g.yo ba dang / bye brag rlung srog 'dzin 'khrugs pa bcas kyi dbang gis so/ /9zas spyod dro la snum bcud ldan pas rlung nad sel nus pa'i chos nyid gang yin nam/lan/ rlung gi mtshan nyid grang zhing phra la yang rtsub skya ba sogs 'phel ba de dag la sel byed kyi gnyen po zas spyod dro la snum bcud ldan pa'i rigs bsten na phan tshun chos mi mthun par 'joms thub pa'i phyir ro/ /10 snying rlung gi khyad par kyi nad rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ snying la rlung zhugs par gyur na de'i rtags su snying khams 'phar tshul dang blta rtsa'i rgyu ba mi snyoms pa dang / lus khams 'dar zhing ro stod brgyangs pa/shes pa 'khrul te smra ba 'chal ba/ gnyid chung zhing shu yis 'debs pa sogs kyi rtags mngon pa yin no/ /11 srog rlung gi nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rtags ni rtsa chu shas cher rlung spyi mthun/ /'ga' zhig nges med rtags kyang 'byung ba srid/ /yid mi bde zhing 'jigs skrag sems la 'char rmi lam za zi mang la gnyid chung zhing / /lus 'dar rngul mang shes pa 'phyo ba dang / /mgo 'khor dbugs sdud dka' zhing mid mi thub/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /180

12 rlung nad kyi 'don bzhi'i sbyor ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ 'don la dkar 'don dmar 'don skyur 'don dang / /sgog 'don bzhi las dang po tsag bcad mar/ /tshoms phye 'o bskol sbyar ba 'o mar btsos/ /sga dang rgyam tshwa btab pa dkar 'don yi na/ /lug sha'i khu bar sbyar ba dmar 'don no/ /skyur 'don khugs pa'i glum la mnye'u byas/ /mar rnying bu ram sga btab btsos pa'o/ /sgog 'don sgog skya tshos par btsos la bsnur/ /mar dar rus khu rgyam tshwa'i phye btab btso/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /13 rlung nad gso bar bya ra sgrim dgos don ci/lan/ rlung ni cha grang gnyis ka'i zung du 'jug /mkhris tshad 'bud cing bad kan grang ba 'khyags/ /dmu 'or skya rbab g.yo zhing skran rnams sgong / /bsags pa'i nad rnams thams cad rlung gis slong / /byer ba'i nad kun sna 'dren rlung gis byed/ /tshad gzhug phal cher thor bu'i rlung gi 'bud/ /de phyir rlung gi nad la bya ra sgrims/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /14phyi nang gsang gsum du rlung zhugs pa'i gnas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ sha lpags rtsa rus zhugs pa phyi yi rlung / /don lnga snod drug la zhugs nang gi rlung / /srog 'dzin la sogs rnam lnga gsang ba'i rlung / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /15 rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad kyi rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad ni rlung gi byed las 'khrugs te klad pa'i dbang rtsa'i nus pa nyams zhan du 'gyur nas na ba zhig red/ rlung gyur mur 'gram zug cing gzer ba dang / /dpral ba smin mtshams so na ldang dub byed/ /rna ba 'ur zhing snum dugs byas pas bde/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /16 rlung nad ce spyang mgo'i rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni lus kyi rlung khrag chu ser gsum/ /rkyen ni gnyid chag bser bu mang smra sogs/ /rlung bskyed rkyen dang drag shul nyin gnyid dang / /khra/ ga mkhris bskyed pa'i zas spyod bsten las 'byung / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /17 rlung nad ce spyang mgo'i thog mar gso thabs ji ltar yin nam/181

lan/ rlung nad ce spyang mgor thog mar dpyad kyis bcos dgos pa ste/ skar chu grang mos reg bya nyams par bran la/ de nas mar dkar gyi 'ol skom tshan mor seng ldeng dang chu ser sman gsum gyi phye mas bran pa pus mor bcing la/ de steng phying ba snum ldan me bsros pas nyin zhag gcig gi bar bcing nas 'jog dgos/18 khrag rlung stod 'tshangs zhes pa'i rgyu gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni lus kyi ngan khrag rnams/ /khyab rgyu'i rlung 'khrugs stod du phul/ /dbugs dang rtsa lam 'tshangs pa la/ /khrag rlung stod 'tshangs zhes su bshad/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /19khrag rlung stod 'tshangs rlung shas che ba dang khrag shas che ba gnyis kyi slong rkyen gyi khyad par ci yin nam/lan/ rlung shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs kyi slong rkyen ni/ /lto dang gnyid chag bser bus bus pa dang / /mang du smras dang yid mi dga' ba'i tshig /mya ngan sems las ches dang chu klung sgra/ /phyi yul char rlung grang ba kha thal dang / /ja sogs bsil pa'i rkyen gyis bslang ba yin/ /grang shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs kyi slong rkyen ni/ lus sems 'khrugs pa'i sgo gsum bya ba byas/ /me nyis dros che sna tshogs chang mang 'thungs/ /drag shul rkyen gyis khrag ngan kha bslangs te/ /khrag shas che ba'i stod 'tshangs 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /20khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad dang stongs tshad nad gnyis kyi khyad ci ltar 'byed dgos sam/lan/ de yang rlung nad stod 'tshangs kyi nad ni dbugs rngub na dka' snyam byed kyang phyir 'byin na bde bar mngon pa dang / stongs tshad kyi nad yin na dbugs kyi rngub 'byin gang yang dka' snyam mi bde ba'o/ /21 mkhris pa zhes ming btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mkhris pa zhes pa 'bar ba'i don yin zhing / ngo bo lus kyi drod khams cha shas yongs rdzogs dang / de'ang lus la me 'bar ba ltar drod skyed cing zas 'ju bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /182

22 mkhris pa'i nad kyi dngos rgyu gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni zhe sdang dang bcas pa lus kyi cha shas thams cad snum bcas rno tsha sogs mtshan nyid bdun ldan rnam par ma gyur tha mal du gnas pa la nad gzhi'i mkhris pa zhes bya ba de dang / de dag gi mtshan nyid shas cher 'dzin pa snod kyi mkhris pa tshad las ma g.yos pa de dag mkhris pa'i nad kyi dngos rgyu yin/23 mkhris nad rigs kyi dbye ba mdor bsdus na gang dag yod dam/lan/ mkhris pa rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na rnam pa bzhi ste/ /nad gzhi'i mkhris pa thang la lhags pa dang / /me drod mkhris pa sa/zhan gyi gnas gyur pa/ /snod kyi mkhris pa kha lud kha shor dang / /thun mong mkhris pa rtsa ru rgyu ba dang bcas so/ /24mkhris nad tsha grang gnyis la khyad par gyi rtags ci 'dra 'byung ngam/lan/ mkhris nad tsha ba'i khyad par gyi rtags ni skom dad che ba dang / rtsa grims shing dri chu'i rlangs pa che la ku ya mthug pa/ kha kha zhing lus kyi sha drod sngar bas tsha ba dang / nub gnyid chung la bshang mdog ser ba dang / sha chang mar rnying bu ram sogs drod bcud rigs kyis gnod pa ni mkhris pa tsha ba'i mi 'gyur ba'i rtags yin la/ mkhris nad tsha ba'i nad rtags las go ldog tu 'byung la khyad par me drod 'ju stobs chung zhing / bshang ba'i mdog dkar po 'byung ba ni mkhris nad grang ba'i mi 'gyur ba'i rtags so/ /25mkhris nad la mig sprin bzhin lpags chu mdog ser ba sogs rtags mngon pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ nad gzhi mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid rno tsha 'phel bas de'i rlangs pa yar gyen du rgyu ba dang mchin pa mig gi me tog yin pa'i phyir mig sprin ser ba dang /bzhin lpags ser ba ni nad gzhi mkhris/ pa'i mtshan nyid cher 'phel nas snod mkhris kyi mkhris khu kha lud pa'i rtsa lam du khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /26 mkhris pa k+ka ya nag po zhes pa'i go don ci/lan/ mkhris pa k+ka ya nag po zhes pa ni legs sbyar kyi skad de bod skad du zad byed zer/ 'dir snod kyi mkhris pa phyi sha pags dang bar rtsa rus nang don snod kyi 183

gnas su byer te zad par byed pas na zad byed dang / nag po ni sha pags dang sen mo nag thig 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /27 bad kan zhes ming gis btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ bad ces chu dang kan zhes sa'i khams te/ ci'i phyir bad kan zhe na/lci la bsil ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /28bad kan gyi rtsa ni bying la rgud pa dang chu mdog dkar zhing dri rlangs chung ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/lan/ mtshan nyid lngi brtan 'jam pas na 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba gting du bying zhing rtsa shugs nyams pa'i mngon mi thub pa gud cing / bar pho mchin la gnas pa'i me drod nyams nas khrag rlung rgyu ma thub pas rtsa rgyud kun la rtsa gcig gi 'phar tshul gsal bor brtag mi thub pa zhar ba dang / bar pho mchin gyi me drod nyams zhing sa chu'i rang bzhin bsil ba 'phel bas dri chu'i mdog dkar zhing dri dang rlangs pa chung ba'o/ /29 lten gyi ngo bo gang yin pa dang rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ bad kan lten zhes bya ba'i ngo bo ma zhu ba'i rkyen gyis bad kan be snabs 'phel ba de nyid pho ba'i gnas lhin sna'i 'og tsam gyi char tshogs pa la zer zhing / na lugs su lhin zhes bya ste nyams la 'dril snyam byed pa/ stong nges na la mnan na 'dril ba med/ /dang ga mi bde kha zas 'ju ba dka'/ /zos dus na zhing ltogs na bde bar mngon/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /30 bad kan mgul 'gags kyi rtags dang rnam grangs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ bad kan mgul 'gags kyi rtags ni mid pa'i sbubs su be snabs chags nas mid pa 'chus shing zas skom mi thar 'gags par 'gyur ba yin pa dang /de'i rnam grangs su gre thog dang / mid 'chus/ pho rub/ ske 'ching sogs so/ /31bad kan mgul 'gags nad kyi ngo bo dang thog mtha' bar gsum gyi nad rtags ci 'dra yod dam/lan/ bad kan mgul 'gags zhes pa pho ba dang / /brang dang glo bar bad kan rgyas pa yis/ /bad kan rlangs pa glo yu mid par chags/ /dper na mdong mo'i logs 184

la 'o chags 'dra/ /'di la thog ma bar dang tha ma'i rtags/ /dang po gre ba tsha la mid pa dang / /brang dang ske stong lhin sna chags pa na/ /zas dang skom sogs mid pa dka' snyam byed/ /bar du zas dang skom gnyis mid pa dka'/ /gre ba na la lud pa ljan ljin mang / /mid pa log cing bya rog mig gnyis gzer/ /dbugs rngub dka' snyam sha skam lus stobs 'chor/ /tha ma gre ba tsha skam zas mi thar/ /thar kyang pho bar mi phebs brang du sdod/ /zos dus glo langs skyug cing skyigs bu 'byung / /dbugs 'tshubs nga ro che la mid pa 'gags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /32 bad kan rang rgyud can dang gzhan rgyud can gyi khyad par gang yin nam/lan/ bad kan rang rgyud can zhes pa ni bad kan skya bo kho na nyes pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa rkyang pa 'phel zad du gyur te rang gi rjes su mthun pa'i nad rtags rnams gsal bor ston pa yin la/ gzhan rgyud can ni bad kan nad gzhan dang 'dres pa'i ldan 'dus nad kyi mtshan nyid lhan du ston pa la zer/33grang mkhris nad la thog mtha' bar du bya ma rung ba dang spang dgos pa de gang dag yin nam/lan/ de yang grang mkhris nad gzhi 'di nyid la/ /thog mtha' bar du gtar ba mi bya zhing / /rgyun sbyong dgos na ma gtogs rtsub bshal spang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /34bad kan lcags dreg zhes pa'i ngo bo dang slong rkyen na lug/sa ci ltar yin nam/lan/ lcags la tsā chags pa ltar du pho ba'i sul la bad kan be snabs chags pas kha zas mi 'ju zhing skyug pa sogs 'byung ba'i nad zhig ste/ be snabs 'phel te pho ba'i nang sul la/ /lcags dreg chags pas pho ba'i me drod nyams/ /sgregs 'tshang pho ba thams cad hrem mer na/ /dang ga mi bde sha skam sdod snying 'dod/ /be+e snabs bad kan kha zas zos tshad skyug /ces pa ltar ro/ /35 bad kan ser bo zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ nad kyi rang mdog la bltos nas btags pa'i pho ba'i me drod 'ju byed kyi stobs nyams nas snod mkhris rtsa mig tu byer te sha mdog ser bor 'gyur ba mkhris 185

pa dang bsdongs bas so /36bad kan ser bo'i gnas sa dang rgyu lam bsdongs zla na lugs bcas gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ bad kan ser bo zhes bya gnas sa mchin dri la gnas/ rgyu ba mchin dri'i rtsa lam nas rgyu/ bsdongs pa mchin dri la gnas pa'i khrag dang bsdongs/ na lugs ni gzer ba mchin dri'i kha 'khor na/ mgo na zhing mkhris pa skyugs/ mur 'gram 'khyug cing gzer/ pho bar nyams mi bde ba sogs so/ /37bad kan dkar po'i bsdongs zla dang rgyu lam sogs gang dag yin nam/lan/ bad kan dkar po zhes pa gnas sa pho ba'i yul na gnas/ bsdongs pa pho ba la gnas pa'i rlung dang bsdongs/ rgyu ba pho ba la gnas pa'i rgyu lam nang rgyu/ na lugs ni pho ba sbos grang lhag par sbo/ zas ngan zos nas 'khru ba'i tshul yang ston no/ /38 bad kan 'ju skem zhes bya ba'i nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ bad kan 'ju skem zhes bya ba de'i rtags su ci zos kyang 'grangs pa med cing bad srin 'phel te lus stobs mi 'phel zhing skem par byed la/ lus kyi stobs chung la sha rnams skam shing gsus pa shin tu che ba byin pa 'dar la sgyid pa skyur ba bcas so/ /39 bad kan grum bu dkar bo zhes bya ba'i nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ de'i rtags su pho ba dang mchin pa gnyis gang yin cha med du na ba dang /kha zas ci dang ci zos kyang mi zhim zhing yid la med cing 'khru ba'am yang na skyug par byed pa la yan lag gi nywa gzhi dang mig rus rnams byer nas grum bur 'gyur ro/ /40 bad kan gyi nad gso ba'i rtsa don gang yin nam/lan/ dang po bad kan ngo bo bsil ba'i phyir/ /sman dpyad zas spyod rnam bzhi drod du sprug /sa 'dra gnyen po'i kha na lci ba'i phyir/ /lan res mi sel yun tu bsten pa gces/ /zhes pa'o/ /41bad kan gyi nad bcos par pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces par gdams dgos don ci/186

lan/ spyir na bad kan ngo bo bsil ba'i phyir/ /khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba bad kan byed/ /sha lpags rtsa tshigs phyi ru byer ba nyung / /rang gi gnas las gzhan du zhugs pa dkon/ /phal cher ma zhu pho bar rgyas pa'i sa/ /de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces pa yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /42 ci zhig la bad kan smug po zer/lan/ bad kan smug po ni rlung gis rang mdog sngo/ mkhris pa'i rang mdog ser/ bad kan gyi rang mdog dkar ram skya/ khrag gi rang mdog dmar/ chu ser gyi rang mdog ser ba bcas 'dus nas dbyer mi phyed par smug por 'gyur ba ltar nad 'di nyes gsum khrag dang chu ser bcas 'dus pa'i nad yin pa'i don mtshon byed kyi ming ngo /43 smug po'i skabs su khrag nyid rgyu ru bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rang srid dgra la log pas lus zungs 'drul bar byed de/ dper na/til mar rang 'tshig pa'i rgyu rang gis byed pa ltar ro/ /yan lag brgyad par/ nyes pa gzhan ltar khrag dang ni/ /gzhan gyis dbang gis nyes min kyang / /de ni til mar 'tshig pa ltar/ /nad kyi rgyu ru bzhag pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /44bad kan smug po tsha rkyen can dang grang rkyen can gyi dbye 'byed byed stangs ji 'dra yin nam/lan/ tsha rkyen 'grams khrag lhag dang mtshon khrag lus/ /tsha skyur zas kyis khrag mkhris 'phel las byung / /grang rkyen me mnyam 'ju byed mthu mnyam pas/ /ma zhus rgyu byas bad kan grang shas che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /45 smug po'i dus gsum zer ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ thog mar smug po khrag mkhris 'phel bas tsha ba'i dus dang grang ba skyes na dang po rang gnas su gab pa dang / bar du tsha grang 'thab pa'i dus yin te khrag mkhris tsha la bad rlung grang ba yin zhing de dag shed snyoms pas tsha grang 'thab pa tha ma khrag mkhris tsha ba'i stobs zad de bad rlung rgyas pas grang bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /46 bad kan smug po'i mi 'gyur ba'i khyad par gyi na lugs ji ltar yin nam/187

lan/ dri ma smug la skam zhing sha ril 'dra/ /'grangs kyang na la ltogs kyang na ba dang / /grang yang na la dros kyang na bar byed/ /ces pa'o/ /47 smug po'i dus kyi lo ma rnam gsum zer ba gang yin nam/lan/ dang po mjug dus chu tshan chu skyur skyug /bar du smin nas ser po rgya bshal skyug /tha ma rgyas nas khrag rul dud khu skyug /ces pa bzhin no/ /48smug po'i rnam 'gyur bcu gsum gyi sbas don bkral ba bcu gsum po gang yin nam/lan/ 'phyur ba mgo nad dang 'dra/ kha yan snying rlung dang 'dra/ byer ba dug dang 'dra/ rgyas pa 'grams pa dang 'dra/ zhud pa tsha grang 'thab pa dang 'dra/ 'byams pa skya rbab dang 'dra/ 'dril ba rdo skran 'dra/ gab pa grang ba dang 'dra/ skyugs pa ma zhu ba dang 'dra/ 'khrugs pa glang thabs dang 'dra/ 'gyings pa dmu chu 'dra/ 'grims pa mkhal nad 'dra/ ral ba skya rbab 'dra ba ste bcu gsum ni smug po'i rnam 'gyur bcu gsum gyi sbas don no/ /49 smug po byer ba mi nor ba'i rtags gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ de ltar byer rtags sna tshogs ci 'dra yang / /mdor na pho mchin nad dang bsdongs pas shes/ /res mos na'am sngas dus pho mchin na/ /phyis gzhan nad byung sngar nad med na nges/ /zhes pa'o/ /50 smug po mtsho rdol zhes pa ci 'dra zhig la zer ram/lan/ smug po rgyas pa'i ngan khrag rnams/ /mtsho ltar chags shing gnas pa de/ /gyen thur gang rung rdol ba'i tshe/ /smug po mtsho rdol zer ba yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /51 smug po gyen rdol zhes pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ smug po zhu ba'i gnas dag du/ /rgyas nas rdol te dud mdog gi /khrag ngan gyen du skyugs pa'i tshe/ /smug po gyen rdol zhes su bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /52 smug po 'gyings pa zhes pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ smug po pho ba'i tsha grang 'thab/ /bshal skyugs mi thub hrem mer na/ /'ju ba dka' zhing pho ba 'tshing / /'di dus smug po 'gyings zhes zer/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /188

53 smug po'i nad kyi brtag thabs la bya ra bsgrim dgos don ci/lan/ khong nad phal cher smug po'i rgyu yis bskyed/ /mi mkhas rmongs pas dug du 'dzin pa yod/ /la las tsha ba la las grang bar 'dzin/ /la las sa bdag gdon du 'dzin pa'ang yod/ /de phyir smug po'i nad la bya ra sgrims/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /54bad kan smug po'i nad kyi gso tshul gces par gdams dgos don ci/lan/ lar ni smug po 'dus pa'i nad yin pas/ /sa 'dra gso dka' nad snur lci ba'i phyir/ /lan res zhi bar mi 'gyur bcos rnams bskyar/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /55 gcong nad ces par bzhed tshul mi mthun pa yod pa dag gang yin nam/lan/ rgyun ring nad kyis gdung zhing srog gnas pa'i rten lus zungs rnams zad cing skem por gyur pa'i don la bzhed pa zhig dang / khong nad du bzhed pa bcas gnyis 'chis so/ /56 ma zhu ba gcong nad kyi rgyu yin zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rgyu gti mug las byung zhing ngo bo mtshan nyid lci zhing bsil ba gtso bor gyur pa'i zur bdun ldan de la bad kan zhes bya ste lus la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa de nyid ma zhu ba 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas so/ /57 ma zhu ba zhes pa'i nges tshig ji ltar yin nam/lan/ myag byed bad kan dag gis myag ma nus/ /'ju bar byed pa'i mkhris pas 'ju ma nus/ /me mnyam rlung gis dwangs snyigs 'byed ma nus/ /de la ma zhu zhes su brjod pa yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /58 spyir grags pa'i gcong sde bzhi de gang dag yin nam/lan/ bad mkhris lhin dang lcags dreg gcong gi sde/ /'khru skyugs 'bras dang sur ya gcong gi sde/ /dreg grum thig nag rkang 'bam gcong gi sde/ /'or skran skya rbab dmu chu gcong gi sde/ /sde bzhi zur brgyad phra mo bcu drug go /zhes pa ltar ro/ /59 ma zhu ba de rkyen gang gis bskyed pa yin nam/lan/ de rkyen rten nam ma goms mi 'phrod dang / /ngo bo mi 'ju ba yi rkyen bzhi yod//ces pa ltar ro/ /189

60 ma zhu ba'i nad 'byung mi srid pa'i rkyen gang dang gang yod dam/lan/ na tshod dar la lus stobs ldan pa dang / pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs che ba/lus ngag gi bya bar brel ba che ba/ snum bag gi kha zas rgyun du bsten pa/ mi 'phrod pa'i zas bsten par goms gshis chags pa'am yang na brid nas goms par slob pa'i rigs la dus kun tu ma zhu'i nad 'byung mi srid pa'o//61 snyigs ma ma zhu ba dang dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i khyad par gang yod dam/lan/ snyigs ma ma zhu na lces ro mi tshor zhing pho ba 'tshing la sgreg cing skyug pa dang / gang ma zhu ba'i rigs lhag par gnod pa dang zas de goms par zos sam yun ring lon nas de ltar min pa ni snyigs ma ma zhu ba/ spro ba chung zhing yi ga 'gag pa dang sgreg pa mang la sha skem zhing snying ga dang rtsub logs na ba bcas ni dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rtags so/ /62 skran nad kyi rgyu la rigs mi 'dra ba gang dag yod dam/lan/ skran nad 'byung ba'i rgyu la ma zhu ba dang / bad kan/ khrag rlung dang khrag mkhris/ srin dang chu ser ba spu la sogs pa ni gcong chen skran nad kyi rgyu yin no/ /63 skran nad la dbye ba ga tshod yod dam/lan/ dbye ba bad kan zas lten rdo yi skran/ /rlung gi lten skran khrag mkhris rtsa skran dang / /spu srin chu skran rnag skran bcu gcig go /zhes pa'o/ /64skran nad rnam pa lnga'i gyur tshul gyi khyad par dang ngo bo yi khyad par gang yin/lan/ rdzas kyi ngo bo gyong rlan snum pa sogs ma zhu rang sor du lus pa be snabs kyis 'dril bas snyigs ma ma zhu'i zas skran du 'gyur ba dang / dwangs ma ma zhu mchin par gnas pa mkhris pa'i rtsi chags nas 'dril ba snod kyi mkhris skran/ dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i mchin pa'i ngan khrag de nyid rgyu mar babs te mkhris par 'dril bas sra bar 'dril ba rgyu ma'i mkhris skran/ pho long dang mngal du skran gang byung yang rlung gis bskyod de 'phyo ba dang lding ba ma brtan par 'phel 'grib byed pa rnams ni rlung gis bskyed pa'i skran yin/ bud med bu btsas pa'i nad lhag mngal du 'dril ba la khrag 190

skran zhes su bshad pa'o/ /65 skran nad kyi mi 'gyur ba'i khyad par gyi rtags gang dag yod dam/lan/ skran kun spyi rtags rtsa rgyud zhan cing zhar/ /chu la skran thigs nya mig 'byung ba dang / /gang la skran yod steng du dreg pa chags/ /kha zas 'ju dka' grang rkyen sgreg cing skyug /dri ma sri skam 'khru yang srid pa yin/ /sha skam shed chung 'grangs dang grang rjes na/ /drag shul nad ldang 'di rnams skran rtags yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /66 skran nad phyi nang bar gsum so so'i rtags ci ltar ston pa yin nam/lan/ bar gnas sra 'dril lag 'og bzung bar nus/ /phyi na gnas pa dngos su gsal bar ston/ /gting na gnas na rtags la nad ngos bzung / /glo mchin mcher skran gang sar gzer ba yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /67 skran nad gso dka' sla'i khyad par gyi nad rtags gang yin nam/lan/ skran nad tsha grang gi rigs gang yin yang zug ha cang che zhing lus zungs gsum shor na bcos dka' la/ zungs stobs dang ldan zhing na zug chung ba dag ni bcos sla'o/ /68 tsha skran dang grang skran gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ tsha skran rtsa ni mnan na mkhrang zhing spun/ /skabs su tsha ba thog babs bzhin du sdod/ /mi nor rtags su gzhan du 'gyur ba dka'/ /dper na re ba chu bcug bzhin du gyong / /tsha skran chu ni dmar la me 'od chags/ /mi nor rtags su khrag rul rwa gzhob bro/ /grang skran nad la rtsa chu phyi yul gsum/ /rtsa ne bar dang rgod med 'khril zhing thogs/ /mi nor rtags su tsha 'brum nyil ba 'dra/ /de yang cung zad bde snyam 'khyag nas na/ /grang skran chu ni dkar zhing spu 'dra mang / /wu ba med la steng na ling tshe long / /ku ya dkar po spabs pa skam po 'dra/ /bskol na ser sla grang rjes cung zhig dmar/ /mi nor rtags su chu la dri ma med/ /grang skran phyi yul lus la dreg pa chags/ /kha so nag gam sngo ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /mi nor rtags su grod pa gzhan las che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /69 skya rbab nad kyi gyur tshul ji ltar yin nam/191

lan/ ma zhu'i dwangs ma mchin gnas zungs ma gyur/ /ngan khrag chu ser rgyas pa rlung gis gtor/ /lus kun khyab pas skya rbab dag tu g.yo/ /zhes pa'o/ /70 ci 'dra zhig la skya rbab zer ba yin nam/lan/ rlung gis gtor ba'i byer chu nyid lus kun khyab cing byer bar gyur te pags pa dang sha skyi'i bar du gnas nas skya zhing dkar la rbab rbab dag tu g.yo bar byed pas na skya rbab kyi nad ces bya'o/ /71 skya rbab kyi bcos thabs dang por rlung bcos byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ nad 'di'i sna khrid rlung gis byed pa'i phyir mngar gsum gyi ting khrol dang lug sha lo yib sogs bzang zhing gar chang btung ba dang lus la bsku mnye byed pa sogs rlung bcos byed dgos so/ /72skya rbab nad la zas sman sogs yang zhing 'ju sla ba bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ nad 'di kha zas 'ju dka' ba dang khengs po can/ de bzhin spyod lam mi 'phrod pa sogs kyis bskyed pa'i phyir gso byed kyi gnyen po yang zhing 'ju sla ba'i rigs bsten dgos so/ /73skya rbab nad kyi dpyad bcos la chu gsang rnams bsros dgos pa ji ltar yin nam/ lan/ steng gi chu gsang tshigs pa dang po dang / bar gyi chu gsang tshigs pa bcu gsum/ /'og gi chu gsang tshigs pa bco brgyad bcas rnams mes bsros nas rlung dang chu sgo bkag pas slar mi ldog pa'i phyir ro/ /74chu'i mkhar brgyad po gang dag yin nam/lan/ bol gong ngar gdong chu so bcu drug mdo dang pho ba brang zhol kha gdong mig lcibs te chu yi mkhar brgyad do/ /75 'or nad ces pa'i go don ci/lan/ dang po kha zas ma zhu dwangs snyigs 'dres/ /mchin gnas zungs su ma gyur ngan khrag rgyas/ /de nyid sha pags byer bas chu ser bskyed/ /chu ser 'or du lhung 192

ste g.yo bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /76 'or nad skyed pa'i rkyen gsum gyi khyad par ci yin nam/lan/ 'or nad bskyed par byed pa'i rkyen la zas kyis skyed pa dang / dus kyis skyed pa/ rkyen gyis skyed pa gsum las/ dang po zas kyis skyed pa ni/ kha zas ma zhu ba dwangs snyigs 'dres pa mchin gnas su zungs su ma smin par ngan khrag 'phel zhing rgyas pa de nyid sha pags la byer bas chu ser de 'or du lhung te g.yo bar 'gyur ro/ gnyis pa dus kyis bskyed pa ni/ skya rbab ma bcos pa'am dus las 'das te rnying par gyur pa las byung ba yin no/ gsum pa rkyen gyis bskyed pa ni/ nad kun bcos nyes las bskyed pa'am yang na nad 'khrugs par gyur pa las 'byung ba yin no/ /77 'or nad kyi khyad par ba'i rtags gang dag yin nam/lan/ khyad par gyi rtags ni gdong dang rkang bol brang gsum chu so sogs skrangs pa dang /sha dang pags pa'i bar du chu ser gyis khengs nas 'og tu gang bcug pa de phyogs yon por skrangs pa sogs kyi nad rtags ni 'or nad spyi la 'byung ba yin no//78 tsha 'or dang grang 'or la rtags kyi khyad par gang dag yod dam/lan/ grang 'or lus brtse skrangs gsob mtshan gnyid chung / /nyin che skrangs rtsub grang na mi bde la/ /tsha 'or mig chu ser ram yang na dmar/ /rtsa rnams gzer 'khyug pags ser dros na skrangs/ /zhes pa'o/ /79 dmu chu zhes pa'i go don ci/lan/ dmu chu zhes pa ni pho ba'i me drod nyams pa las skye bar 'gyur la/ dmu zhes lha srin sde brgyad kyi nang tshan gdug pa can zhig gi ming yin pas des btang ba'i nad chu khams kyi snyigs ma dwangs ma'i gnas su shor nas rdzing bu chu'i khengs pa ltar don snod rang rang gi gnas su rgyas pa'i chu nad la'o/ /80 gcong chen dmu chu'i rgyu gang yin nam/lan/ gcong chen dmu chu'i rgyu'am gzhi ni rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan chu ser khrag la sogs pa yin la/ de yang dwangs ma ma zhu ba khrag 193

mkhris glo mchin mcher ba sogs la zags pa'am/ smug po'i nad thur du zags pa'i chu la sogs pa ni rten can zhes nad gzhi'i steng du chu nad 'byung ba'i phyir gcong chen dmu chu'i rgyu yin no//81 dmu chu bskyed pa'i zas spyod kyi rigs gang dag yod dam/lan/ zas mi 'phrod cing 'ju dka' ba dang khengs po'i rigs dang / bshal gyi rjes zas spyod log pa/ bsil sbyor thal ba/ ngal ba thang chad cing dub pa'i rjes la chu mang btung ba dang rlan steng du nyal ba sogs pas pho ba'i me drod nyams pa sngon gyi las sam klu bdud sogs kyis dmu chu bskyed pa yin/82dmu chu'i dbye ba la nang gses kyi khyad par gang dag yod dam/lan/ gcong chen dmu chu'i nad la nad dang gdon dang dug las gyur pa gsum yod de/ rtsa kha log pa'i 'khyims chu gcig dang / khrag byer dang / mkhris byer/chu byer te byer chu gsum/ pho bar zags pa/ long du zags pa/ mchin par zags pa/mcher par zags pa/ glo bar zags pa/ rtsa skran zags pa/ khrag zags pa/ chu skran zags pa ste zags chu brgyad/ rgyu ba'i rdol chu gcig ste dril bas bcu gsum dang /de'i steng du gdon las gyur pa'i chu gcig dang / dug las gyur pa'i chu gcig ste dbye ba bco lnga yod pa'o/ /83 dmu chu'i nad pa'i 'tsho 'chi'i khyad par la dbye 'byed byed stangs gang 'dra yod dam/lan/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i tsha chu'i rigs mi 'tsho la gsor mi rung ba dang /nad gzhi rnying ba'i steng du chu nad byung na rten can zhes bya ba de nyid 'tsho bar dka' ba/ bad rlung las gyur pa'i grang ba'i chu nad dang gzhi gzhan bral te rten can min pa'i rigs ni gso sla ba/ ldan pa'i chu nad kyi rigs dag kyang gso ba legs na 'tsho ba mang du 'byung ba yod pa'o/ /84spyir dmu chu bcos thabs rnam pa lnga bo de gang dag yin nam/lan/ dang po chu bo'i 'ol kha bsgyur ba dang / /gnyis pa rgya mtsho gnas su skam pa dang / /gsum pa rdzing gi khung bu brtol ba dang / /bzhi ba mtsho bo yur du drangs pa 194

dang / /lnga ba rtsa la dgag mig gzhug pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /85 dmu chu'i bcos thabs rdzing gi khung bu brtol bar thabs ga tshod yod dam/lan/ rdzing gi 'or khung lta bu bsal ba la chu bshal dang chu sbyong / 'phrul gyi 'dzag pa dang rnam pa gsum mo/ /86 dmu chu sman gyis gso bar gnad gtso bo rnam pa gnyis yod pa de gang yin nam/lan/ dgra lta bu'i gcong chen dmu chu'i nad kyi stobs gzhom pa'i phyir/ gso thabs dang po rang phyogs lta ba'i pho ba'i me drod kyi stobs gso zhing bsrung ba dang /gnyis pa gzhan phyogs lta bu'i dmu rdzing gi nad de'i stobs gzhan du bsgyur ba'i thabs tsha chu grang chur bsgyur te dmu rdzing gi nad de nyid ming gi lhag ma tsam du gtong ba'i gso thabs gnyis so/ /87gcong chen dmu chu'i nad 'di tha mar rgyas dus 'tsho 'chi brtag thabs ci 'dra ldan yod dam/lan/ dbugs dal dang ga bde la skom dad chung / /zug med lus yang mig dkar dri chu sngo/ /rtsa rgyud snyoms pa shed che 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /dang ga mi bde yang yang skyugs pa dang / /glo mang mig ser dbugs thung skom dad che/ /dri chu dmar ser bska la nyung ba dang / /zungs zad stobs shor ba spang bar bshad/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /88 dug ces pa'i go don ci 'dra yin nam/lan/ 'jig rten khams 'dir dug dang sman ces phan gnod kyi dngos po gnyis so sor sgro btags pa'i ming yin pa las 'di ni sman dang 'di ni dug go ces mtha' cig tu brjod mi nus shing / dper na/ phan pa'i las byed pa la bdud rtsi sman dang / gnod pa'i las byed la nyes pa dug ces goms pa'i ngag rgyun du chags pa las thams cad du tshig de mi 'gyur ba ni ma yin te/ dug du grags pa'i btsan dug kyang rma bya'i zos na lus zungs 'phel ba'i bdud rtsir 'gyur la/ gsos su grags pa'i 'o ma'ang srog chags sbrul la dug dngos su 'gyur ba ltar/ bsten shes ma shes dang goms ma goms kyi dbang gis phan gnod kyi nus pa 'byin pa la dug dang sman du btags 195

pa'o//89 dug ces pa'i rgyu mtshan dang der rtsa ba'i dbye ba ga tshod yod dam/lan/ rno dro rtsub pa sogs yon tan bcu dang ldan pas mdangs kyi yon tan las go ldog cing mi mthun pas 'joms shing lus kyi 'byung ba rnams dkrugs pa dang tshe dang gzi mdangs sogs 'phrog cing 'joms par byed pas na dug ces btags pa yin/ de la sbyar dug dang / gyur dug dngos dug ces rtsa ba'i dbye ba gsum yod pa yin/90 sbyar dug ces pa'i go don ci 'dra yin nam/lan/ dug gi rgyur gyur pa'i rdzas rigs sna tshogs lhan du sbyar ba ni bya ba'i las kyis bsgrubs pa yin pas na sbyar ba'i dug ces bya ba yin/91 dug rigs bskur ba'i rta lnga zhes pa de gang dag yin nam/lan/ mthong ba nyi ma'i zer la bskur ba dang / du ba rlung gi rdzi la bskur ba/'goms pa sa yi gnas la bskur ba/ reg pa snum gyi rta la bskur ba/ khong ba zas la bskur ba bcas so/ /92 dug rigs 'jug pa'i tshul ci ltar yin nam/lan/ zer la bskur ba mdangs la 'jug pa dang / /rdzi la bskur ba rtsa sgo sna nas 'jug /rlangs la bskur ba rtsa sgo ba spu 'jug /reg pa snum la bskur pa ba spu'i sgo nas 'jug /zas la bskur ba kha so lam nas 'jug pa'o/ /93 sbyar dug gyur tshul gyi go don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dwangs ma'i rta la dug zhon pas lus zungs bdun dang dri ma gsum la sogs pa kun la khyab pa'i phyir gnas kyis bsgyur ba'i nad rtags 'dra min sna tshogs pa ci yang ston pa dang / rlung la sogs pa'i 'du ba rnams kyang phan tshun 'khrug cing 'thab pa'i phyir nad 'di nyid thog mtha' kun du ngos bzung ba dang bcos thabs rjes gcod sogs shin tu dka' ba dang / sbyor ba'i rigs dang lus kyi nad khams sogs skur ba'i rta yi bsgyur bas 'jug sgo rnams su gcig tu ma nges par gar yang 'bab pa yin no/ /196

94sbyar dug gi nad la brtag pa'i sgo ji tsam yod pa yin nam/lan/ brtag thabs rnam pa bdun yod de/ phyi'i rtags la brten nas brtag pa dang /nang gi rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa dang / gsang ba'i sgo nas brtag pa/ rdzas rigs sbyor ba'i sgo nas brtag pa/ man ngag rdzas kyi sgo nas brtag pa/ babs sa gnas kyi sgo nas brtag pa/ mi 'tsho 'chi ltas la brtag pa bcas so/ /95 sbyar dug nad kyi spang blang gi khyad par ci ltar yin nam/lan/ ngos zin gso ba rung dang mi rung ni/ /mi thub 'chi ltas sha zad mur gong rdib/ /dang ga 'gags sam zas skom zos tshad skyugs/ /lce rnyil sen mo'i bkrag shor lus stobs zad/ /'brum pa nag pos khyab dang rngam pa thung / /gnas lngar skrangs dang smyo dug sman mi len/ /nang khrol rul 'khru gson khrag skyugs par byed/ /de rtags ldan na mi 'tsho spang zhes gsungs/ /de ldog 'tsho nges yin pas gso ba sgrims/ /zhes pa'o/ /96 sbyar dug bcos thabs kyi rtsa don gang yin nam/lan/ sbyar ba'i dug gi nad kyi bcos thabs la byer ba sdud pa dang / gnyen pos bsad pa/ sbyong byed kyis nad dag par byed pa/ zungs ngan zhing nad rnying pa'i rigs la bsdu bsad chig chod bya ba dang phyir mi ldog pa'i phyi rjes bcad pa'i thabs dang rnam pa lnga ru bsdus te bstan pa yin no/ /97 sbyar dug rlung gyur sogs khyad par ba'i rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung ldan sbo sgregs mgo 'khor mkhris pa ldan/ /khong tsha 'khru dang khrag gis gzer 'khyug byed/ /bad kan lus lci mgo na 'ju dka' 'khren/ /chu ser ldan pas g.yo skrangs tshigs gzhi na/ /zhes pa'o/ /98 sha dug gi rgyu'i khyad par ngos bzung tshul ci ltar yin nam/lan/ sha rlon sa la babs pa'am bem pa dang / yul phyogs kyi sa la rang bzhin gyis dug yod pa'i rlangs pa sha la phog pa ni sha dug 'byung ba'i rgyu yin no/ /99 sprul dug lus la mched pa myur ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/lan/ sbrul gyi dug gis khrag dag la/ /ma brten lus la gnod mi byed/ /khrag ni 197

cung zad la brten yang / /til mar thigs pa bzhin du mched/ /ces pa'o/ /100bse dug gi khyad par gyi rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ 'brum pa skya sib g.ya' zhing 'phrug snying 'dod/ /phrugs pas rnag chu 'byung zhing rma ru mched/ /sha mdangs dmar la gzer 'khyug tsha bshal byed/ /mgo lus lngi la dbang bo 'khrul ba dang / /tha ma skra dang smin pa byi par byed/ /ces pa'o/ /101 khyi dug gi mtshan nyid ci ltar yin nam/lan/ mtshan nyid khyi de 'on long kha chu 'dzag /kha gdangs mgo bo smad cing mjug ma phab/ /'khyom zhing phyogs med kun tu rgyu ba yin/ /de yi mche bar dug babs rmugs pa dang / /dbugs la dug babs kha rlangs phog pa'am/ /mig la dug babs mthong yang dug rgyu'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /102 khyi dug nyid gso ba dka' sla'i khyad par ji ltar phyes sam/lan/ mi rigs rlung gi mi la khyi dkar dang / mkhris mir khyi dmar/ bad kan mi la khyi nag 'dus pa'i ming khyi rgyal po'am khra bo lta bus rmugs dang de bzhin pho la khyi mo dang mo la khyi phos rmugs na gso ba dka' zhing / de las ldog pa'i rigs ni gso ba sla ba yin no/ /103 don snod ces pa'i go don ci 'dra yin nam/lan/ don zhes pa dwangs ma'i rten rdog po'am 'bur du don pa snying sogs la zer te/ dwangs ma rang gnas su rgyu ba sogs so so'i don byed nus pas so/ /snod ces snyigs ma bskyil pa'i gnas snod ltar stong bar gyur pa pho ba sogs drug la zer te snyigs ma thams cad thur du drangs pa'i bya ba byed nus pas so/ /104snying zhes tha snyad btags pa'i go don ci/lan/ byang khog stod kyi char srog rtsa nag po las 'bras bu smin pa ltar kha thur du bltas shing rtse mo lus kyi g.yon ngos su phyogs pa de'i ming ste/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/lus kyi rtsa nag stod kyi char/ /tshe srog sems kyi dbang rten du/ /bil ba'i snying po ltar gnas pa/ /de la snying zhes bshad pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /105 snying nad skyed pa'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yod dam/198

lan/ rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kan gsum/ /rkyen ni gnyid mi log pa dang / /'jigs pa dag dang mya ngan dang / /sems mi bde ba dag las 'byung / /zhes pa bzhin no/ /106snying 'phyos nad la thun mong ma yin pa'i nad rtags gang yod dam/lan/ de la tshigs pa drug bdun khyad par du na zhing tshigs kha phye ba sogs 'byung ba dang / nad sdug tu phyin nas lus kun zug cing dran med brgyal zhing ma bcos rnying nas snying rlung smyon par 'gyur ba'o/ /107 snying gzer dang snying tshad nad gnyis mi 'dra sa'i khyad par gyi rtags gang yin nam/lan/ snying tshad lhag par du tsha myag byed cing snying 'phar te gris gtubs snyam sems shing dran shes mi brtan pa dang shes pa 'khrugs la lce skam thung ngur 'gyur ba yin zhing / snying gzer lce skam la na zug phur ba btsugs pa ltar gzer ba dang mig 'bur tshugs su blta zhing rngam pa rgod la zhe 'khun 'byung ba'o/ /108 glo nad bskyed par byed pa'i rkyen gang dag yin nam/lan/ rkyen ni rul skyur zo mar tshwa dang / dwa ba/ de bzhin cham pa 'grams dang drag shul rnams kyis bskyed do//109 glo nad kyi dbye ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ glo nad rlung las gyur pa thang bo dang skya rbab gnyis dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa glo nad tsha ba'i rigs/ bad kan las gyur pa chu shor dang thes po gnyis/khrag las gyur pa glo gcong dang glo rgyas gnyis/ khrag mkhris las gyur pa bung tshang can bcas so/ /110 glo nad spyi'i bcos thabs kyi rtsa don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dang po nad lci yang la dpyad nas gang la de 'tsham gyi 'brel yod sman sbyor gtong ba dang / de nas kha zas bsil la yang ba dang spyod lam dal ba sogs bsten la/ des ma phan na brtag dpyad la gzhigs nas gtar ga bya'o/ /111 glo nad tsha subs dang tsha gzer la khyad par ci 'dra zhig yod dam/199

lan/ tsha subs rtsa chu tsha la ro stod rgyangs/ /lud pa tshwa bro wu chung mkhris pa 'ong / /ston dus drag shul drod bcud shin tu gnod/ /tsha gzer nyal ba mi bde dbugs kyis theg/lud pa dmar ser lu zhing skabs su gzer/ /zhes pa'o/ /112 glo nad spyi'i khyad chos ji ltar yin nam/lan/ spyir na glo ba bad kan yul yin pas/ /dbyar dus bde la dgun dus na ba dang / /nyin par bde la mtshan mo na ba yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /113snying gzer gyi nad las khrag gzer dus su ma bcos na nyen che ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/lan/ khrag gzer gyi nad de dus su ma bcos na snying gi nang khrag gis bkang ste myur du 'chi bar 'gyur bas so/ /114snying chu dang snying 'thibs gnyis la khyad par ci yod dam/lan/ snying chu ni snying la chu ser zhugs pa dang / snying 'thibs ni snying la bad kan zhugs pa'i khyad par ro/ /115mchin nad bco brgyad kyi dbye ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dbye ba leb rgan rgyas dang ldem bu dang / /dug thabs chu shor rkun bu 'or lhung dang / /kha lud gzhung rengs mchin grum nag po dang / /mchin nad hal skem mchin dri dkar nag dang / /gnad mchin rtsa byer nad dang bcu gsum tsha/ /mchin rlung mchin rgud rlan grang glang dgur dang / /grang sbos lnga grang bsdoms pas bco brgyad gsungs/ /zhes pa'o/ /116mchin pa'i byed las ci ltar yin nam/lan/ mchin pas khrag gsog 'jog byed pa ma zad/ mkhris pa mdangs bsgyur gyi byed las la brten nas lus zungs kyi bcud rdzas rnams kyi kha dog bsgyur ba dang /mkhris khu zags don dang zhag tshil 'ju bar ram 'degs kyi las byed bzhin yod mdo/ /117 nad rtags gang dag mngon na mchin nad tsha ba yin par nges sam/lan/ de rtags mchin nad tsha ba mchin steng gzer/ /mig dmar mchin pa 200

rgyas snyam skom dad che/ /gdong snum sna khrag 'dzag cing kan rtsa mtho/ /chu mdog dmar la dri mnam rlangs pa che/ /chang 'thung me nyis dros na lhag par na/ /lce skem lus po gyong zhing phyi drod che/ /de rnams mchin nad tsha ba'i mi 'gyur rtags/ /zhes pa'o/ /118 mchin nad dug thabs kyi nad rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ dug thabs mig dmar gdong sngo rtsib steng zug /pho mchin gang snyam 'ju dka' zas rjes na/ /brun skam bol g.yo mur gong mthil bzhi ser/ /gzhug tu mchin pa rul nas dud khur lu/ /zhes pa'o/ /119 mchin nad ldem bu'i rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mchin nad ldem bu na ba mi tshor bar/ /gnyid med khong snyom lus lci zas mi 'dod/ /khrag 'bros sha dang rus pa khad kyis skam/ /zhes pa'o/ /120 mcher nad kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan dang / rkyen ni gdon dang / rlung zhugs pa/ grang ba chu skyur dang ma zhu ba bcas so/ /121 mkhal ma'i gnas yul dang byed las gang yin nam/lan/ chu khams dwangs ma'i rten du gyur pa'i mkhal ma ni gsus khog stod kyi sgal tshigs logs gnyis su gyen du langs nas chags te/ mkhal ma g.yon pa las g.yas cung dma' la yar sna rtsib ma bcu gcig pa dang mnyam la mar sna tshigs pa bcu bzhi pa dang mnyam zhing / de bzhin mkhal ma g.yas pa rtsib ma bcu dang mnyam la mar sna tshigs pa bco lnga pa dang 'brel ba dang / mkhal ma'i dbyibs ni rang gi rna ba dang 'dra ste las gtso bo khrag dwangs snyigs phye ba dang dri chu 'byin sdom byed pa yin /122 mkhal nad spyi'i rgyu rkyen gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gsum/ /rkyen ni brdabs dang mi theg khur dang bteg /rlan steng 'dug dang chu yi las byas dang / /bang 'chongs 'chus dang dkar mngar zas bsten drags/ /zhes pa'o/ /123 mkhal tshad kyi rtags gtso bo gang dag yin nam/lan/ gcin pa yang yang 'bab pa de'ang gcin pa'i nang khrag 'dres shing 201

gtong dus tsha shar rgyag la/ rkang ba bshal ba dang mig gdong skrangs pa/ 'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba phra la grims shing dri chu'i mdog dmar la rlangs pa che zhing grang na nyog pa chags pa'o/ /124mkhal nad grang ba slong ba'i rkyen de gang dag yin nam/lan/ ra phag gi sha dang shing 'bras ma smin pa/ lhag par du skyur kham dang ser sha sogs bsil che ba'i rigs bza' btung drags pa'am chu grang mo'i nang du zhugs drags pa/ brdabs chags dang rmas skyon byung ba/ chags pa spyad drags pa/gzhan yang bud med phru gu mang po skyes pa sogs kyis bskyed pa yin no//125 mkhal gcong gi nad rtags gtso bo gang dag yin nam/lan/ mkhal gcong gi nad rtags gtso bo ni/ lus kyi smad grang zhing rked pa 'khor bar na ba dang / rkang pa bshal la dpyi dang rked par na zug 'byung zhing chu sri ba/ bcud rlugs pa zhes sa bon 'dzag cing rna ba 'on par 'gyur ba yin no/ /126 pho ba'i nges tshig ci ltar yin nam/lan/ pho ba ni byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa ste/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis/ ro drug zas skom gang zos rnams/ /myag bzhu 'dres par sbyangs pa dang / /thur tu gtong zhing 'pho ba'i phyir/ /de la pho ba zhes su bshad/ /ces pa bzhin no/ /127 pho nad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni rlung mkhris bad kan gsum/ /rkyen ni kha zas mi 'phrod dang / /rlan 'dug ma zhu zas mang dang / /skom dad bsil mang pho nad 'byung / /zhes pa'o/ /128 pho nad tsha ba dang grang ba gnyis kyi khyad par gyi rtags gang yin nam/lan/ tsha rtags khrag mkhris las gyur 'khru zhing skyugs/ /zas spyod tsha ches bsil ches gnyis ka gnod/ /bad kan las gyur sgreg cing zas rjes na/ /kha zas ma smin 'khru ba rtsam mdog 'khru/ /grang lhags mi bzod mthil bzhir dreg pa chags/ /zhes pa'o/ /129 rgyu ma'i nad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yin nam/202

lan/ rgyu rkyen mi 'phrod pa'i zas rul sungs can dang / rjen pa/ grang mo'i rigs/ dug can/ mkhregs po/ mngar skyur sogs zos ches pa/ chu mang du 'thung ba/lus khams 'khyags pa/ 'khrug las ches drags pa sogs kyis bskyed pa yin/130rgyu 'gag dang rgyu 'khril gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi rtags gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu 'gag khrag dang mkhris pas dri ma 'gags/ /tsha 'dril gzer zhing dri ma sha ril 'dra/ /rgyu ma gzer zhing thur du bshal ba yin/ /rgyu 'khril rgyu ma rlung gis gcus pa yin/ /'og rlung mi thon 'khril zhing ldang dub byed/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /131 rgyu 'gyings zhes pa'i nad rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu mar bad kan gyi be snabs rgyas pas rgyu ma lci la hril gyis 'gro snyam byed cing dri ma 'gyings pas mi thon la/ skabs su na zhing bad kan gyi be snabs 'khru bar byed/132 rgyu rgan zhes pa'i nges tshig ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu rgan zhes pa ni tsha ba rgyu ma la babs pa dang / kha zas ma zhu ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis rgyu ma'i nang gi zas skom 'dzin byed rgyu rtsi la skyon shor nas yun ring du bshal ba'i rgyu nad rnying ba'am rgan po la'o//133 rgyu ma zhes ming gis btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ ro drug zas skom las byung ba'i/ /dwangs snyigs ma 'dres so so'i gnas/ /rgyu bar byed pa'i lam yin pas/ /de la rgyu ma zhes su bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /134long zhes bya ba'i nges tshig ci/lan/ rlung snyigs zas ro gsog pa'i snod/ /g.yas g.yon dbus dang rnam pa gsum/ /lang long g.yo ba ltar gnas pas/ /long ga zhes su bshad pa yin/ /zhes pa'o /135 long nad skyed pa'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni nyes pa rlung mkhris bad kan gsum la/ rkyen lus grang ba'am bsil sar bsdad drags pa dang / yang na rlan steng bsdad de rlung 'khrugs pa'am pho 203

ba rgyu ma'i nad ro long du lhung ba las skyed do/ /136long nad tsha grang gnyis la khyad par gyi rtags gang yod dam/lan/ long nad tsha ba kha skam la skom dad che ba dang / /long nad grang ba'i rtags su 'ur 'khrog mang du byed pa bcas so//137mkhal gcong gi nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa chu grang zhing rked pa 'khor zhing na/ /rkang ba bshal zhing dpyi mig rked pa na/ /chu sri bcud lug bshul sha sbrid nas na/ /zhes pa'o//138 thor bu'i nad ces pa'i go don ci/lan/ sde tshan du ma 'dus pa dum bu dum bu 'byung ba ste/ man ngag rgyud kyi nyes gsum gso ba sogs skabs bcu bzhi'i khongs su bsdu mi thub pa skad 'gags sogs thor bu'i nad gso ba'i le'u bcu dgu phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sde tshan gyi spyi ming ngo / /139 zas spyod gang gis skad 'gags skyed par byed pa yin nam/lan/ mar tshil la sogs rnying pa'i rigs dang / chang rag ja gar bsten drags pa/ dbyangs gyer ba/ 'khrug las ches pa/ gdangs thon pos smra brjod yun ring du byas pa/ khog stod me nyis dros drags pa/ sha rgyags pa sogs kyis skad 'gags kyi nad skyed pa yin no/ /140 skad 'gags nad byung sa'i gnas dang gtong sman ji ltar yin nam/lan/ skad 'gags byung sa'i gnas gtso bo ni gre ba dang glo mig yin la/ sman du dkar po drug sbyor dang / skad sman 'brug sgra/ li shi drug pa/ li khrag spang rgyan bco lnga/ gnyan tshad dang ldan na li khyung / phan pa kun ldan/ li shi brgyad pa/ khyung sngon dgu pa bcas 'brel yod sman sbyor rnams bsten na legs/141 yi ga 'chus pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang dag yin nam/lan/ zas skyugs bro ba'i rigs dang / rul sungs ma goms pa/ mi 'dod pa'i zas sogs lce dang snying la rtsi ltar zhen pas yi ga 'chus pa dang spyod lam sems las ches pa sogs las 'byung ngo //204

142 gyen rgyu rlung dang khrag mkhris 'khrugs byed kyi rgyu gang dag yin nam/lan/ chang rag dang sha mar bu ram sogs bsten drags pa dang / tshwa khu'i rigs btung che ba/ tshad gung bsdad pa/ ngal dub che ba sogs kyis gyen rgyu'i rlung dang khrag mkhris 'khrugs pa yin/143 skom dad bye brag so so'i rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung gyur mgo 'khor gnyid med mur 'gram gzer/ /sna dang lce yis dri dang ro mi tshor/ /mkhris gyur kha kha khong tsha kha dri mnam/ /bad kan kha mngal rlon zhing zas mi 'ju/ /'dus rtags kun ston bcud zad zas mid dka'/ /zhes pa'o/ /144skyigs bu'i nad ji ltar byung ba yin nam/lan/ kha zas ma zhu ba dang / rlung 'khrugs pa/ zas spyod dman lhag log pa/gdon gyis 'du ba 'khrugs te gyen rgyu'i bu ga 'gags pa bcas las 'byung ngo / /145 skyigs bu'i nad la dbye ba du yod dam/lan/ de la dbye na zas byung dang / phran tshegs/ zung 'byung / chen po/ zab mo zhes rnam pa lnga yod/146 skyigs bu'i nad lngi yang gi khyad par ji ltar shes thub bam/lan/ nad 'di rigs nyam chung zhing zungs zad pa dang / glo brdol nas lud pa khrag tu lu ba/ lo na rgas pa sogs la skyigs bu chen po shugs drags 'byung ba ni phal cher 'chi bar 'gyur bas/ 'phral du bcos dgos te yun ring na pho thog tu'ang 'gyur ba yin no/ /147 dbugs mi bde ba'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yin nam/lan/ ma zhu ba'i rgyu byas pa la brten nas bad kan 'phel bas dwangs ma'i lam bkag pa dang / lud pa 'phel bas glo ba skabs su lu zhing dbugs rgyu ba'i lam bkag pa las 'byung ba yin no//148 dbugs mi bde ba'i nad la dbye ba du yod dam/ gang dag yin/lan/ dbugs mi bde ba'i nad la dbye na lnga yod de/ phran tshegs/ mun can/dbugs chad/ chen po/ gyen 'byung bcas so/ /205

149 dbugs chad dang gyen 'byung la mi 'dra sa gtso bo gang yod dam/lan/ dbugs chad ni bad kan gyis glo mig 'gags pas gyen rgyu'i rlung gi mthu nyams te dbugs 'byin mi bde zhing kha skam la skad gdangs dma' bas gtam gyi gzhug chad de gsang gtam lta bur smra ba yin/ gyen 'byung ni bad kan gyis gyen rgyu'i dbugs rgyu ba'i lam bkag pas phyir dbugs 'byin bde zhing nang du dbugs rngub pa dka' la thung rtsub bcas so/ /150 glang thabs nad kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen ma zhu ba dang mi 'phrod pa'i zas zos pa dang / rngul grang gis srin 'khrugs pa dang gdon gyis bskyed pa las 'byung ba yin no/ /151 glang thabs nad kyi dbye ba phye tshul ji 'dra yin nam/lan/ de la dbye na gnas kyi dbye ba dang rigs kyi dbye ba rnam pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po gnas ni don glang dang / snod glang / rtsa glang gsum yod pa la/don glang ni mchin pa'i glang thabs dang / mcher ba'i glang thabs bcas rnam pa gnyis dang / snod glang ni phyi rtsa dang nang rtsa'i glang thabs gnyis te gnas kyi dbye ba rnam pa bdun/ rigs ni tsha grang gnyis dang / srin glang / gnyan glang bcas bzhi te rags pa'i sgo bcu gcig yod pa'o/ /152 srin glang gi nad rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ srin glang dkar mngar grang rjes lte ba'i 'og /dru bur 'gril nas ldang zhing na zug che/ /zhes pa'o/ /153 srin nad kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni lus la gnas pa'i srin bu de/ /rkyen ni dkar mngar tshig dang 'dres pa'i zas/ /me nyi du ba grang dang gdon gyis bskyed/ /ces pa'o/ /154tsha srin dang grang srin gyi rtags gtso bo ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tsha srin blta rtsa khong grims spun la 'khyig /chu mdog dmar la rlangs che ku ya mthug /'di rnams tsha srin nad kyi mi 'gyur rtags/ /zhes pa'o/ /155 'khru nad kyi ngo bo ci 'dra yin nam/206

lan/ 'khru nad rmi ma zhu ba dang gnas skabs su 'khru ba dang / pho ba'i me drod nyams pa/ rgyu long rnams su grang ba skyes pa/ mkhris pa snod du lhung ba/ mchin tshad thur du babs pa bcas so/ /156 tsha 'khru dang grang 'khru gnyis kyi khyad par gyi nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tsha 'khru mdog dmar ram ser ba dang / grang 'khru mdog skya la zas mdog 'khru ba/ yang na chu gtsang du blugs la 'khru ba'i dri ma thur mgo gang dal bus chu khar bzhag na chu'i gting du 'gro ba ni snum pa'i cha lci ba yod pas tsha 'khru dang /yang g.yo'i wu ba bcas chu khar ling nger sdod pa ni grang 'khru'o/ /157 dri ma 'gags pa'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yin nam/ lan/ lus khams la tsha ba chen po rgyas pa dang / smug po mkhris pa dang mchin pa'i nad/ rgyu long gi rlung 'khrugs pa/ srin nad/ de min 'o ma gar bo dang / sha skam po/ zho btsos ma/ shing thog a mra sogs bstud nas zas drags pa bcas kyis slong bar byed do/ /158 gcin 'gags nad kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen lgang ba'i kha nyid thur bltas pa'i/ /ngos gnyis chu rgyu'i rtsa yod mkhal mar 'brel/ /de la zas spyod gdon gyis 'du ba 'khrugs/ /lgang ba'i rtsar zhugs gcin nad skyed par byed/ /ces pa'o/ /159 gcin sri ba dang 'gags pa'i khyad par ci/lan/ gcin sri ba ni gcin pa rgyun ldan ltar mi 'bab pa gtong dka' bar gyur pa'i don dang / gcin 'gags ni dri chu 'gags nas mi 'byung ba'i don/160 gcin snyi'i nad ces pa'i nges tshig ci yin nam /lan/ gcin snyi'i nad ces bya ba ni/ /mkhal ma lgang ba'i stobs shor nas/ /mal sa stan dang gnyid log dus/ /dbang med gcin pa grangs mang shor/ /zhes pa'o /161 gcin snyi'i nad kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen lan tshwa mngar bsil lci ba'i zas/ /rlan can mal 'dug bad 207

kan tshil 'phel ba/ /lgang bar zags pas za khu skyed par byed/ /ces pa'o/ /162 za khu zhes pa'i brjod don gang yin nam/lan/ gcin de zungs dang 'dres nas lus kyi stobs mdangs rnams za ba ltar nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir ming yang de ltar btags pa yin/163 gcin snyi dang za khu gnyis kyi khyad par ci ltar 'byed dgos sam/lan/ gcin snyi ni bongs chung ngur 'phral 'phral grangs mang du 'byung ba dang /za khu ni bad tshil 'phel ba zungs su smin ma thub par dri chu'i snyigs ma dang 'dres nas 'byung ba ste/ ji skad du/ gcin snyi yin min gcin pa'i grangs la brtag /za khu yin min gcin pa'i mdog la brtag/ces pa'o/ /164tshad 'khru nad kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen me drod mi snyoms chung ba la/ /drod rlangs che ba'i yul sar chu mang 'thungs/ /bcud med zas kyis me drod phyir la bton/ /phyi yul drod rlangs tsha bas mchin tshad bskyed/ /lus kyi chu khams thur bskyod 'khru bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /165 tshad 'khru so so'i rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung gyur wu ba sgra bcas chu ru 'khru/ /mkhris gyur ser nag sngo la dri ma che/ /khrag gyur khrag 'khru bad gyur 'byar bag can/ /zhes pa'o/ /166 dreg nad ces pa'i go don ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gnas sam mdog la bltos nas btags pa'i lag pa'i gru mo dang /rkang pa'i rgya tshigs la phog pa'i rlung khrag 'khrugs pa'i gang na'i gnas su dreg pa smug nag chags pa la'o/ /167 dreg nad kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ kha zas ro tsha ba'i rigs dang snum bag rgyun du za ba dang / chang btung drags pa/ drag shul gyi las byas pa las khrag 'khrugs pa/ gzhan yang rlung bskyed par byed pa'i zas spyod yang rtsub sogs bsten pas rlung 'phel te log pa'i lam ru zhugs nas rang rang gi rgyu lam bkag pa sogs kyis dreg nad bskyed pa yin/168 dreg nad kyi gnas dang 'phel ba'i rim pa ji ltar yin nam/208

lan/ gnas ni gsar dus pags pa khrag la gnas/ /phal cher rkang ba'i mthe bong gtso smras te/ /mthil sogs long tshigs man dang lag pa yi/ /gru mor gnas la rim pas mched pa de/ /tha ma rnying nas rtsa chu rus tshigs khyab/ /ces pa'o/ /169 dreg nad bye brag pa so so'i nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ khyad par rlung gyur gzer 'phrig 'phel 'grib byed/ /mkhris gyur drod che dmar la reg mi bzod/ /khrag gyur tsha 'brab mdog dmar 'drul bar byed/ /bad kan las gyur g.ya' lci tshor ba med/ /ces pa'o/ /170 grum bu'i nad kyi nges tshig ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tshigs mig chu ser 'phel ba yis/ /'byor byed byed las nyams gyur te/ /tshigs kun chag grum shor ba ltar/ /gyur pas grum bu zhes su bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /171 grum nad kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ de yang tshad pa'i nad rigs gang yang rung / /bcud shor nyid gnyid gtar sngas drag shul gyis/ /tsha ba byer zhing phal cher smad du lhung / /chu ser bsdongs zla bcas pa tshigs la zhen/ sha rus rtsa rgyus la khyab grum bur 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /172 grum nad kyi spyi rtags gang ltar yin nam/lan/ spyi rtags grang shum yun ring sha pags brtse/ /gdong snum mgo bo rked pa dpyi mig zug /shed chung sgyid skyur sha 'bros rngul kha snyi/ /rus tshigs sha rus khol zhing chu rgyus gyong / /'gul tshe lhag par na zhing skad ngan 'chor/ /chu dmar rtsa 'khyug phra mgyogs gting na rgyugs/ /dgye dgu mi shes khyad par mtshan mo thu/ /nyin gnyid mi thub mtshan mo bya ltar yer/ /zhes pa'o/ /173 grum bu dkar po dang nag po'i ngos 'dzin tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ grum dkar bad rlung grang ba shas che bas/ /skrangs mdog dkar zhing zug chung rtsa chu grang / /grum nag khrag mkhris tsha ba shas che bas/ /skrangs mdog nag cing zug che rtsa chu tsha/ /zhes pa'o/ /174chu ser gyi gyur tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dang po gyur tshul kha zas dwangs ma de/ /mkhris pa mdangs sgyur las kyis 209

khrag tu 'gyur/ /khrag gi snyigs ma mkhris pa'i nang du gsog /mkhris pa'i dwangs ma chu ser nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /175srog rtsa dkar po'i ngos 'dzin ji ltar yin nam/lan/ klad pa'i rje zhabs man dang gzhug chung yan/ /sgal rus sbubs su gnas pa'i rgyungs pa ste/ /klad pa dang 'brel srog gnas rtsa byed cing / /nang du mdog dkar srog rtsa dkar po bshad/ /de las gyes pa'i rtsa dkar phra mo yis/ /stod smad phyi nang kun tu khyab par gnas/ /dbang bo yul la 'char bar byed pa dang / /yul lnga'i rnam shes bdag du 'dzin par byed/ /ces pa'o/ /176rtsa dkar nad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen gang dag yod dam/lan/ nad 'di rgyu rkyen drag shul 'grams pa'am/ /rims dug tsha ba rtsa la babs pa'am/ /mtshon gyis bcad brdung rlung 'khrugs rtsar zhugs pas/ /de nyid rtsa dkar nad du 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /177rtsa dkar nad kyi gnas kyi dbye ba gsum zhes pa gang dag yin nam/lan/ gnas ni mgo bo dang / byang khog yan lag bcas gsum ste mgo bo ste klad pa dang / byang khog ste don snod nang 'brel pa'i dar gyi dpyangs thag bcu gsum dang / byang khog ste yan lag phyir 'brel mngon pa'i rtsa drug ste gsum mo/ /178 tshad 'khru la rgya nad tsha 'khru zhes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/lan/ rgya dkar nag sogs tshad rlangs che sa kho na la 'byung bas 'byung khungs la brten nas btags pa'i ming dngos te rgya nad tsha 'khru zhes so/ /179 gcin snyi'i nad gso dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ nad 'di gsar ba'i dus su gso bar ma sgrims na lus zungs dang gcin 'dres pa'i phyir shin tu gso dka' ba yin no//180 dreg nad kyi rtsa chu phyi yul gsum gyi nad rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ dreg gi rtsa ni sna thung mkhrang la grims/ /khrag tshad rtsa 'dra khyad par cung zhig g.yung / /dreg gi chu la nges med tshad pa 'dra/ /mi nor rtags su ra gzhob kho na bro/ /dreg gi phyi yul rkang ba skam khol byed/ /ldang dub byed cing yang yang me ltar 210

'bar/ /'di la tsha dreg grang dreg gnyis su yod/ /tsha dreg dmar la rlangs pa che ba'o/ /mi nor rtags su skrangs la me 'od chags/ /'di la bsil sman gtar ga kho nas bcos/ /grang dreg rkang lag 'khums nas 'gul mi nus/ /de la btsod dang bcud kyis bcos par bya/ /zhes pa'o/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 rlung gi nad nyid thog mar bstan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rags tsam zhig shod/'grel/ rlung ni tsha ba dang grang ba gnyis ka'i zung du 'jug cing dbyer med par kun la khyab par byed pa ste/ dper na/ mkhris tshad me lta bu rlung gi shugs kyis 'bud cing / bad kan grang ba'i bsil ba rlung ngad kyis 'khyags par byed pa dang /de bzhin du dmu 'or skya rbab rnams g.yo zhing / skran gyi rigs rnams sgong bar byed pa dang / rang gnas su bsags pa'i nad rnams rlung gis slong zhing / sha lpags rtsa rgyus sogs la byer pa'i nad kun gyi sna 'dren kyang rlung gis byed pa dang / tshad gzhug phal cher kyang thor bu'i rlung gis 'bud par byed pa'i don gyis rlung gi nad nyid thog mar bstan pa yin no/ /2 lha bsnol 'dre g.yos zhes pa'i go don phris/'grel/ gtso bo rang rgyud ma dag pa las byung ba'i nad kyi kha rlangs de yin pa ni rdzas rigs nyi zer gyi rdul las kyang shin tu phra ba chu bar mig gis mi mthong ba de dag rims nad las bshad pa ltar mdog kyang ser po/ dmar po/ nag po sogs yod pa des mkhris pa tsha ba'am nad so sor skyed tshul yod pa ltar go ba len dgos par 'dod ces so/ /3 dang po bad kan ngo bo bsil ba'i phyir/ /sman dpyad zas spyod rnam bzhi drod du sprug /sa 'dra gnyen po'i kha na lci ba'i phyir/ /lan res mi sel yun tu bsten pa gces/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ de yang spyir bcos pa'i thabs su bad kan kyi ngo bo bsil ba'i phyir 211
