gnyen po zas spyod sman dpyad rnam pa bzhi drod du sprug dgos pa dang / sa dang 'dra bas gnyen po de nyid kyi kha na lci ba'i phyir sman lan re res mi sel bar yun tu bsrings nas bsten pa gces zhes pa'i don no/ /4rgyu ma bcos par 'bras bu gso 'dod pa/ /dug rtsa ma phyungs lo ma bcad skyur 'dra/ /khong nad thams cad ma zhus skyed pa'i phyir/ /ma zhu gso dpyad mkhas pa shin tu gces/ /rgyu nyid grol na 'bras bu ga la 'byung / /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ nad kyi rgyu ma bcos par ngo bo'am 'bras bu gso 'dod pa ni/ dper na/ dug gi rtsa ba ma phyungs par lo ma bcad nas skyur ba dang 'dra ste don med do/ /khong nad thams cad kyi rgyu lta bu ma zhu bas skyed phyir ma zhu ba'i gso dpyad la mkhas pa shin tu gal che bas gces la/ rgyu mtshan ni rgyu de nyid grol ba'i tshe na 'bras bu ga la 'byung zhes pa'i don no/ /5 mnyam gnas rlung gis dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa'i/ /snyigs ma dwangs ma'i rtsa mig shor ba yis/ /mdangs sgyur mkhris pas zungs khrag ma smin te/ /yun ring mchin gnas dwangs ma ma zhu yin/ /zhes par 'grel gyis/'grel/ zas skom log pas me dang mnyam du 'jug pa'i rlung gi mthu nyams pa las dwangs snyigs ma phyes pa'i snyigs ma yang dwangs ma rgyu ba'i rtsa lam du shor ba mkhris pa mdangs sgyur gyis zungs khrag tu ma smin par yun ring mchin par gnas pas/dwangs ma ma zhu bar gyur pa la dwangs ma ma zhu ba zhes pa'o/ /6 spyir na bad kan lngi rtul bsil ba'i phyir/ /khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba bad kan byed/ /sha lpags rtsa tshigs phyi ru byer ba nyung / /rang gi gnas las gzhan du zhugs pa dkon/ /phal cher ma zhu pho bar rgyas pa'i sa/ /de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin gces pa yin/ /'grel/ spyir na bad kan 'di nyid lci la brtul zhing ngo bo bsil ba'i phyir/khong nad kun gyi rtsa ba thams cad bad kan gyis byed pa la/ sha dang pags pa dang rtsa dang tshigs sogs phyi ru byer ba nyung zhing / bad kan rang gi gnas de las rlung mkhris sogs kyi gnas gzhan du zhugs pa dkon kyang bad kan phal cher ma zhu ba pho bar rgyas 212

sa ste/ de phyir pho ba'i kha 'dzin la shin tu gces par bcos dgos pa yin no/ /7 smug po'i rnam 'gyur bcu gsum zhes pa shod/'grel/ 'phyur pa mgo nad dang 'dra ba dang / gab pa grang ba dang 'dra/ kha yan snying rlung dang 'dra/ byer ba dug dang 'dra/ rgyas pa 'grams pa dang 'dra/ zhud pa tsha grang 'thabs pa dang 'dra/ skyugs pa ma zhu ba dang 'dra/ 'khru ba glang thabs dang 'dra/ 'byams pa skya rbab dang 'dra/ 'dril ba rdo skran dang 'dra/ 'gyings pa dmu chu dang 'dra/ 'grims pa mkhal nad dang 'dra/ ral ba skya rbab dang 'dra ste bcu gsum mo/ /ya nga na/ pho bar bad kan gyi nad/ mchin par khrag gi nad/ rgyu mar mkhris pa'i nad/ long du rlung gi nad/ pags la 'grams pa sha la rgyas pas sa bdag gi nad/ rtsa la byer ba dug gi nad/ tshigs la zhugs pa grum bu'i nad/ mgo la mgo nad/ glo la glo nad/ snying la snying rlung / mcher ba mcher nad/ mkhal mar mkhal nad de bsgrims pas bcu gsum mo/ /8 dwangs ma ma zhu pho bar yun ring gnas/ /rlung gis bsgongs nas rdo skran zhes bya 'gyur/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ dwangs ma ma zhu bar pho bar yun ring du gnas pas bad kan dang grang bas rgyu byas te rlung gis bsgongs nas yang yang g.yogs shing mkhregs la sra bar smin pa de ni dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rdo skran zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ga 2 kha 3 nga 4ka 5 kha 6 ga 7 kha 8 ga9 ka 10 kha 11 ga 12 kha 13 ga 14nga 15 ga16 nga 17 ka 18 ga 19 kha 20 nga 21 ga 22 kha23 kha 24nga 25 ga 26 kha 27 ga 28 nga 29 ga30 nga 31 kha 32 ga 33 ga 34kha 35 ga 36 ga213

sa bcad gnyis pa/ tsha ba gso ba/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 tsha ba'i ring rgyu ni/( )ka nyon mongs/ kha ma rig pa/ ga dug lnga/ nga zhe sdang /2 tsha ba'i nye rgyu ni/( )ka rnam gyur mkhris pa/ kha rnam par ma gyur pa'i mkhris pa/ gnyes gsum/ nga rlung /3 tsha ba'i nad kyi spyi'i dbye ba ni/( )ka lnga/ kha drug ga bdun/ nga bzhi/4g.yal 'dar gnyid yer brtse ba ni/( )ka rlung tshad/ kha mkhris tshad/ ga khrag tshad/ nga 'khrugs tshad/5 phrum ser byed la tshigs gzhi srod dus na ba ni/( )ka rnyogs tshad/ kha gab tshad/ ga rgyas tshad/ nga ma smin tsha ba/6 tsha ba'i ngo bo ni/( )ka me drod thang la lhag pa/ kha nad gzhi mkhris pa/ ga snod mkhris/ nga khrag mkhris/7ma smin tsha ba'i rgyu ni/( )ka rlung / kha khrag mkhris/ ga bad rlung / nga grang rlung /8 zas spyod gnyen po bsten sngas pa las byung ba'i ma smin tsha ba ni/( )ka rkyen gyis ma smin pa/ kha rang bzhin gyis ma smin pa/ ga nad khams kyis ma smin pa/ nga gnas skabs ma smin pa/9 lce steng du rlung 'brum 'byung ba ni/( )215

ka tsha ba spyi khyab kyi rtags/ kha ma smin tsha ba'i rtags/ ga rgyas tshad rtags/ nga stongs tshad kyi rtags/10 ma min tsha ba smin pa'i khyad par gyi rtags ni/( )ka rlung 'brum med par 'gyur/ kha dbang bo g.yung ba/ ga grang shum chad pa/ nga lce mdog dkar ba/11 chang ltar smin par byed pa'i tsha ba/( )ka ma smin tsha ba/ kha 'grams tshad/ ga 'khrugs tshad/ ngarims tshad/12 tsha ba sde drug las kun gyi sngon du 'byung ba ni/( )ka stongs tshad/ kha thor bu rlung / ga rnyogs tshad/ nga ma smin tsha ba/13 rgyas tshad kyi rgyu ni/( )ka me drod mkhris pa/ kha nad gzhi mkhris pa/ ga gnod byed mkhris pa/ nga tsha ba'i ngo bo/14rgyas tshad kyi nad zhes pa 'di ni/( )ka bsdongs zla med pa'i tsha ba rkyang ba/ kha bad rlung bsdongs pa/ gakhrag mkhris gnyis shas che ba/ nga 'dus nad stobs shugs rdzogs pa/15 rgyas tshad gso dpyad kun gyi gtso bo ni/( )ka sbyang bcos/ kha gtar ga ga skyugs/ nga me btsa'/16tsha rlangs phyir bton nas tshad mgo gcog pa la( )bya/ka rjul 'byung / kha bsil dugs/ ga chu yi 'phrul 'khor/ ngachu lcag17khyad par rims rgyas la gtar ga mi bzang( )mchogaka rjul 'don/ kha chu lcag ga me btsa'/ nga dugs/18 stongs tshad gyi rgyu ni/( )ka rlung / kha bad rlung / ga khrag mkhris/ nga nyes gsum/216

19 stongs tshad kyi spyi'i dbye ba ni/( )ka drug kha lnga/ ga bdun/ nga gsum/20 tshad gzhug rlung du log pa ni/( )ka rtsa stongs/ kha rlung stongs/ ga tsha stongs/ nga gnas stongs/21 rlung stongs kyi bcos tshul ni/( )ka 'phrad kha so pa'i bcad pa'i tshul du bcos/ kha smyon pa mal 'jug tshul du bcos/ ga kha drag dpung ba gnya' gnon tshul du bcos/ nga'ajam la zhi ba'i tshul du bcos/22 gab pa'i tsha ba'i rgyu ni/( )ka bad rlung / kha grang rlung / ga mkhris rlung / nga khrag rlung /23 grang rlung gi tsha ba'i mgo byibs pa ni/( )ka ma smin pa/ kha bad kan ri thang mtshams/ ga gab tshad/nga bad rlung /24byer ba kun gyi sna khrid ni/( )ka 'grams tshad/ kha ma smin tsha ba/ ga rlung gyis byer ba/ ngarnyogs tshad/25 tsha ba rnyogs pa'i rgyu ni/( )ka rlung / kha khrag mkhris/ ga chu ser/ nga bad rlung /26 tsha ba'i rkyen gtso bo ni/( )ka sha chang bsten pa/ kha mar gsar/ ga drod bcud bsten pa/nga drod bcud bsten drags pa/27phus 'debs shes pa 'khrul ba ni tsha ba( )la babs pa yin/ka snying / kha rtsa/ ga srog rtsa/ nga klad pa/28 nad khrag dang zungs khrag dbye ba'i thang ni/( )217

ka sle tres chig thang / kha 'bras bu gsum thang / ga 'bras sna gsum thang / nga rus bcud gsum thang /29 snying rtsa seng ba ni/( )ka snying rtsa 'phar grangs zhan pa/ kha grang shum byed pa/ ga khams dwangs pa/ nga snying nad med pa/30 rgyas tshad byung na gnyan pa'i na so ni/( )ka rgan/ kha dar ma/ ga byis pa/ nga bud med/31 rnyings tshad kyi rgyu lo zla lon pa ni/( )ka zla gsum/ kha zla gnyis/ ga zla gcig nga zla bzhi/32 tsha ba'i chu dmar ser 'byung ba ni( )rgyas pa'i rtags yin/ka khrag mkhris/ kha mkhris tshad/ ga khrag rlung / nga khrag tshad/33 tsha ba la 'das ni( )tsha ba yin/ka bad kan/ kha rgyas pa/ ga zungs zad/ nga rlung /34bsil gyis bcos dgos pa'i tsha ba ni/( )ka rgyas tshad/ kha stongs tshad/ ga rlung tshad/ nga zungs zad tsha ba/35rnyogs tshad kyi thog ma'i bcos tshul ni/ ( )ka chu bo rka ru drangs ba/ kha rlan chen bye ma skam pa/ ga thal tshan chu yis gsod pa/ nga 'ol kha bsgyur ba/36 dugs tshad gtar na skyon ci 'byung / ( )ka rnyogs par 'gyur/ kha zungs khrag shor ba/ ga byer te ro mi thon/ nga srog rten chad/37 tsha ba gtar mi rung ba'i nad ni/ ( )ka ma smin tsha ba/ kha rims tshad/ ga rgyas tshad/ nga gnyan tshad/218

38 chu mdog dmar la rgya bshal 'dra ba ni/ ( )ka tsha ba rnyogs pa/ kha grang ba rnyogs pa/ ga 'khrugs tshad/nga rims tshad/39 mi'i lus na lhan skyes su srin bu du yod/ ( )ka rigs bzhi/ kha rigs bdun/ ga rigs lnga/ nga rigs brgyad/40 rgyas tshad ni( )yin/ka rkyang ba'i tsha ba/ kha 'dus pa'i tsha ba/ ga ldan pa'i tsha ba/nga yun lon pa'i tsha ba/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 tsha ba skyed pa'i rgyu ni/( )ka mkhris ba tsha la rno ba/ kha dus gdon/ ga ma rig pa/ ngazas spyod/ ca khrag2 tsha ba nyes pa'i sgo nas dbye na/( )ka rlung mkhris/ kha bad rlung / ga khrag mkhris/ nga chu ser/ca ldan pa/3 tsha ba spyi'i 'phar rtsa ni/( )ka mgyogs/ kha rgyas/ ga grims/ nga myur/ca bying /4rgyud 'dir tsha ba dmigs su bstan pa ni/( )ka tsha ba'i nad dar che ba/ kha 'phrul so che ba/ ga sna mang ba/nga ngos bzung dka' ba/ ca rgyas myur ba/5 'grams tshad nad kyi spyi rtags ni/( )ka gzer zug ldang ba/ kha gdong snum pa/ ga rngam 'degs pa/219

nga mgo na ba/ ca tsha rgyag pa/6rnyogs pa'i tsha ba ni/( )ka rlung / kha mkhris pa/ ga khrag nga chu ser/ca rlung /7 ma smin pa'i slong rkyen ni/( )ka rang bzhin gyi sgo nas ma smin pa/ kha nad khams kyi sgo nas ma smin pa /ga gnas kyi sgo nas ma smin pa/ nga rkyen gyi sgo nas ma smin pa/ ca gdon gyi dbang gis ma smin pa/8 ma smin tsha ba mdor bsdus na dbye ba/( )ka rang nyid smin pa/ kha smin long med pa/ ga smin du mi 'dod pa/ nga rkyen phyi smin pa/ ca ma smin pa/9 gtar du rung ba'i nad khyad par can ni/( )ka 'grams tshad/ kha 'khrugs tshad/ ga khrag gzer/ ngargyas tshad/ ca rlung tshad/10 rgyab gyi nad la khrag rtsa( )gtar na bzang /ka ru thung / kha lgang rtsa/ ga drug mgo nga snod ka cadapral rtsa/11 rtsa stongs dpyad bcos la bsreg pa'i gsang gtso bo ni/( )ka tshigs pa drug bdun/ kha an stong / ga mtshogs gsang /nga sdud sgo/ ca snying ga12 tsha ba rus la zhen pa ni/( )ka 'bras bu gsum/ kha tsha sna gsum/ ga bdud rtsi lnga lums/nga rus snying / ca tig ta/13 skyigs bu bcos la( )bsregaka tshigs pa lnga ba/ kha tshigs pa drug pa/ ga tshigs pa bdun pa/nga tshigs pa brgyad pa/ ca tshigs pa bcu ba/220

14gab tshad kyi gnas ni/( )ka pho ba/ kha srog rtsa/ ga mkhal ma/ nga snying / caglo ba/15 gab tshad la gtar khrag bsten na mi nor ba'i gzer ni/( )ka rnag mkhris chags pa/ kha lcags g.ya' chags pa/ ga mar nag chags pa/ nga dri mnam pa/ ca sbre dri mnam pa/16rnyogs pa'i ngo bo ni/( )ka rlung / kha khrag ga mkhris pa/ nga chu ser/ ca tshil/17 tsha bas tsha ba bcos pa ni/( )ka mkhris pa rtsa rgyug kha rtsa stongs tsha ba/ ga rlung rims/nga rgyas tshad/ ca rlung tshad/18 rtsa stongs dpyad bcos la gtso bo gang dang gang bsreg ( )ka tshigs pa drug bdun/ kha an stong / ga mtshogs gsang /nga sdud sgo/19 dri chu mdog dmar ser 'byung ba ni/ ( )ka khrag 'phel/ kha khrag mkhris/ ga bad rlung / nga rno tsha/20 gsang ba'i sgo nas brtag na ( )la bsten dgos/ka zas dang spyod lam/ kha mtshan nyid/ ga sman/ nga dpyad/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/sdig pa'i tsha ba/ gab pa'i tsha ba'i don/thang las lhag pa/ thang zhes pa tshad de nyid las lhag pa'am mang ba'i don/gtar khrag phyed/ nad khrag dang zungs khrag ma 'dres par dbye ba phyed pa'i don/221

zhar la/ zhor la zhes pa'i don/me nyir snyeg me nyi bsro bar dga' snang byed pa'i don/ri thang mtshams/ ri zad nas thang du ma slebs pa'i mtshams/zhu 'khyags/ dgun dus chu 'khyags nyi 'od tshan mos zhu na'ang slar de grang bas 'khyags pa ltar tsha grang gi mtshams/zos 'grog kha zas zos ma thag pa'i don/skya gleg mdog skya la gleg ces bkrag mdangs nyams pa'i don/skra rtsa seng / skra rtsa 'greng ba'i don/kha yar 'ong / tshad steng du grang rtags 'ong ba'i don/bag la nyal/ lkog gyur du gab nas mi mngon pa'i don/tre tre ho'am par ba ta/ gnyan rims nad kyi nad 'bu zhig la go /ba mo/ zhogs pa rtsa ldebs su chags pa'i chu rdul gyi zil ba/gnyid yer ba/ gnyid mi khug pa dwangs par gyur pa/beg ge sib bi'i nad kyi brda snying /'thab gzhob/ spu sogs me dang 'thab pa'i gzhob dri'i rlangs phog pa'i don/en tsam na/ phran bu na ba'i don/ ral gri sna ma/ brda rnying ste ral gri so gnyis pa'i gzhung 'dra ba'i don/phrum ser/ grang shum rgyag pa'i don/za khu/ dri chen 'khru ba'i nang khrag rtsi 'dres pa'i don/rtsa dang bsdebs/ bshang ba dang bsdebs pa'am 'grogs nas bshal ba'i don/rgyu shun 'ong / rgyu ldeb kyi skyi pags phran mo 'dres nas 'ong 222

ba'i don/bying zhing / lus kun 'thibs shing nyob pa'i don/'tham/ sha skam nas pags rus 'byar ba'i don/'khrugs tshad/ nyes pa 'khrugs pas khrag tshad bskyed nas lus zungs tsha bas bsregs pa'o/ /'jam 'khrugs/ yul rlan can dus dpyid ka rang bzhin bad kan na so byis pa dang / nad khams bad kan gyi mi la 'khrugs byung bas khrag mkhris kyi tsha ba bad kan gyis 'go mnan pa'o/ /rnyogs tshad/ chu ser shas che'i tsha ba bcos rjes dang ma smin tsha ba'i rigs la gnyen po bsten sngas pas rlung khrag chu ser sogs chu mig bye mas rnyogs pa bzhin no/ /gag lhog gnyan nad gre bar babs pa gag pa dang sha la babs pa lhog par bshad/tsha ba stongs pa/ tshad pa'i nad gnya' chogs nas tshad gzhug rlung gis 'bud pa/kun 'khrugs/ ma mo mkha' 'gro de rnams gcig 'khrugs na kun 'khrugs pa dam tshig yin pas kun khro zhing 'khrugs pa/gnyan rims/ 'khyam po dang 'bar 'bur lta bu gzhan la 'go ba'i gnyan rims spyi la bshad/rims smyon/ gnyan nad dang 'doms pa'i rims shigabya 'chor/ rlung nad tshad las shor ba/tsha rgan/ tsha ba rgan po lus su 'gram pa/rang bzhin rnyogs pa/ chu ser shas che ba'i tsha ba rnams bcos pa'i rjes la 223

nad gzhi'i thog tu lhung ba/'khyolas/ 'khrugs pa'am phyi yul za zi 'ong ba/gzer 'gram/ gzer phran nges med 'byung ba/bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1ma smin tsha ba'i rkyen ni bad rlung yin/( )2rang bzhin ma smin pa'i tsha bar bad rlung bsdongs zla yod/( )3 chu mdog dmar ser ni ma smin tsha ba kho na la 'byung /( )4nyi grib mtshams zhes pa bsil drod snyoms pa la go /( )5mig chu dmar la gzer 'dril yod pa ni mkhris tshad yin/( )6drag shul gyi spyod pa ni 'grams tshad kyi rkyen gtso bo yin/( )7rnyings tshad kyi bcos tshul ni sbyangs skems tshul du bcos/( )8 tsha lkugs ni lud pa dmar po thon zhing theng bor lu/( )9 ma smin tsha ba thog ma nyid nas tsha bcos byas na mchog( )10 rgyud du tsha ba'i nad dmigs su bstan pa ni grang nad zhor la shes pas so/ /( )11 'jam 'khrugs ni tshad mgo bad kan gyis mnan pa yin/ ( )12mar rnying dang bu ram ni rgyas tshad kyi zas yin/( )13 gnod bya bcu tsha ba'i drod kyi bsrul bas sreg ces brjod/ ( )14rlung stongs smyon par rang mal du 'jug pa'i tshul du bcos dgos/( )15rnyogs tshad dang 'grams tshad dbye tshul ma 'dra ba las don du gcig( )16'grams tshad kyi rkyen gtso bo ni drag shul gyi spyod pa yin/( )17tsha ba'i gtar khrag sla ba ni mtshan nyid kyi zur 'khru gsher 'phel pas yin/( )224

18 ma smin tsha ba'i rgyu zhes brjod dus don du tsha ba smin du mi 'jug pa bad rlung gi rkyen yin/ ( )19 gab tshad skabs sna khrid nang yan phugs 'chol gsum las nang yan kun pi pi ling yin/ ( )20 pho mkhal snying gsum ni tsha ba gab pa'i gnas yin/ ( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 ci zhig la tsha ba'i nad zer/lan/ nad kyi ngo bo la bltos nas btags pa'i lus kyi drod khams kyi cha shas yongs rdzogs rang gi ldang tshad las lhag cing 'phel bar gyur pa'i nad la zer/2 tsha ba'i nye rgyu rnam par ma gyur pa'i mkhris pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid tshad las lhag pas lus zungs dri ma bcas pa'i gnod bya kun bsreg par phyir tsha ba kun gyi rgyu ni rnam par ma gyur pa'i mkhris pa yin te/ mkhris pa de med par tsha ba'i nad 'byung mi srid pa dang rnam par gyur na nad kyi ngo bo yin pa dang / dper na/ shing la gnas pa'i me khams ni shing rang tshig pa'i rgyu yin pa ltar ro/ /3 tsha ba'i nad skyed byed kyi rkyen ni ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rnam par ma gyur pa'i tha mal du gnas pa'i mkhris pa de 'phel zhing skyed par byed pa'i rkyen bzhi ste dus gdon zas spyod do/ /de dag gis rnam par ma gyur pa'i mkhris pa'i tshad pa dus kyi mes bskyod pa lta bur tshad las 'phel bar byed pa yin/4tsha ba'i ngo bo ni ji ltar yin nam/lan/ de la tsha ba zhes bya'i ngo bo ni/ /mkhris pa'i me drod thang la lhag pa yin/ /ci phyir mkhris pa snum bcas rno zhing tsha/ /yang zhing dri mnam 'khru zhing gsher ba ste/ /thang la lhag pa'i tsha ba'i rtags su 'byung / /zhes dang / tsha ba'i rgyu mtshan gnod bya sreg pa ste/ /gnod bya lus zungs bdun dang dri ma gsum/ /'di dag thal bar bsreg pa ma 225

yin kyang / /tsha ba'i drod kyis bsrul pas srog 'dor byed/ /ces pa'o/ /5 spyir tsha ba la dbye ba rnam pa ga tshod kyi sgo nas bstan yod dam/lan/ rnam pa bdun de rten dang dus dang nyes pa dang gnas sa dang rgyud dang gnas skabs dang rigs kyi dbye ba bcas so/ /6 tsha ba sde drug po gang dag yin nam/lan/ tsha ba ma smin pa dang rgyas tshad/ /stongs tshad dang gab pa'i tshad pa/ /rnyings tshad dang rnyongs tshad do//7 tsha ba'i nad la brtag pa'i thabs rnam pa ga tshod yod dam/lan/ spyir rnam pa gsum ste/ phyi rtags la slong ba'i rgyu dang rkyen gyi sgo nas brtag pa dang / nang rtags de mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa dang / gsang ba'i rtags phan pa dang gnod pa'i sgo nas brtag pa bcas so/ /8 tsha nad gsang ba'i sgo nas ji ltar brtag dgos sam/ lan/ gtso bo zas spyod phan gnod kyi sgo nas brtag te 'phrod na tsha ba yin par nges pa dang / mi 'phrod na grang ba yin par nges pa'i 'dris pa dang goms pa yun tu bsten pa'i nges pa rnyed pa yin no//9 ci'i phyir mkhris pa thang las lhag pa'i tsha ba yin nam/lan/ mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid bdun ldan po tshad las lhag pas gdong snum la de bzhin du rno ba myur du smin pas drod che ba dang / yang bas gnyen pos zlog kha yang ba/dri mnam pas dri che ba dang 'khru bas thur du 'byang zhing brlan pa/ gsher ba 'phel bas gtar khrag dang lud pa sla ba bcas rtags 'di rnams 'byung ba'i phyir rtags tsha bar shes par bya'o/ /10 tshad nad dbye byed kyi thang la rnam pa ga tshodayod dam/lan/ dbye thang rnam pa gsum yin te/ sle tres chig thang gis rlung dang tshad gsar dbye ba 'byed par byed pa dang / skyu ru'i chig thang gis khrag gi nad 'byed par byed/ se 'bru dang ma nu sga skya gsum gyi thang gis bad kan tsha ba 'byed par byed pa'o/ /226

11 tshad nad la bshal bya ba'i sngon 'gro bya ra ji ltar bsgrim dgos sam/lan/ ma smin pa smin par bya ba dang byer na bsdu zhing rlung gi kha gnon pa dang /nad gab pa'i tsha ba mgo spur bshu ba/ me drod nyams pa gso la nad rtse bcil ba/rgyas tshad ma yin pa'i nad rnying ba rnams la sngon 'gro khrus dang bsku mnye rgyud ltar bya dgos pa'o/ /12 tshad nad sbyangs pa'i rjes ji ltar gcod dgos sam/lan/ 'byongs rjes 'bras sam phye thug bcas bsil zas kyis bshal rjes gcod dgos pa dang / de ma yin par rjes la drod bsten na bkru ba'i cho ga bshal rjes snod du dug g.yos pa dang 'dra'o/ /13 tshad pa dpyad bcos la thabs rnam pa ga tshod yod dam/lan/ dpyad bcos la thabs rnam pa drug yod de/ gtar gyis khrag ngan rtsa lam nas sbyang ba dang / rngul bton pas tshad rlangs ba spur dbyung ba/ dugs kyis 'phral gyi zug dang gzer ba bcag pa/ lums kyis tsha ba byer ba gdon pa/ chu lcag gis phyi tshad me dbal bcag pa/ me yis tsha ba'i 'bros 'phrang bsdams pa'o//14tshad nad yin yang gtar mi rung pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ spyir khrag mkhris tsha ba'i nad can yin yang kha cig gtar mi rung te/ ma smin pa'i tshad pa de gtar na rnyogs par 'gyur ba dang / rims rigs gtar na don la 'bab pa/ 'khrugs la sogs pa ngan khrag dang zungs khrag ma phye na nad khrag lus pas tsha ro mi thon pa/ stongs tshad gtar na rlung 'phyo la zug gzer skye ba/gnyan tshad gtar na khrag shul srog rtsar 'jug cing / dug tshad gtar na byer te dug ro mi thon pa/ zungs ngan gyi tshad pa gtar na srog rten chad pa yin pas de dag la gtar bya mi rung ba'o//15tsha ba'i nad la drod bcos byed dgos pa dag gang yin nam/lan/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug pa'i nad 'phros pa'i 'phrang bsdams pa dang / rtsa stongs tsha ba'i lam 'phrang gi kha so bas bcad pa/ tshad gzhug thor bu'i rlung gis 'bud pa de mes mnan pa/ rlung gi rims 'dar yer mal du gzhug pa/ lhog pa'i tsha 227

ba la gnyan thog tu gnyan dbab cing tsha ba'i rjes grang bar log pa'i tshe na pho ba'i me drod gso ba bcas rnam pa drug la tsha nad drod bcos byed dgos pa'o/ /16 rgyud du tsha ba gso ba'i skabs dmigs su bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ de yang tsha ba las nad thebs pa mang zhing sna mang la 'khrul so che ba dang /ngos bzung ba dang bcos pa dka' ba rgyas sla ba dang myur srog 'phrog pa ma zad/ tsha nad 'di shes pas grang nad zhor la shes par 'gyur bas so//17 rgyud du gab grang ma bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ me rlung gyen 'gro'i rang bzhin dang sa chu thur 'gro'i chos nyid kyis me lta bu'i tsha bas grang ba sa chu lta bu gab rgyu ni chos nyid la mi srid pas na 'dir ma bstan no/ / 18 ci zhig la ma smin pa'i tsha ba zer/lan/ bad rlung grang bas tsha ba'i mgo mnan nas tsha ba dus su ma smin pa la zer ro/ /19 ma smin pa'i tsha ba zhes ming btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ thog ma'i tsha bar grang ba'i bsdongs zla dang ma phyed par tsha ba'i nad shugs ma rdzogs shing cher skye ba'i 'phro ma chad pa'i phyir ma smin pa'i tsha ba zhes btags la/ 'di dus tsha ba lus zungs dang dbyer med du 'dres nas nad khrag dang zungs khrag 'o ma dang chu 'dres pa ltar dang yungs dkar gyi mar bzhin tsha ba de lus kun la khyab par gnas so//20 tshad pa smin pa'i rtags gang yin nam/lan/ smin rtags lce steng dkar ser rlung 'brum med/ /rtsa stod rgyug la rtsa smad dma' la grims/ /chu mdog dmar ser ku ya ling gis 'dril/ /bsil 'dod lus la dri 'byung dbang bo g.yung / /khyad par grang shum chad na smin pa ste/ /dper na bud shing zad pa'i me dang 'dra/ /zhes pa'o/ /21 ma smin pa'i tsha bar bya ra bsgrim dgos don ci/lan/ ma smin pa'i tsha ba de tsha ba kun gyi sngon du 'byung ba dang / khyad par 228

rims gyi rigs la shas cher 'byung ba'i dbang gis ma smin pa'i rtags dang gang ldan pa de smin bya gces la smin rtags ma shar gyi bar du bcos dgos pa yin/ de yang smin mgyogs shing legs na tsha ba de choms pa sla la 'tsho ba yang skyen/ gal te bcos nyes na gab rnyings rgyas stong rnyogs par 'gyur bas de dus su bcos ka rnams la bya ra bsgrim dgos so//22 ci zhig la rgyas tshad zer/lan/ rang bzhin na so gnas dang nad khams rnams mkhris par 'dom pa la zas spyod log pa yin pas bad rlung gi grogs dang bral bas nad smin zhing tsha ba'i rang stobs kyi shugs rdzogs shing bsdongs zla med pa'i rkyang ba'i tsha ba de la rgyas tshad zer/23 ri thang mtshams la bya ra bsgrim dgos don ci/lan/ dbyar gyi mtha' mar dgun kha 'byung ba bzhin du tsha ba rgyas pa'i rjes la stongs par 'gyur ba de phyir tsha ba zad nges pa'i ri thang mtshams de la bya ra bsgrim dgos pa yin/24rtsa stongs dang tsha stongs gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ rtsa stongs ni gnas srog rtsa la babs pa'i tshad pa dang / tsha stongs ni tshad pa'i nad gnya' chogs nas tshad gzhug rlung gis bud pa la zer/25 gab tshad kyi ngo bo ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dper na/ thal ba'i nang du sbas pa'i me dang 'dra ste/ grang rlung gnyis kyis tsha ba'i mgo byibs pas bad rlung gi 'og du tshad pa'i rtags bag la nyal nas phyi grang la nang tsha bas na gab pa'i tsha ba'o/ /26 gab pa'i tsha rjes drod kyis bcos dgos don ci/lan/ gab pa'i tsha ba pho mkhal snying gsum po de rnams tsha ba'i rjes drod kyis ma bcos na grang bar ldog par 'gyur ro//27rnyings tshad kyi ngo bo ci ltar yin nam/lan/ tsha ba lo zla 'gor nas lus kyi zungs su 'dres shing zhen pa ste/ dper na/ lcags la btsa' zhugs pa'am ras la snum sun pa de bzhin shing la sra rtsi btang 229

ba dang 'dra bar gting 'don dka' ba'o/ /28 ci zhig la rnyogs tshad zer/lan/ rnyogs tshad ni rlung khrag chu ser gsum 'dus pa'i nad te/ de dag zungs dang 'dres tshul ni/ dper na/ chu mig rnyogs pa'am bye chab g.yos pa dang 'dra'o/ /29 rnyogs tshad kyi bcos tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ de la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi go rim bzhin du bcos dgos ste/ dang po chu ser rang sar skam pa'am rlan che'i rigs bye mas skam pa ltar bcos pa dang /bar du gtar sbyongs sogs kyis chu bo yur ba'i rka ru drangs pa ltar dang / tha mar chu ser lus zungs su bsgyur ba dgra bo gnyen du bzlums pa ltar bcos par bya'o//30 ci zhig la 'grams tshad zer/lan/ zas spyod 'khrugs pa las lus zungs rnams 'grams shing khrag 'khrugs nas mkhris tshad bslang ba'i tshad pa lus la byer zhing 'grams pa'i phyir 'grams kyi tsha ba zhes su brjod pa yin no/ /31 'grams tshad kyi spyi rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ spyi'i rtags su gang 'grams na zhing gzer zug ldang ba dang / rtsa ni phra la grims pa chu mdog dmar la dugs pa dang gdong snum zhing dbugs kyi rngam pa 'degs pa lus kyi bya ba dka' ba dag 'byung ngo //32 'khrugs tshad kyi nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rtsa rgyud sbom drag mkhrang mgyogs dang chu mdog dmar ser dri ma dugs shing rlangs pa che ba ma zad/ khyad par du phrum ser yun thung la gzer zug dza drag che ba dang dgye sgur dka' ba/ dbugs rgod la lud pa'i kha dog dmar ser dud khur 'ong ba bcas byung na 'khrugs tshad yin nges gsal bar shes pa'o//33 gnyan nad ces bya ba'i ngo bo ci/lan/ lus la lhan skyes kyi srin bu khrag gar yod du khyab par gnas pa bdun yod pa de zas spyod gdon gyis 'khrugs shing stobs rgyas pas lus la za zhing khros pa'i 230

dug gis lus zungs ma rungs par byed pa de la gnyan zhes pa'o/ /34'grams tshad spyi'i bcos tshul drug po ni ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tsha 'khrugs mkhris thog babs pa'i phyir zhi ba dang sbyang ba sogs mkhris pa'i sman gyi gnyen pos bcos/ tsha 'grams mkhris tshad rdul la babs pa'i phyir tsha ba rol du bsad la tshad ro de ba spur dbyung bas bcos/ tsha 'grams don lnga gang rung la khrag tshad rgyas pa'i phyir na tsha rlung bsad cing gang babs kyi rtsa nas drangs pas bcos/gnyan gzer chu ser dang dri mar babs pa'i phyir gnyan de gnyen pos gsod cing rjes la sbyangs pas bcos/ stong 'khrugs khrag mkhris rlung gis 'bud pa'i phyir rlung btul zhing mkhris tshad bsad la ro gdon/ 'jam 'khrugs tshad mgo bad kan mnan pa'i phyir 'jam la zhi bas bcos la bad kan rngul du dbyung ba bcas so/ /35 rims nad kyi rgyu rkyen ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dbyar dgun stod dpyid dus bzhi'i 'byung ba dman lhag log pa dang spyod lam drag shul byas pa'i rigs dang / nad de'i nad dri phog pa/ 'byung po'i dug gzer phog zhe sdang drag po skyes te khro zhing 'khrugs pa/ yid gcugs pa dang bral ba sogs mya ngan kyis gdung ba/ kha zas bsil drod ma snyoms pa sogs lus khams dang mi mthun pa bsten pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba 'khrugs te rims su 'gyur ba'o//36 ci'i phyir rims zhes btags pa yin nam/lan/ lus kyi mkhris pa'i me drod 'bar zhing cher bskyed pa ni rims kyi ngo bo ste/ de yang lus la 'bab dus thog mar skyi la gnas pa'i rngul la babs/ de nas bad kan mkhris rlung gsum la rim par 'bab cing / thog mar mig rna sna kha chu so bshang lam spyi dang / khyad par du sna la zhugs nas nad de'i dri ma dngos sam nad yod sa nas du ba rlung sogs dris phog na yams su rim gyis 'gos phyir rims zhes par btags pa yin no//37 rlung rims kyi khyad par nad rtags gang yin nam/lan/ khyad par 'dar bu phrum ser yun ring du 'dar ba dang / yer bu la nyin mtshan du gnyid med cing rtsa rgyud g.yo zhing 'bros tshul ston pa yin no/ /231

38 gnyan rims khyad par gyi rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ khyad par mgor bros klad gzer sna khrag 'dzag pa dang / glor babs ro stod gzer la lud pa ser ba/ mkhal mar babs na mkhal rked na zhing dri chu sdom pa/pho bar babs na kha kha la mkhris pa skyugs pa/ rgyu mar babs na na zug che la tshan can 'khru ba sogs 'byung ba'o//39 ci zhig la 'brum rims zer/lan/ tsha ba chu ser la babs nas lus kun khyab cing khyad par 'brum pa rnams rus pa dang rkang dang lha ba'i gting sogs thams cad nas skye bar byed cing / lus zungs thams cad du rdzogs par khyab nas thor bu 'ong bas na 'brum rims zhes so//40 'brum rims kyi nad rtags sam 'byung tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ khyad par ma smin pa'i mngon tshul du mgo bo na zhing glo snying 'phar ba dang / lus kyi sha mdangs la thug cing lus kun brtse ba'i nyams byed pa/ mkhris khu skyugs cing rus rkang 'chag snyam byed pa bcas mthar 'brum thor phyir thon pa'i skabs la bde snyam byed pa'o//41 sib bi'i nad kyi rgyu ni ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni rims nad spyi dang 'dra ba yin la khyad par gyi rgyu ni lus la gnas pa'i chu ser dang khrag la gnyan tshad babs pa yin/42 ci zhig la sib bi'i nad zer/lan/ nad dug rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'gos khyab myur la dgun dpyid kyi dus la byis pa'i lus kyi stod smad kun la 'brum pa dmar leb chung ngus bag la khyab par 'gyur ba'i phyir sib bi zer/43 sib bi'i nad kyi khyad par kyi rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ khyad par du mig skyag mang zhing mig rtsa dmar po chags pa dang / zas skom mid dka' ba/ skad 'dzer la thog mar rkan phug dang kha yi nang 'gram gre ldebs sogs la thor ba skya sib 'byung ba dang / de nas rim bzhin rna rgyab dang mchan 'og ske mjing sogs lus kun la thor ba dmar zhib kyis khyab par 'gyur ba'o//232

44sib bi'i nad gso ba'i tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ nad 'di phog nas sib thor mi don pa'i bar du sman dpyad bsil rtsub rigs bsten pa dang / lus la dro bcos kyis 'brum pa myur du don thabs byed dgos/de yang thog mar zas skom yang zhing 'ju sla'i rigs bsten la/ bar du thang rigs bsten nas sib thor lus kun la khyab par 'don/ mthar nad bab dang bstun nas gnyan tshad gcog rjes lus stobs gso dgos pa'o//45 rgyu gzer nad kyi mtshan nyid ci ltar yin nam/lan/ mchin pa'i khrag tshad thur du babs pa la gnyan nad kyis chu ser dang mkhris tshad rnams bslangs nas rgyu ma gzer zhing 'khru bas na rgyu gzer zhes bya'o//46 rgyu gzer nad kyi mngon tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ 'khru dus rgyu mar zug gzer che ba dang / 'khru bongs chung zhing yang yang 'khru ba/ 'khru mdog dmar ser ram za khu 'byung ba/ mtshams rer be snabs 'dra ba mdog dmar smug 'khru ba'am yang na khrag dang dud khu bshal ba/ rtsa grangs myur la grims shing rtsa smad zhan pa dang / chu mdog dmar ser rtsa dang bsdebs nas 'byung ba'o//47don 'khru dang snod 'khru gnyis kyi khyad par ci ltar yin nam/lan/ de la don 'khru zug gzer che la 'khru bongs chung ba dang 'khru mdog dud khu 'dra zhing dri ma dugs pa/ snod 'khru mdog dmar ser dang za khu be snabs 'khru ba dang 'khru ba'i dri dang rtsa chur tsha rtags chung ba'o//48 gag pa'i nad so so mi nor ba'i khyad par gyi rtags gang yin nam/lan/ pho gag 'brum pa che la mdog skya sob skar chen shar ba dang 'dra ba/ mo gag ni 'brum pa'i mdog dmar la che ba dbyibs rgya phor kha sbub lta bu 'byung ba/ bu gag ni 'brum mdog dkar la sib sib zho gtor ba dang 'dra ba/ gnyan gag ni 'brum par ral gri sna ma'i gzhung dang 'dra ba'o/ /49 cham rims kyi rgyu ni ji ltar yin nam/lan/ khyad par mi gtsang ba'i kha zas dang spyod lam log pa 'dres pa'i sna bug 233

g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kha thur du bltas shing zangs dung lta bur gdangs pa der mi gtsang ba'i du 'tshub dang / thal rdul sogs phog pa'i rkyen las rtsa de nyid cham la phab nas 'gos khyab byung phyir cham pa zhes su btags/50 glo cham dus su bcos ka ma byung ba'i nyes pa ci/lan/ glo cham de thog mar gre ba tsha zhing skad 'dzer ba dang / bar du glo mang la mgo dang brang rgyab na ba/ tha ma lud pa rnag tu lu zhing glo gcong du 'gyur ba'o/ /51 ci zhig la gnyan nad klad gzer zer/lan/ ngo bo gnyan nad spyi dang 'dra la khyad par du gnyan rims kyi nad de nyid mgo bor babs nas klad par gnyan tshad rgyas pas gzer drag tu gtong ba dang 'phel tshul myur zhing 'gos khyab shin tu che ba ma zad/ dgun dpyid dus su na ba mang zhing srog kyang 'phrog sla bas klad gzer zhes so//52gnyan nad klad gzer dus su bcos skyed ma byung na 'bras bu ci 'byung ngam/lan/ nad 'dir dus thog tu bcos ma thub na dbang bo nyams pa dang yan lag zha ba ma zad/ da dung srog kyang shor nyen che ba'i phyir do snang byed dgos so/ /53 gnyan nad stod gzer gyi srung ba'i thabs ci/lan/ ga bur dang mu zi lan tshwa gu gul sogs legs par sbyar ba snying ga'i thad kyi gong ba g.yon la 'dogs par bya/54mkhris pa rtsa rgyug babs gnas las so sor mi 'gyur ba'i rtags ci yod dam/lan/ de yang mgor bros na klad pa gzer zhing sna khrag 'dzag pa dang / glor babs na ro stod gzer dang lud pa ser po lu ba/ mkhal mar babs na mkhal rked na zhing dri chu sdom pa/ pho bar babs na kha kha ba dang mkhris khu skyug pa/ rgyu mar babs na zug che la bungs cher 'khru ba sogs 'byung ba dag las so sor mi 'gyur ro//55 tsha grang gal mdo la bslab dgos don ci/lan/ spyir nad gzhi dbye ba dpag med kyang mdor ru bsdus na tsha ba dang grang ba gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i nad med de/ de yang tsha grang nor bar bcos pa tsha ba grang bar bzung nas drod kyis bcos pa dang / grang ba la tsha bar bzung nas bsil gyis 234

bcos pa na rang bzhin gyi 'tsho ba'i rten srog thams cad 'gag nas 'chi nyen che ba'i phyir ro//56 ci 'dra zhig la tsha grang gal mdo zer/lan/ gnad 'gag phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i thabs la 'khrul gzhi bsal ba tsha grang gal mdo zhes bya'o//57 tsha grang gnyis 'khrul gzhi'i gnad 'gag gang dag yin nam/lan/ spyir gnad 'gag la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ de yang phyi nang rtags dang nad kyi ngo bo gnyis ka tsha ba dang / phyi nang gi rtags dang ngo bo gnyis ka grang ba/ phyi nang sogs kyi rtags tsha bar ston yang don nad kyi ngo bo grang bar gnas pa/ nad kyi ngo bo tsha bar gnas kyang phyi nang gi rtags sogs grang bar ston par 'byung ba bcas so//58 nad gzhi'i rtags thabs bcu bo gang dag yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen yul dus rang bzhin na tshod dang / gnas sa nyin zhag zas zos goms pa chu bcas bcu bo'i tsha grang 'khrul med du brtag dgos/59 ltar snang lnga phrugs gang dag yin nam/lan/ rtags kyi ltar snang 'khrul so/ bcos thabs kyi ltar snang 'khrul so/goms pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so/ bcos skyed kyi ltar snang 'khrul so/ chu mdog ltar snang 'khrul so bcas so//60 ltar snang so so'i sel tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ nad gzhi'i ltar snang 'khrul so rtags kyis bsal/ /rtags kyi ltar snang 'khrul so bcos kyis bsal/ /bcos kyi ltar snang 'khrul so goms pas bsal/ /goms pa'i ltar snang 'khrul so skyed kyis bsal/ /bcos skyed ltar snang 'khrul so chu yis bsal/ /chu yi ltar snang 'khrul so ku yas bsal pa'o/ /235

drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 pho ba'i me gso tshad pa'i lhag ma 'don//zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ de yang tha mar tshad pa'i gzhung ma thon par ro ma lus pa zas spyod sogs rkyen dang 'phrad pa na me stag dang spra ba phrad pa dang 'dra ste/ skad cig la cher mched pa de'i phyir gi wang dang tsan dan dkar po dang cu gang gur kum li shi ste bsil gsum dang / shing mngar dang rgun 'brum dang dzā ti dang / pi pi ling dang / se 'bru dang / shing tsha dang / ka ra rnams sbyar bas pho ba'i me drod gso la gong gi bsil sman rnams kyis tsha ba lhag ma 'don par byed dgos zhes pa'o//2 rims tshad dang po ma smin snyan gsan 'bebs/ /bar du tsha ba smin rgyas gzhi la gnon//tha mar gzhug rgyas thor bu'i zhabs tog byed//zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ rims tshad la dang po ma smin par snga dron tshud pa mgron la snyan gsan 'bebs pa ltar bya/ bar du tsha ba smin zhing rgyas pa'i tshe gzhi bzung ba dang / tha ma mgron la zhabs tog byed pa ltar bcos dgos so/ /3dri ba'i tsha ba nad rnams kun gyi gtso bo yin pa'i rgyu mtshan shod/'grel/ nad gzhi'i rnams grangs sam dbye ba dpag du med pa kun kyang mdo ru bsdus na tsha ba'i nad dang grang ba'i nad gnyis las mi 'da' bas na/ de'i phyir tsha ba'i nad de ni dar mang ba ste nad des thebs pa mang ba dang / nad sna mang zhing nad kyi ngo bo mi brtan pa dang nad gzhan dang 'khrul so che ba/ don snod bar rus rkang sogs la rgyas sla bas na 'gro ba'i tshe srog myur tu 'phrog par byed pa phal che ba ni tsha ba'i nad dang gnyan rims kyi nad ma gtogs nad gzhan cher mi 'byung bas na/de'i phyir nad rnams kun gyi nang nas gtso bo ru bshad pa yin/bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 nga 2 kha 3 ga 4ka 5 nga 6 ka 7 ga 8 ka236

9 kha 10ga 11 nga 12 nga 13 ga 14ka 15 kha16 nga 17 ka 18 ka 19 nga 20 kha 21 kha 22 kha23 ga 24ga 25 ga 26 nga 27 ga 28 kha 29 ga30 kha 31 ga 32 ka 33 ga 34ka 35 kha 36 ga37 ga 38 ka 39 kha 40 kaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 kha nga 2 kha ga nga 3 ka kha ga 4ka kha ga nga 5 ka kha ga 6ka ga nga 7 kha nga 8 ka kha ga 9 ka kha ga 10 kha ga 11 kakha 12 ga nga 13 kha ga 14ka ga nga 15 ka kha 16 ka kha nga17 ka kha ga 18 ka kha 19 kha nga 20 ka ga ngabazhi ba/ dag ba ngos 'dzin/1 ྾ 2 tsu 3 ྾ 4྾ 5 ྾ 6tsu 7 ྾ 8྾ 9 ྾ 10 tsu 11 du 12 ྾ 13 tsu 14du15 ྾ 16tsu 17 18 19 tsu 20 tsus bcad gsum pa/ lus stod gso ba/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 mgo bo'i nad kyi dbye ba la/( )ka gtso bo brgyad dang phal ba drug kha bcu/ ga brgyad/nga dgu/2 rims dang 'dra ba'i mgo nad ni/( )ka rlung / kha khrag ga mkhris pa/ nga srin/3 mig nad bye brag tu dbye na/( )237

ka nyi shu/ kha sum cu rtsa gsum/ ga sum cu tham pa/ ngabaco lnga/4mig nad chu 'khrugs ni/( )ka mtsho gnyis 'dres pa las byung / kha rgyal mo'i rtsa mdangs nyams pa las byung / ga khrag las byung / nga rlung nus nyams pa las byung /5sna khrag phal che ba ni/( )ka 'du ba 'khrugs pa las byung / kha rlung las byung / ga khrag 'phel ba las byung / nga mkhris pa las byung /6wa ba skyugs dang rtsub bcos byed dgos pa ni/( )ka bad rlung / kha rlung khrag ga bad tshil/ nga ldan pa'i nad/7tsan dan dkar dmar lde gu phyis nas byug dgos pa'i so nad ni/( )ka rlung / kha khrag mkhris/ ga bad kan/ nga srin nad/8 sho re'i rtags la gtso bo ni/( )ka 'brum thor/ kha skya tshos/ ga mchu gas/ nga glang shu/9 mig nad skam tshag ni/( )ka bad rlung las gyur/ kha bad mkhris las gyur/ ga khrag mkhris las gyur/ nga rlung mkhris las gyur/10 gre nad rmen bu'i rtags su/( )ka rna ba 'grams pa gzer/ kha sra la zug chung / ga sra la zug che/nga so 'grams na/11 mchu nad kyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/( )ka gcen/ kha rus sbal/ ga lce 'dra/ nga lcung mo 'dra ba/12 rkan men la gtar mang gdab ces pa'i gtar rtsa ni/( )ka rkan gyi 'dom rtsa/ kha 'gram rtsa/ ga rtse chung / nga snod ka13 zas spyod tsha grang gang yang gnod pa'i so nad ni/( )238

ka so 'bras/ kha rlung / ga srin/ nga mkhris nad/14rlung mkhris las gyur pa'i mgo nad ni/( )ka rlung ltar gso/ kha mkhris pa ltar gso/ ga gnyis ka ldan par gso/ nga bad kan ltar gso/15phyi 'grib kyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/( )ka sha 'dzer/ kha srod long / ga rtsa mdangs nyams pa/ ngaling thog16tsan dan dkar dmar gyi lde gu phyi nas byug dgos pa'i so nad ni/( )ka khrag mkhris/ kha bad mkhris/ ga khrag rlung / nga rlung gyur/17ra mchin dmar pos sel ba'i mig nad ni/( )ka sha 'dzer/ kha ling ro/ ga srod long / nga bar 'grib/18 mgo nad khrag gyur gyi nad rtags gtso bo ni/( )ka mgo bo lci ba/ kha rtse chung rgyangs pa/ ga skyug snyam byed pa/nga lus drod che ba19 gre nad la dbye ba/( )ka drug kha gnyis/ ga brgyad/ nga bdun/20 bad kan las gyur pa'i so nad gyi rtags gtso bo ni/( )ka rnyil rul ba/ kha yi ga 'chus pa/ ga rnyil 'drul dri mi zhim/nga za 'phrug byed pa/21 rna nad mkhris gyur gyi nad rtags gtso bo ni/( )ka zug che ba/ kha mgo na ba/ ga chu ser 'dzag la 'brum thor 'byung / nga za 'phrug 'ong ba/22sna khrag ser la sla ba byung sa'i gnas ni/( )ka sne sa bzhi/ kha rtsa kha bye ba/ ga klad pa/ nga glo bur ba/23 mgo nad khrag gyur la thog mar gtong ba'i thang ni/( )239

ka mgo thang gsum pa/ kha 'bras bu sum thang / ga ma rnu bzhi thang / nga 'bras bu bdun thang /24mig nad nang 'grib kyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/( )ka sha lhag kha sngo rib/ ga ling tog nga mig nad chu 'khrugs/25mig nad kyi dbye ba lnga ni/ ( )ka rlung mkhris khrag bad kan srin bcas lnga/ kha sha lhag sha 'dzer/rtsa dra/ sngo rib/ ling ros khebs pa lnga/ ga mig chu'i nad/ mig tshagaling thog rab rib/ 'gribs bcas lnga/ nga rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa bzhi/26klad srin ya ma mgo gtso bo gang la brten nas skyed pa yin/ ( )ka rlung / kha mkhris/ ga khrag mkhris/ nga srin bu/27mig gi dbus ni( )yin/ka rus pa'i khyim/ kha tshil pa'i khyim/ ga chu'i khyim/ ngargyal mo'i khyim/28 mig nad nang 'grib kyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/ ( )ka rtsa mdangs nyams pa/ kha long ros khebs pa/ ga sha lhagang srod long /29 gsal byed dgu ba'i lde gu ni gsal byed bdun pa'i steng / ( )ka ldong ros ba bla bsnan pa/ kha bdud rtsi lcags sbrul bsnan pa/ gshu dag ru rta bsnan pa/ nga skyer ba gur gum bsnan pa/30 dmar la nag pa'i sna khrag de( )'dzag pa yin/ka sne bzhi/ kha klad pa/ ga rtsa kha bye ba/ nga rtse chung /240

gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 mgo nad kyi rgyu rkyen ni/( )ka rlung 'tshub/ kha tsha skyur zas/ ga mang smras/ nga ngu drag pa/ ca gnyid log2sna khrag 'dzag pa'i rigs gsum ni/( )ka dmar la dwangs pa klad pa las byung / kha ser la sla ba klad pa las byung / ga smug nag sne bzhi las babs/ nga dmar nag rtsa kha bye ba yin/ ca dmar la dwangs pa rtsa kha bye ba/3 rgyal mo chu 'byed kyi sbyor ba'i sman sna ni/( )ka a ru/ kha ga bur/ ga rgya skyegs/ nga bul tog cargya tshwa/4mig 'grib kyi khongs su gtogs pa ni/( )ka srod long / kha sha lhag ga ling thog nga rab rib/ca sngo rib/5mgo rus dum bu nyer dgu ni/( ) 6ka dpral rus dum bu drug kha gdong rus dum bu bco lnga/ garna rus dum bu drug nga klad rus dum bu brgyad/ ca sna rus dum bu brgyad/6rna rus dum bu drug ni/( )ka thod rus gnyis/ kha gshol rus gnyis/ ga zam rus gnyis/nga rna ltag gnyis/ ca yob rus gnyis/7rkan nad kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i nad ni/( )ka lce chung / kha rus sbal/ ga gcen nad/ nga chu bur/ca 'bras/8 mig 'grib zas kyis gso ba la ni/( )241

ka lug sha kha nya sha ga phag sha nga chang / ca sgo nga /9 kha nad dbye ba drug ni/( )ka mchu gre/ kha sho re gre mchu/ ga so lce/ nga rkan/ cakha shu/10 mig nad tsha ba la gnod pa'i kha zas gtso bo ni/( )ka skyur rigs/ kha sgog btsong / ga ja gar/ nga 'o ma dron mo/ ca sngo tshod/11 mgo nad khrag gyur gyi nad rtags gtso bo ni/( )ka rtse chung rgyangs pa/ kha grang na bde ba/ ga drag shul gnod pa/nga mur 'gram gzer/ ca tsha na bde ba/12 mig nad long tog 'byung ba'i gnas gtso bo ni/ ( )ka gra mtshams/ kha mig sprin/ ga 'bras bu dkar nag ngamig lcibs/ ca rgyal mo/13 mig gi gra mtshams su 'byung ba'i nad rigs ni/ ( )ka rab rib/ kha mig 'bras/ ga mig tshag nga long togaca phyi 'grib/14mig nad gsar ba'i dus su khrag shas che na( )gtar/ka gser mdung / kha dpral rtsa/ ga mig rtsa/ nga sna rtse/ca rtse chung /15 dbang lnga las rna ba'i byed las/ ( )ldan/ka dag gtsang / kha drod tshad snyoms pa/ ga rlan gsher gyi cha 'dzin pa/ nga sgra 'byin pa/ ca dri snom pa/16 gdung ba'i mig nad khrag las gyur tshe/ ( )ka reg mi bzod pa/ kha dngos po dmar por mthong ba/ ga rnag 'drul ba/ nga rngul gyis gang snyam/ ca g.yal zhing skrangs pa/17mig nad ci las gyur kyang 'phral du zug gzer gcog thub pa'i sman/242

( )ka ldong ros/ kha mdung rtsi/ ga tsan dan dkar bo/ nga zhu mkhan/ ca shing mngar/18 rna ba 'on pa'i rigs bzhi ni/ ( )ka sgra bcas 'on pa/ kha rna spabs sogs 'gags nas 'on pa/ gaskam 'on/ nga ma rlung shor/ ca sngon las/19 sna khrag gi rgyu phal cher khrag 'phel ba las 'byung bas na( )bya/ka chu'i bsgreng / kha rtse chung gtar/ ga chu'i 'ol kha bsgyur/nga me btsa'/ ca dugs/ 20 rnyil nad kyi rtags/( )ka za 'phrug byed/ kha rnyil 'drub ba/ ga khrag rnag 'dzagang lhang lhang du gzer ba/ ca ldang dub byed pa/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/nam tshong / sgrog rus nas gre ba'i bar gyi spyi ming ngo / /mtsho gnyis 'dres/ chu mtsho dang mthong byed 'dres nas nag ram tu gyur pa la zer/lo shur/ sran ma gtso'i lo ma'i rigs shur ba ste rnying ba'i tshod ma/red dang ma red/ nyen kha che ba dang nyen kha med pa'am chung ba zhes pa'i don/spubs ma/ smyug ma dang rngabs rwa khong stong can la'o/ /sha lu/ snar byung ba'i 'bras kyi ming /kha shu/ mchu la shu ba chags par kha shu zer/sne bzhi/ mchan khung gnyis dang brla khug gnyis te bzhi/mig zhu/ rgyal mo 'dal ba'am rim bzhin cher phyin pa'i don/phyi 'grib/ mig gi rgyal mo'i steng du sha 'dzer sogs kyis khebs pa/mig rengs/ mig gi mthong byed kyi dbang rtsa'i bya ba nyams nas 243

mig 'dzum mi shes par gyur pa'i don/rtsa rgyangs/ ljon shing dang mur rtsa sogs rgyangs pa'am khebs pa ste rgyas pa'o//skam tshag bad rlung las gyur pa'i mig nad zhigagasher tshag khrag mkhris las gyur pa'i mig nad zhigadar yos/ gos chen sne tshar can/rna gshog sgra rlabs bsdu ba'i nus pa ldan pa'i rna'i dbang bo'i cha shas la'o//rna 'khyil/ nang du nyan byed tshor snang dbang bo yod pa dbyibs dung g.yas 'khyil dang 'dra ba zhig go /gcod sman/ skabs 'dir rgya tshwa dang rgyam tshwa la go/sgra ngan/ so skye ba'i tshe ma'i nad las byung ba'i byis pa'i mig nad zhigaglogs pa/ mgo bo'i skra gseb nas don pa'i skyi pags dkar zhib can gyi ming /ko ler/ lus kyi gnas nges med kyi gnas su na zug glo bur du ldang ba'i ming /sbrang smyon/ dug can sbrang bus bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi dug dang ldan pa de'i ming yin/dar ye/ smyug ma phra mor gzhogs pa sor bzhi ba la dar seng gis dkris pa la zer/'dzib bu ka byang gi bul tog gi ming /sna bsubs/ sna 'tshubs pa ste sna 'gag pa'i don/men pa 'khrigs/ rma sos pa'am rma kha 'byor ba'i don/rag dud/ ra gan mer bzhu ba'am mer bsregs pa'i thabs bya ba la zer/nang 'grib/ mig gi 'bras bu'i chu 'khrugs pa/244

bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 skye 'gag skye 'bri che ba tshil wa yin/( )2sna khrag dmar la dwangs pa klad pa las byung /( )3 sna la 'bras byung sna nad sha lu yin/( )4sha 'dzer gsar dus khrag mkhris lta bur bcos/( )5mig nad gso ba'i man ngag chu lcag byed rgyu de yin/( )6mig nad gsher tshags ni bad rlung las gyur/( )7bad mkhris ldan pa'i mgo nad rlung gyur ltar gso/( )8 gre nad kun la srin lag g.yon gyi tshigs bar 'og ngos bsreg ( )9 gcong nad ces pa gre ba'i nad kyi nang bsres yin/( )10 mig sprin ser bo 'byung ba ni rgyun spyod log pa kho na las byung /( )11 mgo nad du rtse chung rgyangs pa sogs yod/( )12mig chu rlung gyur mchi ma 'dzag cing rdul gyis gang snyam sems la 'dzum par dka' ba bcas yod/( )13mig nad nang 'grib la mig nang gi chu 'khrugs pa dang mthong byed kyi rtsa mdangs nyams pa gnyis yod/( )14mig nad bar 'grib la rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa las gyur pa bzhi yod/( )15mig nad skam tshag ni bad rlung las gyur ba'i mig lcibs kyi nang du phog pa'i nad zhig yin/( )16bar 'gribs mig nad gzhan gyis mi sel ba'i dpyad mchog ni thur ma yin/( )17cham tshad sogs dus su bcos ma thub pa las tshad ro rdzong la bros te rnag 'dzag pa yin/( )18snang ngor chu'i bshang sgra dang rnga sgra lta bu'i sgra 'byung ba ni 'on pa sgra med spyi 245

rtags yin/( )19drod byugs byas na bde zhing stong snyom sems dang mgo'i gzhogs phyed na ba bcas ni rna nad rnag byung gi rtags yin/( )20skra dkar nad la lug ru ser po nus ldan bsregs pa'i thal ba la yungs dkar dang sbyar nas byug na phan/( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 lus stod ces pa gang la zer ram/lan/ nam tshong yan lus kyi stod char gnas pa'i mgo la lus stod zer zhing der mig sogs dbang bo khag tshud yod/2mgo srin skabs dkar nag mkhar gong bsregs te brtag tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ bsregs rjes grang nas mdog nag por song nas ya ma nag po dang mdog ma log par bsdad na ya ma dkar po'i rtags yin no/ /3 mig sprin ser bor 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mig sprin ser 'gyur la rgyu mtshan gnyis yod de/ gcig ni mchin mkhris kyi nad las snod mkhris sogs kyi rgyun srang 'gags pa las mig sprin ser bor gyur pa dang / cig shos ni rgyun spyod log pa ste rlung 'tshub sogs su 'dug yun ring ba las mig sprin ser bor gyur pa yod par gso bcos bya mi dgos/4mig nad bar 'grib zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mig gi shun pa dang mig 'bras bar nas rgyal mo'i steng du 'grib byed be snabs dkar bo shor te 'grib par 'gyur bas bar 'grib zer/5mig nad nang 'grib ci ltar byung ba yin nam/lan/ mig nad nang 'grib can ni mig 'bras nang gi gnon shugs 'phel ba las byung ba ste/ de ni khang chu rgyun ldan ltar 'khor skyod byed ma thub par 'gag pa 246

las mig 'bras nang gi gnon shugs 'phel nas na zug che zhing long bor 'gyur nyen che ba'i mig nad cig go/6mig nad dpyad kyis bcos tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung gyur la snum 'chos dang / mkhris par sbyong / bad kan la skyugs/khrag la gtar ba bcas kyi sgo nas bca' dgos/7ling 'grib kyi rgyu mtshan dang gso bcos bya tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mig nad ling 'grib can ni mig 'bras nang gi dwangs gsal gzugs can mi gsal bar gyur pa las byung ba dang / gzugs dngos ci yang mi mthong bar gyur tshe gshags bcos byas te mis bzos dwangs gsal gzugs can sprad na legs/8 rna ba'i chags dbyibs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ ji skad du/ rna ba mkhal ma'i rtsa dang 'brel/ /lpags min chu min khyad par byas/ /rna lhan rus pas khyad byas te/ /chu ba rgyus pa klad par 'brel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rna ba ni phyi bar nang rna gsum las grub cing / phyi rna ni rna gshog dang / rna ba'i bu ga rnga pags gsum/ rna bug gi phugs su mnyen zhing sra ba'i skyi pags srab mo zhig yod pa der rnga skyi zer/ rnga skyi'i rgyab kyi stong cha la rnga shag zer/ rnga shag tu rus pa chung chung gsum phan tshun 'brel yod pa sogs la bar rna zer/ rnga skyi la sgra rlabs kyis 'gul shugs thebs te sgra len rus pa brgyud g.yo 'gul thebs pa red/ nang rna'i cha shas rnams ni sgra len dang tshor shes kyi nus pa thon par ma zad/da dung lus khams do snyoms po byed pa'i nus pa'ang thon gyin yod/9 bad rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad kyi rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ bad rlung mgo nad lci 'khyoms zas mi zhim/ /rna ba 'ur zhing 'on la dran mi gsal/ /mgo bo 'khor zhing 'thoms la 'gyel bar 'gyur//zhes pa'o//10 khrag mkhris las gyur pa'i mgo nad kyi rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ khrag rtsa rtse chung rgyangs la mur 'gram 'khyug /mgo lci chang dang drag shul nyin mtshan gnod/ /mkhris gyur rims 'dra mgo lus mig rnams tsha/ /kha kha mkhris pa skyug snyam grang na bde/ /zhes pa'o/ / 247

11 mig nad gsher tshag gi bcos thabs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ skyer ba'i khaṇ+ḍa chu gtsang la sbangs pa'i dwangs ma mig nang yang yang gtigs pa dang / yang na rang byung spang ma dang / thing ga skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ li gri/ dom mkhris bcas lnga nu zho dang sbyar ba byugs pa/ khong du spang khrag bcu gnyis dang / bya khud bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ rdo khrag skyu ru nyer lnga sogs gtong ba dang / tshabs che'i rigs la dpral rtsa dang mig rtsa sna rtse gtar bar bya zhing / zas spyod chang dang ja gar po skyur rigs sgog tsong dang / me nyi bsro ba/ thal rlung gi khrod du 'gro sdod byed pa/'khrugs las drag po sogs la 'dzem dgos/12 mig nad skam tshag gi bcos thabs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ spos rengs dang skyer ba'i khaṇ+ḍa chu gtsang nang spangs pa'i dwangs ma mig nang gtigs pa/ khong du gsal byed a wa bco lnga sogs gsal byed rigs dang /rdo rje rab 'joms/ gur khyung / spang rgyan bco lnga/ bdud rtsi bcu gcig a gar so lnga dang bco lnga sogs gtong ba/ zas spyod tsha skyur dang sha rul/ sngo ngad/ ja gar po sogs la 'dzem pa/ 'od dang / du ba/ rlung bser bu sogs la gzab nan bya dgos so/ /13 so nad spyi'i bcos thabs ni ci ltar yin nam/lan/ sgog skya dang / shing kun/ thang khrom 'bru rnams dar la btums mar la btsos pa so bar bsten pa dang / yang na sgog skya'i me btsa' zhes pa gang na ngos kyi lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs kyi phyi ngos su rus mgo gnyis kyi bar du sgog skya gcig skyes dang btsan dug gnyis zhib btags byas pa kham tshig phyed ka'i nang blug la kha spus/lham sgrog gis bsdams la na zug ma chag ba'i 'jog pa/ yang na thang phrom dang byi tang ga ma ru rtse/ sgog skya bcas rlung ldan la khyung lngar bsnan zhing khrag ldan la sprang rtsi bcu gnyis steng bsnan pa/ yang na gur khyung la bsnan pa sogs nad dang bstun nas gtong dgos so/ /14mig chu rlung gyur dang mkhris gyur gnyis kyi mi nor ba'i nad rtags gtso bo ni ji ltar yin nam/248

lan/ de rtags mig chu'i nad las rlung gyur pa/ /mchi ma 'dzag cing rdul gyis gang snyam sems/ /'dzum par dka' dang dus med 'byed 'dzum byed/ /chu dang bad kan khrag rnag gra mtshams 'dzag /mkhris gyur tsha dmar 'drul zhing 'brum phran khyab/ /g.ya' zhing skrangs la chu ser rnag bcas 'dzag/ces pa'o// 15sna khrag dmar dwangs dang dmar nag 'dzag pa gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ sna khrag dmar dwangs ni rtsa kha bye ba las byung ba dang dmar nag ni sne sa bzhi las byung ba yin/16lce lhag 'byung na dpyad ci zhig bya dgos sam/lan/ lce lhag phyed bcad lcags bsreg thal sman gdab pa'o/ /17mkhris gyur wa ba dang khrag gyur wa ba gnyis kyi mi nor ba'i gzer ci/lan/ mkhris pa'i wa ba phur tshe chung la snyi/ /khrag wa drod bcud drag shul rkyen gyis skye/ /zhes pa'o/ /18 ci zhig la dbang bo zer/lan/ gzugs 'dzin mig dang sgra 'dzin rna/ /dri 'dzin sna dang ro 'dzin lce/ /reg 'dzin lus bcas so so'i yul/ /'dzin pas dbang lnga zhes zer te/ /dper na mig gis gzugs ma gtogs/ /thos snom myong reg mi dbang ltar/ /rang rang yul la dbang byed pas/ /de la dbang lnga zhes su bshad pa'o//drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 sos tshad nyi ma gza' las thar ba bzhin/ /phra rags gzugs rnams 'phral du gsal ba yin/ /'o ltar bo na de dus mi gsal yang / /nad chu dwangs nas ga ler phyi nas gsal/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ sos tshad nyi ma gza' las thar ba bzhin phra rags gzugs rnams mtshon byed dang po mi'i gzugs/ de nas lag pa/ de nas sor mo lta bur rim bzhin gsal zhing mthong ba yin la/ 'o ltar bo na ni sgrib byed 'o rkyal 'dra ba dar ral ba ste 249

de dus mi gsal yang nad chu dwangs nas rim bzhin gsal bor 'ong bas shugs la gso bcos kyang mu mthud du bya dgos zhes pa'i don/2 klad pa'i dbang rtsa bcu gnyis po'i grangs rtsis shiga'agrel/ klad pa'i dbang rtsa bcu gnyis po 'di lta ste/ de yang sna dang 'brel ba'i snom byed dbang rtsa gnyis/ mig gi dra skyi dang 'brel ba'i mthong byed dbang rtsa gnyis/mig ril dang 'brel ba'i mig 'gul dbang rtsa gnyis/ mig steng du 'brel ba'i gyen blta'i dbang rtsa gnyis/ mig zur tu 'brel ba'i zur blta'i dbang rtsa gnyis/ gdong gi sha sgrim khag dang lce rtse sogs la 'brel ba'i 'gul tshor dbang rtsa gnyis/ rna ba dang 'brel ba'i sgra len dbang rtsa gnyis/ lce rtsa dang gre bar 'brel ba'i lce gre'i dbang rtsa gnyis/ ske'i nang nas mar brgyud snying dang glo ba sogs don snod rnams dang 'brel ba'i dpyang thag dbang rtsa gnyis/ ske mjing dang gnya' ba'i sha sgrim gyi rgyud du 'brel ba'i nye 'dabs dbang rtsa gnyis/ lce 'og tu 'brel ba'i lce 'gul dbang rtsa gnyis bcas so/ /3gre ba'i nad kun a ru btso bsregs thang / /mngar ba'i thang dang ril bu kha mur bsten/ /nya khus bdug cing sgang rtsa skyor gong gtar/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ mdor na gre ba'i nad kun la a ru btso ba'am bsregs pa'i thang dang /de bzhin ro mngar ba'i sman sna gang 'dzoms kyi thang dang ril bu kha mur du bsten zhing skrangs na nya khus bdug cing sgang rtsa dang skyor gong gtar ba bcas kyis bcos zhes pa'o//4mig gis gzugs mthong thub pa'i rgyu mtshan shod/'grel/ phyi rol yul gyi dngos po las ldog 'phros byas pa'i 'od de mig sprin dang khang chu brgyud rgyal mo nas 'dzul te/ dwangs gsal gzugs kyi 'od ldog 'phros la brten nas rtsa dkar gyi dra skyi'i steng du dngos su gzhi grub/ de nas dngos kyi zug gzer rnams rtsa dkar dra skyi'i steng gi 'od tshor phra phung brgyud de phra phung de dag ngar langs nas rim bzhin brgyud len rtsa dkar rgyud nas klad pa'i rgya dar gyi rtsa dkar rtsa 'khyil du gnas pa'i mthong tshor lte gnas la brten nas mthong thub pa'i shes pa grub 250

bo/ /5gyes na nad mi sums la bsdus na 'byar/ /mthos na mi non dmas na mi sums pas/ /bdud las phyir bskyed btsan las gdong byol ba'i/ /thur rtse gang gi dbus su brdeg par bya//zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ bar 'grib la dpyad mchog thur mas brdeg skabs gyes na ste gsang mig las thur rtse thung na sgrib byed bshu mi thub pa'i skyon dang / mthong byed la nye na ni sgrib byed thur la 'byar nas sba mi thug pa'i skyon/ smin ma phyogs mthos na sgrib byed mi non/ dmas na sgrib byed mi sums pas bdud de mig mtsho nag po las gra zur phyogs su gro 'bring gang tsam phyir bskyed/ btsan zhes mig rtsa dmar po las gdong byol ba'i gsang ste thur rtse gang gi dbus su brdeg par bya/ zhes pa'o/ /6snas dri tshor thub pas rgyu mtshan shod/'grel/ dri ma snom byed kyi dri 'dzin dbang rtsa ni sna khung gi phugs su che chung sran ma tsam la kha dog ser bo can zhig yod pa'i dbang rtsa de dag dang tshags lta bu'i sna rus brgyud klad gzhung nang gi snom byed dbang rtsa'i lte bar slebs nas/ dri ldan rdzas phran sna khung du slebs rjes nom byed dbang rtsa'i sne mor phog thug btang bas nom byed dbang rtsas skad cig nyid du klad gzhung nang gi snom byed dbang rtsa lte ba la brda bskyal gyin yod/bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin pa gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ka 2 ga 3 kha 4kha 5 ka 6ga 7 kha 8 ga9 ka 10 kha 11 ka 12 ka 13 ga 14ka 15 ka16 ka 17ga 18 kha 19 nga 20 ga 21 ga 22 ga23 kha 24nga 25 ga 26 ga 27 ga 28 ka 29 kha30 ga251

gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 ka gang 2 kha ga ca 3 ka ga nga 4ka kha ca 5 kha ga nga 6kha ga nga 7 ka khang 8 kha ga ca 9 ka ga nga 10 ka kha ga 11ka ga nga 12 ka ga 13 ga nga ca 14kha ga nga 15 kakha ga nga16 ka kha 17 kha ga nga ca 18 ka kha ga nga 19 kha ga 20 ka khag bzhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'jin/1 tu 2 ྾ 3 tsu 4 5 6 ྾ 7tsu 8྾ 9 ྾ 10 ྾ 11 ྾ 12sa 13 tsu 14sa15 ྾ 16tu 17 18 ྾ 19 ྾ 20sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon rma gso ba/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 phyi rkyen las bskyed pa ma yin par nad dang lhan cig tu skyes pa'i rma ngan la/( )ka 'bras/ kha lhan skyes nad/ ga lhan skyes rma/ nga ma nad bu la lhung ba/2'bras nad la rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/( )ka gcig kha gnyis/ ga gsum/ nga dgu/3 'bras nad kyi rtsa rgyud ni( )bar 'phar ba yin/ka phra la grims/ kha phra la 'dar/ ga grims la 'khyug ngasbom la dal/4phyi 'bras rigs rnams gso dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/( )ka yun lon pa'i phyir/ kha lhan skyes yin phyir/ ga gnad steng du 252

byung ba'i phyir/ nga bcos nor ba'i phyir/5gzhang 'brum nad der na zug yod na/( )ka mes bsros/ kha gcod par bya/ ga byin gzhug dang long rtsa gtar/ nga gcod mi rung /6gzhang 'brum yun ring 'gor nas rnying ba'i bcos la mchog tu gyur pa ni/( )ka dar ba/ kha 'o ma/ ga zho/ nga mar/7byug lums 'bras 'dul bcas kun gyis zhi dka' ba ni/( )ka rus 'bras/ kha sha 'bras/ ga rma 'bras/ nga nang 'bras/8me dbal skyed pa'i rkyen gtso bo ni/( )ka rlung / kha ngan khrag ga khrag mkhris/ nga chu ser/9me dbal bcos par thog mar nang skyon bsal dgos phyir( )bsten/ka gtar ga kha skyugs/ ga bshal/ nga lums/10 rkang 'bam skyed pa'i khyad par gyi rgyu ni/( )ka chu ser/ kha khrag ga bad kan/ nga khrag srin/11 glo bur tu 'byung ba'i rkyen gyi rma de la rigs( )yod/ka gnyis/ kha lnga/ ga brgyad/ nga gsum/12klad pa'i rgya dar gyi mdog ni/( )ka skya bo/ kha dmar nag ga smug po/ nga ser nag13 chu rtsa'i gnad grangs ni/( )ka bcu gsum/ kha drug/ ga gnyis/ nga nyer gnyis/14rus rtsa gsum ni/( )ka gzha' khug khyi nyal/ byi sder/ kha sbrul mig ka ba/ bong men/ga mdung tshugs/ 'phred nyal/ 'khyam po/ nga chu rtsa/ srid rtsa/ srog rtsa/15gnyan gyi re thag bzhi'i gnas ni/( )253

ka mtshog ma/ ltag sdud/ spyi gtsug rna ltag kha gtsug gi phyogs bzhir mtshon re'i sar gnas pa'o/ /ga mur gong gnyis dang ra ldebs gnyis/ ngagatsug gi phyogs bzhir tshon bzhi re'i sar/16mgo rma phog pa'i tshe gnyan pa'i gnas ni/( )ka dpral ba'i rwa ldebs/ kha 'phred nyal/ ga sdud sgo bzhi/ ngamakhur tshos gnyis/17don lnga las tshe srog sems kyi rten du gyur pa ni/( )ka mchin dri dkar po/ kha mtsher ba/ ga snying / nga glo ba/18 rtsa chu phyi yul gyi sgo nas brtag par rtsa rgyud grims pa ni/( )ka sha skyon/ kha klad skyon/ ga rus skyon/ nga khrag skyon/19 mgo yi chu rtsa'i gnad grangs ni/( )ka bcu gsum/ kha drug ga nyer gnyis/ nga gnyis/20 khrag rtsa'i gnad ni/( )ka drug kha bzhi/ ga brgyad/ nga nyer drug21 gnad lnga rab 'bring tha gsum las rab tu gnyan pa de ni/( )ka rtsa dang chu rgyus/ kha rtsa dang rmen bu/ ga nywa dang tshigs/ ngachu ba dang rgyus pa/22rmen bu rnam brgyad byer na ni/( )ka gso sla/ kha gso ba tsam/ ga bcos dka'/ nga bcos thabs med/23 byang khog stod kyi snying gsang drug ni/( )ka phra khab/ thugs khab/ na bu/ kha dpal khab/ thugs khab/ bya rog mig ga zangs ma/ sngon bu/ dung 'bud/ nga 'greng bu/ phyir rgyu/bsnol ma/ 24rgya skar lta bu'i gsang rnam pa bzhi ni/( )ka brang gi snying gsang /glo ba'i ma gsang / ma bu gnyis ka'i zur gsang / glo 254

ba gsang / kha rgyab gsang ring mo/ mchan gsang / lto ba'i spyi gsang /gzhang gsang / ga rang gsang / lto ba'i spyi gsang / mchan gsang / dbye gsang / nga rang gsang / mda' gsang / phog gsang / dbye gsang /25rus pa chag pa'i rtags ni/( )ka mod la skrangs shing tsha ba 'ur gyis skyes/ kha mod la skrangs shing 'gul mi nus/ ga grang zhing 'khrog la 'gul mi nus/ nga grang zhing 'khrog la zug cher ldang ba/26sha rma'i dbye ba lnga ni/( )ka bshus/ gshags/ bcad/ brdungs/ rdzogs pa/ kha bshus/gshags/ phug lud pa/ bcad/ ga ral ba/ rnag pa/ 'bras/ sur ya/bshus/ nga bcad pa/ rdzogs pa/ gshags pa/ lhung ba/ bsnad pa/27mchin rtsa gnyis ni/( )ka dung 'bud gnyis/ kha chu mig dang gser gyi ka ba/ ga ru thung dang snod ka nga sha ru dang mon ru gnyis/28 lus dang yan lag sogs lhan du gnas tshe rgyab tu gnas pa ni/( )ka chu ba/ kha rgyus pa/ ga chu rgyus gnyis ka nga rtsa dkar/29 brten pa rus pa'i gnas lugs la grangs/( )ka gnyis/ kha brgyad/ ga nyer gnyis/ nga sum cu/30 rma gzha' ba rnam pa bzhi ni/ ( )ka sha gzha'/ rus gzha'/ tsha gzha'/ grang gzha'/ kha rtsa gzha'/drod gzha'/ rus gzha'/ sha gzha'/ ga tshil gzha'/ sha gzha'/ rtsa gzha'/ khrag gzha'/ nga rus gzha'/ grang gzha'/ rtsa gzha'/ sha gzha'/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 khong 'bras phal che bar byung sa'i gnas ni/( )255

ka pho ba/ kha rgyu long / ga pho long / nga mid pa'i 'brel mtshams/ ca mchin pa/2phyi 'bras las khyad par du gso dka' ba'i rigs ni/( )ka rus 'bras/ kha sha 'bras/ ga rtsa 'bras/ nga tshigs 'bras/ ca don 'bras/3 nyes pa'i rigs las khrag gyur gyi 'bras byung sa'i gnas ni/( )ka pho ba/ kha nu ma/ ga mngal/ nga gzhang / calong /4gzhang 'brum la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/( )ka skam pa can/ kha cha snyoms/ ga gsher ba can/ nga rtsub gsher can/ ca rlon pa can/5gzhang 'brum nad byung dus spang dgos pa'i spyod lam ni/( )ka stan srab pa/ kha bzhon pa zhon pa/ ga rlan grang me nyis gdung ba/ nga grang dro mi snyoms/ ca zas kyis drags pa/6me dbal gyi nad byung sa'i gnas gtso bo ni/( )ka phyi pags pa/ kha bar rus pa/ ga nang don snod/ ngatshigs dmigs/ ca mgo ske/7men bu'i nad thobyung mang ba'i gnas dag ni/( )ka ske mjing mig zur/ kha mchan khung / ga rna 'gram/ ngasne sa bzhi/ ca pho 'gram/8 rkang 'bam gyi nad ldang sla ba'i dus ni/( )ka dgun smad/ kha dpyid sos/ ga ston ka nga dbyar khaca dgun stod/9 rkang 'bam gyi nad 'byung mang ba'i gnas ni/( )ka rkang ba/ kha lag pa/ ga rna mchu/ nga byang khog cadon snod/256

10 rkang 'bam zhes pa'i nad gzhi 'di nyid kyi rgyu gtso bo ni/( )ka bad kan/ kha chu ser/ ga ngan khrag nga khrag mkhris/ca sha rlon/11glo bur du byung ba'i rma la gnas kyi sgo nas dbye na/( )ka mgo rma/ kha byang khog rma/ ga yan lag rma/ nga mtshon rma/ca don lnga'i rma/12rma byer ba'i gnas ni/( )ka pags pa/ kha sha tshil/ ga rtsa rus/ nga tshigs mig ca chu rgyus/13 rma gzha' ba rnam pa bzhi ni/( )ka sha gzha'/ kha rus gzha'/ ga rtsa gzha'/ nga tsha gzha'/ca grang gzha'/14rma smyo ba rnam pa bzhi ni/( )ka sha smyo/ kha khrag smyo/ ga rus smyo/ nga tshil smyo/ capags smyo/15klad pa'i 'dus so gsum ni/( )ka spyi gtsug kha mtshog ma/ ga sdud sgo/ nga ltag ral/ca mur gong /16don snod las byang khog stod du gnas pa ni/( )ka glo ma lnga/ kha snying / ga glo ba'i bu lnga/ nga mchin dri/ca mcher pa/17pho ba'i rtsa ni/( )ka sbrul mig kha ka ba/ ga bong rmen/ nga bya rkang / casnod ka18mtshon rma spyi las rma gso dka' ba der/( )ka gnas kyis gso dka' ba/ kha rang bzhin gyis gso dka' ba/257

ga rkyen gyis gso dka' ba/ nga dus kyis gso dka' ba/ ca nad kyis gso dka' ba/19 khrag rtsa'i gnad drug po ni/( ) ka sngon bu gnyis/ kha khug pa gnyis/ ga sbu gu gnyis/ ngadung 'bud gnyis/ ca lung 'dzin gnyis/20 byang khog rma las smad kyi nang brtol spyi rtags la/ ( )ka zhe mer langs pa/ kha khong sbo ba/ ga ldang dub byed pa/ nga'agro dka' ba/ ca dri chu sri ba/ 21 rma'i rnag 'byams pa'i rgyu drug ni/ ( )ka tsha 'byams bzhi/ kha zas spyod log pa/ ga grang 'byams gnyis/ nga grang 'byams bzhi/ ca dus gdon gnyis/22 rnag pra las gso sla ba'i nad rtags ni/( )ka dkar po/ kha reg bya 'jam pa/ ga ser po/ nga dri ma med pa/ ca sngon po/23 'chi ba'i bya gtong gsum ni/( )ka rtsa yi bya gtong / kha chu yi bya gtong / ga rlung gi bya gtong /nga zungs kyi bya gtong / ca khrag gi bya gtong /24byang khog rma'i bcos thabs rnam pa gsum ni/ ( )ka zug rngu mtshon dang sbyar ba'i bcos pa/ kha don snod gnad dang sbyar nas bcos pa/ ga phog sa gnas dang sbyar nas bcos pa/ nga stod smad yul dang sbyar nas bcos pa/ ca nyes pa'i rigs dang sbyar nas bcos pa/25 mdor bsdus pa'i ske rma'i bcos tshul gsum ni/( )ka rus pa mgo rma'i tshul du bcos/ kha rtsa gnyan byang khog rma'i tshul du bcos/ ga sha dang chu rgyus yan lag gi rma ltar du bcos/ nga rus pa byang khog tshul du bcos/ ca don gnyan rgyal po'i tshul du bcos/258

26ske'i phyi rtsa rnam gsum ni/( )ka khrag rtsa/ kha chu rtsa/ ga rlung rtsa/ nga 'phar rtsa casdod rtsa/27lgang ba'i rtsa ni/ ( )ka chu rtsa/ kha srog rtsa/ ga srid rtsa/ nga 'phar rtsa cadabang rtsa/28 gzer ba la nang gses kyi dbye ba/( )ka khrag gzer/ kha don gzer/ ga mkhris gzer/ nga rtsa gzer/ ca snod gzer/ 29 rus sman sde bzhi zhes pa de/ ( )ka sbal rgyab/ kha mdung rtse/ ga gangs thigs/ nga bul togaca cong zhi/30 rma'i rang bzhin gang dag las gso dka' ba yin/( )ka nya khros pa/ kha rus 'dzer/ ga rtsa 'khums/ nga rus rgyus rul pa/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/sha'u/ rma sos skabs rma'i nang gsar du skyes pa'i sha'i ming /zug rngu lus/ mde'u dang rus 'dzer sogs rma nang du lus pa/sha gdan/ gtar rtsa'i skabs rtsi'i 'og gi sha dang rma'i skabs sha'i 'og rus pa'i khar chags pa'i pags pa srab mo de'o//hol srab/ sru med par phyis mnyed tshar ba'i ra dang gla ba sogs kyi pags pa srab mo'i don/rma red pa/ rma la bla gnyan gyi nad gzhan bsnon mar byung ba'i don/gtam zug mtshon phog pa'i mde'u sogs sha rus nang lus pa/259

rma smyo ba/ rma 'khrugs pa ste sha'u khrag rnag rus mdzer sogs lhag par skyes nas rma kha mthug por phyin pa/lhung ba'i rma/ yan lag sogs bcad nas lus phung dang bral ba'i rma la zer/nan/ rma chas shig ste zhib btags sman gar sla zho tsam rtse 'jam bsros nas byug pa'i rdzas/gnyi ba/ yu ba dang don gcigarma med/ rma med pa rus pa chag pa/bshus pa/ sha'i pags pa bshus pa'i don/wa lung / bu ga phug brdug pa/gshol brkos/ rma'i dbyibs thong gshol gyis bskos pa lta bu sha phyogs su rdzogs pa/grum pa/ rus pa'i chag sna 'khrugs pa'i don/mcher ba'i cha ga mcher ba'i mtha' ma mu la go /ldum chag mnyam por chag pa ste rus pa'i chag sna mnyam pa/bya log spangs/ g.yas g.yon go log tu skrangs pa/'ju rtsi dar sman/ 'ju rtsi ni ze tshwa dang dar sman tsha lar go/zur kha/ dpung ba'i tshigs mtshams kyi steng nas gyen du sor bzhi gzhal sar yod pa'i sog rus kyi nyag pa'i ming /rgya ber/ rgya zhes skabs 'dir klad pa'i rgya dar dang ber zhes pa ka li'i nang gi lha ba'i ming yin pas sgra bsdus pa'o/ /sha gzha'/ rang gnas su gab pa/bya 'das/ bcos pa'i dus las 'das pa/bcar thebs/ gnad la thebs pa/snag po che/ 'phongs shapho tshoms gcig thun gcig gam ya khyor gyi sor mo yongs kyis bzung thub tshod cig la zer/260

pho mdud/ mid pa dang pho ba 'brel mtshams/skyi phur/ rnag thum la gobya chad/ phan tshun bar gyi 'phrin yig chad pa/bya shor/ 'phrin dmigs yul la ma 'byor bar gzhan la shor ba/kha spu ma tshud/ rtsa phan tshun 'byor ma thub pa/nyes byed/ skabs 'dir khrag dang chu ser rnag la bshad/pus brang bcas pa/ pus mo gnyis brang la sbyar ba'i lus spyod pa/rma gsar ba/ rma zhag ma lon pa la gomen pas brtas/ rma kha phal cher sos pa'i dus/sprug 'dir zas bcud lhug por btang ba/'jig zas/ phag sha dang ri bong sha sogs la zer/rma rtsi/ rma yi sos sman/'tsho byed dar rtsa/ klad pa 'tsho bar byed pa'i rtsa'i dra ba gos dar lta bu de la zer/rus rtsa/ klad rus nang na rgyu ba'i rtsa la zer/bzhi pa/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 nang rtsa gsum chod na dri chu sdom par byed/( )2 'ju rtsi dar sman ni rgyam tshwa ste zas 'ju zhing stobs skyed pas so/ /( )3 chu rtsa sgril ma dang chu rtsa 'ja' byed gnyis 'dra/( )4khrag long g.yas dang srin long dbus rtsam long g.yon du gnas pa yin/( )5 pho ba'i rdzems la mtshon phog pa ni 'chi bar 'gyur/( )6byang khog stod smad kyi mtshams ni mchin dris dbye ba yin/ ( )7so rtsa ldad byed gnyis ni rlung khrag gnyis 'doms kyi 'phar rtsa'o ( )8 bon po'i thod ces bya ba'i lha rtsa zhes pa lha ltar steng du gnas pas btags/( )261

9zho yis tshad pa gcog cing kha zas len yang nan ltar rnag la bungs chen gnod pa yin/( )10 ske ni byang khog stod smad la mi gtogs shing yar mgo la gtogs pa yin/( )11 nang rtsa don snod bcu gsum po de dag chod na thur sel rlung nyams pas dri chu sdom pa yin/( )12brten pa rus pa'i gnas lugs ni lus kyi gzhi rten yin/( )13long rtsa ni rgyu stod kyi zur nas g.yas g.yon du tshon re bcal na gnas pa yin/( )14snying tshil la mtshon phog na brgyal 'bog dngangs shing 'dar la 'phral du 'chi bar 'gyur/( )15khrag gzer la gtar dang rtsa gzer me btsa' don gzer dugs kyis bcag par bya( )16lus kyi gnad la mtshon phog na gso dka' la 'chi yang srid pa yin/( )17mig dang rna ba so sogs dbang bo sgo yi rma rang bzhin gyi gso dka' ba yin/( )18 gzhu shul btang 'dra gnyan pa ni 'tshogs ma'i sha'o/ /( )19 rma spyir rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na mgo dang byang khog yan lag bcas yin/( )20 byang khog stod smad mchin dris dbye ba yin/( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 ci zhig la lhan skyes rma zer/lan/ phyi rkyen mda' rdo gri mdung mtshon gyis bskyed pa ma yin par nad rang 262

dang lhan cig du rang bzhin gyis skyes pa'i rma ngan pa la'o/ /2lhan skyes rma la nang gses kyi dbye ba ga tshod yod dam/lan/ lhan skyes rma la 'bras dang gzhang 'brum dang / /me dbal sur ya rmen bu rlig rlugs dang / /rkang 'bam mtshan bar rdol dang brgyad du bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /3 dang po 'bras nad skyed pa'i gzhi mthun gyi rgyu rkyen ci ltar yin nam/lan/ 'bras nad ni spyod lam 'grams pa dang / 'khrugs pa/ kha zas dwangs mar ma smin pa sogs kyis ngan khrag rgyas te rtsar byer ba rlung gis bsgril nas bskyed pa yin/4khong 'bras kyi spyi rtags ni gang ltar yin nam/lan/ khong 'bras skran ltar reg pa sra ba'am/ /mi mngon gting nub zas la 'khren pa ste//smin nas gyen thur gnyis kar rnag rdol 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /5 ci zhig la 'bras nad zer/lan/ phal cher dwangs ma ma zhu ba'i rkyen gyis pho mchin sogs lus zungs don snod kyi gnas nges med du rgyun ldan min pa'i grub cha 'thor ba 'tshar skyes byung ba gong bur bsgril nas lus khams kyi dwangs ma'i bcud rdzas 'jib 'then byed pa dang lus zungs la nyen par byed pa'i nad cig la zer/6dus rgyun du 'bras dang skran nad gnyis nor 'khrul che bas de dag ci ltar ngos 'dzin dgos sam/lan/ lag pa'i spar nyul byas na reg thub dang mi thub las dpyod dgos te/de yang 'bras nad yin na lag pas spar nyul byed skabs ngo bo sra zhing 'ba' 'bur can yin la mtha' mtshams gsal bo med pa dang / g.yo 'gul mi byed pa/ rmen bu'i rgyu lam brgyud nas gnas gzhan du mched la 'tshar skyes byung ba myur ba dang / skran ni lus khams kyi gnas gang rung zhig la kher rkyang du gong bu bsgril ba zhig yin stabs/nye 'khor phung bo'i grub cha dang thad kar 'brel mthud byas med pa dang / 'tshar skyes dal la lag pas spar nyul byed skabs ngo bo 'jam zhing mtha' mtshams gsal ba/g.yo 'gul byed pa/ gnas gzhan du mi mched pa/ skran chags pa'i gnas yul des 263

rang gi phung bo'i grub char btsan gnon 'khel ba dang bu ga bkag pa tsam las de min lus stobs shor zhing zungs khrag zad pa sogs kyi nad rtags dmigs bsal yong gin med/7 gzhang 'brum gyi go don dang de'i rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ gzhang ste a lung kha nas yar sor phyed dang lnga'i mtshams der 'brum pa byung bar gzhang 'brum dang / de'i rtags su 'brum pas gzhang bkug thur sel log /nyes pa 'khrugs te drod chung yan lag na/ /rlung 'khyim khong sbo mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus/ /stobs chung sha skam mchil mang rus tshigs na/ /gcin mang bshang ba nyung zhing 'khru 'am skam//chu sri mtshan ma na 'brab gzhang kha gzer//zhes pa'o/ /8 gzhang 'brum nad kyi gso dka' sla'i khyad par ram spang blang mu bzhi ci ltar yin nam/lan/ gzhang rgyu'i dkyus su rang gi sor phyed dang lnga yod pa las de'i rked par cha snyoms de gnyer ma gsum yod pa'i phyi rol gyi gnyer ma'i dkyus la sor phyed gnyis yod sar nad byung zhing lo ma lon pa'i nad rkyang gsar ba gso sla ba dang / gnyer ma bar ma'i sor phyed de'i sar byung ba dang nad gnyis ldan pa lo gcig 'das pa gso ba dka'/ gnyer ma nang ma'am phugs ma'i sor phyed do la nad gsum gnas pa 'dus pa zhes pa lo 'das pa gso ba tsam du byung yang gso btub pa cher mi 'byung zhing /rkang lag lte ba bshang sgo sogs la mtshon song nas lus skrangs shing bshang rnag gi bla gnyan rnag dang rims btab skyug pa dang / snying ga'am rtsib logs shin tu na ba/gdod nas yod pa'i lhan skyes ni spang dgos so/ /9 ci 'dra zhig la me dbal zhes tha snyad btags pa yin nam/lan/ lus kyi phyi'i pags pa'i cha gang rung zhig tu 'brum thor mes tshigs pa 'dra ba'i chu bur sgor dbyibs zur mang can gyi gzugs su mched pas na me lce 'khor lo'am me dbal zhes brjod/10 sur ya'i nad kyi gyur tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ zas spyod dman lhag log pa'i rkyen gyis khrag 'phel ba dang / mtshon 264

sogs kyis bsnad pa'i khrag lus pa/ 'grams pa'i khrag gtar gyis ma 'chun pa/rims tsha ba sogs rtsar babs pa'i dus su ma gtar ba'i skyon gyis ngan khrag chu ser rnams don snod kyi rtsa mig tu 'dus pas skrangs shing brnags nas 'bras ltar sur ya zhes pa'i nad du gyur pa yin no/ ci/11 sur ya'i nad dang skran nad khong 'bras gsum gyi ngo bo'i khyad par ci/lan/ skran ni ma zhu bas bskyed pa shas che zhing ngo bo 'dril ba dang / khong 'bras ni zas la 'khren zhing zug rngu chung la ngo bo bem pa/ sur ya ni khrag ngan don snod kyi rtsa mig tu 'dus nas ngo bo skrangs pa zug rngu dang bcas pa mthar rnag tu smin pa'o /12 rkang 'bam nad kyi gyur tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ lus khams kyi khrag dang chu ser nad 'gyur byung nas/ dang po lte ba'i 'og la gnas pa'am ro smad la rgyas/ bad kan dang khrag gnyis 'phel bas sha rus rim gyis hreb can du skrangs pa de na ba'i zug gzer cher mi mngon par rim gyis rkang pa stug po nyid du skrangs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /13 rmen bu'i nad ces pa ji ltar yin nam/lan/ ske mjing dang sne sa bzhi sogs men bu'i gnad brgyad dang phra mo mang po la gnyan kha rgyas nas skrangs 'bur chags shing rmar 'gyur ba'i nad cig la go/14rkang 'bam nag po snying la zin pa de ji ltar bcos dgos sam/lan/ rkang ba glo bur du kha dog smug nag tu skrangs pa dang de'i steng chu bur skabs skabs su 'ong zhing zug gzer che ba rnams nyin bdun nas dgu las mi 'da' bar 'chi nges pa'i phyir lan 'ga' nad rtags ma tshang bas gso ba the tshom byung na nad pa rang gi dri chu skrangs por bkrus pas na dmar thig dang ri mo 'byung ba'am sha mdog 'gyur ba dang / yang na bca' sga mar rnying sbyar bas skrangs por byugs nas zug gzer byung na rkang 'bam nad kyi mi 'gyur ba'i rtags yin/15rlig rlugs nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang dbye ba ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon dang thur sel 'khrugs/ /lam log rlig par 265

zhugs te skrangs par byed/ /dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kan tshil gyur dang / /gcin las gyur dang rgyu rlugs drug tu bshad/ /ces pa'o/ /16 ci'i phyir mtshon rma zhes bya ba yin nam/lan/ mda' rdo gri mdung rwa shing mche ba me sogs mtshon brgyad kyis lus la bsnad pas pags pa sha gdan bcas ral ba dang de las khrag rnag chu ser sogs 'dzag pa dri nga la tshor ba sdug bsngal dang bcas lus las 'phral du nyams shing rma ba'i phyir na mtshon rma zhes bya'o/ /17 rma zhes bya ba'i ngo bo dang nges tshig ci ltar yin nam/lan/ khrag dang rnag la sogs pa 'dzag pa dri nga tshor ba drag po'i sdug bsngal dang bcas te/ rang gi lus las 'phral du stobs nyams shing rma bar 'gyur la/ phyi dang nang gi pags pa sha gdan ral ba'i phyir rma zhes bya'o/ /18glo bur gyi rma la rigs ga tshod yod pa dang de dag gi go don ci ltar yin nam/lan/ rigs brgyad yod de/ de yang bshus pa zhes pags pa bshus pa dang /gyen thur du gshags pa/ sha 'phred la bcad pa/ rus la thug pa'i bar rnam par bcad pa/ rus pa bcad nas sha rab tu lhab lhab por 'phyang ba dang / lhu tshigs dang bral ba'i lhung ba/ rus pa sogs grums pa/ mtshon rtses phug pa dang brgyad yin no/ /19glo bur gyi rma gnas gang dang gang dag la byung na gso dka' ba yin nam/lan/ rma gnas mig dang rna ba so dang sna/ /mur gong rtsib logs brang dang lte ba dang / /nu ma mchan khung rlig pa rus mgo dang / /sgal tshigs chu rgyus las byed tshigs mtshams dka'/ /zhes pa'o/ /20 rma gnad du song dang ma song ba de ji ltar brtag pa yin nam/lan/ gnad du song ba sha tshil rus pa dang / /chu rgyus don snod rtsa gnad rnam pa bdun/ /sha gnad skrangs shing byer la khro ba yin/ /tshil bu gnad la song na lhog thabs skrangs/ /rus gnad na zhing rus tshad rkun bur skye/ /chu rgyus gnad la song na zha 266

rengs 'gyur/ /don gnad zug gzer che zhing gzi mdangs 'chor/ /snod gnad drag por sbo 'khrug dri chu sdom/ /rtsa gnad rtsa tshad skyes pa 'du ba 'khrug/ /mdor na sgo gsum gnad la phebs par 'gyur/ /gnad la ma song zug med dang ga bde/ /lus yang bya ba'i las la blo mi ldog /ces pa'o//21 rma gzha' ba'i nang gses ci ltar yin nam/lan/ gzha' la sha rus tsha grang rnam pa bzhi/ /sha gzha' ba ni sha'u skyer mi 'dod/ /rus gzha' rus pa'i steng nas sha mi skye/ /tsha gzha' rma kha shi la rlangs pa che/ /grang gzha' drod bral rma kha shi ba'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /22mgo'i gnas lugs las mi'i rigs mgo dbyibs klad pa dang sbyor tshul gang ltar yin nam/lan/ rlung mgo spyi ring sha klad de/ /mkhris mgo ltag 'bur mar klad do/ /bad kan sog ka bung tshang klad/ /rlung mkhris gru bzhi phrum klad yin/ /bad mkhris zlum po zho klad do//zhes so//23 klad khyim rus pa'i gnas lugs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ pho rus mo rus ma ning rus pa gsum/ /de la sgang dang rtsibs dang mtha' ru 'gyur/ /pho rus gdong mthug lha ba chung la mkhregs/ /mo rus lha gdung snyoms shing srab la mnyen/ /ma ning rus pa lha ba che la gsob/ /de las sgang ni ltag pa nas smin dkyil bar rang sor bzhi zhur po lta bu'i sgang rus pa mthug cing mkhregs la khro ba'i skron la lha ba che ba dang / rtsibs ni sgang g.yas g.yon du sor bzhi bcal ba sgang las srab la lha ba dang gdung snyoms shing mnyen pa yin/ mtha' ni sgang rtsibs las gzhan pa'i rna ba'i ltag rus lhag ma rnams lha ba chung zhing srab la khro ba'i skron par bshad do//24mgor rma phog sa bzang ngan ji ltar yin nam/lan/ ngan pa sdud sgo bzhir phog 'chi ba'i gnas/ /chag tshabs che rung chung rung ngan pa yin/ /'phred nyal srubs steng mig phor mkhur tshos dang / /za 'gram steng rnams phog sa 'bring du bshad/ /phog sa bzang ba dpral ba'i rwa ldebs gnyis/ /chag tshabs che chung med par bzang ba yin//zhes pa'o/ /267

25 gsum 'gyur ske zhes pa'i go don gang yin nam/lan/ ske ni sha rus rtsa gsum shin tu gnyan pa gnas gcig tu 'dril sa zhig ste/ ske ni rus pa'i mkhar la rtsa yi 'phrang / /sha dang chu rgyus kun gyi 'dril sa yin/ /rus gnyan lha ba 'byer bas mgo dang 'dra/ /rtsa gnyan rtsa thigs gsog pa'i byang khog 'dra/ /sha dang chu rgyus gnyan pas yan lag 'dra/ /de phyir gsum 'gyur ske yi bcos thabs bstan/ /zhes pa'o//26klad pa'i 'tsho byed dar rtsa bdun po ni gang dag yin nam/lan/ gnyan gyi re thag bzhi dang / phyi nang du rgyug pa gnyis/ tshangs pa'i skud pa gcig bcas bdun/ de bdun gyi gnas lugs ni/ re thag bzhi ni rna ba'i phyi nang na/ /rtse nag gnyid log gnyis las gyes pa yi/ /dar steng shing lo'i 'dab ltar 'brel bar gnas/ /phyi nang rgyug pa ltag rus 'bur bo nas/ /mkhur tshos byung ste slar log klad pa blangs/ /'dus so gsum 'brel sbubs la phyi nang btsem/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa sha rus klad pa yi//rtsa gsum 'dus te spyi bo'i gtsug na gnas/ /zhes pa'o//27byang khog las rma nang du brtol ba'i spyi rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ nang brtol smrar bcug skad kyi mjug chad cing / /'gro ba'i stangs zhan khong lci dbugs mi bde/ /glo sor langs pas gang rgyab phyogs su 'khyog /kha zas mi 'dod zug che skra mtshams rngul/ /de dgu tshang na nang tu brtol ba yin/ /zhes pa'o//28 pho rtsa so so dang de'i gnas sa gang yin nam/lan/ pho rtsa sprul mig ka ba bong med gsum/ /sprul mig lten sne'i g.yas g.yon mtshon re sar/ /ka ba pho dkyil g.yas g.yon sor gsum na/ /bong med lte ba'i gyen mtshon gang na gnas/ /zhes pa'o//29 rgyu mar bu ga du yod zhag re thub ces pa'i don ci/lan/ dus skabs de dang de lta bu la rgyu mar mtshon gyis phug pa'i bu ga du yod kyang zhag re ste gcig ma gtogs tshe gnas mi thub ces pa'i don no//30 men bu'i gnad brgyad po gang dag yin nam/lan/ men bu'i gnad ni skyogs ra'i tshigs mtshams nas/ /phrag gong sor bzhi 268
