rmen bu mgo sngon gnad/ /khyi khros sna nas gyen du sor lnga na/ /dpung ba'i rmen bu smug po gnas pa yi/ /pus mo'i phyi zur tshigs kyi mtshams nas yar/ /mtho gang bcal ba men bu dkar po'i gnad/ /de nas sor gsum sbrul mgo gdengs pa'i gnad/ /ces pa'o/ /31 klad snying nas byung ba'i rlung rgyu ba'i chu rtsa bcu bo de gang dag yin nam/lan/ de la rlung rgyu ba yi rtsa dkar ni/ /dpung ba'i lug gzhug phyi mchan chu rtsa'i gnad/ /gru mo'i bar na rlung rtsa rat+na'i gnad/ /pus mo'i gnyan gong rus rtsa sgyed bu'i gnad/ /sre long phyi long bar na rgyungs rtsa'i gnad/ /mthe bong spu skyes pa yi pir mgo'i gnad/ /de bcu rlung 'phyo bya ba nyams pa'i gnad//ces pa'o//32 zlum bcos rgyal po zhes pa'i don ci yin nam/lan/ gso yul la bltos na rgyal po rnams yul gnyan zhing sran chung ba'i phyir dang / bcos thabs la bltos na bzlum 'chos rgyal po dang tshul mtshungs pas so//33 yan lag skabs kyi gnyen po bcu dgu gang dag yin nam/lan/ 'jibs kyis rma yi chu ser phyir la drang / /zhun gyis rma yi skrangs pa bzhu ba ste/ /nan gyis byer sbos skrangs pa rang sar mnan/ /me yis rtsa yi zug bcag 'bros 'phrang bsdams/ /gtar gyis khrag ngan chu ser phyir la dbyung / /sman gyis rma khong gnyis kyi nyes pa bsal/ /deb kyis rnag chu byer ba bcar la gdab/ /chings kyis mnan dang deb gnyis rang sar bzhag /skyogs kyis tshigs kyi 'phrul 'khor bsdam pa gces/ /zhes pa'o//34rus gnad brgyad po gang dag yin nam/lan/ sgal tshigs brang rus rtsib ma lha ru rtse/ /sgrog rus dpyi dang sog pa gzhug chung brgyad/ /zhes pa'o//35 yan lag gi tshigs shor ba'i rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ shor rtags zug gzer cung zad tsam la ldang / /mon du skrangs shing brkyang bskum bya ba nyams/ /gang shor 'bur kyong ring thung 'byung ba yin/ /dpyi yi gtug thag sog pa'i gnyan thag chad/ /bcug kyang mi sdod zha 'theng 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes 269

pa'o//drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1dang po zhag bdun zhugs pa khrag gis dus//bram ze lta bur gtsang sbra'i sgo nas bcos/ /bar du zhag bdun rgyas pa chu ser dus/ /dge slong lta bur spyod lam zhib mor bcos/ /tha ma zhag bdun smin pa rnag gi dus/ /rgyal po lta bur zas kyi bcos pa'o/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ nyes byed dus kyi sgo nas bcos par bya ba ni/ dang po zhag bdun ni zhugs pa khrag gi dus yin te/ skabs der bram ze lta bur gtsang spra gtso bor bton pa'i sgo nas bcos pa dang / bar du zhag bdun nang rgyas pa chu ser gyi dus su dge slong lta bur spyod lam zhib mo'i sgo nas bcos pa/ tha ma'i zhag bdun nang smin pa rnag gi dus su rgyal po lta bur zas kyi sgo nas bcos so zhes pa'i don no/ /2rus gnyan lha ba 'byer bas mgo dang 'dra/ /rtsa gnyan rtsa thigs gsog pas byang khog 'dra/ /sha dang chu rgyus gnyan pas yan lag 'dra/ /de phyir gsum 'gyur ske yi bcos thabs bstan/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ de la rus pa shin tu gnyan pa ltag pa'i ske tshigs rma byung tshe lha ba byer ba ste sha rus bar du rnag dang chu ser gsog nas sha rus bye zhing mer por gyur nas lha ba la'ang skyon 'byung ba ni mgo'i rma dang 'dra/ rtsa gnyan gnyid log rtse nag sogs la rma byung tshe rtsa nas khrag 'byung chu ser lhung ba'i phyir na byang khog gi rma dang 'dra/ rgyang sha las byed ltag chu leb mo sogs la rma byung na 'gul spyod kyi byed las nyams pa'i yan lag gsum ga'i rma'i bcos thabs 'dus pa ske'i bcos thabs bstan pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don no//3chag lugs ma la bu thog chag pa dang / /smyu gu kha dang rdum chag grum pa bzhi/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ ma la bu thog chag pa ni tshigs ske chag pa dang / rkang kha dbrag gi 270

gcig chag pa/ smyu gu kha ni gseg sbyor du chag pa/ rdum chag ni mnyam par chag pa/grum pa ni chag sna 'khrug pa'o/ /rma can ni nang gi rus pa chag pa ma zad phyi'i sha pags kyang brtol ba/ rma med ni rma kha med par nang gi rus pa chag pa'o//4'chor sa g.yas g.yon steng 'og rnam pa bzhi/ /dpung ba pus mo'i steng du 'chor mi srid/ /rgya tshigs mkhrig ma g.yas g.yon 'chor mi srid//gru mo long tshigs rgyab tu 'chor mi srid//dpyi la phyi shor nang shor rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ shor sa g.yas shor dang / g.yon shor/ 'og shor/ steng shor rnam pa bzhi yod de/ de yang dpung ba a zur gyis mnan pa dang pus mo'i steng du sla nga bkab pas steng du 'chor mi srid/ rgya tshigs dang mkhrig ma gnyis g.yas g.yon 'chor mi srid cing / gru mor gzhu mchog bkab pa dang long tshigs sre long gis bkab pas rgyab tu 'chor mi srid/ dpyi la phyi shor ring du 'gro/ nang shor thung du 'gro ba'i rnam pa gnyis so//5tshigs pa gsum nas rtsa gsum mdun du byung / /dbus kyi rtsa las snying ni 'bras bu'i tshul/ /sul gsum nang na rtsa lnga rlung rtsa dbus/ /rlung khrag 'dres pa'i rtsa bzhi phyogs bzhir gnas/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/ 'grel/ de la tshigs pa gsum pa nas rtsa gsum mdun gyi ngos su byung la de gsum po'i dbus kyi rtsa de las snying ni 'bras bu'i tshul du gnas shing snying gi phyi sha dkar nag mtshams su sul gsum yod pas dbus ma'i nang na rtsa lnga yod pa'i dbus su rlung gis gang ba'i rtsa ka ti ka gnas/ de'i rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhir rlung khrag 'dres pa'i 'phar rtsa bzhi gnas pa yin zhes pa'i don no/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ga 2 nga 3 kha 4ga 5 nga 6 ka 7 kha 8 ga9 ka 10 nga 11 ga 12 ga 13 nga 14ga 15 kha271

16 ga 17 ga 18 kha 19 ga 20 nga 21 kha 22 nga23 kha 24nga 25 ga 26 ka 27 nga 28 ga 29 kha30 kaganyis pa/mang 'dems/1 ga nga 2 kakha ga 3 kha ga 4kag 5 kakha ga nga 6 ka ga7 ka khang 8 ka kha nga 9 kakhag 10 kha ga 11 ka kha ga12 ka ga nga 13 ka kha nga ca 14ka kha ga nga 15 ka kha ga 16ka kha ga 17 ka kha ga 18 kakha ga 19 ka khang 20 kha ga ca21 ka ga 22 kakha nga 23 kagang 24ka ga nga 25 ka kha ga26 kakha nga 27 ka kha ga 28 kakha ga nga 29 ka kha ga ca30 ka kha ngadag pa ngos 'jin/1 tsu 2 ྾ 3 tsu 4྾ 5 ྾ 6 7 ྾ 8྾ 9 10 ྾ 11 snyo 12 gyo 13 ྾ 14྾15 ྾ 16tsu 17 ྾ 18 19 tsu 20 snyos bcad lnga pa/ byis nad gso ba/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 byis pa zhes pa ni/( )ka lo gcig nas lo lnga bar gyi phru gu/ kha skyes ma thag pa nas lo gcig lon pa'i phru gu/ ga lo gcig nas lo brgyad par gyi phrug gu/ nga skyes nas lo gsum bar gyi phru gu/2 byis pa btsa' dus kyi nyer spyod la( )bstan/272

ka bkra shis pa dang mi shis pa gnyis kyis/ kha lte ba gcod stangs sogs rnam pa bzhi yis/ ga ma'i nu zho bsnun thabs bcas rnam pa drug gis/ nga bkra shis pa'i smon tshig bcas rnam pa gsum gyis/3 byis pa'i lte ba gcod stangs ni/( )ka khrag bu ngos su bzhur la sor bzhi nas gcod/ kha khrag ma ngos su bzhur la sor bzhi nas gcod/ ga khrag bu ngos su bzhur la sor do nas gcod/ nga khrag ma ngos su bzhur la sor gsum nas gcod/4lce yi steng du gur kum hrī yig 'bri ba ni/( )ka dbang shes gsal ba'i phyir/ kha smra ba la mkhas pa'i phyir/ gablo stobs bskyed pa'i phyir/ nga nad rigs 'gog srung phyir/5btsas nas nu zho ster ba'i dus ni/( )ka btsas ma thag kha btsas nas zhag dang po/ ga btsas nas zhag bzhi ba/ nga dus tshod ma nges pa/ 6byis pa rnams la nad mang zhing 'chi nyen che ba'i dus ni/( )ka skyes ma thag pa'i zhag grangs 'ga'/ kha skyes nas nyin nyer brgyad kyi tshun chad/ ga skyes ma thag pa'i zhag grangs gsum/ nga skyes nas lo gcig bar/7byis pa rnams kyi gzugs brtas pa ches mgyogs pa'i dus skabs ni/( )ka thog ma'i zla ba gsum/ kha thog ma'i zla ba drug ga zla ba drug gi rjes nas/ nga lo bco lnga dang nyi shu tsam/8 gdon srung gi rdzas gdags pa'i gnas gsum ni/( )ka spyi bo/ rna shal/ srin lag kha mgul ba/ so/ dpral ba/ ga spyi bo/ lag pa/ mgul ba/ nga rna shal/ srin lag dpral ba/9 byis nad skyed pa'i rkyen ni/( )ka ma dang bu rkyen/ kha bu rkyen gcig pu/ ga ma rkyen gcig pu/273

nga phyi rkyen gang rung /10 byis nad spyi'i dbye ba ni/( )ka lhan skyes nad dang glo bur gnyis/ kha nyi shu bzhi/ ga nyi shu tham pa/ nga bcu drug11 byis nad 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/( )ka ma rlung / kha nyes gsum/ ga phyi gdon/ nga ma rig pa/12 'khru mdog dmar ser ljang nag dud khur 'khru ba ni/( )ka tsha 'khru/ kha grang 'khru/ ga tsha grang 'dres pa/ nga rgyu 'khril/13 nu zho'i mdog sngo la sbyin bag can chur zhugs na gting du nub pa ni/( )ka rlung nad las gyur pa'i rtags/ kha mkhris nad las gyur pa'i rtags/ga bad kan gyi nad las gyur pa'i rtags/ nga phyi gdon glo bur ba las gyur pa'i rtags/14rna ba nas rnag 'dzag cing 'on par 'gyur ba ni/( )ka ma rlung bu la shor ba/ kha lhan skyes kyi nad/ ga rna nad glo bur ba/ nga mkhris nad/15 rna ba'i rtsa ris gsum skam nas mi gsal na ni/( )ka tsha ba'i rtags/ kha grang ba'i rtags/ ga 'chi ba'i rtags/nga 'tsho dka' ba'i rtags/16byis pa'i nu zho 'thung ba'i dus su sman dpyad nyid/( )ka bu la bya/ kha ma la bya/ ga ma bu gnyis kar bya/ nga gang yang min/17 byis pa'i brang nad la mchog tu shes pa ni/ ( )ka gtar ga kha me btsa'/ ga chu mda'/ nga sman/18 ga bur sbyor ba gtong mi rung ba ni/( )ka grang rlung can/ kha chu ser can/ ga gnyan shas can/ nga274

lhan skyes can/19 glo nad rnying ba rlung dang ldan pa ni/( )ka tsha gzer/ kha thang po/ ga tsha subs/ nga thes po/20byis pa'i skad gdangs bya ngang ba'i skad dang 'dra na/ ( )ka glo nad rtags/ kha bshal skyugs gi nad rtags/ ga gdon rkyen thebs pa'i rtags/ nga grang ba'i nad rtags/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 byis pa bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan ni/( )ka mgo sngon skyes la gan rkyal byung / kha 'dar zhing dngangs la ngu skad drag ga mtshog ma che la skra mtshams dma'/ nga mig 'byed la 'dzum mdangs shes pa/ ca glo bur ngu ba/2 ma'i nu zho skams nas mi 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/( )ka mya ngan gyis mnar pa/ kha smyung bar gnas pa/ ga lus dub pa/ nga nad kyi 'gal rkyen/ ca tsha bas gdungs pa/3 'khru nad tsha ba'i rtags ni/( )ka lus drod che la shes pa 'thibs pa/ kha ljang khu'am dud khu 'khru ba/ga rgyu long sbo 'khrog byed pa/ nga tshabs cher khrag tu 'khru ba/ casbo 'khrog byed pa/4rlung las gyur pa'i zho ras kyi nad rtags ni/( )ka chur zhugs na wu ba dang bcas chu steng du 'phyo ba/ kha ro bska ba rang bzhin rtsub pa/ ga mdog sngo la ro skyur ba/ nga chu'i gting du 'bying ba/ ca nges med/ 5 byis pa'i glo tshad las 'khun sgra khong nas 'byin pa'i rgyu gtso bo ni/( )ka glo sbubs sogs su ljan ljin mang du song ba/ kha mchin dri dang lto 275

sha'i nus pa nyams pa/ ga glo bar gnyan tshad sogs rgyas nas dbugs 'byin dka' ba/ nga bad kan 'phel ba/ ca khrag zad pa/ 6byis pa'i nad kyi spyi rtags ni/( )ka mig 'byed dka' ba/ kha ngo mdangs nag pa/ ga drag du lu ba/ nga dbugs 'byin rngub mi bde ba/ ca zas mi 'ju ba/7byis pa'i nad tshabs che la mi 'tsho ba'i rtags su/( )ka mthil bzhi dmar ba/ kha dbang ba'i bkrag mdangs shor ba/ gdabugs thung gre ba gsog cing ngar ba/ nga mchin pa lte bar slebs/ca pho ba chu yis khengs pa/8 glo nad thang bo bcos thabs ni/( )ka sman/ kha zas/ ga bshal/ nga gtar gca me btsa'/9 byis nad tsha 'khru bcos pa'i thabs ni/( )ka zas/ kha spyod lam/ ga gtar ga nga sman/ca chu prag10 byis nad phra ba'i khongs su gtogs pa ni/( )ka glo tshad/ kha zho ras kyi nad/ ga pho ba'i nad/ nga srog bya'i nad/ ca srog rlung /11 byis pa 'on long zha ba sogs 'byung ba'i gzhi ni/ ( )ka nad rigs bu la lhung ba/ kha ma'i mi gtsang ba/ ga gdon rkyen/ nga zas spyod/12 byis pa'i glo nad la dbye na( )yod/ka tsha gzer/ kha tsha rgyas/ ga thang bo/ nga tsha subs/13 mchin nad rgod babs kyi rtags( )mngon/ka dbugs kha rgod pa/ kha lce mur la stong bldad byed pa/ gamathil bzhi ser po/ nga mchu so rnyil la dreg pa nag po chags pa/276

14rna nad 'grams pa'i rtags/ ( )ka rna rtsa skrangs pa/ kha rnag 'dzag pa/ ga ske 'gyur dka' ba/nga 'on par 'gro ba/15byis pa'i men nad ni rtsa nad yin phyir rtags su/ ( )ka rkang lag 'khums nas rkyong ba/ kha gzhogs g.yas pas nyal mi shes pa/ ga ngu skad phra la 'dzer ba/ nga nub gnyid yer ba/16mchin nad grang babs la dpyad( )bcos dgos/ka gtar ga kha lums/ ga me btsa'/ nga sbyang ba/ca dugs/17byis pa mkhris nad las skyugs pa chad pa dka' na( )bsregaka dngul 'dul/ kha zha rengs/ ga lten sna'i rtsa/ ga spyi gtsug nga sdud sgo/18 byis pa btsa' grogs la mtshan nyid gang dag ldan dgos/ ( )ka sngar bu ma 'chi ba/ kha nad med la blo rno ba/ ga na tshod dar ba/nga gshis lugs dang ngang rgyud bzang ba/19 byis pa'i lus brtas pa mgyogs zhing byung ba ni/ ( )ka zas skom/ kha sman/ ga spyod lam/ nga lag len/20 byis pa'i srog rtsa'i nad la me btsa' gdab pa'i gnas/ ( )ka tshigs pa drug pa/ kha tshigs pa dang po/ ga tshigs pa bdun pa/ nga tshigs pa dgu ba/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/rna ba gshog rna ba rgyab du 'byar ba ma yin par tshur gshog pa/gan rkyal skyes/ ma'i tshang ra'i dbyibs dang byis pa 'khor phyogs gnyis mthun par skyes pa'o//277

sha lngags gtsang / pags mdog gsal ba/res grogs skar ma/ skar rtsis las bshad pa'i tshes zhag rer dbang ba'i rgyu skar gang yin de'o//a ba se/ byang lugs la rtsa a wa dang 'ol mo se/ zur lugs ltar na yungs dkar la ngos 'dzin no//zhib tshags/ phran chung gi don/rtsa dang 'phar sgo drag pa/ 'phar rtsa don snod kyi yul lam sgo rnams 'phar drag pa zhes dang mtshog ma drag tu 'phar ba la'ang gomig gi a 'bras/ mig 'bras/hreng hreng bor/ rkang mgo phyir rengs nas bskum mi shes pa/nyad nyod/ bya rmyang mang du byed pa/ rkang lag g.yob pa/ kha chu 'dzag pa ste bshad srol mi 'dra ba gsum yod/tsha gzer/ tsha drod che la gzer zug yod pa/ shes pa bying 'thibs che ba/ shes pa mi gsal/skyug mi shes pa/ lud pa phyir 'phen mi shes pa/gdan shig 'phrug pa/ mal stan lag pas 'phrug pa/rtsam mdog 'khru ba/ zas gang ma zhu ba de'i mdog ltar 'khru ba/rngul 'thibs pa/ rngul chu 'dzag pa/hrem me na ba/ gyong zhing rtsub nyams can zhig go/nal nol/ sha'i skyo ma 'dra ba/mar mer/ sra ba ma yin pa/khong lci ba/ khong snyoms pa dang don mtshungs/btsa' thor/ lhan skyes kyi nad de btsa' dus nas thor ba yod pa'i don/bsen thor/ rgyu 'grul kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sen mo sogs gdon rkyen las byung ba'i thor ba/278

phol nad/ 'phongs nad/hril pa/ rnyid pa'i don/'brub pa/ drag tu 'khru ba/ban bun/ mi gsal ba ste 'di yin 'di min zhes ngos bzung byed mi nus pa'i don/snar ba/ ring bo nar dbyibs can/phrom phrom/ hril hril gyi rnam pa can du chags pa/'dar ba/ myur du g.yo ba/dngangs/ rgyu 'jigs skrag la brten nas sems gyi tshor ba stong seng nge pa/dbyes/ srid zheng gi tshad/snyom/ 'gul bskyod sogs ci yang mi 'dod pa/zla phud/ skyes nas zla ngo lon nas zla thog ste phud btab pa/'on pa/ rna ba'i dbang bos rang gi yul sgra la longs spyod mi nus pa/long ba/ mig gi dbang bos rang gi yul gzugs nyams su mi myong ba/sho re/ mchu yi cha shas nyams te gas srubs lta bu 'byung ba de la zer/dras pa/ gcod pa'am dras pa/nye du/ gnyen bshes kyi 'brel ba yod pa'i ming /sri'u/ skyes nas yun ring ma lon pa'i byis pa ste/skabs 'dir sngar bu ma 'tsho bar 'chi ba'i don/a 'bras ldog mig 'bras gyen du 'khor ba/nyad nyad mang / kha nas zas med bzhin du brdar ba'am mur mur byas pa/279

lam rde/ chu so'i gnas la byung ba'i rde'u nad/phug rde/ lgang ba'i nang nas 'byung ba'i rde'u nad/rgya zhig rgya srubs skrangs pa/sen mo 'drug sen mo rno ba'i cha med pa/bzhi pa/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 byis pa'i lte ba ske la dkris na dbugs 'gags pas nyen che ba yin/( )2 ma'i zungs stobs nyams pa la lte khrag ma ngos su 'ded dgos/( )3 btsas pa'i nad kyis gzir te srog bral ba dang 'dra bar snang ba de zas sman spyod lam sogs snum bcud rigs bsten nas gso dgos/( )4byis pa btsas nas zhag gsum gyi rjes su nu zho ldud pa'i nges pa ma mchis/( )5nu zho dang po babs dus ngo bo ska la mdog ser cung zad 'khru ba'i nus pa yod/( )6byis pa rnams la me drod mi snyoms pa dang glo tshad sogs 'gos nad rigs phal cher skyes nas zla drug gi tshun chad byung ba mang /( ) 7byis pa rnams ni lus brtas pa gtso zhing mgyogs pas zas spyod bsrung ba shin tu gal che/( )8byis pa'i brang rgod tsha ba ni glo yu dang go sbubs brang skyi sogs la gnyan tshad rgyas pa las byung ba'i nad do//( )9byis pa stong skyugs byed pa ni pho ba'i gnas min par gtso bo mchin pa dang mchin drir gnas pa yin/( )10lce gzhung ser ba mngon pa ni mchin pa rgyas pa sogs kyis mkhris pa'i rgyu lam bkag par brten nas rlangs pa yar lce la chags pa yin/( )11 grang 'khru ni zas spyod log pa'am lus 'khyags pa sogs kyis slong /( )280

12nu zho rtsam mdog skya bor 'khru ba ni gtso bo mkhris pa'i rgyun srang bkag pas 'ju stobs zhan pa yin/( )13zho ras nad ni rlung mkhris bad kan gsum las gyur pa yin/( )14sgra ngan zhes pa kha nad kyi rigs shig yin/( )15byis pa'i gre 'gags dang glo tshad glo yu'i tshad pa sogs phan tshun nor nyen che/( )16byis pa rnams kyi mig la thal rdul shor ba sogs kyi skabs lag pas phur ba lta bu mi gtsang bas mig nad sgra ngan bskyed pa yin/( )17skyes ma thag 'dar zhing dngangs na bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan yin/( )18zas dang nu zho 'dres mar spyod pa'i dus na bu la sman dpyad bya dgos/( )19byis pa la gtar ka dang me btsa' sogs yun nas bya mi rung /( )20sha nad bcos pa la sha dang khrag gis tshod ma byas la bsten par bya/( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 byis pa gso ba la dgos pa chen po gang yod dam/lan/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po sku bltams ma thag chos rjes don grub rin chen gyis 'phral yun dgos pa du ma'i ched du byis pa nyer spyod sogs tshul bzhin mdzad dgos na/ phal ba'i skye bo rnams kyis tshul 'di 'bad pas bsten dgos pa smos ma dgos la/ byis pa gso tshul ji bzhin mi shes pa'i skyon gyis mi rigs phal cher blo rtsal dang 'bad rtsol gzugs byad zhan cing / tshe thung nad mang rang bzhin ngan pas mi dge bcu'i las la spyod pa sogs nyes skyon ji snyed cig mi 'dod thog tu babs pas byis pa nyer spyod ji ltar byed tshul gyi rim pa tshul bzhin bslab par bya'o//2byis nad gso ba'i rtsa don gang yin nam/281

lan/ byis pa brda mi 'phrod pas brtag dka' dang / /sman pa sman la 'jigs pas gso ba dka'/ /de phyir de sogs phyi yi rtags las dpag /mthong goms sgo nas gso ba 'bad par bya//zhes pa'o//3byis pa'i nyer spyod las byis pa myur du btsa' ba'i rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ de nas myur du btsa' rtags lus snyom zhing / /dku lhod smad lci mtshang ra rked pa na/ /lto ba chu so na zhing ldang dub byed/ /mtshan bye gcin mang dbang med na zug ldang //zhes pa'o//'byis pa btsa' thabs kyi nyer spyod legs bskus chu ni dron mo blug ces pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ snum legs par bsku ba gtso bo rlung mi 'phel ba'i phyir te/ thur sel rlung sogs 'phel na mngal sgo bkag nas btsa' dka' ba'i rtags 'byung ba dang /chu dron mo blug pa ni bud med sbrum ma lus ngos kyis mi gtsang thams cad bkrus pa ste btsa' dka' ba'i rngul rgyas nas bu'i dbang ngo rnams kyi nang du mi 'gro ba'i phyir ro//5byis pa btsa' dus su bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan gang dag ldan nam/lan/ shis rtags lugs 'byung skyes dang gan rkyal byung / /lte ba stod dkris ngu skad drag po sgrog /spyi bo ring la mgo sra mtshogs ma chung / /skra mtshams mtho la sha gtsang rna ba gshog /kha lces nu ma drag 'jib 'dar zhing dngangs/ /de 'dra mi nor gso sla bkra shis 'byung / /zhes pa'o//6byis pa'i lte ba gcod stangs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ skyes nas skar ma gcig nas gnyis nang du lte ba nas phyir sor gang tsam gyi mtshams su sred bus dam lhod ran par bcings la de nas phyir sor gang gi mtshams nas gcod pa dang / rma kha bkrus te sang ras kyis dril la bzhag pa'o//7byis pa btsas rjes nu zho ldud pa'i dus nam dang de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ btsas nas zhag dang po dang gnyis pa gsum pa'i bar du nu zho mi ster la zhag bzhi bar ldud dgos ste/ snying la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams ni/ /btsas nas kha ni dbye ba'i phyir/ /nyi ma gsum pa'am bzhi ba la/ /bud med la ni nu zho 'byung / /zhes 282

dang / de bzhin deng dus ltar na btsas nas zas skom ci yang mi ster bar 'o ma kho na bsngags par bshad pas nu zho bsnun pa'i dus ni skyes nas skar ma sum cu tsam nas so//8 nu ma bsnun pa'i thabs ci ltar ci yin nam/lan/ nu ma gnyis res mos su bsnun dgos te bsnun pa'i skabs nu tshar bar bya/ 'grangs rjes byis pa bslangs la rgyab tu cung zad brdung ste/ pho ba'i stong cha yong bar byas te 'o ma ldud pa sngon 'gog bya ba'o//9phru gu btsas nas lo gcig gi bar zas spyod sogs lhag par gzab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skyes nas nyi ma nyer brgyad kyi tshun la byis pa rnams la nad mang ba dang 'chi ba'i nyen che ste/ lo dang po'i shi tshad kyi sum cha'i gnyis ni skyes pa'i zhag nyer brgyad tsam dang / lhag par du bdun phrag dang por nyen che ste shi tshad de brgya cha'i bdun cu'i yan zin/ skyes nas lo gcig tshun dang lhag par du zla ba drug gi tshun la byis pa rnams la me drod mi snyoms pa dang glo tshad sogs 'gos nad kyi rigs mang la shi tshad kyang mtho bas gnyid nyal ba dang zas skom bshang gci dus ltar du byas nas gtsang spra la do snang byed dgos/10byis pa'i lus zungs gso zhing stobs skyed phyir zas sman bsten tshul ci ltar yin nam/lan/ sngar bshad 'o ma sbyin bya zhing / /kha zas yang dang brtas byed byin/ /zhes dang / drod skyed pa'i sman dang 'bras yos skyo ma sogs sbyin par bya ba dang / shin tu drag po'i nad ma gtogs/ /rno sman bkru sman la sogs spang / /zhes mdor na skabs 'dir byis pa brtas mgyogs la/ don lnga snod drug gi nus pa dang zungs bdun me drod sogs 'gyur sla bas bde srung ste/ phyis mi 'byung ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/11byis pa so skyes pa'i nad rtags dang go rim ji ltar yin nam/lan/ byis pa so skyes tshe tsha ba cung zad rgyas pa dang / mchil ma mang du 'gro la kha chu bzhur pa/ gnyid med par yer ba/ sems 'tshig pa lus kyi stod smad kun tu mi 283

na ba ni gcig kyang med pa'o//12byis pa la nad 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gang dang gang bstan yod dam/lan/ rgyu ni rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa la/ /rkyen ni ma yi rkyen dang bu rkyen gnyis//zhes pa'o//13 rgyu nyes gsum las byis nad bskyed tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ rgyu rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gsum la rkyen gyis bsgyur sla ba dang bsgyur ba'i tshe dar ma dang mi 'dra ba'i dbang shes dang tshor ba me drod 'ju stobs sogs kyi ngo bo mtshan nyid de nyid bad kan gyi cha nas chu khams 'phel zad la rag las shing zungs bdun smin pa la gegs byed pa'o//14spyir byis par nad phog pa'i mngon tshul ji 'dra 'byung ngam/lan/ spyi rtags rtag tu ngu las nar shes bya/ /gang nar 'ju dang der mnan na ba dang / /mig 'byed dka' zhing ngo nag dang ga 'gag/rtsed mo mi rtse dbugs mi bde ba dang / /skad gnya' 'khun zhing sen mo rno ba'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /15 byis pa ngu drags pa dang rlan drags pa sogs spyod lam gyis nad slong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ ngu drags pa ni byis pa rnams kyi glo ba dang mgrin pa sogs brtas tshar med pas de dag gi nad bskyed pa dang dbugs 'gags te brgyal ba/ snying rlung langs te dran pa 'thor ba sogs 'byung nyen che ba dang / rlan drags na rims dang pags nad sogs 'byung sla ba dang tshigs 'gyur sla bas so/ /16 byis nad slong ba'i kha zas gang dag yin nam/lan/ zas dang skom gyi rigs tsha ba shas che'am yang na bsil ba shas che ba dang / ma goms pa/ mi 'phrod pa/ mngar ba zos drags pa/ ma tshos pa/ rul ba sogs so/ /17 byis pa la lhan skyes kyi nad 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mngal gnas kyi skabs su ma'i zas spyod sogs rkyen gang rung la brten nas ma yi nyes gsum 'phel zad 'khrugs pa'i nad lte ba dang nu ma'i lam nas bu la 284

lhung ba'am yang na mi rgyud kyi nad rgyun mar byung ba byis pa btsas pa'i skabs nyid nas nad can du skyes pa yin no/ /18byis pa'i glo bur nad ces pa'i go don ci yin nam/lan/ glo bur zhes pa ni ma rkyen las byung ba min par byis pa rang gi zas spyod kyi rkyen gyis kha bsgyur nas byung ba ste/ skyes pa'i dus na nad med kyang skyes nas glo bur du byung ba'i nad la'o/ /19ma rlung bu la shor nas rna ba 'on pa'i nad gang dag yin nam/lan/ ma rlung bu la shor nas 'on pa ni/ byis pa rnams la byung ba mang ste/ so skyes pa'i dus rna bar na zug 'byung ba mang ba dang / rnag 'dzag nas rim gyis mi thos par 'gyur la/ de min mngal rlung las gyur pa'i nad rna ba 'khums pa can dang /mngal gnas skabs su byung ba sha 'dzer can gyi rna ba'i nad sogs 'byung ba'ang yod/ /20glo nad tsha gzer dang theng bo'i nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/lan/ tsha gzer rtsa grims 'thims che gting nas 'khun/ /dbugs thung glo lu kha mig btsums nas lu/ /lud pa 'gog la snying brdungs skyug mi shes/ /thang bo glo nad rnying ba rlung ldan te/ /drag tu lu zhing lud pa 'gog rgyu med/ /mig dang mchu skrangs lce rnyil dkar ba'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /21 byis pa la mchin nad byung ba'i rtags mtshan ci ltar yin nam/lan/ spyi rtags tsha grang gnyis po gang babs kyang / /mig sngo gyen ldog byad dang mthil bzhi ser/ /lus lci rngam pa ring thung ldang dub na/ /'khun zhing snga dro bde la dgong dus na/ /mchin pas pho ba mnan pas 'khru skyugs byed/ /ces pa'o/ /22 tsha 'khru dang grang 'khru so sor khyad par gyi rtags gang dag yod dam/lan/ 'khru ba'i nad la tsha 'khru grang 'khru gnyis/ /tsha 'khru dbugs thung rtsa dang 'phar sgo drag /bzhin snum phyi tshad che la shes pa 'thibs/ /'khru mdog dmar ser ljang gu dud khur 'khru/ /grang 'khru dbang bo gsal la 'phar sgo dal/ /'khru mdog nu zho rtsam mdog skya bor 'khru/ /zhes pa'o/ /285

23 byis par 'khru nad 'byung sla ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ byis pa rnams la ni pho ba'i nus pa dang chags grub sogs brtas tshar med pas pho ba'i chu skyur dang / 'ju byed gyi rigs mi 'dang ba'am nus pa zhan pa zas la goms med pa sogs kyis 'khru nad 'byung ba'o/ /24byis par skyug nad 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ byis pa'i pho ba chung zhing 'phred la chags pa dang ldir zhom la mid pa 'brel mtshams gnyom pa/ rgyu mgor 'brel mtshams dam pas skyug sla ba yin no//25 skyugs nad bskyed pa'i rkyen gang dag yin nam/lan/ mid pa 'byar la zangs tshags chung ba/ pho ba gcus zhing rgyu ma 'gul mi legs pa/ gsher mas rgyu mgo btums pa'am gzhang dam cing 'gag pa/ mkhal tshil rgyas pa/ mchin dri rlugs pa/ klad chu rgyas pa/ mkhal ma'i tshang tshing la chu bsags pa/ klad khrag shor ba sogs dang / de bzhin klad tshad dang / rgyu tshad/ chu so'i gnyan tshad/ glo yu dang glo ba'i tshad pa sogs kyis slong ba yin/26byis nad gre 'gags de glo tshad dang glo yu'i tshad pa sogs su mi nor ba'i rtags ci yod dam/lan/ skad 'dzer ba dang kha chu mang ba tsam gyis gre ba 'gags pa'i nad yin min brtag dka' ste/ 'dir gtso bo glo lu khyi skad 'dra ba/ lus rngul skabs mgrin sgra 'ong ba/ dbugs 'byin rngub dka' ba/ lte ba dmar skrangs sogs 'byung ba ni gre ba 'gags par nges so /27byis par nad phog skabs rna rtsa la mngon tshul mi 'dra ba gang dag yod dam/lan/ brtag yul byis pa de'i rna ba'i mdun phyogs nas nyi 'od dam glog 'od sogs la gtad nas byis pa'i rna rgyab la blta bar bya ste/ de yang rna ba g.yon par rtsa ris gsum mngon pa'i gong ma snying rtsa dang / bar ma mtsher rtsa/ 'og ma mkhal g.yon gyi rtsa yin pa dang bu mo la glo snying go ldog dgos par gsungs/ rtsa de dag las glo rtsa dang snying rtsa mchin rtsa gsum po gang 'dzings pa na/ nad yod rtags yin la gong 'og bar gsum gyi rtsa bskams nas mi gsal na 'chi ba'i rtsa yin pas 'tsho ba dka' ba 286

dang / rna rtsa de'i mdog dmar nag dang rtsa rgyud sbom pa yin na tsha ba dang / ser skya dang rtsa rgyud phra ba'am stong na grang ba/ phan tshun ban bun du 'dzings na gdon rtsa dang / yang rna ba dang lag pa'i mdzub rtsa dang po gug na 'chi ba'i ltas dang / bar ba gug na gso dka' ba/ tha ma gug na nad gzhi yod tsam pa/ rtsa chad 'dug na 'chi ba'i rtags dang / khyad par du snying rtsa chad na 'chi ba'i ltas nges can yin la/ de ldog rna rtsa nyid shing lo rgyas pa ltar byung na nad med pa'i rtags no/ /28spyir byis nad bcos pa la dus skabs kyi khyad par dang thun mong min pa'i zas sman gang dag bsten dgos sam/lan/ spyir byis pa la sman bcos byed pa'i dus skabs gsum yod de/ byis pas nu zho 'thung ba'i dus su sman dpyad kyi bcos na byis pa de'i ma la bya ba dang /zas dang nu zho 'dres mar spyod pa'i dus su ma bu gnyis ka la sman dpyad bya ba/ zas kho na za ba'i dus su bu la sman dpyad bya dgos pa/ de yang zas ni yang zhing pho bar 'ju sla ba'i rigs sbyin par bya ba dang /sman la zhi byed dang sbyong byed gnyis las zhi byed sman ni nus pa bzang zhing 'jam la khong du 'ju sla ba'i rigs ka ra dang bu ram gyis kha blangs te mngar shas che bar bsten pa dang / dpyad du me btsa' sran ma phos pa tsam btab bo//drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1de nas bu skyes sgra dang ni/ /chu dang rlung gis dga' ba bskyed/ /btsas pa'i nad kyis gzir ba yis/ /srog bral 'dra ba slar gso bya/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ bud med bu btsal ba myong goms kyi btsir lugs dang 'dug stangs sogs bslab nas byis pa btsas ma thag bdag gi bu khyod snying gi nang nas skyes pa yin pa dang / lo brgya phrag tu 'tsho la ston dus brgya mthong ba/ tshe ring zhing nad med bkra shis bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog bcas skye ba'i smon tshig brjod pa dang /btsas ma thag tu bu'i lus chus yi bkrus la/ btsa' dka' bas ma'i dbang bo shor 287

pa la chu grang gdong la rgyag pa sogs bkru ba dang rlung bsil g.yab dag gis dga' ba bskyed la/ btsas pa'i nad kyis mnar ba te srog phral ba dang 'dra ba snang ba de slar drod bcud can gyi zas sman dang spyod lam sogs bsten nas lus srog legs par gso bar bya'o//2byis pa'i mig la nyi ma'i zer mi btang / /yon por mi bzung bslang ba sngas pa min/ /mi dang bya gcan 'go nad 'jigs skrag bsrung / /skabs su bsku mnye nyi mas ran par bsro/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ ma dang bu rdzi sogs kyis byis pa snyor skyong byed pa'i spyod lam ni 'di ltar bya dgos te/ byis pa mal du bsnyal skabs sogs su mig la nyi zer phog na shed bor 'gro bas nyi ma'i zer mi btang ba dang / rkang mthil dang mgo'i mtshog ma me dang nyi 'od sogs kyis bsregs na mig mi gsal bar 'gyur bas grang reg gis mnar du mi 'jug pa dang / yon por bzung na sgur por 'gro ba dang gyen du bslang ba snga drags na mchin thag chags tshar med pas mchin pa mar 'bab pa'i nyen che ba/ yang na thab kyi me dang chu 'gram lta bu me chu'i 'jigs pa dang / sha la rngam pa'i bya dang gcan gzan sogs kyi 'jigs pa/ rims nad sogs 'gos mched che ba'i nad rigs bcas dus rgyun du bsrung zhing 'jigs skrag bskul pa'i gnod tshe sogs nam yang mi yong bar gzab dgos/ de yang mtshams su bsku mnye bya zhing me dang nyi ma'i 'od kyis ran par bsro bas lus zungs nad med tshe ring bar rgyas par 'gyur bar bya'o//3 byis pas nu zho ma nus pa'i gong du nu zho brtag tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ dkar yol sogs snod gtsang ma gnyis kyi nang du chu blugs la/ de'i steng du byis pas nu ma ma nus pa'i sngon du nu zho bzhos la nyung re blugs pas/ kha la lding ba'am chu dang 'o ma gcig tu 'dres na nu zho skyon med pas byis pa yang 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang / chu dang 'o ma gnyis ma 'dres par phrom phrom du 'dug na lus srog la gnod pa'o/ de bzhin nu zho chu yi gting du hril gyis song na na ba'i rtags dang / chu spu ka ba tshugs na mi 'chi ba tsam/ snod gnyis ka'i nang gi nu zho chu dang 'dres par chu 288

yi zhabs su song na byis pa'i srog mi 'tsho ba'i rtags/ snod gcig gi nang gi 'o chu gnyis gcig tu 'dres shing / gcig gi nang gi 'o chu ma 'dres pa'am gcig gi nang gi nu zho kha ru lding zhing / gcig shos nang gi nu zho gting du song na'ang byis pa de ni gso dka' ba'i rtags yin/ yang nu zho chu yi kha ru lding na rlung nad dang / bar du lding na tsha ba/ 'og tu lding na grang nad yod pa'i rtags bcas yin pas/ byis pas nu zho de 'thungs na nad de dang de bskyed par 'gyur ba'o//bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 ga 2 ga 3 kha 4kha 5 ga 6 kha 7 kha 8 ga9 ka 10 ka 11 kha 12 ka 13 ga 14kha 15 nga16 kha 17 kha 18 ga 19 kha 20 khaganyis pa/mang 'dems/1 ka kha 2 ka kha ga 3 ka kha 4gaka kha 5ka kha ga 6 ka kha7 kha ga nga 8 ka kha ga ca 9 ka ga nga ca 10 kha ga 11 kakha ga12 ka ga nga 13 ka nga 14ka ga 15 ka kha 16 kha ga17 ga nga 18 ka kha 19 ka ga 20 kha ga ngabazhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 tsu 2 ྾ 3 ྾ 4 5 6tsu 7 8tsu 9 gyo 10 tsu 11 gyo 12 du 13 ྾ 14྾15tsu 16 ྾ 17 ྾ 18 ྾ 19 ྾ 20 tsu289

sa bcad drug pa/ mo nad gso ba/ dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 mo nad 'byung ba'i rgyu gtso bo ni/( )ka zas spyod/ kha zla mtshan/ ga rlung / nga sngon las/2 zla mtshan 'byams na gtar dgos pa'i rtsa ni/( )ka ru thung / kha long rtsa/ ga rgyab rtsa drug 'dus/ nga rtse chung /3 bud med la skyes pa las lhag pa'i nad ni/( )ka so gnyis/ kha nyi shu/ ga zhe gsum/ nga zhe lnga/4mo nad phal ba la mtshan ma'i nad sogs dbye ba/( )ka bu ma phyin sogs dgu/ kha khrag ma chod sogs lnga/ ga nad gzhug lus pa bcas bdun/ nga dug thabs bcas brgyad/5rgyu ma'i khrag tshabs kyi rtags gtso bo ni/( )ka snying 'phyo chu so na zhing skyug snyam byed/ kha rgyu ma tsha zhing gtub snyam byed/ ga 'doms g.ya' mo mtshan tsha ba/ nga mgo bo na zhing zla mtshan mang ba/6spyir bud med kyi zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i dus ni/( )ka lo bco lnga lon nas 'dzag kha lo bcu gnyis lon nas 'dzagag lo bcu drug lon nas 'dzag nga lo nyi shu lon nas 'dzag7khrag tshabs bcu bcos pa la ( )ka bsil drod/ kha drod bcud/ ga bsil/ nga drod/8 rlung tshabs kyi dbye ba ni/( )ka drug kha dgu/ ga gnyis/ nga bcu/9nu ma'i khrag tshabs dpyad kyis bcos pa la( )290

ka byin gzhug gtar ba dang tshigs pa bcu ba mes bsregs/ kha rgyab rtsa drug 'dus gtar ba dang tshigs pa gsum pa mes bsregs/ ga long rtsa dang rgyu rtsa gtar/ nga long rtsa dang lug gzhug gnyis gtar/10 mtshan dbrag g.ya' zhing tsha la rked so man chad kyi rus pa na ba ni/( )ka nu tshabs/ kha mkhal ma'i khrag tshabs/ ga khrag tshabs gor ba/nga mkhal ma'i rlung tshabs/11 khrag tshabs bcu dang rlung tshabs drug ni/( )ka zas spyod gnyis log pa las byung ba/ kha zla mtshan chu ser rlung gis bsgril ba las byung ba/ ga zla mtshan chu ser rlung gis byer ba las byung ba/nga zla mtshan 'gag pa las byung ba/12 mngal gyi srin bu gnyis ni/( )ka ma ru tse dang khrag srin rkang med/ kha a so dang bar ba ta/ ga.a so dang rgya skyegs/ nga ma ru tse dang a so/13 rgyu ma'i rlung tshabs kyi rtags la/( )ka rgyu ma bsdams shing zla mtshan 'byung ba/ kha rgyu ma sbo zhing ldang dub byed pa/ ga rus pa khol shing snying mi bde ba/ nga rgyu ma 'gag nas dri ma mi thon pa/14mo nad bye brag skabs kyi rtsa nad la dbye ba/( )ka bcu/ kha brgyad/ ga drug/ nga bcu drug/15sha skran bem po'i nad ni/( )ka bu mo chung chung skyes pa dar ma dang 'phrad de mngal 'grams las byung ba/kha bud med gzhon nu ma skyes pa mang bos 'dod pa spyad pa las byung ba/ga 'khrig pa mang bo spyad drags pa las byung ba/ nga rlung las gyur pa/16mngal gyi srin bu langs pa'i nad ni/( )ka grang ba'i nad/ kha tsha ba'i nad/ ga tsha grang snyoms pa'i nad/291

nga khrag nad/17bu btsas rjes nad lhag 'dril nas na zug skyes na/( )ka byi sa'i dugs bya zhing mngal bshal bya ba/ kha zas dro ba dang bsil sman gtong ba/ ga sman bsil ba dang zas dro ba bsten pa/ nga drod bcud bsten pa/18 mngal srin khros pa'i rtags la/( )ka nu ma rgyas la sems 'phyo ba/ kha mngal skrang shing chu ser 'dzag pa/ga khog sbo zhing 'ur 'khrog 'byung ba/ nga lus kyi sha bem por byed pa/19 mngal nad phal cher bskyed pa'i rgyu ni/( )ka zla mtshan/ kha rlung / ga zas spyod/ nga sngon las/20 mcher ba'i khrag tshabs nad la gtar ba'i rtsa ni/( )ka rtse chung / kha ru thung g.yon pa/ ga snod ka nga ru thung g.yas pa/gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 pho mo gnyis skye 'gyur gang la rag las/( )ka sngon las/ kha pha ma'i khu khrag ga lte ba bsgyur/ ngadus/ ca gdon/2 skyes pa las lhag pa'i mo nad kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni/( ) ka nu ma/ kha mngal/ ga zla mtshan/ nga sngon las/ carlung /3 mo nad spyi la dbye na/( )ka khrag tshabs/ kha rnying tshabs/ ga nu tshabs/ nga rlung tshabs/ ca mchin tshabs/4mo nad rlung tshabs byung mang ba'i rten ni/( )292

ka lo na gzhon pa/ kha lo na rgas pa/ ga lus stobs zhan pa/nga lus stobs bzang ba/ ca byis pa/5mo nad khrag tshabs kyi rtags ni/( )ka rked so rus pa na ba/ kha mngal 'dzag 'khyil dang rnag tu 'gyur ba/ga rgyu zhabs tsha 'brab byed pa/ nga lus grang la sha mthing bar du na ba/ ca glo lu ba/6rlung tshabs spyi'i bcos thabs la ( )ka sha bcud/ kha chang bcud/ ga sman bcud/ nga rtsa gsher/ ca lto gsher/7bya bra zhes pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/( )ka phug ron brun/ kha grog shing / ga 'ba' cha/ nga sbyang tsher ca li shi/8 mngal 'khri ba'i nad kyi rtags ni/( )ka sgyud skyur tshig pa za ba/ kha zas skom sna tshogs 'dod pa/ gastong skyugs byed la dang ga zhan pa/ nga gnyid la dga' ba/ ca pho ba sgreg pa/9 dmar bo gsum gyi sman mar zhes pa'i dmar po gsum ni/( )ka tshos/ kha btsod/ ga 'bri mog nga rgya skyur/ca tsan dan/10 mtshan ma'i nad la spang dgos pa'i zas spyod ni/( )ka nyin gnyid/ kha rta bong bya sha ga drag dal mi bya/ ngazas skom bcud can/ ca bsam blo mang du gtong ba/11 skye rgyun gcod thabs la/( )ka dus gcod/ kha gtan gcod/ ga bsrung ba/ nga gnas skabs gcod pa/ ca ma nges pa/12 rlung tshabs sel ba'i chang bcud dag ni/( )293

ka sbrang dang bu ram chang / kha mar chang / ga rus chang / ngagaze ma'i chang / ca nas chang /13 mo nad spyi'i phyi yul gyi nad rtags ni/( )ka kha skam la lus nyams chung ba/ kha khrag dang wu ba chu ser 'dzag pa/ga brla rked na ba/ nga dri chu sri la snyi ba/ ca glo lu yang yang rgyag pa/14bu ma phyin pa'i nad la ni/( )ka gson po/ kha gshin po/ ga nal bu/ nga ya nga can/ca dme can/15bu btsa' ma 'dod pa'i 'gal rkyen ni/( )ka nang snod nas ma gyur pa/ kha bar rus mig nas ma thon pa/ gaphyi sha lpags kyi mig nas ma thon pa/ nga nal ba dbyung ba/ ca gang yang ma yin pa/16mo nad dug thabs slong ba'i rkyen ni bu btsas rjes su/( )ka sha mar rnying ba zos pa/ kha nyin mo gnyid log pa/ ga drag shul bya ba/ nga zho dar sogs bsil zas bsten drags pa/ ca rtsol ba bcag pa/17mngal nad mkhris gyur gyi zla mtshan gyi mdog ni/( )ka ser ba/ kha nag po/ ga sngo ba/ nga dmar ba/ caljang khu/18 mngal nad bad gyur gyi rtags/ ( )ka g.ya' ba/ kha ro smad grang ba/ ga sbyin bag 'dzag pa/ ngadri ma che ba/ ca tshor med bem pa/19 mo nad dug thabs byung ba'i nyes skyon ni bu btsas rjes/ ( )ka sha mar rnying ba bros pa/ kha bya ba drag shul sogs byas pa/ gaganyid log pa/ nga snum bcud bsten drags pa/294

20 mngal 'khri ba'i dus su zas spyod gang dag 'dzem dgos/ ( )ka drag shul/ kha rlan gnas/ ga rta bong bya/ nga gang 'dod zas rigs spang / ca sman rigs tshod zin/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/khrag tshabs/ mo nad gsar ba ste bud med gzhon nu dang dar ma'i rigs la 'byung mang ba'i nad/rlung tshabs/ mo nad rnying ba ste lo na rgas pa dang lus stobs zhan pa'i bud med la 'byung mang ba'i nad/tshabs nad/ 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa'i bud med kyi zla mtshan lus la byer ba las byung ba'i nad kyi ming /za khu/ mo nad kyi skabs 'dir zla mtshan dkar bor gokhol zhing na ba/ mtshams mi 'jog par lhang lhang na ba/tsha 'brab/ lus la tsher ma'am lcag gis brab pa lta bu'i na zug ldang ba'i mngon tshul/'brum/ lus la 'brum pa 'byung ba'i gnyan rims kyi ming /sha mthang bar du na/ sha dang pags pa'i phyi rtsi'am bar du rtse shur rgyag pa'i don/tsha gzer/ tsha drod che zhing gzer zug yod pa/sri mtshan ngan pa/ rtags mtshan ngan pa/dkar khra men/ gzi mig dgu pa/chu so/ lte 'og lgang pa'i gnas su bzhed pa zhig dang pho mo'i mtshan ma'i chu gtong ba'i kha la bzhed pa gnyis/de ba dā ru/ nyag rong tsan dan dang shug pa tsan dan no/ /bshul sha sgal ba'i phyi shul chen po can shul chags te rta bong sogs rmig zlum gyi sha'o/ /295

ling tog thog mar mig lcibs kyi nang ngos dang mig 'bras kyi steng du 'brum chung 'byung zhing na zug shin tu che ba'i mig gnad/gor ba/ mngal nang du zla mtshan 'khyil te gor gor gyi rnam pa can du chags pa/chu bur can/ mngal du chu skran chu bur ltar chags shing chu ser phyir babs nas zla mtshan chu ser 'dzag pa'i nad/khrag skran hrem po/ khrag ro 'dril bas bu chags pa ltar hrom po'o//pho span rengs pa/ bu mo gzhon nu skyes pa mang po phrad nas spyad drags pas mngal du dreg pa chags pa'o//skran ro nag po/ bu btsas rjes la khrag ro 'dril ba'o//rtsa skran ling ba/ bu btsas rjes rtsa 'grams nas rtsa la skran chags pa'o/ /sa bon skran/ skyes pa'i sa bon mngal du 'dril ba'o/ /khrag skran za khu/ bu ro mngal du lus pas skrangs la hrem pa bu mi chags shing pho ba sbo zhing 'khrog pa'o//nying lo/ mngal gnas lus can gyi chags sdang gi 'du shes kyi ming /gshin po/ mngal nas bu shi ba phyir len pa/nal bu/ rigs rgyud gcig par gnyen sgrig pa las byung ba'i bu dang pha ngos bzung med pa'i bu phrug la zer/bu rtsa/ rkang ba'i long rtsa dang byin gzhug la goza ma/ skabs 'dir bud med la gobazhi pa/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 zas spyod dman lhag log pa dang chu ser 'dus pa las mo nad bskyed mi thub/( )2rlung tshabs ni mo nad rnying ba ste lo na rgas pa dang lus stobs zhan pa'i bud 296

med la 'byung mang /( )3mo nad skabs kyi za khu zhes pa ni rnag dang chu ser rtag tu 'dzag pa'i don yin/( )4rus chang gis rlung nad kun sel zhing rus pa'i rlung tshabs 'don pa yin/( )5 bu mo gzhon pa skyes mang phrad nas spyad drags pas mngal du dregs pa chags pa de la sha skran bem po/( )6bad kan las gyur pa zla mtshan mang la g.ya' zhing za 'phrug byed cing ro smad grang la zug chung zhing sbyin bag nal bor 'dzag ( )7khrag skran za khu ni bu ro mngal du lus pas skrangs la hrem pa bu mi chags pa pho ba sbo zhing 'khrog pa'o/( )8bu mi 'byung ba'i nad ni gnyen sgrig nas lo gsum yan phyin rung mngal mi chags pa de'o//( )9 zla mtshan dus kyi nad de ni mang che ba de sngon byis pa btsa' ma myong ba'i bud med khag cig la zla mtshan bab la nye ba dang / yang na zla mtshan 'bab pa'i skabs sam rjes de la rgyu zhabs dang rked pa sogs na zug chen po gtong ba'i nad cig red/( )10btsas rjes khrag shor ba ni byis pa btsas rjes kyi nyin zhag 'ga'i nang khrag mang po shor ba de la go ( )11byis pa btsas rjes mngal du nad lhag 'dril nas na zug ldang dub can langs pa'i nad la mo nad bang tshad kyang zer/( )12bu btsas tsan dan bco brgyad gyis bud med rims kyis btab pa'i nad dang btsas rjes tshad pa skyes pa sel bar byed pa'o/ /( )13mo nad dug thabs rlung tshad bsdongs pa'i nad sman gyis tshad pa gcog pa dang bcud kyis rlung sna glan dgos pa'o/ /( )14rmen skran mkhal sked 'chad snyam byed dang mtshang ra mi theg rgyu chu sdom par 297

byed/( )15dran pa mi gsal zhing mgo 'khor rna ba 'ur ba bcas snying la rlung tshabs zhugs pa'i rtags yin/( )16bsem se'i skran nad 'di thog mar nad rtags gsal po med rung cher rgyas pa'i skabs su rgyu zhabs sbos nas rdog rdog yod pa dang bcir gnon byas na gcin kha snyi ba sogs kyi mngon chul yod/( )17mngal 'khri nas zla ba bdun tshun chad byis pa btsa' shor byung na gson mi thub/( )18byis pa btsas ma nyid nas khrag mang po shor na phal cher sha ma'i lhag ro lus pa'i skyon yod/( )19 gnyen sgrig byas nas lo gnyis 'gor rjes da dung mngal mi chags pa ni bu mi 'byung ba'i nad yin/ ( )20byis pa btsas rjes ngal dub byung ba dang glo langs dang bshang btsir drags pa sogs kyis bu snod lug pa'i 'gal rkyen byung /( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 mo nad bzhi bcu'i grangs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ mngal nad lnga dang rtsa nad bcu drug dang / /skran nad dgu dang srin bu nad rigs gnyis/ /phal ba'i nad brgyad bzhi bcu tham pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /2za ma mo lus thob pa'i rgyu gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ spyir sngon gyi las dang nyon mongs 'dod chags kyi dbang gis pho mor snang ba las/ bsod nams las nyon gyi dbang gis thob pa yin te/ sngon las nyon mongs dang pha ma'i khu khrag mang nyung / dus ste zla mtshan 'dzag rjes kyi zhag grangs bcu gnyis po/ lte bsgyur/ de bzhin rtsa'i dbang bcas las thob pa yin no/ /3 mo nad spyi'i rtsa chu'i nad rtags ji ltar yin nam/298

lan/ mo nad rtsa ni chu ser rtsa yin pas/ /dal dang mkhrang 'bur rgyu ba dka' ba ste/ /legs par brtag pas rtsa smad zhar zhing nar/ /mngal tshad skyes na khrag tshabs me ltar 'bar/ /mngal srin zhugs na ma zhu ba dang 'dra/ /legs par brtag pas rtsa dpangs gzhan las dma'/ /mo nad chu ni nges med bu snod las/ /rul dang rnyogs dang kha mdog sna tshogs pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ / 4bud med kyi gnas tshul khyad par du bstan pa'i nang nas zla mtshan zhes par go don ci yod dam/lan/ bud med la dmar cha'i snyigs ma khrag tu gyur nas zla mtshan zhes bya ba zla ba re re bzhin mngal sgo nas 'bab par 'gyur ba ste/ zla ba re bzhin dkar phyogs dus/ /mngal kha 'byed pa'i rtags mtshan du/ /mngal khrag snyigs ma rlung stobs kyis/ /'dzag par zla mtshan zhes su bshad/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /5bud med bcu gnyis lon nas lnga bcu'i bar du zla mtshan 'ba' pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ zla mtshan de'ang bu mo lo bcu gnyis ma lon pa'i gong du dwangs ma rnams rang rang gi gso bskyed kyi bya bas bsam se'ur gsog pa'i skabs med cing / lo lnga bcu thal nas 'byung ba nyams pa'i dbang gis gsog pa'i rgyu med pa'i don gyis mi 'dzag go/6ci zhig la mo nad rlung tshabs zer/lan/ rlung tshabs ni khrag tshabs nad yun 'gor te rlung dang bsdongs pa rus pa rnams 'khol zhing na ba de'o/ /7bsam se'u zhes pa'i gzugs dbyibs nus pa sogs ji ltar yin nam/lan/ bsam se'u de ni sgal tshigs bcu gsum pa'i 'og na gnas pa ste/ rtsa chen gnyis dang 'brel ba las rtsa chen de gnyis kyang bu snod g.yas g.yon dang phan tshun 'brel/ de'i gzugs dbyibs che chung nges pa med cing / gcig nyid du mi gnas par chung ba'i skabs su sha'i men bu tsam dang / che zhing khu khrag khengs pa'i skabs su bya'i sgong nga tsam pa/ byed las ni lus zungs kyi mthar phyin pa'i dwangs ma 299

khu khrag de nyid gsog pa'i snod byed pa'o// 8 tshabs nad bcu drug po de gang dang gang yin nam/lan/ khrag tshabs glo snying mchin mcher mkhal mkhris dang / /rgyu ma 'o ma nu ma gor pa bcu/ /rlung tshabs mgo dang rus pa snying mkhal ma/ /pho ba rgyu ma'i tshabs dang drug tu bshad/ /ces pa'o//9 rtsa nad byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ bud med kyi zla mtshan dang lhan du rlung gis gtor nas lus kyi gnas kun tu byer ba las byung ba'i rtsa nad ces bya'o/ /10 mngal skran ci ltar chags pa yin nam/lan/ bud med kyi mngal du zla mtshan chu ser dang lhan du rlung gis bsgril ba las byung ba'i mngal skran rigs dgu chags pa ste/ zla mtshan chu ser rlung gis bsgril pa las/ /tshabs skran zhes bya dbye ba dgu ru 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /11 tshabs nad ces brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ bud med kyi lus la lo zla du mar gnas shing lus zungs nyams par byed pa dang lus sems la mi bde bar byed pa'i nad tshabs chen po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /12 tshabs nad dang tshabs skran gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ zla mtshan de nyid chu ser dang rlung gis bskyed de rtsa nang don snod sogs la byer ba las rtsa nad ces bya ba'i tshabs nad dang / zla mtshan de chu ser dang bcas rlung gis mngal du bsgril ba la tshabs skran zhes bya'o/ /13 khrag tshabs gor ba zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mngal du zla mtshan 'gyangs nas zho ltar chags te skabs 'gar bu snod nang du gor gor lta bu zhig 'dril pa'i nyams byed pas na ming yang de ltar du grags so/ /14ci 'dra zhig la nu tshabs zer/lan/ nu mar gnyan kha rgyas te skrangs pa'i nad mang che ba byis pa thog mar btsas pa'i bud med 'o ma ster mkhan gyi gras la phog pa zhig go/300

15 ci zhig la bu mi 'byung ba'i nad zer/lan/ bu mi 'byung ba'i nad ni gnyen sgrig byas nas lo shas phyin rung mngal mi chags pa la zer ba dang / de yang dper na sa bon 'dra ba'i khu ba dang / zhing sa dang 'dra ba'i ma'i khams dmar ram bu snod sogs phyogs gnyis kyi rgyu rkyen la rag las yod do/ /16mngal 'chi nad rtags ci ltar yin nam/lan/ mngal 'khri ba'i mngon tshul rnams yal 'gro zhing rgyu zhabs dang nu ma che ru 'gro mtshams bzhag nas chung du 'gro ba/ byis pa'i 'gul bskyod dang snying sgra yal ba/ da dung 'chi skyon nas rgyun ring phyin pa yin na sbrum ma bang chad pa dang / tsha ba rgyag pa/ grang shum rgyag pa/khrag dri ngan pa kha ba/ rgyu zhabs la 'then zug rgyag pa sogs kyi mngon tshul yod pa red/17mngal srin gyis skye sgo g.ya' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ de ni grang ba'i snyigs ma gsang ba'i sgo nas dus bar med du 'dzag pa dang skye sgo'i gseb tu srin bu chags yod pas g.ya' ba 'byung ngo / /18 mngal bsrung ba'i thabs bya dgos don ci/lan/ ma'i lus zungs la gnod pa'i zas spyod 'ga'i lus zungs zad na mngal 'chi ba'am yang na rlung 'phel ba'i dbang gis mngal gyi nang du skam par 'gyur ba'i phyir gang dag rigs brgyud 'dod pa rnams kyis 'bad pas bsrung dgos so/ /19 mngal gnas byis pa'i sdod lugs la brtag pa'i thabs gang yin nam/lan/ spyir mngal gnas byis pa'i sdod lugs la brtag thabs rnam pa lnga yod pa ste/ dang po bu snod kyi mthil zhabs su byis pa'i mgo bo dang phung sogs cha shas gang yod myang nas blta ba dang / gnyis pa mdo rus 'brel mtshams su myang ste rgyu zhabs g.yas g.yon nas mgo rus 'tshol ba dang mi rnyed tshe 'phred nyal yin min brtag pa/ gsum pa sbrum ma'i g.yas g.yon 'khod snyoms yin min la brtag nas sgal gzhung dang rkang lag 'tshol ba dang / 'phred nyal yin na rgyu zhabs kyi zhogs 301

gcig la mgo bo dang gcig la rkang pa yod pa tshor thub/ bzhi ba mgo bo tshang sgam nang du babs tshar ba yin na mdzub mos tshang sgam nang du tshud gang thub byas te brtag pas shes/ lnga ba skyes mi thub pa zhes pa'i chags tshul la brtag zhib byed mkhan lhag par che ba dang dbus dma' la g.yas g.yon gnyis mtho ba'i dbyibs su byung ba bcas so/ /20mngal nad ma lus skyed pa'i rgyu gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen gzhi mthun ni nyal bo mang du spyad pa dang / khrag 'dzag pa'i dus dang bu btsas pa'i rjes la zas dang spyod lam log pa rnams kyis mngal gyi nad ma lus pa skyed par byed pa'o//21bu btsas rjes bu rogs ma thon na thabs ji ltar bya dgos sam/lan/ btsas nas chu tshod phyed ka song rung bu rogs ma thon na/ ri bong ril ma dang rgya tshwa rgya ru rmongs gzhob rnams mang dang sbyar ba btang la/ khyi rlig rgya tshwa thug pas nges par thon srid pa dang / sman sbyor zhi byed drug pa dang zhi byed bcu gcig gtong zhing rlung bdug bya dgos/22bu snod lug pa'i slong rkyen dang mngon tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ bu snod lug pa ni byis pa btsas rjes ngal gso yag po ma byung ba dang /ngal dub byung yang byis pa btsa' skabs mtshan dbrag ral skyon byung ba/ glo langs pa dang bshang bcir drags pa sogs kyi slong ba yin/ de yang rtags su mkhal rked na ba dang / rgyu zhabs 'then zug rgyag pa/ mtshan ma nas thum rdog cig phyir lug pa/ 'gul bskyod dang 'gro 'dug mi bde ba/ nad gzhi tshabs che ba'i skabs bu snod lug shugs che ba dang / bu snod la brdar zad byung nas rma bshus chag pa sogs kyi mngon tshul yod/23mo nad dug thabs ces pa'i go don ci/lan/ byis pa btsas rjes zas spyod log nas gnyan tshad skyes te dug gi na tshul bzhin ston pa'i nad cig yin/ 'dir rlung tshad bsdongs bas na bsil sman gyis tshad pa gcog pa dang bcud kyis rlung sna glan dgos so/ /302

24btsas rjes khrag ma chod na ci ltar bya dgos sam/lan/ byis pa btsas rjes kyi nyin zhag gcig gi nang khrag mang bo shor ba la/bur chang dang ka ra sbyar ba blud pa dang / rtswa khu byug chang dang sbyar ba btang /yang na nas tshig khu ba tshigs sna lta bu der sbrang rtsi dang dom mkhris mi skra'i gzhob sogs btang nas gcod pa'o/ /25zla mtshan dus kyi nad las zas spyod gtsang spra'i 'phrod bsten la do snang bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ zla mtshan 'bab pa'i skabs su bud med kyi lus stobs cung nyams par gyur yod pas lus kyi nad 'gog nus shugs yang rgyun ldan las zhan par gyur yod/zla mtshan 'bab pa'i skabs su mngal kha phye zhing mngal nang du rma kha yod pa sogs nad 'byung ba'i rten dang ldan pas nad gang yang 'byung sla ba dang / dus der mtshan kha sogs su 'bu phra sna tshogs ldan pas nad rigs gang yang myur du 'byung srid pa ste/btsog pa cung zad kyis kyang nad sna tshogs 'byung nges pas na zla mtshan dus kyi gtsang sprar do snang byed dgos so/ /drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 bsod nams dman pas za ma mo lus thob/ /nu ma mngal dang zla mtshan khyad par lhag /lus zungs phyi ma khu ba dkar dmar gnyis/ /zla mtshan dmar po bcu gnyis lon nas 'dzag /mngal nang khu ba 'dzin zhing sha lus bskyed/ /dkar po nu ma la rgyas gsos su 'gyur/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ sngon kyi las dang nyon mongs 'dod chags kyi dbang gis pho mor snang ba las/ bsod nams las nyon gyi dbang gis za ma mo lus thob pa yin zhing / bud med kyi lus thob pa las nu ma mngal dang zla mtshan bcas kyis khyad par du lhag cing /dwangs ma khrag sha tshil rus rkang khu ba ste lus zungs bdun kyi phyi ma khu ba dkar dmar gnyis kyi cha shas lus kun tu khyab pa las/ bud med la dmar cha'i snyigs ma khrag 303

tu gyur pa zla mtshan dmar por gyur nas zla re bzhin mngal sgor 'dzag pa de yang bu mo lo bcu gnyis ma lon pa'i gong du mi 'dzag pa dang / der zla mtshan tha mal du gnas pa rnams 'khrig pa spyod skabs lus kyi rtsa rnams g.yo bas bsam bse'ur gnas pa'i dwangs ma'i khrag de rlung stobs kyis mngal nang du babs/ pho yi dwangs ma khu ba dkar po de lhan cig tu 'dzin cing phru gu'i sha lus la sogs pa'i lus kyi cha shas rnams bskyed par byed/ bud med kyi khu ba dkar po'i dwangs ma rang gi lus kyi gsos yin pas mi 'bab pa dang snyigs ma 'o mar gyur nas nu ma rgyas te phru gu btsas nas cher ma gyur bar gyi gsos su 'gyur ba'o/ /2 nal bu 'don thabs sman gnyis gsum dang lnga/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ nad bu 'don thabs sman gnyis zhes pa 'om bu sum gnyis/ khron bu sum gcig dang / gsum zhes pa 'ol mo se dwa ba thang phrom dkar po gsum dang / lnga zhes pa rgya tshwa/ rgya skyegs/ ri bong ril ma/ dngul chu/ byang ba'o/ /3 dang po mngal chags zla ba lon pa dang / /pho mo gnyis kyi mtshan ma dod pa'i dus/ /ma dang bu la chags shing zhe sdang skye/ /de dus mtshan ma'i nang du nying lo 'byung //zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ dang po mngal du chags nas zla ba lon pa dang / bzhi ba gor gor mer mer nar nar po de las pho mo ma ning rim par 'gyur zhes pa'i pho mo gnyis kyi mtshan ma dod pa'i dus su mor 'ong rgyu yin na pha la chags shing ma la sdang ba dang phor 'ong rgyu yin na ma la chags pa dang pha la zhe sdang skyes te/ de dus mtshan ma'i nang du nying lo langs zhes bya'o/ /bdun pa/ rkyang 'dems/ mang 'dems/ dag pa ngos 'dzin gyi lan/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 kha 2 ga 3 kha 4nga 5 kha 6 kha 7 kha 8 ka9 kha 10 kha 11 kha 12 nga 13 ka 14nga 15 kha304

16 kha 17 ka 18 kha 19 kha 20 ngaganyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 ka kha ga 2 ka kha ga 3 ka nga 4gakha ga 5 ka kha ga 6 ka khag 7 ka nga 8 ka kha ga 9 ka kha ga 10 ka kha ga 11 ka kha ga12 kha ga nga 13 ka kha ga nga 14ka kha 15 ka kha ga 16 ka khag 17 ka kha ga 18 ka kha ga 19 ka kha ga 20 ka kha ga cabazhi ba/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/ 1 ྾ 2 tre 3 ྾ 4tsu 5 ྾ 6snyo 7tu 8tsu 9 10 ྾ 11 ྾ 12 tsu 13 14྾15du 16tsu 17tsu 18 ྾ 19 ྾ 20sa bcad bdun pa/ gdon nad gso ba/dang po/ rkyang 'dems/1 smyo byed nad la dbye ba/( )ka drug kha bdun/ ga lnga/ nga brgyad/2 'byung gdon nad la bcos ka byed dus/( )ka gdon bcos ang dang po/ kha sman bcos gtso bo/ ga gnyis ka cha mnyam/ nga gang yang ma yin/3 smyo brjed nad du 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni/( )ka mya ngan/ kha gzhi nas snying stobs zhan pa/ ga sems las che ba/ nga rlung 'khrugs pa/4yid 'jug bu ga'i lam nad kyis bkag yod pa bsal bar ( )ka me btsas bsreg kha dugs sman bdug ga sbyor ba rnon pos 305

sbyangs/ nga gtar ga bya/5gza' grib nad kyi nad 'gyur byung ba'i gzhi rtsa'i ngo bo ni/( )ka rlung mkhris ma snyoms pa/ kha rlung ma snyoms pa/ ga khrag rlung ma snyoms pa/ nga mkhris pa 'phel ba/6 gza' nad phog pa'i rtags su 'gal rkyen gtso bo ni/( )ka brda byed/ kha bsam gzhigs/ ga dran shes/ nga mya ngan/7 smyo brjed nad la bcos ka byed dus/( )ka sman bcos ang dang po/ kha gdon bcos gtso bo/ ga de gnyis zung 'brel/ nga gang yang ma yin/8 gza' nad las gzhogs g.yas la phog pa mang ba de/( )ka chu gza'/ kha me gza'/ ga rlung gza'/ nga sa gza'/9 nad pa'i lag mthil gang phog ngos la sen mos mnan rjes sngo thig byung na/( ) ka rlung gza'/ kha me gza'/ ga chu gza'/ nga nam mkha'i gza'/10 gza' nad can kyis bsten pa'i zas ni/( )ka sha chang gi rigs/ kha mar rnying / ga zho dar sogs dkar chos/ nga dmar chos/11 klad pa'i dbang rtsa'i gyes tshul ni/( )ka rkyang ba/ kha bsnol ma/ ga dra rgya/ nga gnyis gshibs/12 lus phyed g.yas pa'i sgul skyod kyi nus pa dang tshor ba shor 'gro na ni/( )ka klad pa'i zlum phyed g.yon par grib skyon thebs pa/ kha klad zlum g.yas par nad phog pa/ ga klad pa'i rgya dar la nad phog pa/ ngaklad pa'i dbang rtsa la nad phog pa/13 mis bsam blo gtong ba dang 'gul skyod byed pa dag ni/( )306

ka klad pa'i dbang shes/ kha klad pa'i rgya dar gyi rlung gi byed las/ga klad snying / nga klad pa'i dbang rtsa/14sems la gnas pa'i nad ni/( )ka smyo byed/ kha smyo byed brjed byed/ ga brjed byed/ ngagaza' nad/15 'byung gdon gso ba'i le'u 'dir rtsa ba'i sa bcad du yod/ ( )ka lnga/ kha drug ga bdun/ nga brgyad/16smyo byed nad 'dir thog mar dpyad bcos bya dgos don/ ( )ka nad kyi rang bzhin rtsub pa'i phyir/ kha nad dug rang bzhin ldan pa'i phyir/ ga yid 'jug bu ga nad kyis bkag sel pa'i phyir/ ngaganyen po gzhan gyi mi thub pa'i phyir/17smyo byed nad la zas gang rigs bsten na phan/ ( )ka bsil drod snyoms pa/ kha dkar zas / ga dmar zas/ ngasnum bcud/18 sems kyi dpyad shes dang mi ldan pa'i rnam par shes pa de la/ ( )ka 'byung gdon/ kha smyo byed/ ga brjed byed/ nga gza'/19gzhogs g.yas la phog nas lce g.yas thung ba dang sog pa g.yas pa dmar thig 'brum pa 'byung ba ni/( )ka chu gza'/ kha sa gza'/ ga me gza'/ nga rlung gza'/20 gza' nad skabs kyi gsang sman ni/ ( )ka rma bya'i khrag kha bya rog gi snying / ga rma bya dang bya rog gi snying khrag nga ri bong gi snying /gnyis pa/ mang 'dems/1 rlung las gyur pa'i smyo byed nad yin na ni/( )307

ka gtam mang ba/ kha ngu 'bros byed pa/ ga zhu ba'i dus su ldang ba/ nga bsil zas la dga' ba/2 smyo byed la bsten pa'i phan zas ni/( )ka lo sha kha mar rnying / ga bu ram/ nga gar chang /3 smyo byed 'byung mi nus pa'am 'gog srung gi thabs ni/( )ka snying stobs che ba/ kha sha chang sogs dmar chos spang ba/ gagatsang spra la gces pa/ nga rim gro zhu ba/4thog ma nyid nas khrag mkhris tshad pa'i bsdongs zla bsal dgos pa ni/( )ka 'byung gdon/ kha smyo byed/ ga mdze nad/ nga brjed byed/5gza' phog rjes slar mi 'bros phyir du/( )ka yug ma'i rkang nam mgo la 'phur ba/ kha dri chu mgor byug pa/ garim gro bca' ba/ nga gang yang ma yin/6mdze nad dpyad kyi bcos par gtar dgos pa ni/( )ka dpral rtsa/ kha smin dbrag ga chu ser gdong rtsa/ nga rgyu rtsa/7klu gdon gyi nad 'di nyid/( )ka thug reg mi bzod pa/ kha mthong pas skyug bro ba/ ga bsam pa'i skyi g.ya'/ nga tshe 'di'i gnyen 'dun dang bral dgos/8 mdze nad lus la zhugs pa'i rtags/ ( )ka gzi mdangs nyams pa/ kha pags pa 'gas la rtsub pa/ ga skra dang smin pa byi ba/ nga snying la zhe sdang skyes/9 spu gsum zhes pa ni/( )ka skra kha smin ma/ ga ba spu/ nga mig spu/10 khur po lci bo zhig glo bur du yar btegs par dang rkyen byas nas gzhogs g.yas 308

bshal rtse kha lkugs pa dang / lhag par rtsa rgyud phra la grims shing sen mor ser thig babs pa bcas ni spyi dang bye brag nad/ ( )yin/ka chu gza'/ kha gza' nad/ ga me gza'/ nga sa gza'/gsum pa/ ming 'grel/'byung bo/ 'byung ba bzhi'i cho 'phrul la dbang 'byor bas na 'byung bo/kyal ka ku re'am rtsed mo'i ming /do sdo/ 'khrugs sems sam gnod la sdang ba'i bsam pa/bla ma/ gza' phur bu la lha'i bla ma zhes des gnod pa'i gdon nad/grum bu/ 'bras bu bum pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba'i yi dwags kyi rigs shig gi ming /byad stems/ gnod pa gtong mkhan la byad pa dang de'i mthu dang nus pa la byad stems/tshal ba gyon/ gos dum bu byas nas gon pa/nya la sred pa/ nya sha la lhag par dga' ba/'bras chan khu ba/ 'bras chang la goyi ga 'chu/ gdon snying la zhugs pas zas za 'dod med pa/dran rkyen/ nor dang chung ma sogs nyams pa de dran pa'i rkyen byas pa la brten nas nad ldang ba/rus shing na/ lus kyi rus sgrom rnams yongs su na ba/tshigs ring / brgyal 'bog byung ba'i bar thag ring ba/dkar khra men/ gzi mig dgu ba la zer/migs pa/ rtsangs pa'am rmigs bu ste bye ma myu gu'o/ /ring bsrel/ mchog gi nor bu ste 'phel gdung /gza' chog gza' dgyes par byed pa'i thabs sam cho ga309

pha wang long bu/ rdo gru bzhi gser mdog can zhigabyad dgrol/ mthu las dgrol bar byed pa/smreng gis dkrol/ bslab bya skul tshig lta bu smra ba/za thang / dbang thang ngam mnga' thang zhes bsgos tshad de la bya'o//gdon/ lus dang srog 'don par byed pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa gdon zhes pa'o//srog rtsa myos byed gsang / nu ma'i rtse nas mchan khung ngos su tshon gzhal ba'i sar/kye hud/ smre ngag gi tshig 'o dod du 'bod pa lta bu/rlon/ skabs 'dir bshal gyi don no//lha min/ nus pa dang mthu lha las zhan pa rgyun du 'thab 'khrug la dga' ba'i lha/bab chol/ bab col ste tshul dang mi mthun pa'am don dang 'gal ba mang du smra ba/khus 'debs/ ki btab nas bos pa'i don de byed las la bltos nas btags pa'i sman mar gyi sbyor ba zhigs gnyan/ sa chu sogs kyi bdag po rang rang la gces shing de la thug reg byung na bzod thabs med pa'o//bshan dmar/ gnyan sar sems can bsad pa'i sha khrag gi dmar ro//tsi ti dzā la/ mdze nad kyi skad dod/snying bo bzhi/ rkang lag mthe bong gi rtsa ba bzhi la sha ro byung ba/chu gsum/ skra dang smin ma ba spu bcas so/ /mir khi/ sog skad ste brgyal gzer gyi ming /zer mo/ bya zer mo dngos/brtul zhugs/ rang gi sems btul ba'i ngang nas bzang bo'i spyod pa la zhugs pa/310

mi chos/ mi'i lugs dang mthun pa'am 'jig rten mi chos ya rabs kyi bya ba/lha chos/ sems can la byams sems kyi sgo nas mi dge bcu spong ba dang dge bcu nyams su blangs pa bcas/bas mtha'/ mtha' 'khob ste zad mtha'/dug lnga/ skabs 'dir 'byung lnga'i gza' las phog pa'i nad lnga la dug lnga zer/ skra smin byi ba/ skra smin sogs dal bus lhung ba/dri za/ lha'i rol mo ba la zer/sha za/ srin po'i bye bragayi dwags/ rtag tu yid la zas btags pas na yi dwags zhes pa'o//g.yeng byed/ shi 'dre'am ro langs kyi bye brag ste gdon 'dis gnod pas rtags su sems rgyud g.yeng ba'o//mtshun lha/ bon chos kyi sgra las byung ba'i dur lha'i ming /bzhi pa/ dag pa ngos 'dzin/1 gza' nad ces pa nad bdag gi ming btags pa'o//( )2 mdze nad ces pa mtshan nyid la bltos nas btags pa'i ming /( )3 smyo brjed ces pa byed las la bltos nas btags pa'i ming ( )4smyo brjed nad la gdon bcos gtso bor 'dzin dgos/( )5brjed byed ni gtso bo brda byed la 'gal rkyen thebs pa/( )6mdze nad kyi gnyen po gtso bo bya khyung lnga ba/( )7gza' nad ni nus pa'i rang bzhin gyi sems khams nad rigs yin/( )8 'byung gdon smyo brjed rnams la me gtar gnyis las snga mas phan/( )9 gdon chen bco brgyad las g.yang byed gdon zhes byed las kyis btags/( )311

10khyad par nad pa'i lag mthil gang phog ngos la sen mos non par mnan rjes sngo ba byung na chu gza' yin par nges so/ / ( )lnga ba/ dri lan 'debs pa/1 gdon nad ces pa'i nges tshig ci/lan/ grib ma 'dre 'dzin ltar blo'i rnam rtog gis yid shes sogs rang gnas su sdod du mi 'jug par gzhan dbang gi gnas su phyir gdon cing 'phrog par byed pa'o//2 gdon nad kyi go don ci/lan/ rnam rtog gtsor byas pa'i phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du mas sems kyi 'byung ba'i khams 'phel zad 'khrugs gsum gyi rnam par gyur nas yid shes sogs rgyun ldan min pa'i na lugs ston pa'o//3 'byung gdon nad kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu rkyen sdig pa mi dge'i las mang spyad/ /grogs med ya nga gcig pur bsdad pa dang / /ya ga can la 'bags gtses brnyas pa dang / /mchod 'os chag dang mya ngan gdungs la sogs/ /mi 'tshams lus ngag 'gal las 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o//4'byung gdon gyis zin pa'i spyi'i rtags sam mtshan nyid gang yin nam/lan/ 'byung bo ste mi ma yin la sogs pa gang zag gi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs nas sngar gyi spyod pa las gzhan du bsgyur ba ni 'byung gdon nad kyis zin pa'i rtags so//5 'byung bo'i gdon chen bco brgyad po ji ltar yin nam/lan/ de yang lha gdon dang / lha min/ dri za/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ tshangs pa/ srin po/ sha za/ yi dwags/ grul bum/ byad stems/ g.yeng byed/ ro langs/mtshun lha/ bla ma/ drang srong / rgan po/ grub pa bcas so//312

6 gdon gyi 'dzin pa'i dus ji ltar yin nam/lan/ lha'i gdon ni zla dang po'i yar ngo tshe bcu gsum dang / lha min gdon ni yar ngo tshe bcu gsum dang mar ngo'i tshe bcu gnyis/ dri za'i gdon ni yar ngo tshe bcu bzhi dang mar ngo tshe bcu gnyis/ klu'i gdon ni yar ngo tshe lnga/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon ni yar ngo tshe bdun nas bcu gcig tshangs pa dang srin po yar ngo tshe brgyad nas bco lnga/ mtshun lha tshe sum cu'am gnam stong dang yar ngo tshe brgyad dgu bcu/rgan po dang grub pa drang srong la sogs pa ni gong gi dus ma yin pa'i dus gzhan no//7 gdon nad gso thabs ci ltar yin nam/lan/ deng rabs ltar bshad na/ brda byed dang / nyams 'gyur/ stangs stabs/ bya spyod sogs la brten nas nad pa'i yid sems la 'gyur ldog gam shugs rkyen thebs su bcug ste nad gzhi gso bcos byed pa zhig la zer/8gdon chen bco brgyad skabs kyi klu gdon dang gdug pa klu'i gdon gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ gdon chen bco brgyad skabs kyi klu gdon ni lha srin sde brgyad kyi nang gses te klu'i gdon yin la/ gdug pa klu'i gdon nad ni chu ser nag por phyi rol gyi gnyan srin bsdongs zla byas nas byung ba'i mdze nad do/ /9 ci zhig la smyo byed zer/lan/ smyo byed ces pa ni zas spyod lam gdon rkyen sogs kyis yid shes kyi lam logs par zhugs nas rnam shes smyo bar 'gyur ba'i nad rigs zhig yin/10smyo nad bcos thabs las thog mar bsku mnye dang lums skyugs khrus dang gtar bas bcos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ rnam shes rgyu gnas te yid 'jug bu ga'i rgyun srang ngam rtsa srubs rnams nad kyis bkag yod pa de bsal ba'i phyir du sbyong byed la brten nas bkru zhing dag par byed pa dang / 'jam rtsub dpyad la brten nas slar mi ldog pa'i phyi rjes gcod dgos zhes pa'o// 11brjed byed nad kyi rang bzhin ci zhig yin nam༈313

lan/ mi'i dran shes la 'gal rkyen thebs pa'i nad de/ dran shes bde bar rgyu ba'i nus pa nyams te sems rmongs par 'gyur ba dang 'du shes 'khrul nas snying stobs dang blo gros zhan par 'gro ba'o/ /12smyo byed dang brjed byed nad kyi rgyu rkyen gyi snga gzhug gi go rim grub tshul ji ltar yin nam/lan/ smyo byed ni sems kyi dran pa lam log tu gyur kyang / rnam shes rmongs pa'i dbang du song la/ grub pa'i lus kyi sems khams su rgyun ldan min par smyo bar byed pa/ brjed byed nad ni rnam shes med par rmongs bag gi mgo bo 'khor te sems kyi dran pa gnas gcig tu mi 'dug par gnas nges med du khyab cing / gtso bo klad skyon thebs pa'i brjed nges che ba yin no//13 gza' nad kyi dbye ba ji ltar yin nam/lan/ gza' nad la dbye ba lnga yod de/ me gza'/ chu gza'/ rlung gza'/sa gza'/ nam mkha'i gza' bcas so//14gza' nad kyi ngo bo ci ltar yin nam/lan/ gza' nad kyi ngo bo ni glo bur du byung ba'i klad skyon gyi nad zhig yin/15 gza' nad bskyed pa'i rgyu rkyen ci ltar yin nam/lan/ zas sha khrag dang chang bcud can zos pa dang / chu shel dang me shel nyi zer sogs kyi 'od glo bur du phog pa/ glo bur du 'gul bskyod byed pa dang shed shugs 'don pa/ lus kyi khrag rlung ma snyoms pa bcas las byung ngo / /16gza' nad la khyad par gyi nad rtags mi 'dra ba 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/lan/ phyi yul gza'i khams mi 'dra ba dang nang lus po'i 'byung khams kyi khyad par las gza' nad bye brag pa'i rtags de 'byung bzhi'i nyes gsum gyi mtshan nyid dang rjes su mthun par na tshul mngon pa'o//17 gza' brgyad kyi khams rnams ci ltar yin/lan/ nyi ma mig dmar me yi khams/ /zla ba lhag pa chu yi khams/ /pa sangs 314

spen pa sa yi khams/ /phur bu sgra gcan rlung gi khams/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /18 gza'i 'dzin dus de dag la nad de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ nyi zla skar ma sogs gza'i rgyu dus dang rgyu phyogs kyi khyad par te rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog las mi'i lus khams spyi dang sgos su klad skyon gyi nad 'byung bar dam zab kyi 'brel ba dang shugs rkyen nges can thebs srid par bstan pa'o//19 ci zhig la klu gdon zer/lan/ klu gdon ni nad bdag gi ming nad la thogs pa zhig dang yongs grags su mdze nad ces nad kyi mtshan nyid la bltos nas btags pa'o//20klu gdon gnas kyi dbye ba bco brgyad po gang yin nam/lan/ zhugs tshul gnas kyis dbye na skyi pags rtsi/ /mdog stobs sha tshil chu ba rtsa dang khrag /chu ser rus tshigs lha ba klad rkang khu/ /don la zhugs pas dbye ba bcu dang brgyad/ /ces pa'o/ /21 klu gdon gyi mdor bsdus bcu gsum la brtag pa de gang dag yin nam/lan/ lus gnad spyi bo dang / ngag gnad mgrin pa/ yid gnad snying gasnying gnad lce/ glo gnad sna/ mchin gnad mig mtsher gnad mchu/ mkhal gnad rna ba/ yan lag gnad tshigs pa/ tshil gnad dreg bzhi dang rkang ba'i mthil dang lag pa'i gru mo/ rus gnad so/ sha gnad mthe bong / chu rgyus gnad mtshan ma ste bcu gsum mo//22 brjed byed kyi nad kyi 'khrul so gang yin nam/lan/ spyi rtags 'byung tshul snying 'dar mgo bo 'thom/ /rngul 'byung sro zhing stobs chung rus shing na/ /kha chu sna chu mang zhing nad langs dus/ /'gyel zhing so 'cha' rkang lag g.yob pa dang / /wu bar skyug cing mun par zhugs snyam pa'i/ /phal cher mir khi'i nad dang 'khrul ba mang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /23 gza' nad phog ma thag tu sad mda' btang na phan yon ci yod dam/lan/ dang po gza' nad phog ma thag tu sad mda' gul dkar mtheb tshig tsam dang / shing mngar spang rgyan cha mnyam khong tu btang bas srog zin 'bros mi srid 315

pas bcos glags yod pa'o//24gza' nad la zas spyod gang dag 'dzem dgos sam/lan/ kha zas chang dang mar rnying sha khrag sogs dmar gyi rigs rnams mig yul du spang bar bya ba dang / spyod lam ni mi gtsang ba dang / grib ma/ me dang nyi ma/thab gzhob/ ku sgra rol mo rnams spang bar bya dgos so/ /25mu tig nyer lngar gsang sman bsnan pa gtong zhes pa'i gsang sman de gang yin nam/lan/ mu tig nyer lnga'i sbyor ba la gsang sman rma bya dang bya rog gi snying khrag sogs bsnan pa'o//26 klu gdon gyi rgyu rkyen gang yin nam/lan/ rgyu ni lus la gnas pa'i chu ser la/ /zhes pa ste mdze nad nye bar len pa'i rgyu ni lus la lhan skyes su yod pa'i rnam par ma gyur pa'i chu ser dang / lhan cig bskyed pa'i rgyu ni lha srin sde brgyad kyi klu gdon yin/ rkyen ni zas spyod dbang gis 'du ba 'khrugs par gyur pas chu ser nag po lus la rgyas pa'o/ /27mdze nad kyi brtag thabs las phyi'i brtag thabs gang dag yod dam/lan/ phyi la mngon tshul rmi lam brtag pa dang / /mtshan nyid lus ngag yid la brtag pa'o/ /rmi lam chu dang shing dang ne'u gseng dang / /sbal lcong nya sbrul 'bu sbrang sdig sdom sogs/ /lus la 'byar dang gseb na 'dug pa dang / /g.yag mdzo gcan gzan rnams kyis ded pa dang / /mi shong sgo 'phrang 'dzul dang g.yang la lhung / /nyi nub sa sros ser ba 'byin pa rmi/ /lhas tshor dus de gdon gyis 'debs pa'i rtags/ /zhes pa'o/ /28mdze nad kyi brtag thabs las nang gi brtag pa dang gsang ba'i brtag pa gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ nang gi brtag la rnam rtog ci 'dra yang / /bzhin nyid me long 'dra ste bkrus la brtag /me tog yod sar chu mi chags par skam/ /skya smug dmar sogs sha mdog 'gyur ba la/ /sha lpags btegs nas mthe bos mnan rjes 'ong / /sna gong 316

mkhur tshos smin dbrag rnams su mang / /me tog skam na dus las 'das zhes bya/ /gsang ba sman gyi sgo nas brtag pa ni/ /mu zi gu gul shu dag gla rtsi bzhi/ /srub ka lo mar mnyam la ras su phur/ /dri chur spangs la zhag gsum skom du btang / /dri chu khrag dang chu ser sna tshogs dang / /rang gi mdog las gnod dang mi gnod brtag /ces pa ltar ro//drug pa/ rgyas 'grel/1 'dzin dus tshes bzhi brgyad dam bcu gcig dang / /bco lnga bco brgyad nyi shu gnyis dang lnga/ /nyi shu dgu dang rgyu dus brgyad la 'dzin/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/'grel/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can gnyis ltos bcos sam ltos grub rang bzhin gyis 'brel ba'i phyir na rang byung khams kyi nyi zla la sogs pa'i rgyu dus dang rgyu phyogs sogs las 'gro ba'i lus spyi dang sgos su klad skyon 'byung bar 'brel ba dam zab yod la/ khyad par tu nag rtsis kyi gzhung sogs su gtan la phab pa'i gza' bcu'i rgyu dus dang rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'dzin dus te/tshes bzhi dang brgyad/ bcu gcig bco lnga/ bco brgyad/ nyi shu gnyis/ nyi shu lnga/nyi shu dgu bcas la mi'i lus khams 'gul bskyod sogs la gnod pa nges par du yod par snang ba ma zad/ tshabs che ba'i nad rtags mngon rgyu yod de/ dper na/ tshes nyi shu dgu la bzung ba'i cha bzhag na/ phog ma thag nas skyugs zhing dbang bo 'khrul ba dang / snying gar chu bcag brgyab kyang mi dngangs pa/ mig 'dzum mi shes pa'i rtags sogs 'byung bas dus 'di dag gi skabs su phyi rol yul gyi 'gyur ldog dang nang sems can gyi lus gyi 'gyur ba gnyis rten 'brel gyi 'brel ba grub pa yin zhes pa'o/ /2 mtshan nyid 'byung po mi ma yin la sogs/ /lus ngag yid la zhugs nas spyod pa sgyur/ /zhes par rgyas 'grel gyis/ 'grel/ mtshan nyid 'byung po mi ma yin la sogs pa ga 'dra zhig gi gzugs 317
